tei:titleStmt.tei:title: grāh/zhes pa grub/phyi ma rnams la dz dang gra gnyis ka'i ra la sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byed/gzhan snga ma bzhin te/dza gṛ ha tuḥ/dza gṛ huḥ/༈dza gṛ hi tha/dza gra hi tha
grāh/zhes pa grub/phyi ma rnams la dz dang gra gnyis ka'i ra la sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byed/gzhan snga ma bzhin te/dza gṛ ha tuḥ/dza gṛ huḥ/༈dza gṛ hi tha/dza gra hi tha

tei:div.tei:p: grāh/ zhes pa grub/ phyi ma rnams la dz dang gra gnyis ka'i ra la sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byed/ gzhan snga ma bzhin te/ dza gṛ ha tuḥ/ dza gṛ huḥ/ ༈dza gṛ hi tha/ dza gra hi tha/ dza gṛ ha thuḥ/ dza gṛ ha/ ༈dza grā ha/ dza gra ha/ dza gṛ ha/ dza gṛ hi ba/ dza gṛ hi ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ 'di la'ang kha cig e sogs sbyor zer/ ༈byeny gnon pa la'o/ /zhes pas byings beny bzhag/ny rjes 'brel/ pha rol tu ṇap/ gnyis brjod ha sa dbyi/ nyer bsgyur saṃ sngon du bzhag/slar yang dag par bsgyur bas bye dang po'i ya e dang bcas pa i ru song ste bi ru gyur/ bye phyi ma la 'phel ba/ ā ya/ saṃ bi byā ya/ zhes pa grub/ saṃ bi byā ya swā dz+nyuṃ naṃ su dz+nyaḥ/ legs par shes pas yang dag par gnon par byed do/ rang gi mi shes pa rnams/ zhes pa'o/ /phyi ma rnams la bye phyi ma yang*/ slar yang dag par bsgyur bas bi ru bsgyur/ bi phyi ma'i i ni ya dbyangs med du bsgyur ba sogs sngar bshad pa rnams kyis rigs 'gre ste/ saṃ bi byā tuḥ/ saṃ bi byuḥ/ saṃ bi byi tha/ saṃ bi yi tha/ saṃ bi bye tha/ saṃ bi bya thuḥ/ saṃ bi bya/ ༈saṃ bi byā ya/ saṃ bi bya ya/ saṃ bi byi ba/ saṃ bi byi ma/ ༈saṃ bi bye/ saṃ bi byā te/ saṃ bi byi re/ ༈saṃ bi byi ṣe/ saṃ bi byi the/ saṃ bi bya dh+we/ ༈saṃ be bye/ saṃ bi byi ba he saṃ bi byi ma he zhes pa rnams so/ ༈ beny thags kyi spun bsgyur ba la'o/ /zhes pas/ be bzhag/ṇap pha rol/ be nyo ba ya na bi/ beny'i ba y ap med pa la'o/ /ap bi kā ra ṇa'i yul ma yin pa'i beny'i byings ni ba yr bsgyur ba ste/ de yang ny rjes 'brel phyis pas/ be kho na ba y'o/ /gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa yal/ ba dang po slar yang dag par bsgyur bas u ste/ u ba ya ྄a zhes pa byung*/ u pa dhā ring*/ drangs/ u bā ya/ phyi ma rnams la ba 'og ma yang ur bsgyur/ 'dra ba ring u ya tuḥ/ ū yuḥ/ ༈ū yi tha/ u ba yi tha/

ū ya thuḥ/ ū ya/ ༈u bā ya u ba ya ū yi ba ū yi ma zhes pa rnams so/ /'di la'ang kha cig ū ye sogs dang dha ḍha sbyor bar 'dod do/ ༈byā dha rdung btags la'o/ /zhes pas byings byā dha/ dha'i dbyangs a yig brjod don/ pha rol tu ṇap bzhag/byings gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa phyis/ bya gyi ya btags slar yang dag par bsgyur bas i ru song bas bi byung*/ u pa dhā ring*/ dh+ra a la drangs/ bi byā dha/ ā tus sogs la bya gnyis kar la saṃ pra sa ra ṇa byed pa shas che ste/ bi bidh zhes 'byung ba blo la bzhag ste/ bi bi dha tuḥ/ bi bi dhuḥ/ ༈bi bi dhi tha/ bi bya dhi tha yang na'o/ /bi bi dha thuḥ/ bi bi dha/ ༈bi byā dha/ bi bi dhi ba/ bi bi dhi ma rnams so/ ༈pra tsh shes par 'dod pa la'o/ /zhes pas byings pra tsh ṇap bzhag/gnyis brjod dang po'i ha sa sogs tsh gong ma dang*/ p thog ma'i ra btags phyis/ tsh phyi ma a la drangs/ pa pra ts+tsha/ pa pra ts+tsha tuḥ/ pa pra ts+tshuḥ/ ༈pa pratsitha tha/ yang na tsh ṣ tha ṭha byings kyi ṣ rnam dbye'i ṭha la drangs/ pa pra ṣ+ṭha/ pa pra ts+tsha thuḥ/ pa pra ts+tsha/ pa pra ts+tsha/༈pa pra ts+tshi ba/ pa pra ts+tshi ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ saṃ yo gān+na ki twa/ rab sbyor mtha' las kit ma yin no/ pa ro ྅ k+ṣa'i rkyen gyi skabs 'dir/ gsal byed rab sbyor gyi mtha' las/ pha rol phyi mar byung ba'i ṇap sogs rkyen bco brgyad ni/ kit kyi tha snyad mi byed te/ sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa yang med 'phel ba dang yon tan gyi rnam 'gyur gang yang mi byed pa'o/ /de'i dper brjod ni bshad ma thag pa'i pra tsh nyid yin te/ pra ni gsal byed rab sbyor yin zhing*/ slar yang dag pa bsgyur ba dang*/ yon tan dang 'phel ba mi byed pa'i tshogs sngar bshad pa yin pas so/ ༈yang parti ka'i lung drangs pa/ mtho mtsham dang yang yang dag gi don la loṭ gyi skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig gi mtha' tshig phrad nyid do/ /zhes 'byung ba'i mtho mtsham pa'i gnod pa ni/

dbang che rngan can gyi don te/ de dang yang yang gi don la/ pa ro3k+ṣa'i rkyen ṇap byin pa ni tshig phrad kyi sgrub pas loṭ te shis byed kyi skyes bu dbus ma'i gcig tshig hi zhes par ā de sha byed te/ de nas gcig tshig de'i mtha' can du 'gyur ro/ /dper brjod ni/ skam dhir 'gro ba dang mya ngan dag la'o/ /lūny gcod pa la'o/ muṣ rkun po la'o/ /hṛny 'phrog pa la'o/ /zhes pa ste byings bzhi po 'di dag la 'jug༈de yang skaṃ dhir ṇap dha'i ir rjes 'brel/ ṇap hi ru bsgyur/ byed pa po la ap'o/ skam dh a hi zhes byung*/ nyer bsgyur a ba sngon du bzhag/hi 'jig/a ba skan+dha zhes pa grub/ ༈lūny ṇap ny rjes 'brel ṇap hi ru bsgyur/ nā bi ka ra ṇa byung*/ na'i dbyangs ā ring po ni ī ring por bsgyur/ lū nī hi/ zhes so/ ༈mu ṣ ṇa pra hi ru bsgyur/ bar rkyen ā na bi kā ra ṇa'o/ ༈ṣ a la drangs/ na ṇa ru song*/ hi 'jigamu ṣā ṇa/ ༈hṛ ṇap hi ru bsgyur/ ap hṛ yi ṛ yig yon tan har drangs hi 'jigaha ra zhes so/ ༈bzhi po de dper brjod kyi ngag ma gha'i snyan ngag gi gzhung las lung drangs pa ni/ pū rī ma ba skan+dha lū nī hi nan+da naṃ/ mu ṣā ṇa rat+nā ni ha rā ma rāṃ ga nāḥ/ bi gṛ h+ya tsa kre ṇa mu tsi dwi ṣā bā shī ya/ it+tha mash+tsā s+tha ya ma harni shaṃ di baḥ/ grong khyer dud mo can dang dga' ba'i tshal rnams gcod/ /rin chen rnams brkus 'chi med yan lag ma rnams phrogs/ /mtho min sdang byed mkha' nyin dang mtshan mor ni/ /dbang gi gnod pa 'di 'dra byed de ngal gso med/ /ces pa lta bu ste/ tshig rkang dang po'i a ba skan+dha dud mo can dang*/ lū nī hi gcod par byed pa dang*/ tshig rkang gnyis pa'i mu ṣā ṇa rku bar byed pa dang*/ ha ra 'phrog par byed ces pa rnams so/ /de yang lha min mang pos lha'i grong khyer zhig la rngan can du spyod pa yang yang byas pa'i don la/

tshigs bcad gcig gis dbang che'i gnod pa dang*/ yang yang gi don gnyis kar ston pa'i dper brjod do/ /de dag ni gtso bor 'das dus yun ring po lon pa'i don la 'jug cing*/ gzhan yang don sna tshogs pa la 'jug par 'gyur ba liṭ'i rkyen nam pa ro3k+ṣa ste lkog gyur rkyain ṇap la sogs pa'i sde tshan gyi bya ba rags pa tsam brjod pa'o// ༈ //ā shi ṣi/ smon par byed pa la'o/ /yāt yā stāṃ/ yā sus/ ༈yās/ yā staṃ/ yāsta/ ༈yā saṃ/ yā swa/ yāsma/ ༈sī ṣ+ta/ sī yastāṃ sī ran/ ༈sīṣ+ṭhās/ sī yās+thaṃ/ sī dh+waṃ/ ༈sāṃ ya/ sī ba hi/ sī ma hi/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈de ltar na smon pa'i don gyi yāt sogs bco brgyad po la'ang yāt nas yāsma'i bar dgu ni pa ra smai dang*/ ༈sīṣ+tanas sī ma he'i bar dgu ni āt+ma ne yin te/ /sde tshan skabs 'dir pa ra smai dgu la kit kyi ming dang*/ ༈āt+ma ne dgu la pit kyi tha snyad btags shing*/ ༈'grel par lung drangs pa na/ ā shir+yā dā de paṃ ki ti di bak+ta byaṃ/ zhes 'byung ste/ de bod skad du bsgyur na/ smon pa brjod pa la yāt sogs paṃ kit do/ /zhes bshad do/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈yāt sogs phyi ma'i skabs 'dir/ paṃ gyi ming can gyi rkyen ni pa ra smai dgu ste/ de dag kit dngos min yang de dag la kit kyi brda chang sbyor ro zhes pa'o/ /smon pa'i sde tshan 'di la yang ling gi tha snyad sbyor bar mdzad de/ byings phyed pa sde tshan drug las 'di ni gnyis pa'o/ ༈de la pa ra smai'i dbang du byas te/ bhū zhes pa la yāt sogs dgu sbyor na/ byings la rkyen sbyar ba kho na las gzhan rnam 'gyur chen po med de/ bhū yāt/ bhū ya stāṃ/ bhū yā suḥ/ ༈bhū yāḥ/ bhū yā staṃ/ bhū yā sta/ ༈bhū yā saṃ bhū yā swa/ 'di sgrubs ma zin par s dang ba brtsegs pa tsam yin/ yās ba zhes s dang ba sgra ma 'dres par klog pa'i brda la ba yig yongs rdzogs 'bri/

bsgrubs grub mtshams su so ba zhes sgra 'dres par klogade'i brda la wa zur 'bri'o/ /de nas bhū yāsma/ zhes pa ste/ yā sus dang*/ yās kyi mtha' brtan s yig dbyangs med rnam bcad do/ /saḥshrī mān bhū yāta/ de dpal dang ldan par gyur zhig༈dzī ba srog 'dzin pa la'o/ /dzī ba'i ba yig gi a ni brjod don no/ ༈dzīb yāt ces pa bzhagab dbyangs med yāt kyi yā la drangs/ dzī byāta/ de kho na ltar/ dzī byā stāṃ/ dzī byā suḥ/ ༈dzī byāḥ dzī byā staṃ dzī byāsta/ ༈dzī byā saṃ/ dzī byā swa/ dzī byāsma/ zhes pa'o/ /dper brjod pa/ sha taṃ sha ra de dzī byā t+bha ban/ khyod ston brgya 'tsho bar shogaces pa'o/ ༈ba ts smra ba la'o/ /ba ts/ yāt ces pa bzhagangit la saṃ pra sa ra ṇa byed de/ ba ts'i ba dbyangs bcas u ru bsgyur/ yā la ts drangs/ uts+yāt/ de bzhin du/ u ts+yā stāṃ u ts+yā suḥ/ ༈ /u ts+yāḥ/ u ts+yā staṃ u ts+yāsta/ ༈u ts+yā saṃ u ts+ya swa u ts+yasma/ ༈ /dā de re/ dā sogs kyi e'o/ /byings dā sogs la smon pa'i rkyen gyi pa ra smai byin na byings mtha'i ā yig ni e yig tu 'gyur te/ de yang ḍudā ny byin pa la'o/ /dā yāt dā sogs kyi e'o/ /zhes pas dā'i dbyangs e ru song*/ de yāt de yā stāṃ de yā suḥ/ ༈de yāḥ/ de yā staṃ/ de yā sta/ ༈de yā saṃ de yā swa de yāsma/ zhes so/ ༈ḍu dhāny 'dzin pa la'o/ /dhā yāt 'di dag dā sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs kyi dper brjod de/ de yang dā sogs kyi e/ dhe yāt dhe yāstāṃ dhe yā suḥ/ ༈dhe yāḥ/ dheyā staṃ dhe yāsta/ ༈dhe yā saṃdhe yā swadhe yāsma/ ༈pā btung ba la'o/ /pā yāt/ dā sogs kyi e/ pe yāt/ pe yā stāṃ/ pe yā suḥ/ ༈pe yāḥ/ pe yāstaṃ pe yāsta/ ༈pe yā saṃ/ pe ya swa/ pe yasma/ ༈gai sgra la'o/ /gai yāt mtshams sbyor yi ge'i ā'o/ /zhes pas ga'i dbyangs mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ai de ā zhes par bsgyur/

gā yāt byung*/ dā sogs la e ā zhes pa e ge yāt ge yā stāṃge yā suḥ/ ༈ge yāḥ/ ge yāstaṃ ge yā sta/ ༈ge yā saṃ/ ge yā swa/ ge yāsma/ ༈ṣ+ṭhā 'gro ba 'gog pa la'o/ /ṣ+ṭhā yāt dang po'i ṣa ṇa sa na zhes pas byings kyi thog ma'i ṣa yig sa yig tu bsgyur khyad par 'gyur bas khyad par can yang 'gyur/ ṭha yang tha ru song*/ s+thā yāt dā sogs la e/ s+theyāt s+the yā stāṃ s+the yā suḥ/ ༈s+the yāḥ/ s+the yā staṃ/ s+the yāsta/ ༈s+the yā saṃ s+the yā swa s+the yā sma/ ༈mā mchod pa la'o/ /zhes pa pa ra smai ba ti dang*/ māng mchod pa la'o zhes pa āt+ma ne pa ti yin pa'i dbang du byed mod/ ng yig rjes 'brel dbyi bar byas pas/ mā zhes pa la khyad med pas/ u bha ya ba ti ra byed de/ mā yā t dā sogs e/ me yāt/ me yāstāṃ/ me yā suḥ/ ༈me yāḥ/ me yāstaṃ/ me yāsta/ ༈me yā saṃ/ me yā swa/ me yāsma/ zhes par smai rkyen dgu dang sbyar ba'o/ ༈sīṣ+ta sogs la byings mtha' a yig tu mi 'gyur te/ mā sīṣ+ta/ mā sā+-i yā s+t+rāṃ/ māsīran/ ༈māsīṣ+ṭhāḥ/ mā sī yā s+thāṃ/ mā sī dh+waṃ/ ༈mā si ya/ mā sī ba hi/ mā sī ma hi/ zhes pa āt+ma ne rnams dang sbyar ba'o/ ༈ohāk gtong ba la'o/ hā yāt dā sogs kyi e he yāt/ he yā stāṃ he yā suḥ/ ༈he yāḥ/ he yā staṃ/ he yāsta/ ༈ he yā saṃ/ he yā swa/ he yang sma/ ༈sho phra mor byed pa la'o/ /sho yāt mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge la ā'o/ sh o zhes pa de sh ā zhes par song*/ dā sogs la e sha e ru song*/ drangs nyer bsgyur a bsngon du bzhagash yig s yig tu song*/ a ba se yāt/ zhes pa byung*/ ṣo mtha'i las rnams la'o/ /'dir mtha'i las ni khang pa rtsig pa la sogs pa ring du thogs pa rnams kyi mthar gang gi nyin mo grub par byas ba de'i las kyi ming ngo*/ ༈ṣo yāt mtshams sbyor yi ge ā/ ṣā yāt/ dā sogs kyi e ṣe/ ṣa sa nar 'gro/ se a ba sngon du bzhaga.a ba se yāt ces 'byung sho dang ṣo byings don mi 'dra yang cho ga gcig pas gzugs gcig par byung*/

de bzhin du rigs bsgres te/ ab se yāstāṃ/ a ba se yā suḥ/ ༈a ba se yāḥ/ a ba se yā staṃ/ a ba se yā sta/ ༈a ba se yā saṃ/ a ba se yā swa/ a ba se yāsma/ zhes pa'o/ /de dag gis dā sogs kyi sgrub tshul bshad zin to/ ༈yā dā dau/ /yāt la sogs pa la'o/ /smon pa'i don gyi rkyen yāt la sogs pa'i skabs 'dir byings ṛ yig mtha' can gyi pha rol tu/ yāt sogs ya yig dang po can gyi rnam dbye pa ra smai dgu po dag byung na/ byings mtha'i ṛ yig ni ring zhes par bsgyur pa'o/ /ḍu kṛny byed pa la'o/ /zhes pas byings kṛ rnam dbye yāt kṛ'i ṛ yig ring zhes par ā de sha byas/ ng rjes 'brel/ k ri yāt drangs kri yā t/ de bzhin du/ kri yās+t+rāṃ/ kri yā suḥ/ ༈ kri yāḥ/ kri yā staṃ/ kṛ yā sta/ ༈ kri yā saṃ/ kri yā swa/ kri yāsma/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈āt+ma ne la 'di ltar/ uḥ/ ṛ gyi'o/ /uḥzhes pa ṛ gyi zhes par ji ltar 'gyur snyam na/ 'di mtshar che ste/ ṛ yig la ngas byin/ ngasi ngas dag gi a u'o/ /ṛ us zhes pa byung ste/ ṛ gyi zhes pa yin/ u de ḍit yin te rnam dbye rnams ā de shas gzugs bsgyur ba la ḍitra zer bas so/ /ḍit la ṭi dbye ste/ 'dir gsal byed kyi yi ge med pas ṛ yig rang nyid ṭi yin pas ṛ dbyi'o/ /u'i s rnam bcad/ des na ngas kyi rnam 'gyur u yig de la ṛ yig gi nus pa yod pas/ ngas zhes pa drug sgra gcig pu ma yin no/ /ṛ nus med par drug sgra gcig po yin na*/ u la mi sdod par ngas su ldog 'gro dgos pa las/ 'dir ma ldog par u yig tu sdod pa ni/ ṛ bag la zha ba yod pa'i rtags yin pas/ ṛ gyi zhes pa 'byung ba yin no/ /gzhung sgra sgrub thams cad dkyus la 'brir mi lang yang*/ 'di'i rigs ya mtshan pas blo gros 'phel ba'i dgos pas bkod do/ ༈ /de yang byings mtha' ri yig gi pha rol tu rnam dbye'i rkyen/

su dang sī yod pa la iṭ med pa yin na yon tan tu mi 'gyur bas 'dir a niṭ te it med kyi rkyen sī ring po yin pas yon tan med de/ kṛ sīṣ+ta ku i la sogs s ṣ ru 'gro kṛṣī ṣ+ta de bzhin du/ kri ṣī yāsrāṃ kṛ ṣīr n/ ༈kṛ ṣī ṣ+ṣāḥ/ kṛ ṣī ya s+thāṃ/ nā mi las dha ḍha/ kṛ ṣī ḍhaṃ/ ༈kri ṣī ya/ kṛ ṣī ba hi/ kṛ ṣī ma hi/ bud+dha ste maṅga la dṛ ṣīṣ+ta/ sangs rgyas kyis khyod bkra shis par mdzod cigate maṃ ga laṃ ni las kṛṣīṣ+ta bya tshig bud+dhaḥbyed pa po'o/ ༈ tsiny gsog pa la'o/ /tsi yāt bzhagaya la'o zhes pa byings mtha' ring por song*/ tsī yāt/ de bzhin du/ tsī yāt/ de bzhin du/ tsi yā stāṃ tsī yā suḥ/ ༈tsī yāḥ/ tsi yā staṃ/ tsi yā sta/ ༈tsī yā saṃ/ tsi yā sba/ tsī yasma/ pa ra smi'o/ ༈ āt+ma ne 'di rnams ā shiṣa yin kyang*/ yā yig gi rkyen min pas ring po mi byed/ sī yin kyang byings mtha' ṛ yig ma yin pas yon tan byed de/ tse ṣīṣ+ta/ tseṣī ya stāṃ/ tse ṣī ran/ ༈tseṣīṣ+ṭhaḥ/ tseṣī yās+thāṃ/ tse ṣī dh+waṃ/ ༈tse ṣī ya/ tse ṣī ba hi/ tseṣī ma hi zhes pa'o/ ༈ṣ+tu bstod pa la'o/ /ṣ+tu yāt dang po'i ṣa ṇa sogs ṣ s ru song*/ des ṭa yang ta ru song*/ ya la'o/ /ring po'o/ /stu yāt/ stū yā staṃ/ stū yā suḥ/ ༈stū yāḥ/ stu yā staṃ stū yāsta/ ༈stu yā saṃ/ stu yāswa/ stuyā sma/ ༈sīṣ+ta sogs la yon tan te/ sto ṣīṣ+ta stoṣī yās+t+waṃ sto ṣī ran/ ༈sto ṣīṣ+ṭheḥ stoṣī yās+thaṃ/ stoṣīḍhaṃ/ ༈stoṣī ya/ sto ṣī ba hi sto ṣī ma hi/ zhes so// ༈ /shwa sta ne/ nang bar la'o/ /tā tā rau/ tā ras༈tā si/ tī s+thas/ tā s+tha*༈ ༈tāsmi/ tā sbas/ tā smas/ ༈tā tā rau tā ras/ ༈tā si/ tā sā the/ tā dhe*༈tā he tāsba he/ tāsma he'o/ 'di rnams la gzhung gzhan du luṭ ces zer ro/ /de ma 'ongs pa'i dus las sang nyin lta bu la tā sogs rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jugader ma zad ltos sa ltos 'jog la brten nas lo shas tshun la 'jug pa yin/

ma 'ongs pa shin du dus thag ring ba la mi 'jugadaper na bod skad la yang*/ sang zhes pa sang nyin la gtso bor 'jug kyang*/ sang phod sogs sang gnangs skabs cig ces dus nges med lo shas la 'jug pa'ang yod kyi/ shin du rang dus thag ring ba la mi 'jug pa bzhin no/ /si sa tā sī s+ya pā miṭ/ si sa tā sī s+yap rnams la iṭ'o/ /de la si ni sde tshan la kār bcu par 'byung bar 'gyur/ sa ni gong du bshad pa'i 'dod pa'i rkyen no/ /tā ni bshad ma thag pa 'di ste/ 'dir bco brgyad po kun la thog mar tā yig go sī ni ā shi ṣa'i bdag don gyi rkyen/ sīṣ+ta la sogs pa sī dgu'o/ /s+yap ni myur du 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bha biṣ+ya ti la sogs par 'byung ste/ 'di rnams la iṭ ā ga ma rkyen du 'byung ste de yang byings la mi ster rnam dbye la ster ba yin mod/ rnam dbye'i tha mar mi ster thog mar ster ro/ /bhū yod pa la'o/ /bhū tā zhes pa bzhaga.iṭ ṭ rjes 'brel bhū yon tan bho o ab drangs/ bha bi tā/ bha bi sgrub tshul nges na/ gzhan rnam 'gyur tsam med de/ bha bi tā rau/ /bha bi tā ra s/ ༈bha bi tā si/ bha bi tas+thaḥ/ bha bi tā s+tha༈ bha bi tā smi bha bi tasbaḥ/ bha bi ta smaḥ/ shwo bha bi tā rā dz+yabhāraḥku mā ra s+ya/ gzhon nu nang par rgyal srid la 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /shwo bha bi tā bya ba rgyal srid la 'jog byed po/ ku mā ra ni bya byed kyi 'brel pa'i tshig go nai ga swa rā nu dāt+tā/ dbyangs gcig pa'i a nu dāt+ta las ma yin no/ /'di ni tā sogs la iṭ 'jug par bshad pa'i dmigs gsal te iṭ 'gog pa'o/ /de yang byings dbyangs gcig pa yang yin/ a nu dāt+ta te skad gsangs dma' bar klog pa'ang yin pa de la iṭ mi 'jug pa ste/ tā la sogs pa nang bar gyi rkyen rnam dbye rnams pha rol tu yod pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /dbyangs gcig pa zhes pa'i don byings gang la dbyangs rkyang pa'am/

dbyangs la gsal byed mtha' rten tu 'byar ba'am/ gsal byed dbyangs zhugs pa mtha' brten med pa dang*/ de la mtha' brten yod kyang rung ste/ dbyangs kyi yi ge gcig las med pa'o/ /de la'ang ā yig ring po dang*/ ū yig ring po dang*/ ṝ yig gi mtha' spangs pa ste/ it mtha' dang*/ īt mtha' dang*/ ut mtha' dang*/ ṛt mtha' can rnams so/ /de la'ang rags par na grags che ba'i dbang du byas na/ i yig mtha' can las/ shwi dang shrī gnyis/ ī yig mtha' can las ḍī dang shrī gnyis/ u yig mtha' can las/ ru snuk+ṣ+ṇu nu k+ṣu yu ste drugaṛt mtha' can las bṛng dang bṛny gnyis te bcu gnyis po dbyangs gcig pa yin yang a nu dāt+ta min pas iṭ bcas so/ /i ī u ṛ mtha' can byings gzhan rnams iṭ med shas che'o/ ༈yang bhū yod pa la'o/ /bhū thob pa la'o/ /zhes sogs bhū'i tshogs pa rnams dang*/ lū ny gcod pa la'o/ /pūny dag pa la'o/ /bh+runy skyong pa la'o/ /tūd pe ṣut srog chags mngal nas grol ba la'o/ /ṣūny 'byin pa la'o/ /de dag la sogs pa ū ring mtha' can dang*/ kṝ 'phangs pa la'o/ /tṝ mchong pa dang rkyal ba la'o/ /nṝn pe/ bṝ skyong ba dang 'gengs pa la'o/ /dṝ rnam par 'jog pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyi ṝt mtha' rnams iṭ bcas yin/ lhag ma iṭ med yin zhes gtso che ba'i dbang las so/ ༈ des skabs 'dir bhū nas dṛ bar spangs pa'i ā ū ṝ'i mtha' dang*/ shwi sogs bcu gnyis spangs pa'i i ī u ṛ'i mtha' can dbyangs gcig pa'i byings rnams bzung bar bya'o/ /ḍu patsaṣ 'tshed pa la'o/ /ḍu dang ṣ phyis/ /pa ts tā bzhag/tsu'i ku'o/ ts k ru song*/ pak+tā/ pak+tā rau/ pak+tāraḥ/ ༈pat+kā se/ pak+tā the/ pak+tā dh+we/ ༈pak+tā seha pak+tā sba he pak+tāsma he/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ḍudāny sby-in pa la'o/ / dā tā/ dā tā rau/ /dā tāraḥ/ sogs bco brgyad thams cad do/ ༈pā btung ba la'o/

/ pā tā/ pā tā rau/ /pā tā raḥl sogs pa dang po dgu'o/ ༈tsiny gsog pa la'o/ /tsi tā thams cad la byings kyi yon tan te/ tsi zhes pa tse zhes par 'gro /tse tā/ tse tā rau/ tse tā raḥ/ zhes sogs bco brgyad do/ ༈ṇīny thob pa la'o/ ṇī tā/ byings kyi dang po'i ṣ yig s dang ṇ yig n ru bsgyur dgos pas nī tā yon tan gyi phyir ne tā/ de bzhin du/ ne tā rau/ ne tā raḥsogs bco brgyad do/ ༈hu sbyin pa dang mchod pa la'o/ /hu hātā yon tan no/ /ho tā/ ho tā rau/ ho tā raḥsogs pa dgu'o/ ༈gaml̥ 'gro ba la'o/ ༈ /ḍu kṛny kṛ tā/ yon tan no/ /kartā/ kartā ra/ kartā raḥl sogs pa'o/ ༈ /hṛny hṛ tā yon tan no/ /ha dhā/ ha dha rau/ ha rtā rau/ ha rtā raḥl sogs pa bco brgyad do/ ༈yā thob pa la'o/ /yā tā/ yā tā rau/ yā tā raḥl sogs pa dgu'o/ ༈ /gaml̥ 'gro ba la'o/ /gam tā bzhag/m nga ro/ gaṃ tā/ gaṃ tā rau/ gaṃ tā raḥsogs dgu'o/ /de dag ni nang bar gyi rkyen shāstana'o// ༈ /da ni bha bi ṣ+ya ti bshad par bya'o/ /t+yā dau bha bi ṣ+ya ti s+yap/ 'byung 'gyur la ti sogs la s+yap'o/ /rgya skad bha bi ṣ+ya ti/ zhes pa bod skad du/ 'byung 'gyur te spyir ma 'ongs pa dang khyad par dus ring po'i ma 'ongs pa'i don la rnam dbye tip sogs bco brgyad 'jug pa la bar du rkyen s+yap kho na thams cad du 'jug go /'di la klus bkod du l̥ṭ ces ming btags so/ ༈bhū tip gong du s+yap p rjes 'brel/ iṭ ster ba de rnam dbye la ster ba yin mod/ 'on kyang s+ya kyi gong du bzhagabhū i s+ya ti zhes pa byung bhū yon tan bho o ab bha b b i la drangs sa ṣa bha bi ṣ+ya ti/ ༈bhū bha bi dang s+ya ṣ+ya gzhan 'dra ste/ bha biṣ+ya taḥ/ bha bi ṣ+yan+ti/ ༈ bha bi ṣ+ya si/ bha bi ṣ+ya thaḥ/ bha bi ṣ+ya tha/ ༈ bha bi ṣ+ya mi/ bha bi ṣ+yā baḥ/ bha bi ṣ+yā maḥ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ yadz lha mchod pa la'o/

/de la'ang iṭ med/ snga mas rigs 'gre ste/ yadz s+ya ti tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs dz ṣa ru song*/ yaṣ s+ya ti/ ṣa ḍhoḥkaḥse/ ṣa ḍha dag gi sa la ka'o/ /byings kyi mtha'i ṣ yig ḍha yig dbyangs bral ni/ rnam dbye sa yig thog ma can gyi sa yig mthong ba las ṣa 'am ḍha yig k yig tu 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ste/ sa yig yin no cog ga la yin/ bha bi ṣ+ya ti 'byung 'gyur gyi rkyen bco brgyad po kho na'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /yak s+ya ti ku i la s+ya ṣ+ya k ṣ+ya la drangs/ yak+ṣ+ya ti grub bo/ ༈de bzhin du/ yak+ṣa ces pa kun la 'grub par byas te/ yak+ṣ+ya taḥ/ yak+ṣ+ya taḥ/ yak+ṣ+yan+ti ces pa la sogs pa dgu'o/ /hanṛ tathas+yap/ han dang ṛt rnams la s+yap kyi'o/ /l̥r ra btags yin/ṭa'i skabs 'dir byings han dang rit mtha' can dang*/ gaml̥ rnams la s+yap yod na iṭ ster dgos ta s+yap kyi'o/ /zhes s+yap yod na de'i sngon du cig cig dgos so zhes pa yin pa las/ su zhig ce na iṭ dgos so/ /han s+ya ti zhes 'bri aṭ ṭ phyis n i la drangs ku i la ha niṣ+ya ti/ gzhan yang ha niṣ+ya taḥ/ ha ni ṣ+ya n+ti la sogs pa dgu'o/ ༈kṛ tip s+yap sngon iṭ ṛ ar drangs ku i la ka ri ṣ+ya ti la sogs pa bco brgyad do/ ༈gam ti s+ya iṭ drangs ku i la ga mi ṣ+ya ti la sogs pa dgu'o/ ¿༈bs 'dug gnas la'o/ /bs ti s+ya sa sto3n pi/ ap med pa las ni ta'o/ /ap kyi yul ma yin pa bha biṣ+ya ti'i skabs 'dir byings mtha'i s yig ni t yig tu 'gyur te/ pha rol rkyen sa yig mthong ba la yin na/ 'dir kun la s+ya sbyor bas sa yig kho na'o/ /bs s+ya ti zhes pa las s yig t yig tu bsgyur/ drangs ba tes+ya ti de bzhin du/ bta s+ya taḥ/ btas+yan+ti zhes sogs dgu'o/ ༈ /daha thal bar byed pa la'o/ /ha'i dbyangs a phyis/ daha s+ya ti/ dā sogs kyi gha'o zhes pasah gh dang po'i dzab sogs/ da dha ru song*/

kha sa la tsa pa sogs gha k ru song*/ ku i la k ṣa 'dus pa k+ṣa dha k+ṣ+ya ti/ grub/ dha k+ṣ+ya taḥ/ dhak+ṣ+yan+ti la sogs pa dgu'o/ ༈ /du ha rab tu 'gongs pa la'o/ /a phyis༈ du ha s+ya ti/ h gh/ d dh/ dhu dhu gh s+ya ti u pa dhā la ghoḥ/ u pa dha thung ngu dag la'o/ /l̥r ra btags yin ṭa'i skabs 'dir byings kyi u pa dha thung ngu la yon tan 'byung bas/ 'dir dhu zhes pa'i u yig ni u pa dhā thung ngu yin pas yon tan dho zhes so/ /ku i la k ṣa k+ṣa/ dho k+ṣ+ya ti/ dhok+ṣ+ya taḥ dho k+ṣ+yan+ti la sogs pa dgu'o/ ༈bhi dir rnam par 'joms pa la'o/ /r rjes 'brel i brjod don bhid s+ya ti u pa dhā thung ngu la yon tan te/ bhe dza pa tsa par 'gro bas d t ru song*/ bhetas+ya ti/ bhetas+ya taḥ/ bhe tas+ya n+ti sogs dang*/ bhetas+ya te/ bhetas+ye te sogs bco brgyad do/ ༈tshi dir gnyis su byed pa la'o/ /i dang r dbyi tshi d s+yati yon tan d t ru song tshetas+ya ti/ tshetas+ya taḥ/ tshe tas+ya n+ti zhes sogs bco brgyad do/ /'di la yang na tsha gnyis/ dang po ts drangs pas ts+tsho ru song bar byed/ yang na byings rang dus na/ ts+tshi dir du 'dod/ yang na tsha rkyang du byed de gsum po gdam ka'o/ ༈tuṣa dga' ba la'o/ /ṣa'i a yal/ tuṣ tir+p+ya s+ya/ ṣaḍha dag gi sa la ka'o/ ṣ k yon tan/ kṣa k+ṣa/ toṣ+ya ti/ de sogs par sme dgu'o/ ༈tud gdung ba la'o/ /tud s+ya ti yon tan/ d t te tas+ya ti de sogs dang po dgu'o/ ༈āt+ma ne'i tshig can gyi dper brjod ni/ e dha 'phel ba la'o/ /a phyis e dh te s+ya iṭ e dh i s+yata drangs ku i la e dhi ṣ+ya te de bzhin du/ e dhi ṣ+ye te e dhi ṣ+yan+te/ ༈e dhi ṣ+ya se e dhi ṣ+ye the e dhi ṣ+ya dh+we/ ༈e dhi ṣ+ye/ e dhi ṣ+yeb he e dhi ṣ+yā ma he'o/ ༈ shīng nyal ba la'o/ /shīng te s+ya pra d dang p yal/ shīng la thams cad du yon tan no/ /zhes pas she si sa tā si s+yap rnams la iṭ'o/

zhes pas iṭ ster she i s+ya te byung*/ e ay drangs/ ku i la/ sha yi ṣ+ya te/ de bzhin du/ sha yi ṣ+ye te sha yi ṣ+yan+te/ ༈sha yi ṣ+ya se sha yi ṣ+ye the sha yi ṣ+ya dh+we༈ sha yi ṣ+ye sha yi ṣ+yā ba he sha yi ṣ+yā ma he zhes so/ ༈o hāk gtong ba la'o/ hā tip s+ya p rnam 'gyur med hā s+ya ti la sogs pa dgu'o/ ༈ḍudāny sby-in pa la'o/ /dā tip s+yap rnam 'gyur med/ dā s+ya ti la sogs pa dgu dang*/ dā s+ya te la sogs dgu'o/ ༈ṣ+tu bstod pa la'o/ /ṣ+tu tip s+yap dang po'i ṣa ṇa sogs ṣa s ṭ t drangs stu s+yati yon tan/ ku i la/ sto ṣ+ya ti sogs dang*/ sto ṣ+ya te sogs bco brgyad do/ ༈ṣuny sbed bsnan la'o/ ṣuny s+ya ti ny song*/ ṣ s ru song yon tan/ s+ya ṣ+ya ru 'gyur so ṣ+ya ti sogs dang*/ soṣ+ya te sogs so/ ༈ཾ /bhu dza skyong ba dang za ba la'o/ a dbyi bhu dz s+ya ti tsu yi ku'o/ dzg ru song*/ g k ru song*/ yon tan no/ /ku i la k ṣ k+ṣa bhok+ṣ+ya ti/ de bzhin du/ bhok+ṣ+ya taḥ/ bhok+ṣ+yan+ti/ ༈bhok+ṣ+ya si/ bhok+ṣ+ya thāḥ/ bho k+ṣ+ya tha/ ༈bhok+ṣ+ya mi/ bhok+ṣ+ya baḥ bhok+ṣ+yā maḥ/ ༈bhok+ṣ+yā te/ bho k+ṣ+yā+e te/ bhok+ṣ+yan+te/ ༈bhok+ṣ+yase/ bhok+ṣ+ye the/ bhok+ṣ+yadh+we/ ༈bhok+ṣ+ye/ bhok+ṣ+ya ba he/ bhok+ṣ+ya ma he zhes pa rnams so/ /de ltar bha'i ṣ+ya ti'i rkyen 'di rnams la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam 'gyur rnams byings kho na la 'byung ba yin/ byings mtha' mi 'dra ba mang po yod kyang*/ s+ya rang dang rnam 'gyur ṣ+ya gang yin kyang rung ste/ s+ya a thung mtha' can yin pas/ te dang ti sogs kyi bar gyi rnam 'gyur phran tshegs rnams bha ba dang e dha ap bi ka ra ṇa'i skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /ka lā par s+ya dang lhan cig pa'i ti sogs zhes s+ya ti s+ya tas sogs/ s+ya rnam dbye nyid du byas/ 'dir bar rkyen du mdzad mod don gcig go /l̥r ra btags yin ṭ bha bi ṣ+ya ti'i bya ba mdo tsam bstan zin to//

༈ /da ni sde tshan dgu pa bya ba shor ba'am rjes kyi rim pa bshad de/ s+yap kri yā ti kra me/ bya ba lus pa la s+yap'o/ /'dir kri yā ti kra ma/ zhes pa ni/ lo tsā ba shong dpangs sogs kyis bya ba shor bar bsgyur/ /de ni dus la ma 'khel ba'am rgyu tshogs ma 'dzom pas don ma grub pa'i ming yin la/ yang 'dir 'grel par kri yā ti k ma'i don/ /a niṣ+bat+ta la bshad pas phyis 'phro la 'jug gam mi 'jug kyang rung ste/ da lta bya ba ma rdzogs par 'phro lus pa'i don yin/ der ma zad bya ba zin ma thag pa'i grub pa gsar pa la yang 'jug par bshad do/ /de lta bu'i don la dip sogs rnam dbye'i rkyen bco brgyad 'jug rkyen gyi ngo bo deng min dang 'dra yang 'dir thog mar s+yap sbyar bas/ byings dang de dag tshogs pa'i rnam 'gyur la mi 'dra ba yod do/ /'di la pā ṇi ni pa rnams l̥ng zhes tha snyad byed do/ /bhū dip zhes pa bzhag/s+yap iṭ dip sogs la aṭ ces gong du aṭ a bhū is+ya dip zhes byung*/ rkyen gyi p dang i mi snang*/ bhū yon tan/ o ab abhab is+yad byung b i la drangs ku i la sogs d t ru bsgyur/ abha bi ṣ+yat/ zhes pa grub/ ngag tu bkod pa'i dper brjod ni/ yā dā su bṛṣ+tiḥsu rā dz+yaṃ tsā bha biṣ+ya ta/ ta dā su bhi k+ṣa ma bha bi ṣ+yut/ gang dag tu char babs shing rgyal po bde bar gyur pa/ de dag tu slong mo bzang po thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ste/ char babs rgyal po bde ba ni grub pa gsar ba'i dpe dang*/ slong mo thob par 'gyur ces bsams pa ni/ da lta thob ma zin pas bya ba ma rdzogs pa'i dpe'o/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ a bha biṣ+ya tāṃ a bha biṣ+yaṃ/ ༈a bha bi ṣ+yaḥ/ ༈a bha bi ṣ+ya taṃ/ a bha bi ṣ+ya ta/ ༈a bha biṣ+yaṃ a bha bi ṣ+yā ba a bha bi ṣ+ya ma/ ༈bhu dza skyong ba la'o/ /bhudz s+ya dip tsu'i ku dz g ru song*/ kha sa la tsa pa sogs g k ru song*/

aṭ bzhagaku i la sogs sa ṣa ru song*/ k ṣ 'dus pa k+ṣa a bhok+ṣ+yat/ des mtshon a bho k+ṣ+ya tāṃ a bhok+ṣ+yan/ ༈ a bhok+ṣaḥ/ a bho k+ṣ+ya taṃ/ abhok+ṣ+ya ta/ ༈a bhok+ṣ+yaṃ a bhok+ṣ+ya ba/ a bhok+ṣ+yā ma/ zhes pa dang*/ a bhok+ṣ+ya ta a bhok+ṣ+ye tāṃ a bhok+ṣ+yan+ta/ aṃ ta a ta ru bsgyur na/ a bhok+ṣ+ya ta/ ༈a bhok+ṣ+ya thāḥ/ a bhok+ṣ+ya thāṃ/ a bhok+ṣ+ya dh+waṃ/ ༈abhok+ṣ+ye a bhok+ṣ+ya ba hi a bhok+ṣ+yā ma hi'o/ zhes pa'o/ ༈gaml̥ 'gro ba la'o/ /gam dip s+yap iṭ aṭ a gam a s+yad zhes pa byung*/ /m i la drangs ku i la a ga mi ṣ+yat/ de bzhin du/ a ga m-iṣ+ya tāṃ/ a ga mi ṣ+ya n la sogs pa dgu'o/ /a bhok+ṣ+ya d+bha bān+ya d+ya ga mi ṣ+yat/ gang khyod ni zas la 'ongs so/ /'ongs pa ni bya ba zin pa yin/ zas ni da lta ma thob pas bya ba lus pa'o/ ༈ḍu pa tsa ṣa 'tshed pa la'o/ /pats dipa s+yap sngon du aṭ ts k ru bsgyur/ s ṣa k ṣ k+ṣa a pa k+ṣ+yat de bzhin du/ a pak+ṣ+ya taṃ sogs dang*/ a pak+ṣ+ya ta la sogs pa bco brgyad do/ /dz+wa la 'bar ba la'o/ /adz+wal is+ya dip gong du nyer bsgyur pra bzhag/'dra ring prā dz+wa li ṣ+yat ces pa grub/ de bzhin du/ a dz+wa li ṣ+ya taṃ la sogs pa dgu'o/ /a pak+ṣ+yad+bha bār+ya d+ya g+niḥprā dz+wa li ṣ+yat/ khyod kyis tshos shig gang du me rab du 'bar bar ro/ /zhes pa ste/ 'bar ba ni grub pa dang*/ tshos shig ni ma grub pa'o/ ༈/han 'tsho ba la'o/ /han e han is+ya dang*/ sngar bzhin sgrubs/ a ha ni ṣ+ya t la sogs pa dgu'o/ ༈ /shakl̥ nus pa la'o/ /shakl̥ l̥ rjes 'brel dip s+yap aṭ a shak s+ya d byung*/ sngar bzhin sgrubs pas a shak+ṣ+ya ta a shak+ṣ+ya taṃ la sogs pa dgu'o/ /a ha ni ṣ+ya d+bha bān+ya d+ya sha k+ṣ+yat/ khyod rang nus pa ji tsam pas choms shig/nus pa ni sngar yod nyid dang*/ 'joms pa ni sngar ma zin pas da lta 'phro can bya ba'o/ /de dag gis ni kri yā ti kra ma'i rkyen gyi bya ba'am/ l̥r ra btags yin nga gi cho ga rags pa tsam bshad zin to/

/ ༈ //da ni rgya skad du bhū ta ste bod skad du 'das pa'am sngon byung ba'am byung zin zhes bya ste/ 'grel par 'das pa tsam zhes 'byung bas 'das pa thams cad la 'jug par gsal la/ gtso bor 'das nas dus yun ring lon pa'i don la/ dip sogs bco brgyad 'jug tshul bshad par bya'o/ /bhū te si/ byung zin pa la si'o/ /byings gang la sngon byung ba'i don la/ di p sogs kyi sngon du si rkyen du ster/ si dang lhan cig pa'i dip sogs la/ 'dir byung ba'i rnam dbye zhes bya/ pra kri ya'i gzhung la lung zhes grags so/ /de ltar rkyen si zhes pa las i ni brjod don te rkyen ni s dbyangs med kho na'o/ /rnam dbye'i ngo bo dip sogs yin pa'i di p sogs la aṭ'o/ /zhes aṭ sngon du 'jog go ༈bhū dip p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don/ bar du si thog mar aṭ a bhū sd zhes pa byung*/ dā de pe/ dā sogs kyi pa la'o/ /pā zhes pa par smai rkyen gyi ming yin/ /byings dā sogs zhes pa ni/ dā dhā s+thā iṇ bhū pā zhes pa rnams la pha rol du dip sogs pa ra smai rnam dbye dgu po byung na/ bar gyi si ni dbyi bar bya'o/ /'di rnams la iṭ dang yon tan dang 'phel ba rnams mi 'byung ngo*/ /des na 'dir yang s yig dbyangs med yal te/ d dbyangs med t ru song*/ a bhūt/ pha rol tu pṛṣ+ti bzhag na t slar yang dra drangs abhūd+pṛṣ+tiḥ/ sngon char ba babs pa'i don no/ ༈de bzhin du/ a bhū tāṃ/ ji skad du/ bhū la si dbyi ste dbyangs la buk'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ 'di rnams nang nas dbyangs kyi rkyen an dang a mip la buk rkyen du ster te/ s mi snang ba'i shul du buk ster/ de yang byings bhū la yin gyi gzhan la ma yin no/ /buk gi k rjes 'brel/ u brjod don rkyen p kho na'o/ /bhu an si phyis buk aṭa/ a bhub an byung drangs a bhū ban/

༈a bhūḥ/ a bhū tāṃ a bhū ta/ a mip la buk/ a bhū baṃ a bhū ba/ a bhū ma zhes so/ /༈ḍudāta ྄ dā dib si ds da/ sa dbyi aṭ a dāt ༈a dā tāṃ/ ༈s+ya ba daḥ/ ā dang bid kyi si la'o/ /byings ā ring mtha' can dang byings bid la/ /byung pa'i don gyi rnam dbye pha rol na yod pa'i bar du si phyis pa'i rjes la rnam dbye an yin na an ces pa de us zhes par 'gyur ro/ /u s+yā lo paḥ/ us kyi ā dbyi'o/ /an gyi rnam 'gyur us zhes pa de byung na/ byings mtha'i ā ring po dbyi bar 'gyur ro/ /dās a na.aṭ syal an us/ dā yi ā ring po phyis u la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ a duḥ/ ༈a dāḥ/ a dā taṃ/ a dā ta/ ༈a dāṃ a dā ba a dāṃ ma pa ra smai rnams so/ ༈dā tan n yal si aṭ/ a dā sat byung*/ dā dbyangs/ ā ring po i ru song*/ di ku i la/ ṣ t ṭ ru song*/ drangs a diṣ+ta grub/ ༈a di ṣā tāṃ/ ༈aṃ ta a tar bsgyur/ a di ṣa ta/ ༈s ṣ ru song na/ thā ṭhā ru 'gro/ a di ṣ+ṭhaḥ a di ṣā thāṃ/ dha la s phyis/ a di dh+waṃ༈ a di ṣi/ a di ṣ+wa hi/ a di ṣ+ma hi/ zhes pa ste at+ma ne'o/ 'on kyang kha cig pa ra smai kho nar 'dod do/ ༈ḍudhāny dhā la yang des 'gre ste/ a dhā t/ a dhā taṃ/ an us/ us la/ ā ya la/ a dhuḥ/ ༈adhāḥ adhā tāṃ/ a dhā ta༈ a dh+waṃ/ a dhā ba/ a dhā ma/ ༈de bzhin du āt+ma ne sbyor na/ i dhaṣ+ti la sogs pa dā'i sa skabs kyis shes so/ ༈ṣ+ṭhā 'gro ba 'gog pa la'o/ /ṣ+ṭhā dip si/ dang po'i ṣa ṇa sogs s+thā ru bsgyur aṭ as+thā sd ces so/ /s mi snang*/ d ta/ as+thāt/ a s+thā tāṃ/ as+thuḥ/ ༈as+thāḥ/ as+thā taṃ/ a s+thā ta/ as+thaṃ/ as+thā ba as+thā ma/ ༈iṇ bgrod pa la'o/ /iṇ dip si ji skad du/ iṇ gyi si dbyi ba la gā'o/ /zhes 'byung bas si phyis pa'i rjes su iṇ zhes pa gā zhes par 'gro /aṭ a gā t/ a gā tāṃ/

a guḥ/ ༈a gāḥ/ a gā taṃ/ a gā ta/ ༈a gāṃ/ a gā ba/ a gā ma/ zhes so/ /'di yang u bha ya pa ti'i dbang du byas na/ tan sogs sbyor bar 'dod pa ltar/ a re mā gāḥsā dh+wa saṃ mā gāṃ garbi ta man+ti raṃ/ /kye 'jigs sar ma 'gro khang bzang dbyen par ma 'gro shigaces pa'o/ ༈pā btung ba la'o/ /pā dip si phyis aṭ a bāt/ zhes sogs si phyis/ iṇ gā ru bsgyur ba sogs 'dra'o/ 'das pa'i don gyi rkyen rnams āt+ma ne pa ti byings la sbyor na/ ghaṭ rtsed mo la'o/ /ghaṭ tan bzhagan khyad don si aṭ/ meṭaḥ/ mā las aṭ'o/ dgag pa'i don gyi mā zhes pa sngon du bzhag na/ aṭ mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /s gong du iṭ mā ghaṭ is ta zhes pa byung drangs/ s ṣ/ ta ṭa ṣ ṭa la drangs/ mā gha ṭiṣ+te/ ༈dbyangs la ṣ 'dren/ mā gha ṭi ṣā tāṃ/ mā gha ṭi ṣa ta/ ༈mā gha ṭi ṣ+wa ta/ ༈mā gha ṭiṣ+ṭhāḥ/ mā gha ṭiṣā thāṃ/ dhe tsa se rlo bo/ dha la'ang si dbyi'o/ /lung rnam dbye'i skabs 'dir spyir btang āt+ma ne'i rkyen si dbyi ba min kyang*/ dmigs gsal dha'i rkyen la si dbyi'o/ /mā gha ṭi dh+waṃ/ ༈mā gha ṭi ṣi/ mā gha ṭi ṣ+wa hi/ mā gha ṭi ma hi/ zhes pa rnams so/ /'grel bar sma sbyar ba la yang aṭ dbyi bar 'dod do/ /zhes bshad de/ bhū dip si yal aṭ a bhūt sma gong du bzhag na/ aṭ mi snang*/ sma bhūt byung zin to/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈yang lung drangs pa ji skad du/ 'jug bzhin pa'i don la sma sbyar bas byung ba'i don nyid do/ /zhes bshad pas/ dper na/ smṛ tiḥ.āhasma hā rī tāḥ/ dran pa bshad do ljang sngo'i bu/ zhes so/ /ya dza ti sma yu dheṣ+ṭhi ra/ g.yul ngor brtan pas lha la mchod do/ ༈ṇit+pe/ pa la ṇit'o/ /pa zhes pa ni/ pa ra smai rnam dbye ste de la si ster zhing*/ si des byings la 'phel ba skyed pa'i skabs der/ ṇit kyi tha snyad si de la 'dogs te/ 'phel ba byed do bar shes pa'i phyir yin no/

/de yang bar rkyen si thams cad lam yin mod kyang*/ ṛ mtha' can thams cad la sogs pa mang po la'o/ /seḥ/ si la'o/ /si'i pha rol du dip dang sip yod na īṭ āg ma ster dgos te de yang gong du ster/ sngon du nyer sgyur yang 'jog pa yin no/ ༈dper brjod ni/ ḍukṛny kṛ la dip si aṭ akṛs t byung*/ s deṇi t zhes bya bas kṛ'i ri ār du 'phel bar bya/ dip la īṭ ring po sngon du sbyar/ ak/ ārs īd ces pa byung*/ nyer sgyur āng ng rjes 'grel mtshungs 'dra k ā la drangs/ s ṣa ṣ ī dang r ṣa'i steng du sbyar/ ā kār+ṣī t kun du byed do/ /༈nyer sgyur ā bir sbyar na/ ā bir ak/ ārs īt s ṣ so sor drangs ā bir kāsar+ṣīt/ ༈nyer sgyur nir dang sbyar na nir ak ārs īt ni ra kār+ṣīt/ swa dz+nyā naṃ yo gī ni ra kār+ṣīt rang gi ye shes rnal 'byor rnam par grol ba sgom mo/ ༈de bzhin du kṛsip si īṭ aṭ 'phel ba ak ārs īs ku i la so sor drangs s rnam bcad/ a kār+ṣīḥ/ ༈gzhan rnams la īṭ mi 'jug/kṛtāṃ si 'phel ba aṭ ak ārstāṃ sa ṣ/ tā ṭā/ r drangs a kār+ṣaṭā/ ༈ an us gzhan 'dra a kār+ṣūḥ/ ༈ de bzhin du/ a kāraṃṣaṭa/ a kāraṃṣaṭa/ ༈ a kār+ṣaṃ/ a kār+ṣ+ma/ a kār+ṣ+ma ces so/ ༈ hṛny hṛ di p si īṭa/ a ṭ 'phel ba a h ā rs īd ces so/ /nyer sgyur pa ri sngon du'o/ /s ṣa r drangs i y par+ya hār+ṣī t/ yongs su dga' ba'am/ dga' ba'i rnam grangs so/ /de bzhin du/ par+ya hā raṃṣ+ta/ par+ya hār+ṣuḥ/ ༈par+ya hār+ṣīḥ/ par+ya hāraṃṣ+ta/ par+ya hār+ṣā/ par+ya hār+ṣaṃ/ par+ya haraṣ+wa/ par+ya hārma/ ༈iṭaḥ.īṭi/ iṭ dang īṭ la'o/ thog mar iṭ thung ngu dang pha rol du īṭ ring po yod pa'i bar gyi si dbyi'o/ /gzhung don ni/ sngon bzhin īṭ ring po gzhan pa'i rjes su iṭ thung ngu'ang dgos iṭ gnyis kyi bar du si yal lo zhes pa'i don no/

༈bad gsal po smra ba la'o/ /bd dip si aṭ dip la iṭ s la iṭ ba la 'phel ba'o/ /a bād is īd ces pa byung*༈ i gnyis bar gyi s dbyi/ 'dra ba ring po so sor drangs a bā dīt/ de bzhin sip la īṭ ring po dgos/ gzhan rnams iṭ thung ngu gcig pos choga.a bā dish+tāṃ/ a pā diṣuḥ/ ༈a bā dīḥ/ a bā diṣ+taṃ/ a bā diṣ+ta/ ༈a bā di ṣaṃ/ pādi ṣ+wa/ a dā dish+ma/ ༈badz rku ba la'o/ /bradz dza'i a dbyi dip bzhag si aṭ dipl īṭ s la iṭ 'phel ba nyer sgyur pra aprādz.is.ī ta s mi snang 'dra ring*/ so sor drangs prā brādzīt/ sip la sgrub lugs de dang 'dra/ gzhan la īṭ ring po med aṣ prā brā dziṣ+tāṃ/ prā brādzīṣuḥ/ ༈prā brā dzīḥ/ prā brā dziṣ+tāṃ/ prā brā dzi ṣ+ta/ ༈prā brā dzi ṣaṃ/ prā brā dzi ṣ+wa/ prā brā dziṣ+ma/ ༈lung drangs pa ha ma ya'i mtha' dang*/ k+ṣaṇa shwas dzā gṛ has la sogs la 'phel ba bor ba'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ de rnams kṛ sogs kyi sde yin kyang 'phel ba mi byed te/ de yang h mtha' can dang*/ m mtha' can dang*/ y mtha' can dang*/ k+ṣaṇa shwas dzā gṛ ha s la sogs pa'o/ /yang i ṭo gra haṃ/ grah rnams la iṭ'o/ /zhes pa dpe 'ga' zhig las gzhung 'di mdo yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ 'grel pa yang byas 'ga' zhig las lung 'dren du byas nas 'grel pa med/ dpe la la na lar gyis mi 'dug mod/ don la de ltar kha 'gengs dgos so/ /de'i don ni iṭ thung ngu ring por bsgyur pa'i don yin mod/ gra h sogs kho na la yin gyi/ h mtha' can ha sa'i bar kun la ma yin no/ ༈dper brjod grah dip si aṭ īṭ 'di h mtha' yin 'phel ba med/ gzhan 'dra a gra hī t/ gra h tāṃ/ si aṭ iṭ 'phel ba med/ agrah s i tāṃ yod/ iṭ thung ngu īṭ ring por bsgyur s ṣ tā ṭā so sor drangs agra hīṣ+tāṃ/ a gra hī ṣuḥ/

༈dip dang 'dra/ a gra hīḥ a gra hāṣ+taṃ/ a gra hī ṣ+ta/ ༈a gra hī ṣaṃ/ a gra hī ṣ+wa/ a gra hī ṣ+ma/ /dpe 'ga' zhig las mdo 'di mi 'don pas/ 'phel ba spangs pa kho na las dip sip slangs pa'i bdun po la hi thung ngu yin zer te gdam khar bya'o/ ༈ṣa ha yid dga' ba la'o/ /ṣah dip si iṭ īṭ aṭ ṣa sa ru song*/ si'i s dbyi d t drangs a sa hīt/ ༈sip la yang de dang 'dra/ a sa hīḥ/ ༈gzhan rnams la īṭ ring po med/ tha rnams ṭha ru 'gyur/ an us/ ba dang ma ṣ+wa dang ṣ+mar 'gyur pa rnams ma rjed par bya'o/ ༈a sa hiṣ+taṃ sogs pa ra smai dang*/ ༈a sa hi ṣ+ta sogs āt+ma ne rnams so/ ༈/sham dm nye bar zhi ba la'o/ /sham dip si iṭ īṭ aṭ sha sa ru song*/ as mīṭ/ ī ṭ med/ a sa miṣ+tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈dm dip si iṭ īṭ aṭ ang mīt/ īṭ med/ a dmiṣ+tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈day bgrod pa la'o/ day dips iṭ īṭ aṭ ad yīt/ snga ma rnams kyis 'gre/ a da yiṣ+tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /k+ṣiṇa 'tshe ba rnams la'o/ /k+ṣi ṇ dip ak+ṣi ṇī t/ ak+ṣi ṇī ṣ+tāṃ/ ak+ṣi ṇi ṣuḥ ak+ṣi ṇīḥl sogs pa'o/ ༈ /shwas prā ṇa dha ra ṇe/ shwas srog 'dzin pa la'o/ /a shwa sīt/ a shwa siṣ+tāṃ༈ a shwa si ṣuḥl sogs pa'o/ ༈ dzāgṛ gnyid sangs pa la'o/ /dzāgṛ dip si iṭ īṭ aṭa/ a dzā gṛ is īd gṛ'i srog yon tan ar du song*/ g ar drangs a dzā ga rī t/ de bzhin du/ a dzā ga ri ṣ+tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈ha se rgod pa la'o/ ha se e rjes 'brel/ dip aha sīt/ a ha siṣ+tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ /a gi la gi ma thi ba gi ma gi swa gi ri gil ghi 'gro ba la'o/ /byings mtha'i i yig rnams brjod don no/ /byings brgyad po de gcig gis rigs 'gre /la gi i brjod don lag sa dip si iṭ ī ṭ si yal/ a la gī t/ a la giṣ+tāṃ/ a la gi ṣuḥ/ a la gīḥl sogs pa'o/

༈lo po hra swā t dzha si/ thung ngu las dzha sa la dbyi'o/ /byung ba'i don gyi rnam dbye lung gi skabs 'dir/ byings gsal byed mtha' dang*/ dbyangs ring mtha' ma yin par dbyangs thung gi mtha' yin na/ rnam dbye dzha sa pha rol la bar du byung ba'i si ni dbyi'o/ /dzha sa ma yin pa dbyangs dang mthar gnas dang ha dang sde pa lnga'i lnga pa rnams la ma yin zhing*/ 'di la iṭ med s mi dbyi ba rnams la ku i la ṣ ru bsgyur/ dbyangs la ṣ yig 'dren no/ ༈ḍukṛny kṛta bzhagasi thung ngu dang*/ pha rol dzha sa la si dbyi aṭ/ a kṛ ta/ a kṛ ṣā tāṃ/ aṃ ta/ a ta ru bsgyur/ akṛ ṣata/ ༈akṛ thaḥ/ akṛ ṣā thaṃ/ nā mi la dha ḍha/ a kṛ ḍaṃhwa/ ༈a kṛ ṣi/ akṛ ṣ+wa hi/ akṛṣ+ma hi/ byings 'di āt+ma ne tshig can yin pas/ pa ra smai rkyen rnams mi 'jug go /༈ḍudāny/ dā ta si aṭ dā sogs i'o/ adis ta dā ring po di thung ngur song*/ thung ngu las dzha sa la dbyi'o/ /ta ni dzha sa yin/ s dbyi a di ta/ a diṣā tāṃ/ i di ṣa ta/ ༈a di thāḥ/ a di ṣā thāṃ/ a di dh+waṃ/ ༈a di ṣi/ i di ṣ+wa hi/ a diṣ+ma hi/ ༈ḍu dhāny/ dhāta/ si dā sogs yin pas/ ā te/ dhi/ dzha sa la dbyi/ a dhi ta/ a dhi ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈ing kha ton byed pa'o/ /ng nyid rjes 'brel/ nga'i dbyangs a yal/ i ngo bā gī sau/ ing si la gi yang na'o/ /byings ing ni lung gyi rnam dbye'i skabs 'dir/ bar rkyen si dang 'dus pa las/ ing nyid gī zhes par ā de sh byed do/ /'di la nyer bsgyur sngon du bzhag dgos/ ing tan n dbyi si aṭ/ a dh+ri sngon du bzhaga.a dhi/ a ghi st byung*/ ku i la sṣ ta ṭa ru song*/ mtshams sbyar/ drangs/ a dh+ya gīṣ+ta/ a dh+ya gī ṣā tāṃ/ a dh+ya gī ṣ+ta/ ༈a dh+ya gīṣ+ṭhaṃḥ a dh+ya gī ṣā thāṃ/ a dh+ya gī dh+waṃ/ ༈a dh+ya gī ṣi/ a dh+ya gī ṣ+wa hi/ adh+ya gīṣ+ma hi/ yang na'o zhes pas/

id a brjod don/ ng rjes 'brel tan bzhag aṭ byings dbyangs dang po can la aṭ lhag po gong du bzhaga.a i la e e ai la ai nyer bsgyur a dhi sngon du bzhagasṣ ta ṭa a dh+yaiṣ+ta a dh+yaiṣā tāṃ a dh+yaiṣ+ta༈ a dh+yaiṣ+ṭhaḥ a dh+yaiṣā thāṃ/ a dh+yaiḍhaṃ/ ༈a dh+yai ṣi/ a dh+yai ṣ+wa hi/ a dh+yaiṣ+ma hi/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ru sgra la'o/ /ru dip si iṭ īṭ aṭ ru 'phel/ o āb si yal/ 'dra ba ring*/ a rā bīt/ a rā biṣ+taṃl sogs pa'o/ ༈ḍupatsaṣ/ pa ts tan/ dzha sāt/ dzha sa las so/ /pa ts sogs la lung gi skabs 'dir rnam dbye dzha sa pha rol du byung na si dbye ste/ gzhan āt+ma ne si dbyi ba min kyang*/ pats sogs la dzha sa pha rol du yod na yin te/ dbyangs pha rol la ma yin no/ /pats ta si aṭ tsk ru song*/ a pak+ta/ a pak+ṣā tāṃ/ a pak+ṣa ta/ ༈a pak+thāḥ a pak+ṣā thāṃ/ a pak+ṣa dh+waṃ/ ༈a pak+ṣi/ a pak+ṣ+wa hi/ a bak+ṣ+ma hi/ ༈pa ra smai la byings kyi u pa dhā la 'phel ba ste ā ring po'o/ /dip dang sip la īṭ ring po 'juga.a pāk+ṣīt/ a pāk+ṣatāṃ/ a pāk+ṣuḥ/ ༈a pāk+ṣīḥ/ a pāk+taṃ/ a pak+ta/ ༈a pāk+ṣaṃ/ a pāk+ṣ+wa/ a pāk+ṣ+ma/ ༈prats+tshi shes par 'dod pa la'o/ /pratsh dip si īṭ iṭ aṭ/ u pa dhā ring po'am byings kyi 'phel zhes bya/ si mi snang*/ 'dra ring*/ a prāts+tshit/ yang iṭ thung ngu med par/ a prātsh s īd byung*/ tsh ṣ/ ṣ k/ s ṣ/ a prāk+ṣīt/ 'di tsh dbyangs med kyis s mthong ba'i nus pa yin/ snga ma dbyangs dang phrad pa'i nus pa'o/ ༈an us dang sip la īṭ ster ba dang*/ a mip rnams la tsh yig de si mthong bas ṣ de/ k/ s kho rang ṣa/ kṣ k+ṣ ru 'gro de dbyangs la 'dren/ tāṃ taṃ ta rnams la si dbyi/ tsh ṣ/ ta ṭa aprāṣ+tāṃ/ a prāk+ṣuḥ/ ༈a prāk+ṣīḥ/ yang na a prā tshīḥ/ a prāṣ+taṃ āprāṣ+ta/ ༈a prāk+ṣaṃ/ a praṣ+t+wa/ a prāṣ+ma/ ༈dzha sa'i pha rol min na si mi dbyi ste/

edha 'phel ba la'o/ /edh ra si iṭ aṭ/ a edha/ iṭa sta/ ku i la ta ṭa/ ai dhiṣ+ta/ ai dhi ṣā tāṃ/ ai dhi ṣa ta/ ai dhiṣ+tāḥ/ ai dhi ṣā thāṃ/ dha la si dbyi e dhi dh+waṃ/ ༈a dhi ṣi/ ai dhi ṣ+wa hi/ ai dhiṣ+ma hi/ ༈shīng nyal ba'o/ /shīng tan ng n yal/ si iṭ yon tan aṭ/ e ay/ s ṣ/ taṭa/ a sha yiṣ+ta/ a sha yi ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa sngar bzhin te/ dha la si dbyi'o/ ༈ru dhir sgrib pa la'o/ /i ri to bā/ ir la yang na'o/ /ru dhir la sogs pa ir rjes 'brel can gyi byings la ng yig rkyen du 'gyur te/ yang na ma yin no/ /de yang 'das pa'i don gyi dip sogs pha rol na yod na yin la/ 'di la si rkyen mi 'jug go ng khyad don a bzhagaru dh dip ng aṭ/ aru dha/ ang byung drangs d t/ a ru dhat/ rnam dbye a thung la byings mtha' sbyar ba'i rkyen gyi a yal nas rnam dbye dbyangs dang sbyor/ ba ma la ring po sogs byings thams cad pa'i a thung mtha' can dang 'dra/ byings dngos gsal byed dha'i mtha' can yin yang*/ bar rkyen ng'i a bcug pas a thung mtha' can du song ba'i rgyu las so/ a ru dha tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈a ni ṭo nā mi ba taḥ/ iṭ med pa'i nā mi las 'phel ba'o/ /lung gi skabs 'dir byings iṭ med la si ster zhing*/ pha rol si yod na byings kyi dbyangs dang po 'phel ba byed do/ /bshad ma thag pa ru dh+ra la yang na ng rkyen yod/ de la si spangs yang na si 'ong*/ de la ng rkyen spangs zhes pa las/ 'dir phyi ma ste si ster dgos kyang dzha sa pha rol 'phel ba byas ma thag si dbyi bar bya la/ byings kyi dh ta ru bsgyur/ rnam dbye ta dang tha dhar 'gro ba las 'dir ta yin/ byings mtha'i ta ni dha la d ru 'gro/ an us dang*/ dip sipl īṭ ring po ste/ ༈de yang ru dh dip si īṭ aṭ 'phel ba/ a rau dhr īd dh ta drangs/ d t/

a raut+sī t/ ༈ru dh tāṃ si aṭ 'phel ba/ a rau dh s tāṃ byung dzha sa'i bar du s phyis/ dh t/ ta tha dag gi dha'o zhes rnam dbye taṃ dh+waṃ du song*/ byings mtha' t d ru bsgyur/ a rau d+dh+waṃ/ ༈de bzhin du/ a rau t+suḥ/ ༈a rau t+sīḥ/ a rau dh+waṃ/ a rau d+dha/ ༈a rau t+saṃ/ a rau t+s+wa/ a raut+sam/ zhes pa'o/ ༈tshi dir ir rjes 'brel/ tshid dip nga aṭ a tshid ad byung*/ a tshi dad/ a tshid tāṃ la sogs pa te byings a thung mtha' can gyi bya ba'o/ ༈yang na tshid dip si īṭ aṭ a tshid s īd byings la 'phel ba dang*/ d t/ a ts+tshai sīd/ byings mtha' d yig yin/ rnam dbye ta yod na dzha sa'i bar yin pas si dbyi/ sip dzha sa yin yang sngon du īṭ 'jug pas si dbyi ba mi rung*/ dbyangs*/ ོga ma gzhan dang wa ma la lta ci smos/ a tshid s īd byings la 'phel ba dang d t/ a ts+tshai sīd/ byings mtha' d yig yin/ rnam dbye ta yod na dzha sa'i bar yin pas si dbyi/ sip dzha sa yin yang sngon du īṭ 'jug bapas si dbyi ba mi rung*/ dbyangs thog ma gzhan dang wa ma la lta ci smos a tshait+taṃ/ a tshait+suḥ༈ a tshai sīḥzhes sogs ats+tshait+s/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ ༈dibu rtsed mo la'o/ dib dip si iṭ ī w aṭ a dip is īd byings la yon tan es yal/ 'dra ring*/ a de bīt/ a de biṣ+tāṃ a de bi ṣuḥ/ a de bīḥ/ la sogs pa'o/ ༈sibu bsnyen par byed pa la'o/ /si bu u brjod don/ sib dip si iṭ īṭ aṭ u pa dhā la yon tan/ a seb īd ces so/ /s dbyi 'dra ring*/ a se bīt/ ༈īṭ ring po med/ s ṣ/ ta ṭa/ a se biṣ+tāṃ/ ༈a se biṣ+saḥnas a se biṣ+wa/ a se biṣ+ma/ zhes so/ /'di 'dra'i byings 'ga' zhig la mi rtag par mi smra'o/ /zhes 'grel par gsung pa ni iṭ rtag tu 'jug ces pa yin/ kha cig tu iṭ mi 'jug na res 'ga' 'jug kyang iṭ rtag pa min

pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ ༈dṛ shir mthong ba la'o/ /i r rjes 'brel dṛ sh dip da rkyen u pa dhā yon tan aṭ ad ar sh ad ces byung a dar+sha t/ adar+sha tāṃ/ adar+sha n la sogs pa'o/ ༈yang na sgrub tshul gzhan te/ rā re dzha sidṛ shāṃ/ dṛ sha rnams kyi dzha sa la ar ra'o/ ༈lung gi skabs 'dir dṛ sh la sogs pa byings mang po rnams kyi pha rol du rnam dbye dzha sa byung na/ byings kyi yon tan a r ni ra dbyangs bcas su 'gyur ro/ ༈dṛsh dip si īṭ aṭ/ u pa dhā yon tan/ a d a r sh s īd ces pa'o/ /ar ra/ sh ṣ/ ṣ k/ s ṣ/ byings kyi d ra la drangs/ u ba dhā ring po k ṣ k+ṣa/ ī la drangs a drā k+ṣīt/ ༈thog ma a dra grub par byed/ tāṃ īṭ med/ si phyis sh ṣ/ ta ṭa/ a drāṣ+tāṃ༈ an us s mi 'phyid/ sh ṣ/ k sṣ/ a drāk+ṣuḥ/ ༈a drwa k+ṣīḥ/ a drāṣ+taṃ/ adrā ṣ+ta/ ༈adrā k+ṣaṃ/ adrā k+ṣ+wa/ a drā k+ṣ+ma zhes so/ ༈spṛ sh reg pa la'o/ /spṛ sh dip si īṭ aṭ/ a spṛsh s īd bkod/ spṛ gyi ṛ yon tan ar ni ra dbyangs bcas su song*/ u pa dhā ring*/ shṣ/ ṣ k/ si s ṣ/ a spra ra/ kṣ īd ces byung drangs pas a sprāk+ṣit/ ༈spṛsh tāṃ/ si aṭ/ a spṛshs tāṃ dzha sa'i bar gyi s dbyi/ yon tan/ ra u ba dhā ring*/ sh ṣ/ ta ṭa/ asprāṣ+tāṃ/ ༈an us/ si mi dbyi/ ī med/ sh ṣ/ ṣ k/ si ṣa/ asprāk+ṣuḥ/ sip dip 'dra rung*/ a sprā k+ṣīḥsogs/ a sprāk+ṣ+ma zhes pa'i bar ro/ ༈mṛdzuṣ dag pa la'o/ /mṛ dzuṣ ṣ rjes 'brel u brjod don mṛdz dip s ī aṭ sngon du pa ra bzhag/'dra ring*/ ṛ ar de ra u pa hā ring*/ pa rā mrādzs īd ces pa byung dzṣ ṣk s ṣ drangs/ pa rā mrāk+ṣīt/ ༈ta rnams la s dbyi dbyangs la ma yin/ ba ma la'ang min no/ ༈pa rā mrāṣ+tāṃ༈ pa rā mrā k+ṣuḥ

nas parā mrāk+ṣ+ma'i bar ro/ ༈ /bhi dir 'joms pa la'o/ /ir dgos don no/ /si s+yoḥ/ si dang sī la'o/ /bhid la sogs pa byings iṭ med la/ 'dir si dang gong gi sīṣ+ta sogs si ring po'i rkyen byin na/ u pa dhā la yon tan med de/ 'dir bhid iṭ med yin/ bhi bhe ru mi 'gro/ bhi nyid du gnas so/ /bhid tan si aṭ/ a bhid s t/ a bhit+ta/ ༈s mi dbyi/ rkyen gyi ā la 'dren/ gzhan de dang 'dra/ a bhit+sā tāṃ*༈a bhit+sata/ ༈thā sa la si dbyi/ a bhi d+thāḥ/ la sogs pa ste dh+waṃ la s yal/ a bhi t+sam hi'i bar ro/ ༈pa ra smai ster na/ a bhi dat/ a bhait+sīt sogs 'byung bar 'dod do/ ༈bṛ tu 'jug pa la'o/ /u brjod don/ bṛta tan si iṭ aṭ a bṛt ista ces pa byung*/ bṛ yon tan/ ar s ṣ/ taṭa/ t i la drangs/ a brtiṣ+ta/ a brti ṣā tāṃ/ a brti ṣa ta/ ༈a brtiṣ+ṣāḥ/ dh+waṃ la si dbyi/ a brtiṣ+ma hi/ zhes pa'o/ ༈gaml̥ sṛ bl̥ 'gro ba'o/ /lit+pu ṣā derngaḥ/ l̥t puṣ sogs la ng'o/ /l̥ rjes 'brel can gyi byings dang*/ puṣ la sogs pa'i byings la ng yig gi rkyen 'byung ste/ 'das pa'i don gyi dip sogs la'o/ ng rkyen yod pas si bcad pa'o/ /ng yig ni yon tan 'gog pa'i khyad don te rkyen a nyid do/ ༈gaml̥ l̥ rjes 'brel ga m dip ng ng yal/ a bzhag drangs/ a gam t/ a ga ma tāṃ/ a ga mn/ ༈a ga maḥ a ga ma taṃ/ ga ma ta༈ a ga maṃ/ a ga mā ba/ a ga mā ma/ ༈sgrub tshul ga m 'dra bar bya ste/ sṛ gl̥ la yang a sṛb t/ a sṛ pa tāṃ/ asṛ pa n/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈muts-il grol ba la'o/ /l̥ khyad don/ muts dip ng aṭ amuts ad drangs d t/ a mu tsat/ la sogs pa'o/ ༈puṣ rgyas pa la'o/ /puṣ dip ng aṭ a puṣ.ad t ru song drangs/ a pu ṣat/ a pu ṣa tāṃ/ a pu ṣan/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈d+yut snang bar byed pa la'o/

/d+yu t dip nga aṭ/ a d+yu tat/ a d+yu ta tāṃ/ a d+yu tn/ ༈bts yongs su brjod pa la'o/ /ji skad du/ ba tsa'i ng la sak ā ga ma'o/ /zhes bshad pas lung gi skabs 'dir puṣ sogs kyi nang tshan bts la sak ā ga ma ster te/ de yang byings kyi dbyangs mthar ster bas ba dang ts'i bar du sak ster ro/ a dang k rjes 'brel/ bts dip ng aṭ sak a bsts ad ces pa byung*/ s rnam bcad de u u la o/ ts.a la drangs dt/ a bo tsa t/ a bo tsa tāṃ/ a bo tsan/ ༈a bo tsaḥ/ a bo tsa taṃ/ a bo tsa ta/ ༈a bo tsaṃ/ a bo tsa ba/ a bo tsā ma/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ha sha ṣāṃ tāt+sak ha sha ṣa'i mtha' las sak'o/ lung gi skabs 'dir byings ha mtha' dang*/ sh mtha' dang*/ ṣ mtha'i rigs kyi pha rol du sak ā ga ma sbyin dgos pa mtha' las zhes pa'i don no/ /bts skabs ltar gsal byed mtha' can gyi byings kyi dkyil dbyangs mtha' ru byed pa de 'dra min/ byings rdzogs pa'i mthar 'byung ngo zhes pa'o/ ༈duha rab tu gang bar byed pa la'o/ /h'i a yal/ duh dip sak ng aṭ a du h s.ad h'i ḍha'o zhes pas/ h ḍh+ra/ de yang k ru song*/ s ṣ/ sa/ du dhu/ d t/ a dhuk+ṣut/ ༈a dhuk+ṣa/ de dang 'dra bar sgrubs nas/ a dhuk+ṣa tāṃ/ a dhuk+ṣan la sogs pa'o/ ༈li hā ro myang ba la'o/ /ā phyis lih dip sak nga aṭ a lihs ad h ḍh ḍhk s ṣ a lik+ṣat/ a lik+ṣa tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈bi sha 'jug pa la'o/ bish di ྄p sak ng aṭ yang na pra yang sngon du bzhaga.abishs ad/ yang na/ pra a bishs ad ces pa'o/ /sh ṣ/ ṣ k s ṣ k+ṣa a bik+ṣat/ a bik+ṣa tāṃ/ a bik+ṣan/ ces pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈kṛṣa bshor btod pa la'o/ /bi le kha na/ zhes ba shor btod pas rko ba'am 'bri ba'i don yin/ spyir kṛṣa 'gugs pa'i byings kyang yin no/ ༈kṛṣ dip sak ng aṭ akṛṣs ang ṣ k s ṣ k+ṣa a kṛk+ṣad/ a kṛk+ṣa tāṃ/ a kṛk+ṣan/

༈a kṛk+ṣaḥ/ a kṛk+ṣa taṃ/ a kṛk+ṣa ta/ akṛk+ṣaṃ/ akṛk+ṣ+wa/ a kṛk+ṣ+ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ /de ltar na/ tip sogs rnam dbye brgya dang brgyad cu rnams kyis byings las tshig tu sgrub tshul rags pa rnams brjod zin to/ ༈ /de ltar rnam dbye brgya dang brgyad cu 'am/ la yig sde tshan bcu pos byings rnams la bya ba byed tshul gyi rnam 'gyur rags pa bshad zin nas/ da ni zur du bkol ba'i don gyi rnam grangs rnams bshad par bya ste/ de las dang por dngos po dang las kyi don la āt+ma ne'i tshig can cho ga rab tu sbyor ba'o/ ༈de yang sngar bshad zin pa'i bha ba karma'i rkyen gyi 'jug pa ni/ laṭ ling loṭ lang rnams kyi las dngos yin/ ༈'dir ni pa ro3k+ṣa ste lkog gyur ram liṭ dang*/ ༈a shī ṣa ste smon pa'am ling phyi ma dang*/ ༈shwa sta ni te nang par ram l̥r ra btags yin ṭ dang*/ ༈bha bi ṣ+ya ti ste 'byung 'gyur ram l̥ṭ dang*/ ༈kṛ yā ti kra ma ste bya ba lus pa'am l̥r ra btags yin nga dang*/ ༈bhū ta ste byung zin nam lung ces pa'o/ /sde tshan drug po de'i bha ba karma ste las dngos rnam 'gyur rnams 'dir 'chad do/ ༈bhū zhes pa la liṭ'i at+ma ne ster te/ bhū e zhes pa bzhagaganyis brjod bhu a dag gi ṇa sogs la ā'o zhes pas bhū dang po'i dbyangs ā ring por gyur/ thung ngu'o zhes pas ā ring po a thung ngu song*/ /dzha pa rnams kyi dza ba dang tsa ba'o/ /zhes bha bar song*/ bhū ba'i bu k'o zhes pas buk ā ga ma ster a nu sngon du bzhag/a nu ba bhu be/ su kha ma nu ba bhū be de ba dat+ten/ bde ba rjes su myong bar gyur zhig lha sbyin gyis/ zhes so/ de ba dat+te na/ lha sbyin gyis te byed po/ su khaṃ ni bde ba ste las a nu ba bhū ba ni rjes su myong gyur te bya ba'i tshig go ༈de bzhin du/ a nu ba bhū bāṃ te/ ༈a nu ba bhū bi re/ ༈buk gi rjes su iṭ ster/

ku i la a nu ba bhū bi ṣe/ ༈a nu ba bhū bā the༈iṭ 'jugadha ḍha/ a nu ba bhū bi ḍehwa/ ༈a nu ba bhū be/ iṭ 'juga.a nu ba bhū bi ba he/ ༈a nu ba bh+yū bi ma he/ zhes pa ste gsal byed thog ma can la iṭ 'jugadabyangs thog ma can la phar drangs pa'o/ ༈ḍupatsaṣ 'tshed pa la'o/ /pats e bzhagaganyis brjod dang po ha sa sogs ts dang po phyis/ patsa rnams kyi kit la dbyi ste/ a'i e yang ngo*/ /zhes pas pa thog ma phyis/ phyi ma'i srog e ru bsgyur ro/ /drangs pe tse/ de bzhin du/ pe tsā te/ pe tsi re/ ༈pe tsi ṣe/ pe tsā the/ pe tsi dh+we/ ༈pe tse/ pe tsi ba he/ pe tsi ma he/ zhes so/ ༈ta nu spangs pa la'o/ / tan.e gnyis brjod n dang ta phyis ta te te ne/ te nā te/ te ni re la sogs pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ me ne me nā te me ni re la sogs pa'o/ ༈da ti/ da dā te/ da di re/ lta bu patsa sogs min pa la phyi ma'i a er mi 'gro ba'i tshul shes par bya'o/ / yang na yi ge dang po kho na 'phel bas kyang rung ngo*/ ༈ṣ+ṇā gtsang byed la'o/ /ṣ+ṇā e gnyis ṇa phyis sā thung ngu*/ paṃ pā sa ra si rā me ṇa yat+kṛ ti shī ta yā sa ha/ ya di dzānā si ta twa nga sa sne haṃ sa bi lā sa yā/ pad+ma'i mtsho la dga' byed dang*/ /gang du shī ta lhan cig rtse/ gtsang byed gang dang gang yin la/ /de der ngang pa rnam par rol/ zhes so/ /'dir dper brjod ni rkang pa gsum par sa sde dag byed ces pa de'o/ glai m+lai spro ba zad pa la'o/ /glai e gnyis brjod la dang po dbyi/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge la ā/ gāglā.e thung ngu'o/ /kuha la tsu zhes pas ga yig dza yig tu song*/ ā ta mtha' ni i p min pa dbyi bas/ glā'i a phyis/ e la drangs dza gle/ dza glā te/ dza gli re la sogs pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ m+lai e ma ni ku ha min pas tsu ru bsgyur du med/ /gzhan 'dra ba mam+le/ mam+lā te/ ma m+li re/ ༈mam+liṣe/ mam+lā the/ mam+li ḍehwa/

༈mam+le/ mam+le ba he/ ma m+li ma he/ zhes pa'o/ ༈lung drangs pa dbyangs mtha'i dbyangs rnams dang*/ han grah dri sha rnams kyi yang dngos po dang las dag go zhes dang*/ i sa tā sī s+yap rnams kyi ṇit yang na ste iṭ'o/ /zhes 'byung ba byings mtha' dbyangs yin pa rnams dang*/ dbyangs mtha' min yang dṛ sh la sogs pa'i tshogs dang*/ han grah rnams la byed po'i rkyen ma yin/ dngos po dang las te/ dngos las kyi don la/ 'das pa'i si dang*/ 'dod pa'i don sa dang*/ nang par gyi tā dang*/ smon pa'i sī ste/ sīṣ+ta sogs dang*/ kri yā ti kma'i s+yap rnams sbyar ba'i tshe/ iṭ spyir btang 'jug pa kho na dang*/ rkyen de rnams ṇit kyi brda chad 'jug pa dang mi 'jug pa gdam nga ste/ 'jug pa'i phyogs la byings kyi dang po 'phel ba dang*/ mi 'jug pa'i phyogs la yon tan te/ skabs 'di dag tu iṭ yod phyin 'phel ba dang yon tan gang rigs gcig nges par 'ong ba'o/ ༈smon pa'i rkyen nam a shī ṣa la/ bhū sīṣ+ta/ bar du iṭ ṇit la 'phel ba bhau/ au ā b/ bhā p i sīṣ+ta/ a nu gong du bzhagadrangs/ ku i la/ nu bhā bi ṣīṣ+ta/ su kha ma nu bhā bi ṣīṣ+ta bha ba tā/ bde ba rjes su myong bar gyur zhig khyod nyid do/ ༈de bzhin du/ a nu bhū bi ṣī yāstāṃ/ a nu ni mtshon byed nyer sgyur 'phrod mthun pa gang yang rung ba'o/ ༈'dir kun la a nu sbyar te/ bhū bi ṣī ran/ ༈bhā bi ṣī ṣ+ṭhā/ bhā bi ṣīḍaṃhwa/ ༈bhā bi ṣī ya/ bhā bi ṣī ba hi/ a nu bhā bi ṣī ma hi/ ༈ṇi t ma yin pa'i phyogs la bhū iṭ/ sīṣ+ta/ bhū yon tan/ a nu gong*/ ku i la/ a nu bha biṣī ṣ+ta/ bha bi ṣī yā stāṃ la sogs pa bha thung ngu'i khyad ma gtogs gong bzhin no/ ༈ /shīng nyal ba la'o/ /shī sīṣ+ta iṭ i shi 'phel ba shai/ ai āy/ ku i la/ shī yi ṣā ṣā/ shā yi ṣī yā stāṃ la sogs pa dang*/

༈ṇit min pa la yon tan te/ sha yi ṣīṣ+ta la sogs pa gong bzhin no/ ༈ḍu kṛny/ kṛ sīṣ+ta iṭ 'phel pa ste ār/ kā ri ṣīṣ+ta/ kā ri ṣī yā stāṃ/ kā ri ṣī ran sogs dang*/ ༈ṇit min pa la skabs 'dir dmigs gsal yin pas iṭ med/ yon tan dang 'phel ba gang yang med/ kṛ nyid la gnas/ kṛ ṣīṣ+ta/ kṛ ṣī yā stāṃ/ kṛ ṣī ran zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈nang bar gyi don la tā tā rau ta ras phyi man chad te/ bhūtā iṭ 'phel ba/ u nu gong a nu bhā bi tā/ de bzhin du a nu thams cad la sbyor bar go nas/ a nu bhā bi tā rau/ bhā bi tā raḥ/ ༈bhā bi tā se bhā bi tā sā the bhā bi tā dh+we/ ༈bhā bi tā he/ a nu bhā bi tā swa he/ a nu bhā bi tā ma he'o/ ṇit ma yin pa la yon tan te bha thung ngu khyad tsam ma gtogs gzhan 'dra ༈ a nu bha bi tā/ bha bi tā rau/ bha bi tāraḥ/la sogs pa'o/ ༈bha bi ṣ+ya te don la bhu te s+yap iṭ 'phel ba au āb ku i la a nu gong a nu bhā bi ṣ+ya te/ ༈gong a thung mtha'i skabs dang 'dra/ rkyen gyi ā ring i ru bsgyur/ e dang a thung la gong ma'i mtha'i a yal/ ba ma la ā ring po'o/ /a nu bhā biṣ+ye te/ a nu bhā biṣ+yan+te/ ༈bhā biṣ+ya se/ bhā biṣ+ye the/ bhā biṣ+ya dh+we/ ༈bhā biṣ+ye/ bhā bi ṣ+yā ba he/ a nu bhā biṣ+yā ma he'o/ ༈ṇit ma yin pa'i phyogs la yon tan te/ a nu bha baṣ+yi te la sogs pa ste/ bha thung ngu'i khyad par te gzhan 'dra'o/ ༈bya ba lus pa'i don s+yap dang bcas pa'i dip sogs te bhū dip s+yap iṭdip sogs aṭ 'phel ba/ au āb/ a nu gong*/ a nu a bh+ra āb i s+yad ces byung*/ nu'i ub dbyangs med gsum dbyangs dang sbyar/ ku i la/ d t a n+wa dhā bi ṣ+yat ces so/ /a n+wa bhā biṣ+ya ta twa ya ta twaṃ ya d+ya shro ṣ+yat/ rjes su zhugs shig gang du khyod de kho na nyid nyan pa la'o/

/zhes so/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+ye tāṃ/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+ya ta/ ༈a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+ya thāḥ/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+ye thāṃ/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+ya dh+waṃ/ ༈a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+yai/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+yā ba hai/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+yā ma hai/ ༈ṇit min la yon tan dang ab ste/ a n+wa bha biṣ+ya ta zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈da ni bhū ta te byung zin kyi don la/ iṇ ta n+ya karti ri/ ta n la byed pa po min pa la iṇ'o/ byed po'i don ma yin pa ste/ dngos po dang las la pha rol du byung zin gyi rnam dbye thog ma tan zhes pa la bar rkyen iṇ 'jug go iṇ yod na si spangs pa yin no/ /tan ma yin pa gnyis tshig ā taṃ la sogs pa la iṇ mi 'jug si nyid sbyin dgos/ ṇi t la 'phel/ ṇi t min yon tan gong dang 'dra'o/ /lo paḥ/ dbyi ba'o/ /iṇ dang rab sbyor rnam dbye tan dbye ste/ n rtag tu mi snang bar byed mod/ ta yang phyis 'gog pa'o/ ༈bhū tan n yal bar du i ṇ ṇ spangs aṭ 'phel ba au āb a nu gong a nu a bha āb ita zhes pa byung dbyi ba'o/ /zhes pas ta mi snang*/ mtshams sbyar/ a n+wa bhā bi/ zhes so/ a n+wa bhā bi bha bo bha ba tā/ nor 'gog par byung ngo khyed la'o/ bhū ā tāṃ si iṭ 'phel ba/ ku i la/ aṭ/ a nu gong*/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣā tāṃ/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣata/ ༈a n+wa bhā biṣ+ṭhaḥ a n+wa bhā bi ṣā thāṃ/ dh+waṃ la si dbyi/ a n+wa bhā bi dh+waṃ/ ḍhāṃ du byed pa'ang yod/ ༈a n+wa bhā bi ṣi/ a n+wa bhā bi ṣ+wa hi/ a n+wa bhā biṣ+ma hi/ ༈gal te ā tāṃ man chad ṇit min la yon tan te/ a n+wa bha bi ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ /tan la ṇi t yin min gyi dbye ba med par shes so/ ༈ḍukṛny kṛ tan iṇ 'phel ba/ ār aṭ tan 'jiga.a kā ri/ zhes so/ /phyi ma rnams la iṇ med/ si dang iṭ 'byung bas/ a kā ri ṣā tāṃ dang*/ a kā riṣ+ṭhāḥdang*/ si phyis/ a kā ri ḍaṃhwa dang*/ a kā ri ṣ+wa hi/ la sogs pa'o/

༈ṇit min pa la ā tāṃ sogs la yon tan 'phel med/ a kṛ ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ hṛny la yang 'gre a hā ri/ a hā ri ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /kṛ sngar bzhin la nir dang āng sngon du bzhagang rjes 'brel ni rā dang aṭ mtshams sbyar/ ni rā kā ri/ ni rā kā ri ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈dhṛny yang de dang 'dra/ nir āng sbyar na/ ni rā dha ri/ ni rā dha ri ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈ḍupatsaṣ/ patsa tan/ iṇ 'phel ba/ aṭ drangs/ tan 'jiga.a pā tsi/ pats ā tāṃ si 'phel ba tsa'i ka'o s ṣ k+ṣa/ a pak+ṣā tāṃ/ dzha sa las so/ ka dang thā gnyis ka dzha sa yin pas si 'jig go /a pak+thāḥ/ dh+waṃ la'ang de dang 'dra ba la ka ga ru 'gro /a pag+ngaṃhwa/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra'o/ ༈bhu dza skyong ba la'o/ /u pa dhā thung ngu'o/ /zhes 'byung ste 'phel ba bkag yon tan byed do/ /bhu dz tan iṇ yon tan bhe 'khris na dbyangs med pas o abr mi 'gro/ aṭ a bhi dzi/ ༈bhudz.ā tāṃ si iṭ med pas 'di la yon tan 'phel ba med/ aṭ a bhudz s ā tāṃ byung*/ dz ṣ ṣ k sṣ k+ṣ/ a bhuk+ṣā tāṃ/ abhuk+ṣa ta/ dz ṣ si yal a bhuṣ+ṭhāḥl sogs pa'o/ ༈pa da 'gro ba la'o/ /da'i a yal/ pad tan iṇ 'phel ba/ pā aṭ nyer bsgyur prati pra ti a pād iṭ mtshams sbyar/ tan 'jig pat+ya pā di ༈pad ā tāṃ si iṭ med pas yon tan 'phel spangs/ d t drangs/ mtshams sbyar/ pra t+ya pat+sā tāṃ dang*/ ༈thā s la si 'jig pa t+ya pa t+thāḥdang dh+waṃ la'ang pa t+ya pad+dh+waṃ/ pa t+ya/ pat+s+wa hi dang p t+ya pat+sam hi'i bar du'o/ ༈bhaṇ sgra la'o/ /bhaṇ tan.iṇ 'phel ba aṭ ta yal a bhū ṇi/ ༈si dang iṭ byung*/ a bha ṇi ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈bts tan iṇ 'phel ba aṭ a bā tsi/ ༈ātāṃ la iṇ dang iṭ med si 'jig ts k/ s ṣ/ k+ṣ a bak+ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /grah tan iṇ 'phel ba/ aṭ a grā hi/

༈ā taṃ sogs la si iṭ 'phel ba yon tan/ ṇit yin min gyi khyad par yin/ aṭ s ṣ/ a grā hi ṣā tāṃ/ zhes sam/ a gra hi ṣā tāṃ/ zhes so/ ༈thās la si mi dbyi/ drangs pas ṣ+ṭhāḥyong*/ dh+waṃ la si dbyi gzhan 'dra'o/ ༈ /ṇiny tan ny n yal iṇ 'phel ba ai/ ai āy nir sngon du bzhag aṭ nir an āy iṇ ces pa byung*/ drangs ta mi snang*/ ni ra ṇā yi/ ༈ā taṃ la si iṭ 'phel ba/ nir ṇā yi ṣā tāṃ sogs 'gre'o/ ༈ā to yuk/ āt kyi yuk'o/*/lung gi dngos las kyi skabs 'dir byings ā ring mtha' can la yuk ā ga ma ster te/ nyit dang ṇit pha rol la'o/ zhes 'byung 'dir ṇit kyi ming can no/ ༈/pā btung ba la'o/ /pā tan iṇ yuk k rjes 'brel u brjod don aṭ a pā y it ta yal/ a pā yi/ ā tāṃ sogs si dang iṭ a pā yiṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈ṣ+ṇā gtsang byed la'o/ /ṣ+ṇā tan snā iṇ yuk aṭ a snā yi/ iṭ si ྄a snā yi ṣā tāṃ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /ḍudhā ny/ dhā dan iṇ yuk ṭ nyer bsgyur ni gong du bzhagani adhā y i t ta dbyi mtshams sbyar/ drangs/ n+ya dhā yi/ si iṭ yuk s ṣ n+ya dhā yi ṣā tāṃ la sogs pa'o/ ༈pa da 'gro ba la'o/ /pa da sogs kyi byed pa po la iṇ'o/ /zhes gzhan las bshad/ 'di la nyer bsgyur ut sngon du 'jogapad tan iṇ aṭ ut ub/ d.it ces pa byung 'phel ba t d ta yal drangs/ u da pā di/ ā tāṃ la iṭ med si yod 'phel ba min/ iṭ yod na ṣa ru 'gro yang de 'dir iṭ med pas sa'o/ /gzhan 'dra/ u da bat+sā tāṃ zhes sogs so/ ༈bu dha byang ba la'o/ /budha tan iṇ yon tan aṭ a bo dhi/ ā tāṃ sogs si iṭ med pas yon tan 'phel ba med dh d/ de t/ a bhut+sā tāṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ yang lung drangs pa dza ni dang badhi dag la 'phel ba ma yin no/

༈dza ni tan i sangs/ iṇ/ aṭ/ 'phel med tan mi snang*/ a dza ni/ si iṭ yod kyang yon (tan )'phel med de dmigs gsal yin/ a dza ni ṣā tāṃ zhes sogs te/ ༈badhi yang de dang mtshungs so/ /zhes pa ni la yig sde tshan phyi ma drug las dang dngos po'i don can gyi rab tu bya ba rnams so/ ༈ /da ni rkyen mtha' can gyi bya ba rnams bshad de/ byings kyi mthar rkyen sbyar yang ming ngam tshig tu ma grub pa la slar bsgrub pa'i phyir pha rol ti sogs kyi rnam dbye byung na/ rkyen mtha'i rnam 'gyur 'byung tshul rnams bshad par bya'o/ /a ti sha ye na ha sā der+yang dwish+tsa/ phul du byung ba la ha sa dang po'i yang te gnyis kyang ngo*/ /bya ba dang 'brel ba gang yin yang bya ba'am bya ba can de phul du byung ba'i don can du sgrub par byed pa la yang zhes pa'i rkyen sbyar nas byings de rkyen mtha' can du byas nas rnam dbye sgrub pa yin la/ yang gi rkyen byin na byings gnyis su 'gyur la/ de ni rkyen gyi rnam 'gyur yin pa'i tshig gi rigs su gtogs pa'am tshig rjes mthun pa nyid kyi phyir/ tshig gnyis pa can zhes kyang ming 'dogs so/ ༈ya ngi/ yang la'o/ /byings kyi thog ma'i dbyangs de nā mi'i yi ge yin la/ de la rkyen yang yig byung na/ nā mi de yon tan du 'gyur ro/ /bhū yang te zhes pa bzhag ng khyad don/ gnyis brjod/ dzha pa rnams las dza ba tsa pa'o/ /bhū dang po būr song*/ de yon tan bo bhū ya/ sa dhā tuḥ/ de byings so/ /de byings rkyen mtha' can du song ba yin/ mtha'i ya de rkyen yin yang rkyen gyi ming bor te byings nyid kyi brda chad bya'o/ /ti sogs kyi rnam dbye yang rkyen gyi gtso bo yin mod/ rnam dbye'i mtha' can ni byings tshig tu grub pas tshig ces bya yi dbyangs rkyen mtha' can mi zer ro/ /gong du bshad pa'i bha ba zhes pa lta bu tshig tu grub ma zin la ap bi kā ra ṇa'i rkyen gyi mtha' can yin mod kyang*/

bi kā ra ṇa'i khyad par gyi ming yod pa rkyen mtha' can zhes rkyen mtha' tsam gyi ming nas mi 'bod do/ ༈bi kā ra ṇa sogs bar rkyen zhes nges par byings dang rnam dbye'i bar du 'god de rnam dbye med thabs med la/ yang la sogs pa 'di dag ni tshig tu sgrub na rnam dbye dgos kyang*/ /spyir rnam dbye ma bkod pa'i snga rol tu/ byings la rkyen 'di dag sbyar te bzhag pas chog pa'i phyir 'di'i ming ni byings zhes te/ byings ni bya ba mi byed kyang byings la bzhag chog pa dang 'dra/ don la rkyen sbyar ba yin yang rkyen mi zer te/ rkyen zhes bya ba las ka tshugs pa lta bu'i don yin te/ g.yos dang tshos la sogs pa las de la zhugs nas rdzogs par byed dgos/ 'phro bzhag tu mi rung ba dang 'dra bar ming tshig tu sgrub pa dang*/ de phan sogs phyed tsam sgrubs nas bzhag tu mi rung ste/ dper si sogs la bṛk+ṣa la de byin na/ bṛk+ṣa e a zhes pa tsam la bzhag tu mi rung la/ ti sogs la bhū a ti zhes pa tsam la bzhag tu mi rung ba dang*/ de phan la bi shra ma aṇ zhes pa tsam la bzhag tu mi rung ste/ byings dang ming la ma gnas tshig tu ma grub pa'i bar du lus pa'i rnam pa bya ba sde tshan cig brtsams la ma grub pa'i rnam par song ba'i rgyud las so/ /spyir rkyen la byings ming tshig tu sgrub don gzhan sgrub pa dang*/ /byings ming du sgrub pa dang*/ byings byings su sgrub pa rnams so sor yod do/ /'dir yang sa sogs rkyen 'di dag byings mthar sbyar nas/ bi kā ra ṇa dang rnam dbye ma byin par 'jog pas kyang don ston du rung ba'i phyir dang*/ 'di la de dag byed pa ni las ka gzhan gsar pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir dang*/ byings la rkyen gyi bya ba byed pa ltar rkyen 'di dag la yang bya ba byed pas so/ /de ltar go nas/ ya rkyen la ap bi kā ra ṇa ster p yal/ ya'i srog a mi snang*/ bi kā ra ṇa'i a la drangs/

bo bhū ya te/ grub bo/ bo bhu ya/ ap dang bcas pa sngar bzhin sgrubs pa ni/ bha ba dang 'dra bar a thung mtha' can du grub pas/ a mtha'i skabs ltar sgrub pa ste/ bo bhū ye te/ bo bhū yaṃ te/ la sogs pa brta ma ne dang*/ ༈bo bhū yet la sogs pa cho ga 'byung dang*/ ༈bo bhū ya tāṃ la sogs pa ā shi ṣi dang*/ ༈a bo bhū ya t la sogs pa an d+ya ta na te āt+ma ne rkyen kho nas sgrub bo/ ༈bhudz skyong pa la'o/ /bhudz ap yang te/ gnyis brjod thog ma'i ha sa dza dang po phyis bha dang po ba/ yon tan/ dz phyi ma ya stengs drangs/ bo bhu dz+ya te/ bo bhu dz+ye te/ bo bhu dz+yan+te sogs laṭ dang*/ ༈bo bhidz+yi ta la sogs pa ling dang*/ ༈bo bhu dz+ya tāṃ sogs loṭ dang*/ ༈a bo bhu dz+ya ta la sogs lang ste āt+ma ne rnams so/ ༈bhuṣ rgyan la'o/ /bhuṣ yang*/ ap/ te/ gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa yon tan ṣa ya la/ bo bhūṣ+ya te/ bo bhūṣ+ye te bau bhū ṣ+yaṃ te/ sogs da ltar ba dang*/ ༈bo bhūṣ+ye ta sogs bi dhi sam+bha ba dang*/ ༈bo bhūṣ+ya tāṃ sogs a shi ṣi dang*/ ༈ a bo bhu ṣ+ya ta sogs ha ste na'o/ ༈ /mu he sems pa nyams pa la'o/ /mu ha yang ap/ te/ mu h mu t ya a te thog ma'i ha sa yon tan/ ha ya la drangs/ mo mu h+ya te sogs/ ༈ /mo mu h+ye ta sogs/ ༈ mo mu h+ya tāṃ sogs/ ༈ a mo mu h+yat sogs/ ༈ li ha ro myang ba la'o/ /lih ya ap te gnyis h yal li le/ le li h+ya te/ ༈le li h+yeta/ ༈le li h+ya tāṃ/ ༈a le li h+ya ta la sogs pa'o/ ༈/hu sbyin pa dang lha mchod pa la'o/ hu yang apa ྄te hu hu/ hu dang po dzhu/ de dzu/ de yon tan/ dzo hu ya te sogs dang*/ ༈dzo hu ye ta sogs dang*/ ༈dzo hu ya tāṃ sogs dang*/ ༈a dzo hu yat sogs so/ ༈bid shes pa la'o/ /bid yang ap te/ gnyis/ dbyi/ yon tan drangs/ be bid+ya te/ ༈be bi d+ye ta/ ༈be bi d+ye taṃ/ ༈be bid+ya t/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/

༈ātaḥ/ at'o/ yang gi rkyen pha rol du yod pa'i byings kyi thog ma'i srog a thung yod na ā ring du 'gyur ro/ /āt ces pa ā ring po'i ming ngo*/ ༈ḍupatsaṣ/ pats yang ap te/ gnyis/ ts yal/ āt'o/ pa thog ma ring po'o/ /drangs/ pā pa ts+ya te sogs/ /pā pa ts+ye ta/ ༈pā pa ts+ya ta/ ༈pā pa ts+yatāṃ/ ༈a pā pa ts+yat sogs so/ /pa ṭha gsal bar smra ba la'o/ /pa ṭha yang ap te/ gnyis/ dbyi/ āt'o/ drangs/ pā pa ṣ+ya te sogs/ ༈pā pa ṣ+ya tāṃ sogs/ ༈pā pa ṣ+ya ta sogs so/ ༈swa rā deḥpa raḥ/ dbyangs dang po'i pha rol lo/ byings kyi dang po'i yi ge thog ma de dbyangs su yod pa la/ tshig gnyis pa can gyi pha rol te/ 'og ma la yang gnyis brjod 'byung na/ dbyangs la gnyis brjod 'byung*/ cha shas yan lag ste gsal byed la mi 'byung ngo*/ /de yang gnyis brjod lan gcig grub/ slar yang phyi ma de'i dbyangs la gnyis brjod 'byung ba'o/ ༈ aṭ 'gro ba la'o/ /lung drangs pa aṭ la sogs pa rnams la yang dbyangs dang po dag go /zhes 'byung aṭ sogs ni aṭ dang a sh dang ūr+ṇanya dang ṛ zhes pa 'di rnams so/ /aṭ yang ap te/ aṭ aṭ/ a phyi ma las a gcig gong du byung aṭ/ a aṭ thog ma'i ha sa mi dbyi ste 'dra ring*/ drangs a ṭāṭ zhes so/ /ṭ ya la drangs a ṭā ṭ+ya te/ ༈a ṭā ṭ+ye ta/ ༈aṭāṭ+ya tāṃ sogs so/ /deng min la aṭ dang dbyangs dang po la aṭ gnyis pa sbyar aṭ gnyis dang byings kyi a ste gsum 'dra ring ā ṭāṭ+ya ta zhes so/ /a ṭāḍ+ya te bhṛṣ+taḥ/ phul du byung ba'i ci rtol lo/ ༈ash yang ap te/ ash/ a ash gong bzhin ashā sh+ya te/ ༈a shā sh+yet/ ༈a shā sh+ya tāṃ/ a.a.ashāsh+yata/ 'dra ring ā shā sh+ya ta sogs so/ /a ti sha ye nā sh+tā ti*/ lhag par za'o/ ༈ṛ 'gro ba la'o/ /ṛ yang ap te ṛ yon tan/ ar gnyis brjod/ yang a ar a ar gong bzhin drangs arār+y+ya te/ ༈a rār+yeta/ ༈a rār+ya tāṃ/ a.a.ar/

a.ar/ ya.at sbyar bas ārār+ya ta/ a ti sha ye na i yan+ti/ thag ring por rtsol bas 'gro ba'i don no/ ༈ūr+ṇuny g.yogs pa la'o/ /ūr+ṇuya/ a te/ gnyis brjod/ dbyangs gnyis ur+ṇu ū nū/ 'dra ba sbyar/ ūr+ṇū nū byings mtha' ring*/ nyer bsgyur pra gong*/ mtshams sbyar/ pror+ṇonū ya te/ ༈pror+ṇū ṇū ye ta/ ༈pro r+ṇūnū ya tāṃ/ ༈aṭ aṭ/ ūr+ṇu/ pra gong*/ prā ū r+ṇu/ pro r+ṇu ru/ ka 'gro pror+ṇo nū ya ta/ ༈nya ma dzha pāṃ nuk nya ma dang dzha pa rnams la nuk'o/ /byings kyi mtha' la nya ma so sor bsdu ba yod pa dang*/ nya ma med kyang byings dza pa sogs gnyis brjod kyi thog ma la nuk ā ga ma ster ro/ ༈gaml̥ 'gro ba la'o/ /gam yang te/ thog ma'i ha sa dzha pa rnams kyi sogs/ g dz ru song*/ nuk dzan gam ya te byung n nga ro/ m ya la drangs dzaṃ ga mya te/ zhes so/ /dzaṃ ga mya te tu raṅgaḥ/ rta 'gros phul du byung ba'o/ ༈dzaṃ ga myeta/ ༈dzaṃ gamya tāṃ/ a dzaṃ ga mya ta/ ༈bh+ra mu g.yo ba la'o/ /u ya la bh+ram yang te nuk gong bzhin/ baṃ bh+ra mya te/ ༈baṃbh+ra myat/ ༈baṃ bh+ra mya tāṃ/ ༈a baṃ bh+ra mya/ ༈ /han 'tsho ba la'o/ /han/ yang te/ gnyis brjod/ ha phyi ma gha dang snga ma dzha de dza byed/ nuk dzan gha n ya te gong bzhin dzaṃ gha n+ya te/ ༈ dzaṃ gha n+ye ta/ ༈dzaṃ gha n+ya tāṃ/ ༈a dzaṃ gha n+yat/ zhes so/ ༈'di la yang na bārti ka las/ han nyid 'tsho ba rnams la yang te gh+nī ra 'gyur ro/ zhes bshad pas/ han gh+na zhes pas kun du bsgyur bas 'gyur la/ dmigs gsal du nuk bkag pa'o/ /han yang te/ gh+nī ru bsgyu/ gh+nīgh+nīyate na snga ma yal ku ha la tsu'i gha dzha dzha dza yang la yon tan te/ dze dze gh+nā ya te/ ༈dze gh+nī ye ta/ ༈dze gh+nī ya tāṃ/ ༈a dze gh+nī yat/ ༈dzap dang dzalpa lhag par smra ba la'o/ /dzap yang te nuk gaml̥ skabs dang 'dra dzaṃ dza pya te la sogs pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ dzaṃ dzal+p+ya te la sogs pa'o/ ༈dah la daṃ dah+ya te la sogs pa'o/

༈ya bha 'khrig pa'i bya ba la'o/ /ya bh gong bzhin/ yaṃ ya bh+ya te la sogs pa'o/ /daṃ sha snun pa la'o/ /zhes pa byings daṃ sha'o/ no lo paḥ na ni dbyi'o/ yang rkyen gyi pha rol kit ngi t yod pa'i byings daṃsh la/ u pa dhā'i n yig ste klad skor dbyi/ nuk ster bas de ni nga ror 'gro bas grub gzugs ni 'dra'o/ /daṃsh yang te klad skor phyis dash dash yate/ thog ma'i ha sa mi snang*/ nuk daṃ da sh+ya te/ zhes pa ste daṃ da sh+ya te ma sha kaḥ/ sha sbrang gis smugs so/ ༈bhaṃ dzu 'joms pa la'o/ /u brjod don/ gnyis/ nuk bha dang po ba/ sngar bzhin/ baṃ bha dz+ya te/ baṃ bha dz+ya te marto da n+tī ta ruṃ/ so ldan myos pas shing sdong 'joms par byed do/ ༈nṛt-i? tī lus rnam par 'gyur ba la'o/ /ī bya ba'i don nṛt yang te/ rī gṛ du pa dhā s+ya/ ṛt kyi u pa dhā'i rī ga'o/ /nṛt lta bu byings kyi u pa dhā la dbyangs ṛ yig yod pa'i gnyis brjod kyi thog ma'i 'og tu rīk ā ga ma 'byung ngo*/ byings thog ma ṛ yig a ru bsgyur ba'o/ /nṛt yang te gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa/ ṛ a/ rīk ā ga ma/ k rjes 'brel/ t ya la/ na rī nṛ t+ya te/ zhes sogs so/ /na rī nṛ t+ya te na ṭaḥ/ gar mkhan lhag par gar bsgyur ro/ ༈pṛ tu 'jug pa la'o/ /u phyis pṛt yang te/ rīk pṛ rī bṛ ta ya te ṛ a/ ba rī bṛ t+ya te la sogs pa ste/ ba rī bṛ h+ya te bārtāsu tsin+ta/ sems dga' ba'i gtam la ches 'jug go ༈yang lung drangs pa pad/ sraṃ s/ dh+waṃs/ baṃts/ bh+raṃsh/ kash/ pata/ skaṃd rnams kyi yang te thog mar nīk āg ma'o/ zhes/ pa da la sogs pa'i byings brgyad po de dag la/ tshig gnyis 'phel ba'i thog ma la/ nīk ā ga ma sbyor ro/ ༈pa da 'gro ba la'o/ /pad yang te/ gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa/ nīk/ sngon du nyer sgyur u pa dang*/ de'i yang sngon du dgag pa'i na

bzhag/na u pa pa ni pad ya te/ a u la o/ d ya la/ no pa pa nī pa t+ya te/ nye bar yang ma 'gro shig/ces pa la sogs pa'o/ /'on kyang deng min aṭ mgor sbyor dgos pa de/ u pa dang pa nī gnyis kyi bar du dgos pas no pā pa nī pa d+ya ta la sogs pa'o/ ༈sraṃs/ dh+waṃs bh+raṃ s 'og tu lhung ba la'o/ /sraṃs ya te/ na ni dbyi'o/ /klad skor bsal/ gnyis brjod/ thog ma ha sa zhes pas/ s dang r btags dang po yal/ nīk sa nī sra s+ya te/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈dh+waṃs ya te/ klad skor/ dbyi gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa/ s dang w zur phyis/ dzha pa rnams zhes pas dh d ru song nīk danī dh+waṃ s+ya te/ zhes sogs so/ ༈sraṃs/ dh+waṃs zhes pa de gnyis dang 'dra bar baṃts ya te nga ro phyis gnyis brjod/ dbyi/ nīk/ ba nī bats+ya te sogs dang*/ ༈bh+raṃs ya te/ nga ro yal/ gnyis brjod/ s dang r btags sbas/ bha ni ba ru song*/ nīk/ pa nī bh+ra sh+ya te/ ༈ka sha rdeg pa la'o/ /ka sh ya te gnyis/ ka yi tsa'o/ /nīk/ tsa nī ka sh+ya te/ zhes sogs dang*/ ༈skaṃ dir ir phyis skaṃd ya te thig le bsal/ gnyis/ thog ma'i sa mgo dbyi/ nīk/ katsa/ tsa nī ska sh+ya te/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈tsa ra pha lo ru ts+tsā s+ya/ tsa ra dang pha la'i a ni u'o/ /byings tsa ra dang pha la zhes pa gnyis po'i nyis 'gyur gyi thog ma la num ā ga ma dgos la/ phyi ma'i a yig ni u yig tu 'gyur ro/ /tsar ya te/ gnyis brjod r snga ma yal/ tsa snga ma la num/ um phyis/ na nga ro/ tsa phyi ma tsu/ tsaṃ tsur+ya te/ zhes dang*/ ༈phal ya te/ kha sa tsa pa sogs ph p ru bsgyur/ gzhan thams cad tsa r dang 'dra paṃ phu l+ya te/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ṛ to riḥ/ ṛ t kyi ri'o/ /byings gang zhig dbyangs gcig pa ṛ t mtha' yin pa de ni/ yang gi rkyen lar gi gu can gyi ri ru bsgyur te/ de nas gnyis brjod do/ /kṛ yang te/ kṛ kri ru bsgyur/ gnyis brjod/

thog ma'i ha sa/ kri thog ma'i ra btags phyis ki tsi/ yon tan/ tse ya la'o zhes pas kṛ phyi ma ring po'o/ /tse krī ya te/ tse krī ye te/ tse krī yan+te la sogs pa'o/ ༈tse krī ye ta sogs dang*/ ༈tse krī ya tāṃ la sogs pa dang*/ ༈a tse krī yat la sogs pa'o/ /a ti sha ye na ka ro tī ti/ phul du byung ba'i las byed do/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈de dang 'dra bar hṛny la ste/ hṛ ya/ hri/ gnyis brjod/ ha dang po dzha/ dzar yal/ yon tan ring po/ dze hrī yate/ ༈dze hrī ye ta/ ༈dze hrī ya tāṃ/ ༈a dze hrī ya t/ ༈bṛ ny mchog gyur la'o/ /bṛ yang bṛ bri ru song*/ gong bzhin bebrī ya te/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /don ni a ti sha ye na bṛ ṇo tī ti/ /phul du byur bar gang ba'o/ ༈mṛng*/ mṛ/ yang*/ mri mri/ gong bzhin/ a ti me mrī ya te/ don ni/ a ti sha ye na mrī ya te/ shin du shi ba'o/ ༈dā/ yang*/ te/ gnyis/ ha sa dbyi rgyu med/ dā sogs kyi i/ dā phyi ma i di/ dang po yon tan de/ ya la'o phyi ma ring po dī/ de dī ya te sogs dang*/ ༈de dī ye ta sogs/ ༈de dī ya tāṃ sogs dang*/ ༈a de dī yat la sogs pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ pā yang te/ dā sogs kyi i pi gong bzhin/ naṃ/ pe pī ya te la sogs pa'o/ /de yan chad yang rkyen gyi mtha' can no// ༈ //da ni yang rkyen 'jig pa'i mtha' can bshad par bya ste/ bā n+yatra lu ga nu brta te/ gzhan du 'jig pa rjes su 'gro ste yang na'o/ /sngar bshad pa de las gzhan du sgrub tshul ni/ yang rkyen 'jig pa'i cho ga 'jug ste/ 'chad 'gyur kṛ tan+ta'i rkyen uk dang rab tu sbyor ba yod na ni/ yang rkyen dbyi ba mi 'byung ngo*/ a na pi tsa ha sāt/ ap med pa'i ha sa las so/ /byings ha sa'i mtha' can yin la/ ap byin pa ma yin byin shul yang ma yin na/ byings de 'dra'i mtha' la yad rkyen yod na/ ya rkyen dbyi ba'o/ /lung drangs pa/

zhig par yod pa la pit ta sa ma'i ī'i yi ge yang na'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ rnam dbye pit dang ta sa ma'i yi ge dang por yod pa la ī rkyen 'jug go /dweḥswa re3n pi no ba dhā yā gu ṇaḥ/ dbyangs la gnyis can ap med pa'i u pa dhā yon tan no/ /byings gnyis brjod sngon ma can gyi phyi mar ap ma byung zhing*/ ya rkyen phyis pa rnam dbye dbyangs pha rol can gyi byings de'i u pa dhā la yon tan no/ skabs 'dir yang rkyen 'jig pa'i mtha' can rnam dbye ni byings thams cad pa'i pa ra smai pa ti kho na 'jug go ༈ don de 'dra'i dper brjod ni/ bhudz ya tip ces pa bzhagabhu dz bhu dz/ dz snga ma yal/ bhu bu ru song*/ yon tan/ ya 'jigapit dang ta sa ma la ī yang na bar 'jug/bo bhu dz.ī ti/ bo bhu dzī ti/ zhes so/ ༈ī mi 'jug na/ dz ṣ/ ṣak/ bhu phyi ma la yang*/ yon tan/ bo bho k+ti/ zhes so/ ༈ta s la bo bho k+taḥ/ ༈an+ti la/ dz a la drangs/ nga ro phyis/ bo bhu dza ti/ ༈sip pit yin/ ī 'jugabo bhu dzī ṣi/ ༈ī med na/ dzk/ rkyen gyi sa ṣa/ bo bhok+ṣi/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈pats ya tip pats pats gong ma'i ts dbyi āt'o/ /pa snga ma ring po ya mi snang*/ ī pā pa tsī ti/ ༈ī med na ts k/ pā pak+ti/ ༈dbyangs la an+ti la/ pā pa tsa ti/ ༈sip la pā pa tsī ṣi/ pā pa k+ṣi/ pā pak+thāḥ/ pā pa tsī mi/ ༈pā pa tsa mi/ pā pa tswaḥ pā pa tsa ma sogs dang*/ /pā pats+yāta sogs dang*/ ༈tup la/ pā pa tsī tu/ pā pak+tu dang*/ pā pak+tāt gsum mo/ /hi ni dhi/ pā pag+dhi/ yang na/ pā pak+tāt/ a ni p/ pā pa tsā ni/ ba ma la ā dran par bya/ ༈dip sogs aṭ dip phyis na tsk apā pak/ ī byung na/ a pā pa tsīt/ an us/ a pā pa tsuḥ/ sip/ apā pa tsīḥ/ a mip/ a pā pa tsaṃ/ a pā pa tswa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ba da gsal por brjod pa la'o/ /a ti sha ye na pa da tī ti/ shin du skyen par smra bar byed do/

/zhes pa'i don la/ pā pa da dī ti/ bd y tipa/ bd bd phyis/ a thog ma ring po/ ya mi snang*/ ī pā pa dī ti/ ī med na d t drangs pā pat+ti/ sip/ pā pa dīṣi/ pā pat+si/ thas/ pā pat+thaḥ/ mip la/ pā pa dī mi/ pā pat+mi/ pā patwaḥ/ la sogs pa'o/ ༈bā ba d+yā ta la sogs pa'o/ ༈tu p la ī yod med kyi khyad la/ bā bat+tu/ bā ba dī tu/ bā bat+tāt ces gsum mo/ /hi dhi bā bad+dhi/ bā bat+tāt/ a nip/ bā ba dā ni sogs so/ ༈dip la dip dbyi na/ a bā ba t/ ī byin na/ a bā pa dīt/ an us/ abā ba duḥ/ hi phyis/ a bā bt/ sip/ a bā ba dīḥ/ a mip/ a bā ba daṃ/ a bā ba dwa zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ghaṭ rtsed mo la'o/ /'di la saṃ sngon du bzhag dgos/ ghaṭ yang ti/ gnyis sogs gong bzhin dzha pa rnams sogs gha dzha/ de dza ring po/ saṃ gong*/ ya phyi/ ī/ saṃ dzā/ gha ṭī/ ti/ ī med/ saṃ dzā ghaṭ+ṭi/ saṃ dzā ghaṭ+ṭaḥ saṃ dzāgha ṭa ti/ sip ī gdam nga*/ gong bzhin thas la/ saṃ dzā gha ṭaṭhaḥmip/ saṃ dzā gha nī mi/ saṃ dzā ghaṭ+mi/ saṃ dzā gha ṭ+wa/ la sogs pa'o/ ༈tup la/ saṃ dzāgha ṭī tu/ saṃ dzā gha ṭ+ṭu/ saṃ dzā gha ṭ+ṭāt/ hi dhi dhi ḍhi/ saṃ dzā ghaṭiḍha/ yang*/ saṃ dzā ghaṭ+ṭā t sogs so/ ༈aṭ sngon dusaṃ bzhag/ī sa ma dzā gha ṭīt/ ī med/ sa ma dzā ghaṭ/ saṃ dzāgha ṭ+ṭaṃ/ an us/ samadzāghaṭuḥ si phyis na/ sa ma dzā ghaṭ/ ma phyis na/ sa ma dzā gha ṭīḥ/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈bhū la yang*/ saṃ bo bha bī ti/ saṃ bo bho ti/ zhes dang*/ saṃ bo bha taḥ/ saṃ bo bh ba ti/ saṃ bo bha bi ṣi/ saṃ bo bho ṣi sogs/ mip/ saṃ bo bha bī mi/ saṃ bo bhu ba la sogs pa'o/ ༈saṃ bo bhuyā t sogs dang*/ ༈tup la/ saṃ bo bha bī tu/ saṃ bo bhu tā tra/ hi la/ saṃ bo bhū hi/ yang na/ saṃ bi bhū tāt/ ī nip/ saṃ bo bha bā ni la sogs pa'o/ ༈dip sogs la aṭ dgos/ gong du nyer sgyur saṃ bzhag/mtshams sbyar bas sa ma byung*/

ī sa ma bo bha bīt/ med na/ sa ma bo bhoṭ/ an us dran/ si p phyi ma la ī yod med kyis/ sa ma bo bha bīḥ sa ma bo bho:/ a mip/ sa ma bo bha baṃ/ ba/ sa ma bo bhū ba la sogs pa'o/ ༈ḍukṛny byings/ ṛt mtha' can yang yin/ u pa dhā yin yang rkyen mi snang pa'ang yin na/ byings gnyis brjod kyi bar du ruk ā ga ma dang*/ rik ā ga ma dang*/ rīk ā ga ma ste gsum po gang rung gcig 'jug go /ji skad du/ ṛ yig mtha' can rnams kyi ṛt u pa dhā'i dang po la ruk rik rīk ā ga ma ste yang zhig par gyur pa la'o/ /zhes so/ /kṛ yang tip kṛ kṛ/ ṛ a/ ka kṛ/ ku'i tsu'o/ /tsa kṛ/ ya 'jigatsa kṛ ti zhes pa drug tshan gcig bkod/ dang po gsum la ruk rīka rnams rim can du tsa dang kṛ'i bar du bri'o/ /k gsum ka rjes 'brel/ ru'i u brjod don/ r rkyang lus so/ /phyi ma gsum la'ang de ltar byas pas tsa r+kṛ tsa ri kṛ tsa rī kṛ zhes pa lan gnyis byung*/ dang po gsum la ya'i shul du ī/ phyi ma gsum la ī med/ kṛ drug po thams cad la yon tan te/ ka r zhes pa drug go /dang po gsum r ī la drangs phyi ma gsum r ta'i steng du drangs tsarka rī ti tsa ri ka rī te tsa rī ka rī te tsarkarti tsa rikarti tsa rī karti/ zhes pa rnam 'gyur drug byung ngo*/ /de ltar pit la ī 'jug mi 'jug gdam ka can/ 'og ma rnams la'ang drug drug nges par 'byung*/ tip ni pit yin pas drug༈sip dang mi p kyang de dang 'dra zhing*/ ༈tup la pit kyi drug po de dang*/ pit ma yin pa'i gsum ste dgu/ ༈ ī mi 'jug par nges pa/ gzhan gsal byed thog ma can la kṛ ma 'gyur bar gnas la/ ā ga ma'i rnam 'gyur gsum gsum dang*/ dbyangs thog ma can rnams la/ kṛ'i srog ṛ r te ra btags su 'gyur la/ ā ga ma'i dbye bas rnam 'gyur gsum gsum mo/ tas tsar+kṛ taḥ/

tsa ri kṛ taḥ/ tsa rī kṛ taḥ/ zhes pa gsum ste/ ī med/ gsal byaid thog ma rnams la 'dis 'gre/ ༈an+ti/ tsar+k+ra ti/ tsa ri kra ti/ tsarīkra ti zhes pa ste 'dis dbyangs thog ma can kun la 'gre ste/ ༈ṛr k r srog med rnam dbye'i dbyangs la drangs pa'o/ ༈ /sip tsarka rī ṣi sogs dang*/ tsarkar+ṣi la sogs pa drug go ༈thas tsar+kṛ thaḥl sogs pa'o/ ༈mip la/ tsarka rī mi dang*/ tsarkarmi la sogs pa'o/ ༈tsar+kṛ baḥ/ tsar+kṛ maḥl sogs pa'o/ ༈yāt sogs la/ tsar+kṛ yāt la sogs pa gsum gsum mo/ ༈tup la/ tsarka rī tu sogs gsum tsarkartu sogs gsum tā tad du bsgyur tsar+kṛ tāt la sogs pa gsum ste dgu'o/ ༈dip la ī yod na/ a tsarkarīt sogs gsum dang*/ med na atsar+kṛt sogs gsum/ ༈bṛ tu 'jug pa la'o/ /u brjod don/ brit tip phul du byung ba la ha sa dang po'i ya d do/ gnyis kyang ngo*/ /yang gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa sogs ṛ a'o/ /bṛ thog ma ba ru song*/ ruk ī bar+bṛtī ti/ rik ba ri bṛ tī ti/ rīk/ ba rī bṛ tī ti/ ī med na/ ṛ 'og ma yon tan ar/ barba rti/ ba ri brti/ ba rī brti/ ༈des rigs 'gre ste bar+bṛt+taḥsogs dang*/ ༈bar+bṛ ta ti sogs/ ༈ī/ bar+bṛtī ṣi sogs pit yon tan/ barba rti sa sogs dang*/ bar+bṛt+thaḥsogs/ ༈bar+bṛtatha sogs/ ༈ī/ bar+bṛ tī mi sogs/ yon tan barbar+t+mi sogs/ ༈bar+bṛ tabaḥsogs/ ༈bar+bṛd+maḥsogs dang*/ pa ri bṛt+maḥ/ pa rī bṛt+maḥzhes so/ ༈bar+bṛ t+yāt pa ri bṛ d+yāt sogs/ pa rī bṛ d+yā ma'i bar du gsum gsum nyer bdun no/ ༈ī bar+bṛ tī tu sogs dang*/ ī med na bar+bṛt+tu/ pa ri bṛt+tu sogs/ yang na tā tad/ bar+bṛt+tāt sogs te dgu'o/ ༈bar+bṛt+tāṃ sogs/ ༈bar+bṛ ta tu sogs/ ༈hi dhi/ bar+bṛ d+dhi sogs dang*/ tā ta ng dran/ bar+bṛt+tāt sogs drug go /༈bar+bṛ taṃ sogs༈ bar+bṛ tā ni sogs dang*/
