༈bar+bṛ tā ba sogs dang*/ ༈bar+bṛ t ma sogs so/ ༈ī/ a bar+bṛ tī/ a ba ri bṛ tīt sogs/ ī med na/ a bar+bṛtra dip phyis pa'o/ ༈a bar+bṛt+tāṃ sogs/ ༈aṇ us/ a bar+bṛ tuḥsogs/ ༈ī rnam bcad a bar+bṛ tīḥsogs/ ༈a bar+bṛt+taṃ sogs/ ༈a bar+bṛt+ta sogs/ ༈a bar+bṛ taṃ sogs/ ༈a bar+bṛtwa sogs/ ༈a bar+bṛt+ma/ a ba ri bṛt+ma/ a ba rī bṛt+ma zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de dag ni yang lu gan+t te/ yang 'jig pa'i mtha'i bya ba'o/ ༈kartu yang/ yang byed pa po la'o/ /ngan pa la bzang por rlom pa nye ba'i nga rgyal kun du spyod pa sogs kyi byed pa po'i don la/ yang zhes pa'i rkyen 'jug go /ya la'o zhes pas byings kyi mtha' ring po ste/ sh+yen zhes pa lta bu ming yin pas byings dang ming gzhi mthun pa ste ming gi byings zhes bya'o/ sh+yen yang te y la'o/ /byings mtha' ring*/ sh+yenā ya te/ sh+ye nā yā te/ sh+ye nā ya te la sogs pa'o/ /sh+ye na i ba ā tsa ra tī kā kaḥ/ hor pa dang 'dra bar rlom ste bya rog go /paṇ+ḍi tā ya te mur+khaḥ/ mkhas par rlom ste blun po'o/ ༈ji skad du/ yang la sa dbyi'o/ /zhes 'byung pas s mtha' can gyi s yig dbyi ste/ ap+sa ras yad te ming gi byings mtha' ring*/ s yal ap+sa rā ya te/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /ap+sa rā ya te ku rū pā/ chu byung mar rlom ste gzhugs ngan ma'o/ ༈ /o dzas yang te dza ring*/ sa dbyi o dzā ya te/ sogs so/ /o dzā ya te durba laḥ/ shugs can du rlom ste rjud pos so/ ༈khañdzā ya te paṅguḥ/ gyol por rlom ste gong pos so/ ༈pa yas la sogs pa'i sgra la s dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba gdam ka ste/ phyis na pa yā ya te sogs dang*/ ma phyis na ya ring po med/ pa ya s+ya te zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /pa ya s+ya te ta kraṃ/ 'o ma dang 'dra bar dar ba'o/ /des yang rkyen phyi ma'i bya ba bshad zin to// ༈// ā tsā re u pa mā nāt yaḥ/ nye ba'i nga rgyal kun du spyod pa la sa

ya'o/ /kun du spyod pa ni rlom sems so/ /don de la ya y-ig rkyen 'jug ste/ byings mtha'i a yig ni ī yig tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir rlom sems ni las kyi tshig tu 'byung gsung ngo*/ /'di ni pa ra smai tshig can no/ /pat ya ti/ byings mtha'i a ni ī ru bsgyur/ pu trī ya ti/ zhes so/ /pu trī ya ti shi ṣ+ya mi pa dh+yā ya/ mkhan pos slob ma bu dang 'dra bar byed do/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /pu trī ya zhes pa kun la 'jug/hi 'jigagazhan ap mtha'i skabs bzhin/ ༈prā sā da ya tip de dang 'dra prā sā dī ya ti/ zhes so/ /prā sā dī ya ti kuṭ+yaṃ bir+k+ṣuḥ/ khang bzangs su rlom mo khang mig la slong mo bas so/ /sh+ye na nas prā sā da'i bar de dag ming gi byings so/ /de dag gis ni ya rkyen gyi bya ba bshad zin no/ / ༈ //its+tshā yā māt+ma naḥsaḥ/ bdag nyid 'dod pa la sa'o/ /da ni sa rkyen gyi bya ba bshad de/ 'di la tshig gnyis pa can 'byung ste/ bhū sa tip gnyis brjod/ dang po thung*/ bha ba ru song*/ sa ṣa/ bu bhū ṣa ti/ bu bhū ṣa taḥ/ bu bhū ṣan+ti la sogs pa ste/ a bubhūṣ+ma'i bar ro/ ༈buḥ se/ u ṛ sa la'o/ buḥzhes pa ni u ṛ ngas ngas us su bsgyur/ ub ṛ ṭi yin pas dbyi u dang sbyar s rnam bcad do/ /de la u yig dang ṛ yig dang gra ha dang*/ gu ha'i pha rol tu sa rkyen yod na/ iṭ mi 'byung ngo*/ /nā ni ṭi se/ iṭ med kyi sa la ma yin no/ iṭ med pa'i skabs sa rkyen pha rol la byings yon tan med pa'o/ /se dīr+ghaḥ/ sa la ring po'o/ /pha rol sa rkyen byung na byings mtha' ring por 'gro ste/ ༈de yang tsi nys tip bzhag /tsa ni ka zhes so/ /ā de sha byas/ ki ki ki dang po slar yang tsa yig tu log ki phyi ma ring*/ sa ṣa tsi kī ṣa ti/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ tsi ki ru mi bsgyur na/ yang gzhan 'dra ste/ tsi tsī ṣa te ces pa la sogs pa'o/ /sa dang pa ro3k+ṣa la dzi gi'o zhes 'byung ste/

de yang dzi rgyal ba la'o/ /dzi sa ti dzi gi ru bsgyur gnyis brjod gi gi yang dang po slar dza ru logaphyi ma sa la ring po ku i la sogs s ṣ dzi gī ṣa ti/ dzi gī ṣa taḥ/ ji gī ṣan+ti la sogs pa'o/ /dzi gī ṣe t sogs dang*/ ༈dzi gī ṣa tu sogs dang*/ ༈a dzi gī ṣat la sogs pa'o/ ༈yu 'dres pa la'o/ /yus ti gnyis brjod/ phyi ma ring*/ sa ṣa/ yu yū ṣa ti sogs dang*/ yu yū ṣe t sogs dang*/ ༈yu yū ṣa tu sogs dang*/ ༈a yu yū ṣat la sogs pa'o/ ༈hu sbyin mchod la'o/ ha dzha dzha dza dzu hū ṣa ti la sogs pa'o/ ༈ru sgra la'o/ /ru sa ti gnyis phyi ma ring sa ṣa ru rū ṣa ti sogs/ ༈ /ru rū ṣet sogs/ ༈ru rū ṣa tu sogs/ ༈a ru rū ṣt sogs so/ ༈yaḥse/ sa la a i'o/ /byings mtha' la sa rkyen du byung ba'i skabs 'dir byings kyi dang po'i a yig ni i yig tu 'gyur ro/ /'dir dpe 'ga' las/ gu ṇaḥ/ yon tan no/ /zhes kyang 'byung don la de yang dgos te/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i don la yon tan 'byung la/ rang bzhin du gnas pa ma yin pa'i don la sa rkyen 'byung ste yon tan mi byed do/ ༈bts sa ti gnyis brjod ts ya la sa ya a i'i zhes pas/ pa thog pi/ tsu ku sa ṣa pi pak+ṣa ti sogs/ ༈pi pak+ṣet sogs/ ༈pi pak+ṣa tu sogs/ ༈pi pak+ṣat sogs so/ ༈pā sa ti gnyis brjod/ thung ngu'o/ sa la a i'o/ pi pā sa ti/ pi pā se t/ ༈pi pā sa tu/ pi pāsat/ ༈t+ya dz lang tsho yol ba la'o/ /t+ya dz sa ti/ t+yadz t+yadz dz dang ya btags snga ma mi snang*/ sa la a i dz phyi ma ṣa ṣ k sa ṣa tet+yak+ṣa ti/ ༈ti t+yak+ṣet/ ༈ti t+yak+ṣe tu/ ༈a ti t+ya k+ṣa t la sogs pa'o/ /pṛ tsī mchod yon sbyin pa la'o/ /pṛ tsī ī brjod don pṛtss ti?/ gnyis brjod/ dang po'i ha sa dang po'i ṛ a/ pa sa la a i pi tsak sa ṣa pi pṛk+ṣa ti/ ༈pi pṛk+ṣet/ ༈pi pṛk+ṣa tu/ ༈a pi pṛk+ṣata la sogs pa'o/ ༈grah sa ti bzhag/grah rnams kyi kit ngit kyang ngo zhes pas

slar yang dag par bsgyur ba byed dgos so/ /gṛh byung*/ gnyis brjod/ dang po'i ha sa sogs/ ṛ a/ ga sa la a i'o/ gi dang po'i dza ba rnams so/ /zhes pa/ ga dza ru song*/ ha'i ḍha'o ha ḍha/ ḍha ka/ ga*/ dzi ghṛ k+ṣa ti/ ༈dzi ghṛ k+ṣeta/ ༈dzi ghṛ k+ṣa tu/ ༈a dzi ghṛk+ṣa t/ ha na 'tshe ba dang bgrod pa la'o/ /han+teḥse ṇit/ han gyi sa ṇi t'o/ /byings han gyi mtha' la byung ba'i bar rkyen sa yig la ṇit zhes bya ste/ ming de ltar btags pa'i dgos pa ni 'phel ba'i don gyi phyir ro/ /han sa ti gnyis brjod han han n dang po dbyi/ ha dang po dzha dzha dza/ sa la a i/ dzi han gyis ṇit yin pas ha phyi ma la 'phel pa hā ha n'i gh+na'o zhes pas/ hā gh+na n dbyangs med nga ro/ dzi ghāṃ sa ti/ dzi ghāṃ sa taḥ/ /dzi ghāṃ san+ti/ sogs dang*/ ༈dzighāṃ set/ ༈dzi ghāṃ sa tu/ ༈a dzi ghāṃ sat/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /ḍukṛny/ kṛ sa ti/ ṛt ir/ ṛt ir'o/ /sa rkyen gyi pha rol kit dit kyi rkyen yod la/ byings ṛ yig gi mtha' can ni thog ma rang nas ṛ yig de ir zhes par 'gyur ro/ /kir kir sa ti zhes byung*/ dang po'i ha sa sogs ku ha'i tsu'o/ /ka thog ma tsa tsi i u dag ra ba ha sa la sogs phyi ma ring po sa ṣa drangs/ tsikīr+ṣati tsikīr+ṣa taḥ/ tsikīr+ṣan+ti la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /hṛ ny hṛ sa ti ṛ ir/ gnyis brjod hi r hi r r dang po phyis/ hi dang po dzi phyi ma ring po sa ṣa drangs dzi hīr+ṣa ti/ pa ri sngon du bzhag na pa ri dzi hīr+ṣa ti zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ /dip sogs pa aṭ sngon/ par+ya dzi hīr+ṣa t sogs so/ ༈ /tṝ byings tṝ sa ti ṛ ir gnyis brjod r dang po yal ti phyi ma ring po/ ti tīr+ṣa ti/ ༈ ti tīr+ṣa ta/ ༈ta tīr+ṣe tu/ ༈a ti tīr+ṣatl sogs so/ ༈kṛ sa te iṭ gnyis brjod thog ma'i ha sa ku ha la sa tsu i u ra ba ha sa sogs ring po yak bzhi po rnams la'o/

/tsi kīr sa yak te zhes byung*/ k phyis/ ya taḥ/ yang dang po/ /'di ni rkyen mtha' la las dngos kyi rkyen 'byung ba'i dpe ste/ de yang byings mthar rkyen sa dang yak gnyis 'dzom pa na/ rkyen gyi ya'i srog gi a mi snang bar byed pa'am/ yang na ap med pa'i yul la dngos po dang las rnams kyang ngo*/ /zhes pa rkyen sa yig gi dbyangs a dbyi bar bya ba las skabs 'dir sa'i a phyis/ ku i la/ tsikīr+ṣ+ya te/ zhes pa grub/ tsi kīr r+ṣ+ya te de ba dat+te na/ lha sbyin gyis 'grus par byas so/ /tsikīr+ṣ+ye te/ tsi kīr+ṣ+ya n+te at+ma naṃ pa da te dngos po'i dbang du byas na gcig tshig kho na'o/ /pats 'di la shwa sta na ste/ khar sang zhes pa'i don gyi rnam dbye tā tā rau ta ras sogs ster sa rkyen med/ pa ts tā/ phul du byung ba la ha sa dang po'i yang ngo zhes pas yang gnyis brjod āt'o/ /zhes pas byings kyi thog ma'i dbyangs a thung ā ring du song*/ dbyangs med thog ma dbyi/ pā pats ya tā byung*/ si sa tā sī s+yap la i?ṭa'o/ /gzhan du 'jig pa 'jug ste yang na'o/ /zhes pas yang na ya dbyi ste/ ya dang tā bar du iṭ de nas ya dbyi ba'am/ ya phyis pa'i yul la iṭ 'jug go /pā pa tsi tā/ pā pa tsi tā rau/ pā pa tsi ta raḥ/ sogs so/ /ya mi 'phyid na iṭ mi 'byung ste/ pā pa ts+ya tā/ pa pa ts+ya tā rau pā pa ts+ya tā raḥ/ la sogs pa'o/ ༈dā sbyin pa la'o/ /dā tip sa rkyen gnyis brjod/is+se/ sa la is'o/ /byings dā sogs pa sa pha rol du byung ba byings mtha'i dbyangs a ni is su bsgyur/ /sngar gnyis brjod las/ dang po dbyi'o/ /ap med pa'i sa ta'o/ /zhes pas is kyi s dbyangs med t dbyangs med du song*/ t rkyen sa la drangs/ dit+sa ti sogs/ ༈dit+se ti sogs/ ༈dit+se ta sogs/ /dit+sa tu sogs/ ༈a dit+sat sogs so/ ༈ḍudhāny/ dhā sa ti is gnyis/ dang po yal/ st/ dhit+sa ti/

dhit+sa taḥ/ sogs dang*/ dhi t+set sogs/ ༈dhi t+sat sogs/ ༈a dhi t+sat sogs so/ ༈māng gus pa la'o/ pra gong du 'jogagazhan dā dang 'dra/ prat+sa te sogs so/ /aṭ 'jug na pra dang ma 'bar du 'ong*/ mtshungs 'dra/ prā mit+sa ta sogs te/ at+ma ne pa ti'o/ ༈ḍu la bhaṣ thob pa la'o/ /ḍu dang ṣ bya ba'i don no/ /bha'i a gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi don no/ la bh sa te bzhagaganyis brjod/ la bh la bh sa te byung*/ thog ma ni dbyi'o zhes pas la bh dang po phyis/ kha sa la tsa pa dang dzha sa rnams so/ /bh yig p yig dbyangs med do/ /sa la i s'o/ /la'i is su bsgyur lis ps te byung s k'i dang po yang ngo*/ /zhes pas s dang p dbyangs med rab sbyor gyi dang po is kyi s dbyi/ li p+sa te/ lip+se te/ lip+sa te la sogs pa'o/ ༈ra bha dga' rtsed la'o/ /rabh sa te/ ra bhr bh/ sa te/ phyis/ is ri s bhaste/ s yal/ bh p te sogs so/ ༈t-il ltung ba la'o/ /l̥ rjes 'grel/ sa to beṭ/ pa ta la iṭ yang na'o/ /pat zhes pa'i byings la iṭ 'jug mi 'jug yang na ba ste 'jug pa ltar na pat sa tip pat pat t sa tit/ dang po mi snang*/ iṭ dbyangs thog ma'i a i/ sa ṣa/ pi pa ti ṣa ti sogs dang*/ yang na iṭ mi 'jug ste/ pat pats ti pa t/ dang po phyis/ is pist sa ti s zhig/pit+sa ti sogs so/ ༈āpl̥ khyab byed la'o/ /l̥ rjes 'brel āp byings so/ /āp+no te rī/ ā p dag gi ī'o/ /āp/ āpl̥ gyi byings la/ rnam dbye pha rol can gyi s byung na byings kyi thog ma'i dbyangs ā ring po ni ī y-ig ring por 'gyur ro/ /āp sa ti/ āp āp sa ti/ āp dang po phyi sa phyi ma'i ā ī drangs/ īp+sa ti sogs/ ༈īp+set sogs/ ༈īp+sa tu sogs/ ༈dip sogs la aṭ lan gnyis/ a a īp+sa d/ a.i īp+sa d/ a i e/ e ai la ai'o/ /aip+sat la sogs pa'o/

༈a sha za ba la'o/ /a she ra nā yoḥ/ ash la a nā ya yang na'o/ /byings a sha la rkyen a nā ya 'byung ba'am yang na iṭ 'byung ste/ gnyis ka ma yin te re re'o/ /ash tip bar du a nā ya sbyin/ sh a la drangs/ a sha nā ya ti sogs/ ༈a sha nā yet sogs/ ༈a sha nā ya tu/ ༈aṭ aṭ/ ash a nā ya dip/ ā sha nā yat la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /yang na a nā ya spangs te sa dang iṭ 'jug go ༈ ash is ti p zhes pa byung*/ gnyis brjod/ ash phyi ma'i a de ni is su bsgyur/ ash is sh is ti/ s dbyangs med yal/ sh gnyis i gnyis la drangs/ saṣa/ a shi shi ṣa ti zhes sogs so/ /a shi tu mits+tsha ti/ zas bza' bar 'dod do/ /zhes pa'i don no/ ༈ /gu pu sbed pa dang ngan tshig la'o/ /u rjes 'brel/ gub+bh+yaḥ/ gu p rnams las so kyi ched du'o/ /gup rnams zhes pa gup kyi sde tshan rnams te/ gup tidz kit mān badha dān shān rnams las so/ /byings gup la sogs pa las pha rol du rang gi don ched du sa rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /gup sa ti/ gnyis brjod/ p thog ma yal/ gu thog ma dzu/ dzu gup+sa ti/ ༈dzu gup+sa taḥsogs dang*/ ༈ dzu gu p+sa te la sogs pa ste/ 'di gnyis ka'i tshig can no/ ༈tidz bzod pa la'o/ tidz sa ti/ gnyis brjod/ dz phyis/ dz k sa ṣa k+ṣa ti ti k+ṣa ti sogs gzhan don can dang*/ ༈ti ti k+ṣas te/ ti tik+ṣe te la sogs pa bdag don can no/ ༈ kit nad sangs pa dang the tshom la'oyang ngo*/ /kit sa te gnyis brjod/ ku ha la tsu ki dang po tsi/ ta de yal tsi kit+sa te/ nad gso pa'i don te/ gso bar byed do/ /zhes so/ /bi tsi kit+sa ti sogs nyer bsgyur sbyar ba yang byed do/ ༈mān rnam par dpyod pa la'o/ /ji skad du/ mān la yang ngo sogs pa rnams kyi sa la dang po ni ring po'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ mān sa te gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa sogs/ mā thog ma'i ā i dang*/ mān la sogs pa'i sa la i īn phyi ma nga ro/

mī māṃ sa te/ dpyod pa po yin no/ /bdag don no/ ༈mī māṃ sa ti gzhan don can no/ ༈ /badha smad ra la'o/ /badh sa te gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa/ sa la a i'o/ /mān la sogs pa rnams kyi zhes pas/ ī ring po'o/ /bī dang po'i dza ba rnams ba bha ru song*/ kha sa la tsa pa dzha sa rnams zhes pas dh d de yang t bī bhata te la sogs ba'o/ /dān shān gzi brjid la'o/ /dān sa te gnyis brjod sa la a i/ mān la sogs pa'i sa la ring po n snga ma thim phyi ma nga ro/ /dī dāṃ sa te/ gzi brjid 'dod pa'o/ /zhes sogs so/ ༈ /shān sa te gnyis brjod/ n mi snang*/ i ī/ n klad skor shī shāṃ sa te/ zhes sogs te badh dān shān 'di rnams bdag don can nyid gtso che'o/ ༈gup la rnam grangs gzhan gyi dmigs gsal ni/ gupu bsrung ba la'o/ /ā yaḥ/ ā ya'o/ /gup la sogs pa la rkyen ā ya 'jug ste/ dngos po rang rang gi ngo bo'i don la 'jug pa'o/ gup sogs ni gup dhup bik+ṣa paṇ pan zhes pa rnams so/ /ji skad du/ ap min pa la ā ya la sogs pa dag go zhes 'byung*/ byings kyi dang po la yon tan no/ /gu pu u brjod don/ gup ti/ bar du rkyen ā ya byin/ p ā la drangs/ yon tan/ go pā ya ti/ sogs byings thams cad pa'i rnam dbye rnams so/ ༈ /tap dang dhūp ches gdung ba la'o/ /'dir dhū p'o/ /dhūp ā ya ti/ /drangs/ dhū pā ya te sogs dang*/ dhū pā ye t la sogs pa ste gnyis ka'i tshig can no/ /paṇ 'du 'god dang bstod pa dag la'o/ /paṇ ā ya te bzhag/ji skad du/ pa na yang ngo zhes 'byung*/ paṇa zhes pa kho na mtshams sbyor ba'am/ paṇa zhes pa pan du bsgyur te sbyor pa gdam ka byed de/ ṇ'am n ā la 'dren pa kho na'o/ /pa ṇā ya te sogs dang*/ pa nā ye ta la sogs pa'o/ ༈nām+no ya ī tsā s+ya/ ming la ya ste ā ī'ang ngo*/ /ming gi byings la 'dod pa'am re smon gyi don du ya rkyen 'byung ste/

de'i tshe ming mtha' 'am/ byings mtha'i ā yig ni ī yig tu 'gyur ro/ /pu t dang dha na la ti bzhagar du ya byings/ ī pu trī ya ti/ dha nī ya ti/ bu 'dod/ nor 'dod ces pa'o/ ༈ji skad du/ u da ka ni u dan tu kun du bsgyur ro/ /zhes bshad/ ud ka mits+tsha ti/ chu 'dod pa'o/ /u da ka ya ti/ u dan zhes pa n yig mtha' can du bsgyur/ n ya la drangs*/ u ra n+ya ti/ zhes pa la logs pa'o/ /but ti ji skad du 'dod pa rnams kyi don du/ ming rnams la kāmya rkyen du 'dod do zhes 'byung*/ bar du kāmya rkyen no/ /pu tra kā mya ti bu 'dod pa yin no/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /ka ra ṇe tsa yaḥ/ byed pa la ya'ang ngo*/ /kaṇ+ḍu zhes pa'i byings sogs la byed pa'i don ston pa'i phyir rkyen ya nyid 'jug go /kaṃḍu/ /ti/ /ya byin/ kaṇ+ḍu ya ti/ za phrug byung zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /par smai'o/ nyir+ḍit+ka ta ṇe/ byed pa la nyi ḍi t'o/ /ming gi byings ghaṭa la sogs pa mang po ste/ de byings so zhes 'byung ba/ ming nyid byings zhes gzhi mthun pa'o/ /de la byed pa'i don ston pa'i phyir nyi rkyen du 'jug /nyi de la ḍit kyi ming 'dogs pa ṭi dbyi ba'i dgos pa yin/ nya yig 'phel ba'i khyad don i 'joganyi tāṃ hra swe/ nyi nyid la thung ngu'o/ /byings kyi gzhung rgyas pa las nyi'o zhes klog pas/ sbyir btang rkyen gang la nya rjes 'brel de 'phel ba'i don yin yang nyi rang nyid kho na la sngon gyi byings thung ngu nyid la gnas kyi ring por mi 'gyur la/ ci ste ring po yin yang thung ngur 'gyur ro/ /'di la ap byed pa po lo'i zhes ap 'byung ngo*/ /rkyen gyi i nyid yon tan e ay bar du'o/ ༈ghaṭa tip nyi ny rjes 'brel de ḍit la ṭi/ dbyi/ drangs/ gha ṭi ti/ a'i u padhā'o/ /zhes u pa dhā ring po/ ghā zhes pa thob pa ltar snang yang*/ nyi nyid la thung ngu'o zhes spyir btang bkag nas/

dmigs gsal la u pa dhā 'phel ba dang ring po nyi rkyen bzhag go bar du ap byin/ gha ṭi a ti zhes 'byung*/ yon tan/ ghaṭe/ e ay/ ghaṭā ay a ti byung*/ drangs/ gha ṭa ya ti/ zhes sogs so/ /gha ṭaṃ ka ro ti/ bum pa byed do/ /zhes pa'i don no/ ༈ma han tip nyi i ṭi phyis/ mah i ti/ i e/ ay/ ma ha ya ti la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /bah thob pa la'o/ /bah tip ba ū ru bsgyur/ h ni ḍh dang*/ a ni i ru/ ā de sha byed de/ ba ha ni ū ḍh ru bsgyur ba'o/ /ūḍha nyi ap ti/ i yon tan/ e ay/ ū ḍha ya ti/ zhes sogs te/ ༈di p sogs la aṭ aṭ ū u la o/ o la au au ḍha yat la sogs pa'o/ /gong bha ba ti dang 'dra ba'i lugs so/ ༈pṛ thā de raḥ bṛ tha sogs la ra'o/ /byings pṛ tha sogs la ṛ yig ra ru bsgyur ba khyad par ro/ /pṛ tha yangs pa la'o/ /pṛth nyi ap ti p pṛ tha sogs la ra'o/ /pṛ p ru song*/ gong bzhin sgrubs pra tha ya ti sogs so/ /dṛ ḍha nyi/ ap/ ti/ ṛ ra/ dra ḍha ya ti sogs so/ /de dag gis ni byed pa'i rkyen rnams bshad zin to/ / ༈ //byings la byed du 'jug pa la'o/ /byed du 'jug pa'i don la shis byed kyi rnam dbye kho na la rag ma lus te/ nyi rkyen gyis bskul ba'am/ bka' sbyin pa dang*/ pho nya btang ba sogs rang gi dgos don gyi bya ba'am/ ༈gzhan gyi bya ba yin yang rung rang gi dngos su mi byed par gzhan byed du 'jug pa ste/ 'di'i 'grel pa 'du 'god kyi dgos pa'i don la byed du 'jug pa zhes gsungs don 'du 'god ni gtong len dang*/ gsog zad dang 'phel 'grib dang*/ 'du bral byed pas 'dod don sgrub pa'o/ ༈kṛ nyi ap ti ṛ/ yon tan/ ar/ i e ru song*/ de ay drangs/ ka ra ya ti sogs pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ pā tsa ya ti dang*/ pre ra ya ti sogs mang po'o/ ༈shā su rjes su skyong ba la'o/ /shā su tip nyi ap su'i u o/

so/ o ab shā sap i a ti byung*/ i e/ e ay/ y a la drangs/ a nu gong a nu shā sa ba/ ya ti sogs laṭa ling loṭ rnams dang*/ a n+wa shā sa ba ya ti/ sogs la d rnams so/ /ha no ghat/ ha n'i ghata'o/ khams han ni in dang ap kyi rkyen med pa'i skabs nyit ṇit kyi rkyen dang dbyangs pha rol la khms nyid ghat zhes par bsgyur ro/ /hannyi ap ti han ghat du bsgyur/ u pa dhā ring po/ yon tan/ a y/ ghā ta ya ti/ ༈ghā ta yet/ ༈ghā ta ya tu/ ༈a ghā ta yat/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈sha deḥshat/ sha da'i shatra'o/ /sha d-il sdigs pa la'o/ /l̥ rjes 'brel/ shad/ tip/ nyi/ ap nya so?ng*/ i/ shad shat ru bsgyur/ u pa dhā ring*/ shāt i a ti/ yon tan/ ay drangs/ shā ta ya ti sogs/ a shā ta yat sogs so/ ༈rā to nyau buk /ṛ āt dag gi nyi la buk'o/ /dbyangs ṛ nyid dang ā mtha' can la nyi rkyen pha rol du bkod na/ puk ā ga ma 'byung ngo*/ ༈ /ḍudāny dā rip nyi puk ap rnams rim pas ster/ k rjes 'brel u brjod don/ dāb i ati zhes byung i e/ e ay/ drangs/ dā pa ya te sogs/ a dā ba yat la sogs pa'o/ ༈ṣ+ṭhā 'gro ba 'gog pa la'o/ /ṣ+ṭhā tip/ ṣ+ṭhā s+thā ru song*/ nyi buk ap gong bzhin sgrubs s+thā ba ya ti/ sogs/ yā thob pa la'o/ /yā ba ya ti sogs gong bzhin no/ ༈ /ji skad du/ ṛ ātra dag gi buk mtha'i yon tan no/ zhes bshad pas ṛ 'gro ba la'o/ /ṛnyi buk/ ap/ tip/ ṛ yon tan/ ar/ b.i/ a ti byung*/ b i la drangs/ de la r drangs yon tan ay arba ya ti/ aṭa/ ārba ya ti/ aṭ ārba yat la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /ji skad du/ ing sogs kyi nyi la pu?k'o/ /zhes 'byung bas id smrang 'don na la'o/ ik dran pa la'o/ /ing dang ik gi ng dang k phyis/ i i zhes lus sgrub lugs gcigagrub gzugs gcigadon tha dad do/ ༈ing dang ik'i byings la bi dang a bhi mi 'jug gzhan nyer sgyur ci rigs pa 'jug pa las a ba dang a dhi gnyis lhag par 'jug pa mang ngo*/

/i buk/ nyi/ ap/ ti zhes pa bzhag/b i a ti la/ p ya ti gong bzhin/ a dhi sngon du bzhag i dang 'dra ring 'phel ba dhai ā y y dbyi/ a dhā ba ya ti sogs so/ ༈ji skad du/ hrīklīrī i di krī dzi lī zhes pa 'di rnams i yig mtha' ste/ nyi pha rol yuk'o/ /zhes bshad pas gong gi ing sogs ni de dag go/ ༈eḥ i'i ā'o/ /byings de rnams las hrī yon tan byed i ā ru mi 'gro /gzhan de rnams la byings mtha'i i yig ā ring por 'gro/ yon tan mi byed do/ ༈hrī buk/ nyi/ ap/ ti/ zhes bkod/ yon tan/ ehre/ gzhan 'dra/ hre pa ya te/ ༈līng rnam par 'khyams pa la'o/ /ng rjes 'brel/ lī/ buk/ nyi/ ap/ tip/ bzhag i'i ā'o/ /lī'i ī ā ru song*/ lā gzhan 'dra/ nyer sgyur bi sngon du bzhag/bi lā pa ya ti/ dip la bya lā ba yat la sogs pa'o/ ༈ji skad du/ pa da sogs la yuk'o/ /zhes 'byung ste/ buk gi dod du yuk ster k rjes 'brel u brjod don y lus so/ /pā zhes pa'i khams la yuk/ nyi/ ap/ ti rnams sbyar/ y i la drangs gzhan 'dra/ pā ya ya ti la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /shīng nyal ba la'o/ /sho phra mor byed pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i shīng ng rjes 'brel/ shī de la rnam dbye sbyar ba tsam gyi yon tan te/ she mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge byung*/ she dang sho la yuk nyi/ ap/ rip/ sbyar/ mtshams sbyor yi ge rnams la ā'o/ /zhes pas she dang sho gnyis ka/ shā zhes par song*/ gzhan 'dra/ shā ya ya ti sogs so/ ༈ /ji skad du/ brīny dhūny dang la nuk yang na'o/ /zhes te brīny khyor chu sbyin pa la'o/ /dhūny skyod pa la'o/ /buk dang yuk dod du nuk ster ro/ /brīnu k/ nyi/ ap/ ti/ k dang u yal n i la drangs/ ṣa ri ra sogs ni ṇiru song*/ yon tan sogs brī ṇa ya ti sogs so/ ༈/de bzhin du/ dhū na ya ti la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /dzān la sogs pa rnams la nyi rkyen gyi skabs 'dir yang na thung ngur bsgyur ba'ang yin te/

/dzā na yod ba'i dper brjod ni/ /dz+nyā khong du chud pa la'o/ /dz+nyā buk/ a/ tip zhes pa bzhag/yang na thung ngur bsgyur te/ dz+nya pa ya ti sogs/ gzhan dz+nyā pa ya ti sogs so/ ༈ /ji skad du/ sa la ring po ste/ iṭ is yang na'o/ /zhes bshad pas dzan yod pa'i byings buk rkyen dang 'brel byed/ 'jug gi skabs 'dir byings gnyis brjod kyi dang po ring por 'gyur ba dang*/ phyi ma'i dbyangs is su 'gyur ba dang*/ iṭ yod med gdam ka ste/ is su 'gyur na dang po yal/ nyi med/ iṭ spangs pa'o/ /is mi byed na/ dang po'i ā i ru 'gro/ nyi dang iṭ 'jug go ༈dz+nyā tip sa buk dz+nyāb sa ti byung*/ gnyis brjod/ phyi ma'i ā is/ dang po dbyi/ dz+nyis bas ti byung*/ s dbyangs med yal/ ī ring por song*/ b sa la drangs/ dz+nyīp+sa ti/ zhes sogs so/ ༈yang na/ dz+nyā buk/ nyi/ iṭs ti zhes pa bzhag/gnyis brjod/ dang po thung ngu*/ de i ru song*/ thog ma'i ha sa sogs dz+ny'i nya mi? snang dzi ru song b i b y/ y dbyi/ dang sbyar/ yi/ ku i la sogs/ sa ṣa/ dzi dz+nyā ba yi ṣa ti/ zhes pa la sogs ba'o/ ༈ /tsu rā dernyiḥ/ tsu ra sogs la nyi'o/ /byings tsu ra la sogs pa'i sde la/ rang gi bya ba'i tshig 'byung ba'i don la nyi rkyen du ster ro/ /tsu ra rkun po la'o/ /tsur/ nyi/ ap/ tip/ byings dang po la yon tan/ drangs/ yon tan ay sogs gong bzhin/ tso ra ya ti/ ༈pā la srung ba la'o/ /pāl nyi/ ap/ ti/ yon tan med/ byings 'phel ba dang grub/ pā la ya ti/ ༈tsi tī sañdz+nyā ne/ tsi tī 'du shes la'o/ /tsi tī/ nyi/ ap/ ti/ ī brjod don/ yon tan/ tse gzhan sngar bzhin/ tse ta ya ti/ ༈tsi ti dran pa la'o/ /i brjod don/ tsitnyi/ ap/ ti/ tsi dang t'i bar du mum ā ga ma'i um yal/ mng ro gzhan snga ma bzhin/ tsin+ta ya ta/ artsa mchod pa la'o/ /artsa/ nyi ap ti pa rnam 'gyur gsar pa med/ ar+ts+tsa ya ti/

yang*/ tsu r la ni at+ma ne'i rkyen byed kyang rung ste/ de'i tshe nyi yang bdag don du ster/ ny n rjes 'brel/ bdag don gyi don rtags su byed do/ /des na tsur sogs la spyir btang gzhan don gyi tshig can yang dmigs gsal la gnyis don gyi tshig can du yang byed ces pa'i don te/ tso ra ya te la sogs pa'o/ ༈nye ra ngo dwi tsa/ nyi dang ang la gnyis kyang ngo*/ /nyi kho na dang ang kho na ma yin par nyi dang ang gnyis sdebs kyi mtha' can gyi byings te/ 'das pa tsam gyi don sgrub pa la nyi ru ma zad ang yang rkyen du ster te/ dip sogs pa ra smai pha rol du yod pa'o/ /sa rkyen spangs kyang byings gnyis brjod do/ /ang gi ng ni yon tan spangs/ khyad don no/ ༈tsur tsur/ nyi/ a ng/ dip/ dang po'i ha sa/ nye/ nya'o/ /iṭ dang ap med pa'i yul la 'das pa'i don gyi skabs 'dir rkyen nyi dbyi ste/ ny rtags don snga nas yal bar ma zad i yang mi snang bar byed do/ /de yang nyi rkyang pa dbyi ba min kyang a byung bas nyi dbyi'o/ /la gho dīr+ghaḥ/ thung ngu ring por ro/ /ang pha rol yod pa'o/ /byings kyi thog ma na thung ngu yod na ring por byed do/ /tsū tsur byung nyi yal gzhan snga ma bzhin tsū tsu rat/ aṭ gong a tsū tsu rat/ ces pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /bid shes pa la'o/ aṭ bid bid ad ྄dip thog ma'iha sa thung ngu ring por ro/ /a pī bi dat la sogs pa'o/ ༈duh yongs su gang ba la'o/ /aṭ duh du h ang dip/ snga ma bzhin a dū du hat ces pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈a ngi la ghauh swa u pa dhā yāḥ ang dang thung ngu la u pa dhā thung ngu'o/ /pats pats/ nyi/ angdip/ dang po ha sa a.ī ring po/ nyi dbyi/ aṭ gong a pī pa tsat/ ༈pā la pa la nyi ang dip/ dang po ring po/ gdod nas grub mod ī ru song*/ pā phyi ma u pa dhā thung ngur song*/ a ṭ a bī pa lat/ ༈a pa ṭh pa

ṭha/ nyi ang dip/ snga ma dang 'dra/ apī pa that/༈ /pa da la pra ti sngon du bzhag/prati aṭ pad ྄pad/ nyi ang dip/ sngar bzhin sgrubs pas/ pra t+ya pī pa dat/ sogs so/ ༈ /ghaṭ sgyu 'phrul la'o/ /ghaṭ/ nyi/ ang*/ dip gnyis brjod/ ṭ dang po dang nyi yal/ gha dang po dzha de dza/ de dzi/ ring po/ aṭ/ a dzī ghaṭat/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /na ṛtaḥ ṛt kyi ma yin no/ /ṛ yig rjes 'brel can gyi byings pha rol du ang brjod pa can yin mod kyang*/ u pa dhā sngar nas thung ngu can yin na der zad/ sngar ring po yin na thung ngur mi bsgyur ro/ ḍhau kṛ 'gro ba la'o/ /ḍhaukṛ/ ṛ rjes 'brel/ ḍhauk nyi a ngdip gnyis brjod k thog ma dbyi/ thog ma'i dbyangs thung ngu u ste ḍhu/ dzhapa las dza ba ste ḍu/ nyi yal/ aṭ a ḍu ḍhaukat/ ḍhau ka ti taṃ an+ya pre ra yet/ gzhan dag 'gro ru 'jug go ༈ /de dang 'dra bar yāts nyi/ a dip gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa/ nyi yal/ aṭ/ a ya yā tsat/ zhes sogs so/ ༈ /yā tsa ya ti ti a n+ya prer yet/ gzhan dag slong mo byed du bcug go ༈ji skad du/ rab sbyor la ra gnyis ma yin no/ /zhes bshad pas gnyis brjod skabs gsal byed rab sbyor la ra yig yod na gnyis su mi 'gro ste/ rkyen mtha' 'das don gyi skabs 'dir nges pa'o/ /artsi i/ brjod don artsnyi.ang dip gnyis brjod yin yang r yig mi 'phel bas ats arts byung*/ ts snga ma dbyi/ ny yal/ i buk ā ga ma ster uk phyis aṭ a a/ artsa ྄i b ang ces pa byung*/ mtshams sbyar/ drangs ārtsi bt༈ zhes pa la sogs ba'o/ ༈ /bt thob pa la'o/ /ba heḥk+ti/ ba ha la k+ti'o/ /byings ba ha la rkyen k+ti ster ro/ /bah k+ti nyi ang dip/ zhes pa bzhag sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa bya ste ba u ha'i ḍha/ k yal ti dhi/ dhi ḍhi aṭ dbyangs dang po yang aṭ/ a.e/ uḍh ḍhi/ i.ang ces pa byung*/ ḍhi'i i ṭi yin nyi'i i ḍit mthong bas yal/

nyi i yang ang gi a mthong bas thim ḍha gong ma bsubs/ phyi ma a la drangs/ nyi dang ang la gnyis kyang ngo*/ /zhes gnyis brjod byed ḍha ḍha/ angi pūrba s+ya ḍha s+ya dzaḥ/ ang gi snga rol gyi ḍha ni dza'o/ /bar rkyen ang pha rol du yod pa'i ḍha dang po dza yig tu 'gyur ro/ /a u o/ o au au/ gnas med pa la yang na'o/ /d t au dza ḍhat/ zhes pa la sogs pa dip sogs dgu'o/ ༈ṣ+ṭhā 'gro ba las ldog pa la'o/ /ṣ+ṭhā nyi ang dip/ ṣs/ ṭhāthā/ s+thā da sogs kyi i'o/ /s+thi gnyis brjod/ s+thi s+thi/ s dang po dbyi/ tha ta ti'i nus pas/ sṣ/ thaṭha/ tiṣ+ṭha aṭ pra ti sngon pra t+ya tiṣ+ṭha/ kha cig nyi ang byin pas/ pra t+yi tiṣ+ṭha yat 'byung bar 'dod/ gzhan dag nyi spangs ang byin/ i e/ ey/ pra t+ya ti ṣ+ṭha yat/ zhes 'byung bar 'dod pa 'thad do/ ༈pādip bzhag nyi'i ing de na/ ang pā pī ru bsgyur gong bzhin gnyis brjod/ aṭ/ a pi pi i ang dang po ring*/ nyi'am ing yal/ pi pi iy p ya a la drangs/ a pī pyat/ grub/ ༈yang na nyi'am ing phyis yuk byin/ ya nyid do zhes pas/ pīpyzhes par song ba'i y dbyi pyuk gi ya la drangs bas a pipyat 'byung zer ba'ang yod do/ ༈kra pu rgyags pa la'o/ /u brjod don/ kṛ po ro laḥ/ kṛ pa'i ra la'o/ /kṛpzhes pa'i byings kyi ra yig ni la yig tu bsgyur bar 'gyur ro/ /kṛpnyi/ ap/ ti/ kṛ'i ṛ yig ni yon tan ar/ kar ྄p i a ti/ p.i la r pa la kalpi.ati i e ay drangs kalpa ya ti sogs/ ༈kalpa yetu sogs/ ༈kalpaya tu sogs/ ༈a kalpa yat sogs so/ ༈ /yang kṛp la sgrub tshul gzhan ni kṛp dip bzhaganyi ang*/ gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa sogs p yal aṭ nyer sgyur bi bi a kṛ kṛ p i.ang ces byung*/ nyi'o zhes pas i yal/ ṛ a'o/ zhes bas kṛ thog ma ka ang thung ngu la u ba dhā thung ngu'o/ /zhes pa'i khog don la a thung i thung ngu song*/

thung ngu ring po'o zhes pas i thung ī ring por song*/ ku dang ha'i tsu zhes pas kī tsī ru song*/ kṛ 'og ma'i ṛ l̥ ru song*/ bi atsī kl̥ p.ang mtshams sbyar/ bya tsī kl̥ pat/ bya tsā kl̥ pa tāṃ/ bya tsī kl̥ ban/ ༈bya tsī kl̥ paḥ/ bya tsī kl̥ pa taṃ/ bya tsī kl̥ pat/ ༈byatsīkl̥ paṃ/ bya tsīkl̥ pā ba/ bya tsī kl̥ pā ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ /de dag ni byings rkyen mtha' can la ti sogs 'jug tshul gyi rnam 'gyur rags rim du bstan pa'o// ༈ //da ni kun nas bsgyur ba'i khyad par gyi cho ga dag bshad par bya'o/ ḍ-i shā deḥbash+yā diḥ/ dṛ sh+ya la sogs pa rnams kyi pash+ya la sogs pa'o/ /dṛ sha ṛ sṛ sha da dang*/ /sad pā gh+rā dh+mā dang*/ /s+thā m+nā dā ṇa 'o/ /dṛsh sogs so/ ༈pa sh+ya ṛ ts+tsha dhā ba dang*/ /sī ya sī da b dang*/ /dzi gh+rā dhā ma tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ /ma na yats+tsha zhes pa'o/ / pa sh+ya sogs so/ ༈ /dṛ sha zhes pa pa sh+ya'o/ /ṛ ni ṛts+tshar bsgyur bar bya/ /sha da shī ya sṛ dhā ba/ sa da sī da pā pi ba/ gh+rā ni dzi gh+ra dh+ma dha ma/ /s+thā ni tiṣ+ṭha m+nā ma na/ /dā ṇa ya ts+tshar bsgyur bar bya/ ༈ /de yang dṛ shir mthong ba la'o/ /ṛ 'gro ba la'o/ /sṛ 'gro ba po la'o/ /shang-il sdigs pa la'o/ /ṣangil gyes pa dang 'gro ba dang rdul 'bab pa la'o/ /pā btung ba la'o/ /gh+rā dri snom pa la'o/ /dh+ma sgra dang me sbyor ba la'o/ /ṣ+ṭhā 'gro ba 'gog pa la'o/ /m+nā byang po la'o/ /dā ṇa sbyin pa la'o/ /zhes pa byings bcu gcig po de ni dṛ sh la sogs pa'i ming can no/ ༈de rnams pa sh+ya la sogs par bsgyur ba ni rnam 'gyur dang byings kyi gzhi mthun pa'o/ ༈ /dṛ shir ir yal/ dṛ sh tip/ dṛshpash+ya ru bsgyur ap byung*/ phyis drangs/ pa sh+ya ti/ /byings thams cad pa'i par smai so drug po sbyor te/ a thung mtha' can bha ba skabs kyi lugs bzhin sgrub pa kho na te go bla'o/ /༈ṛtip ap byung*/

ri ts+tsha ru bsgyur ṛts+tsha ti sogs/ /sṛ tip ap byung dhā par bsgyur dhā ba ti sogs/ ༈shang-il tip/ l̥ rjes 'brel/ ap byung*/ phyis/ shang shī ya ti sogs so/ ༈shī ya te la sogs pa a t+ma ne sum cu so drug e dha la sogs pa'i skabs bzhin no/ ༈ ṣang-il a p tip/ l̥ rjes 'brel/ ṣad/ ṣa sa/ sad sīd ru bsgyur/ sī da ti sogs so/ ༈ /pā/ ap/ tip/ pi ba tu bsgyur pi ba ti sogs so/ /gh+rā/ ap/ tip/ dzi gh+ra ru bsgyur/ dzigh+ra ta sogs so/ ༈dh+mā tip bzhaga.ap/ dha ma ru bsgyur/ dha ma ti sogs so/ ༈ṣ+ṭhā aptip ṣ s ṣā thā s+thā/ ti ṣ+ṭha ru bsgyur tiṣ+ṭha ti sogs so/ ༈m+nā.ap tip/ ma na ru bsgyur ma na ti sogs so/ ༈ dāṇ ap tip/ ṇ/ dā n/ yats+tsha ru bsgyur/ yats+tshi ti la sogs pa'o/ /bsgyur zin pa'i byings thams cad a thung yin pa a de mi snang bar byas ap gyi a srog tu bcug pa 'ba' zhig yin no/ ༈ /ga māṃ tshaḥ/ gam rnams kyi tsha'o/ /gam la sogs pa rnams kyi mthar rten dbyangs bral rnams tsh yig tu 'gyur ro/ /ga m sogs ni gam/ iṣu/ yam gsum mo/ ༈gaml̥ l̥ rjes 'brel gam ap tip ces bzhagam tsh ru bsgyur/ tsh gnyis su song*/ dang po ts/ drangs/ gats+tsha ti sogs so drug go ༈i ṣu 'dod pa la'o/ /u rjes 'brel/ iṣ ap tip/ ṣ tshr 'gro ba ni mdo 'dir ma zad gong na'ang yod/ sgrub tshul gam dang 'dra/ its+tsha ti sogs so drug go ༈ya ma mtshams gcod pa la'o/ /ma'i a dbyi/ yam ap/ tip/ yats+tsha ti la sogs pa la yig bzhi po rnams so/ ༈dz+nyā dza nordzā/ dz+nyā dza nī dag gi dzā'o/ /dza nī bskyed pa la'o/ /dz+nyā khong du chud pa la'o/ /dz+nyā zhes pa'i byings dzā ru bsgyur ba dang*/ dza nī zhes pa'i byings kyang dzā ru bsgyur ba yin/ bar rkyen ya dang na gdam ka yin/ gnyis ka ap phyis pa'i yul te shul du ster ro/ ༈dz+nyā ap tip bzhaga.a p phyis/

ya ster te dip sogs pa ya'o/ /zhes/ dza nī dang dz+nyā ni byings di bu sogs la gtogs ba'o/ /dz+nyā dzā ru bsgyur/ /dzā ya ti la sogs pa pa ra smai byings thams cad pa rnams so/ ༈yang kṛ sogs la nā'o/ /zhes pas ya rkyen gyi dod du nā rkyen du ster/ dz+nyā ap te/ a phyis/ nā dzā ru bsgyur/ ha sa la ī'o/ /ṇī dzā nī te/ zhes sogs byings thams cad pa'i āt+ma ne rnams so/ ༈dza nī la yang de dang 'dra ste/ dza nī ap te/ ap yal/ ya dzā ru bsgyur/ dzā ya ti/ zhes sogs so/ ༈dza nī ap/ ti a ya la nā/ dzā ru bsgyur/ dzā nā ti sogs pa ra smai dang*/ ༈de dang 'dra ba la ha sa la ī'o zhes/ nī te dzā nī te/ zhes sogs āt+ma ne rnams so/ ༈shru baḥ shṛḥ shru nyid ni shṛ'o/ /shru thos pa la'o/ /byings shru ni shri tu bsgyur/ dbyangs sogs la nu'o/ /zhes pas 'di la ap med de nu 'jog go shru nu tip/ shru shṛ ru bsgyur/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs na ṇa/ pit la yon tan/ ṇu ṇo shṛ ṇo ti/ ༈ pāwa de hra swaḥ/ pū la sogs pa la thung ngu'o/ /pu ny gya nom pa'o/ /ny rjes 'brel pu ti p nā rkyen pū la sogs pa la ring po thung ngur bsgyur bas pu nā ti la sogs pa'o/ /de dag gi kun nas bsgyur ba'i khyad par raṃ bye brag tu bsgyur ba'i rnam grangs che long tsam mo/ ༈ni bi shā deḥ bi sha sogs la ni'o/ /bi sha sogs kyi byings la sngon du nyer sgyur ni bzhag go /de yang bdag don gyi tshig can te/ ā te la sogs pa rnams sbyar/ bi sha rab tu 'jug pa la'o/ /bish.ap/ te/ ni sngon du bzhag/ni bi sha te/ zhes so/ bi parwa bh+yāṃ dzeḥ bi pa ra dag dzi la'o/ /dzi rgyal ba la'o/ /'di la byings kyi yon tan dang*/ e ay byed/ dzi ap ti/ bi sngon/ yon tan/ dze e ay drangs/ bi dza ya te/ ༈yang na pa rā bzhag pa rā dza ya te/ ༈nyer sgyur med na pa ra smai ti dza ya ti/ ༈rtsa bas ma zin pa'i 'phros don la/

ṣ+ṭhā.apte s+thā ate tiṣ+ṭha ru bsgyur/ a ba gong de'i yang sngon pra ti ṭha'i a yal/ bi ka ra ṇa'i a la drangs nyer sgyur gnyis mtshams sbyar/ pra t+ya ba tiṣ+ṭha te/ ༈dṛ shir ap/ te/ ir song pash+yaru bsgyur sam gong sam+pa sh+ya te/ ༈gam ap te tsh ru song*/ saṃ/ saṃ gats+tshate/ ༈shru nu te/ shṛ ru bsgyur/ ṣa ra ṛ na ṇa/ shṛ ṇu te/ saṃ gong*/ saṃ shṛ ṇu te/ ༈bid ap te a dbyi/ d t/ saṃ sngon/ saṃ nit+te/ ༈bṛtsh ap te saṃ gong*/ saṃ pṛts+tsha te/ ༈āng gong byas na/ ā pṛts+tshati/ ༈tan te bar rkyen u tan/ u te/ āng gong*/ ā tanu te/ ༈ā da do3 nā s+ya bi ha ra ṇe/ dā la āng ste rnam par phye ba ma yin ba 'di la'o/ /byings dā sogs la kha gdangs pa sogs rnam par phye ba'i don/ pa ra smai thob kyi/ āt+ma na mi 'byung*/ rnam par phye ba ma yin pa'i don te/ rnam phye las gzhan pa'am lhag ma la āt+ma nai'i lugs dang bya byed 'jug go ༈dā ap te/ a 'jig gnyis brjod/ dang po thung*/ āng sngon/ dā phyi ma'i srog mi snang t ru song*/ ād t+te/ āng don mang yang skabs 'dir/ lugs dang khrims dang*/ mtshams bcad pa dang*/ dbye 'byed kyi don la 'jug pas/ sbyin yul ngan pa la mi ster/ bzang po la ster ba'i don du 'gyur ro/ /'di la rnam par phye ba dang*/ gdangs pa'i don med pas āt+ma ne'o/ ༈yang dā ap tip/ ap yal/ gnyis brjod/ dang po thur ngu āng gong de'i sngon bi iy/ byā da dā ti/ zhes so/ /byā da dā ti tsa ṭa kaḥmu kha/ bye'u tsa ta ka kha gdangs pa'o/ /kṝ ḍo3nu saṃ pa ri bh+yash+tsa/ kṝ ḍa la a nu saṃ pa ri rnams kyang ngo*/ /kṝ ḍa'i byings la nyer sgyur a nu dang saṃ dang pa ri rnams thog mar 'jug ste/ ap bi can no/ kṝḍ/ ap/ te/ a nu gong*/ a nu krī ḍa te/ ༈de bzhin du saṃ krī ḍa te/ ༈pa ri krī ḍa te/ zhes so/ ༈sa ma pa pro pa bi bh+yaḥs+thāḥ/ saṃ a ba pra u pa bi rnams las s+thā'o/

/ṣ+ṭhā/ ap/ te/ ṣ+ṭhā s+thā ru bsgyur/ de tiṣ+ṭha ru kun nas bsgyur/ saṃ gong du bzhag saṃ tiṣ+ṭha te/ de bzhin du a ba tiṣ+ṭha te/ pti ṣ+ṭhate/ u pa tiṣ+ṭha te/ bi tiṣ+ṭha te/ ༈ ut+bhi bh+yāṃ ta baḥ/ ut bi dag ta ba la'o/ /ta ba'i byings la nyer sgyur ut dang bi dag mgor sbyar ro/ /ta pa/ ap/ te/ ut/ gong ut+ta pa te/ ༈bi gong*/ bita pa te/ ༈ā do ya ma ha naḥ/ ya ma dang ha na la.āng'o/ /byings ya ma dang ha na la nyer sgyur āng thog mar 'ong ngo*/ /lo bs+t+wa nu dat+ta nāṃ/ a nu dat+ta rnams dbyi ba nyid do/ /a nu dat+ta ste skad gsangs dma' ba'i yi ge'i nang tshan nya ma so sor bsdu ba ste/ nya nga ṇa na ma byings kyi mtha'o la yod na/ nya ma yi ge de dbyi bar bya'o/ /de yang nyer sgyur āng sbyar ba la yin gyi/ gzhan la min zhing*/ rnam dbye ngit yin zhing dzha sa pha rol can la'o/ ༈'on kyang yam gyi m nya ma'i yi ge yin/ gong du tsh a de sha bshad pa ltar yang yin pas gdam ka bya'o/ /yam ap te/ gnyis bzhag/m tsh drangs/ tsha gnyis steng ma tsa āng gong*/ ā ya ts+tsha ti/ ༈m tsh ru ma song na dbyi/ ya'i a phyis ap la drangs gzhan 'dra/ ā ya te/ ༈han ap te/ āng gong n yal ha'i a mi snang*/ ap la drangs/ ā ha te/ ༈ā te an+te ā the e rnams la u pa dhā yal/ h dbyangs med gh yig dbyangs med du song*/ n dang gh gnyis ā dang a dang e la drangs an+ti'i n dbyi/ ༈se dang dh+we la dzha sa yin pa'i rgyus/ n yal/ ༈ba he ma he la n dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba nga ro byed pa dang*/ ba ma'i steng du sbyor ba gdam ka yin no/ ༈ā gh+nā te/ a gh+na te/ ༈ā ha se/ ā gh+na the/ ā ha dh+we/ ༈āgh+ne/ ā ha ba he/ ā haṃ ba he/ ā ha n+wa he/ ā ha ma he/ ā haṃ ma he/ ā han+ma te/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈u tash+tsa ra s+t+yā ge /spyod pa dang 'don pa la ut'o/ /spyod pa'am skad gtong ba'i don can/ tsar gyi byings la u t sbyor te/

tsar ap/ te/ ut gong*/ t ts drangs/ uts+tsha ra te sū traṃ/ mdo skad mthon por 'don no/ ༈ji skad du/ sam gsum pa la sbyor ba yang ngo*/ /zhes bshad pas si sogs rnam dbye gsum pa dang sbyor ba'i saṃ dang bcas pa'i tsa ra āt+ma ner 'gyur/ rnam dbye gsum can dang mi sbyor/ pa ra smai'o/ ༈tsar āte saṃ gong*/ ashwaṭā.in/ a shwe na/ ra tha ṭā in/ ra the na/ saṃ tsa rā te a shwe na/ sañtsa rā ter the na/ ༈byā ba pa ri bh+yaḥkri yaḥ krī dngos la bi ab pa ri'o/ /krī te bzhag bar rkyen nā bzhag/bi sngon nā'i ā ring po ī ring por song*/ ṣa ra ṛ'i na ṇa/ bi krī ṇī te/ de bzhin du/ a ba krī ṇī te/ pa ri krī ṇī te/ de yan chad ni byings nyer sgyur sbyor tshul bye brag tu bstan pa mdo tsam mo// ༈ /sha pa khas mi len pa la'o 'di/ la rgya skad du/ u pa lam+bhe zhes pa gcig gis gang la gnod pa byas pa la/ khrims pas rtsad bcad pa na des ngas ma byas zhes khas mi len pa'i don yin/ sha pa ni/ sha pa tha kar+ṇo ti/ rtsad gcod pa rang la zer bas/ sha ba'i byings ni don gnyis po de la ci rigs su 'jug go /'di āt+ma ne pa ti'i byings so/ /sha pa ap/ te/ sha pa te/ zhes pa'o/ ༈dz+nyā shru smṛ dṛ shāṃ sān+ta nā māt/ dz+nyā shru smṛ dṛ sha rnams kyi āt'o/ /dz+nyā la sogs pa byings bzhi po sa rkyen gyi mtha' can la āt+ma ne'i rnam dbye 'jug go ༈dz+nyā/ sa/ te/ gnyis brjod/ dang po thung ngu*/ thog ma'i ha sa/ nya phyis/ dza dzi ru song*/ dzi dz+nyā sa te/ ༈shrus te/ gnyis brjod thog ma'i r phyis phyi ma ring po/ ku i la/ sha shru ṣā te/ ༈smṛs/ te/ sa la ṛ ur/ smur ring por song*/ smrār/ gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ma dang r phyis su lus/ sa ṣa/ su smrar+ṣa te/ ༈dṛshs te gnyis brjod/ sh dang po yal/ ṛ a ru/ a i/ sh k/ sa ṣa/ k+ṣa/ di dṛk+ṣa te/ ༈karmabya ti hā re a n+yat hidhā de rīt/ gcig la 'jug pa'i las hing sa sogs las gzhan pa la āt'o/

/byed po dang bya ba du ma las gcig la byed pa gcig gis 'jug pa'i don la/ āt+ma ne rkyen 'jug go ༈de yang 'tshe ba dang 'gro ba'i don dang/ pa ṭha dang*/ ha sa'i byings la ma yin te 'di rnams la pa ra smai'o/ /han 'tshe ba'o/ /han an+ti/ u pa dhā phyis/ h gh/ bi dang a ti sngon/ drangs/ bya ti ghan+ti/ ༈gaml̥ 'gro ba la'o/ /gam an+ti m tsh/ bi a ti bzhagabya ti ga ts+tshan+ti/ ༈bi a tip/ ṣ/ aṃti/ bya ti pa ṭhan+ti/ ༈bi a ti has aṃ ti/ bya ti ha san+ti/ pa ra smai'o/ ༈bd ap aṃ te/ ap yal/ bi sngon/ mthar/ ba di naḥ/ bi ba dan+te/ ba di naḥ/ rtsod par byed do/ /rtsod pa mkhan no/ āt+ma ne'i dpe ste/ skyes bu sngar rgol phyi rgol gnyis byed pa dam bca' ba dang*/ sun 'byin tha dad pas las rtsod pa gcig la 'jug pa'o/ ༈ /bi a ti bha ba te/ sngon du las kyi don shrad+dha bzhag/shrad+dhā bya ti bha ba te/ mang pos dad pa byed do/ /zhes pa'ang gong dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /kra ma gom pa gnon pa la'o/ /ji skad du/ kra ma'i pa la ring po yang ste/ de nye bar bsgyur ba'i'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ /pa zhes pa pa ra smai te/ k ma'i byings la mgor nyer sgyur dang*/ pha rol pa ra smai yod/ byings kyi dbyangs dang po ring por 'gyur te/ saṃkram ap ti/ kra ring po/ saṅk+rā ma ti/ de bzhin du/ u ba krā mati/ ༈byād bar+yupe bh+yo ra maḥ/ bi āng pa ri u pa rnam las ra ma la pa'o/ /ra ma'i byings nyer sgyur bzhi po sngon du byung na/ pa ra smai pha rol du 'jog/ap 'byung ngo*/ /bi ra ma ti/ ā ra ma ti/ u pa ra ma ti/ ༈brid+bh+yaḥs+yas yorbā/ bṛt rnams las s+ya dang sa dag la yang na'o/ /bṛt rnams ni bṛ t sogs te/ bṛ tu/ bṛdhu/ shṛdhu/ s+yaṃ du/ ka pu rnams so/ /'di rnams la bar rkyen s+ya dang sa gang byung yang nyer sgyur 'jug mi 'jug gdam nga ste/ i'i rkyen byed mi byed kyang gdam nga'o/ /bṛ tu u brjod don bṛt s+ya te i s+ya te yon tan b.r t/

is+ya te/ brti ṣ+ya te/ bi brti ṣ+ya te/ āt+ma ne'o/ ༈ /tip sbyar/ i bor/ gzhan 'dra ba/ r ts+yati t dang r s+ya gyi steng du drangs/ brta s+ya ti/ bi brta s+ya ti/ ༈de bzhin du/ sa rkyen la brti ṣa te/ ༈bar+t+s+n+ya ti/ bi da sbyar gong bzhin no/ ༈mu tsā dermum/ mu ts sogs la mum'o/ /muts/ luts/ bid/ lip/ sits/ kṛt/ khid/ shish/ zhes pa byings brgyad po de ni mu tsa sogs so/ /de rnams la mum ā ga ma ste/ mu dang tsa'i bar sogs byings kyi dbus su 'jug go ༈mut-il grol ba la'o/ /l̥ rjes 'brel/ mut ti/ t ts ru song*/ ts dang ti'i bar du ap mu dang ts'i bar du mum/ m dang u sbas m/ cig shos nga ro/ muṃtsa ti/ muñtsa ti/ ༈bid-il thob pa la'o/ /bid ap ti/ bi dang d'i bar du mum gong bzhin/ bin+da ti/ biṃ da ti/ ༈i di to mum/ i i t la mum'o/ /'dir dpe kha cig la i it la'o zhes pa kho na las mum'o zhes pa mi 'don mod don gcig go /de yang i di taḥzhes pa yod/ it zhes pa dang itaḥmatshams sbyar/ i taḥzhes i nyid ces i yig rang yin/ de la it ces pa ni dbyangs gang phyis pa de la it kyi brda chad byed pas/ i yig īt du byas zhes byings mtha' sngar i yig tu yod pa'i i rang nyid phyis pa'i don no/ /'di la yang byings kyi khrod du mum ā ga ma ster ro/ ༈ /ṭuṇadi yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /'di samṛd+dhi ces pa yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ de ni nor dang ting nge 'dzin gnyis la 'jug go /ṭu dang i phyis ṇad lus so/ /bhū sogs las ap po zhes ap bi 'jug ste/ ṇda.ap te/ ṇa na ru song*/ na dang d'i bar du mum am yal/ m lus de nga ro drangs naṃ da te/ ༈ba di 'dud pa dang bstod pa la'o/ /i phyis bd a b te/ mum/ bam/ d.ate/ baṃ da te/ ༈sha ki ngo zhum pa la'o/ /i phyis ap mum/ shamkra a te/ shaṅka te/ ༈shaṃ ka te sha māṃ dīr+ghaḥ/

sha ma rnams kyi ring po'o/ /sha ma la sogs pa rnams zhes pa am dm tam bh+ram /shm k+ṣam klam maṇ rnams so/ /'di dag la ap dang ya gang rigs gcig ster/ de'i tshe byings kyi dbyangs dang po ring por 'gyur ro/ /ya ster na'ang sngon ap ster dgos pas de phyis pa'i yul la'o/ ༈ /sham dm nye bar zhi ba la'o/ /sham ap/ ti ap phyis/ di bu sogs la ya'o zhes ya bzhag /sha ma sogs la ring por bya/ shā mya ti/ ༈ de bzhin du/ dāmya ti/ ༈bh+ramu g.yo ba la'o/ /u yal/ bh+ram bzhagaji skad du/ bh+ramu kramu klamu/ tsi tru ṭi la ṣ bh+rāsha sh+lāsh dag la ya'i rkyen yang na'o/ /zhes bshad pas sham sogs kyi nang tshan bhm la sogs brgyad kyi khyad chos rkyen ya yig yang na bar byed pa'o/ ༈bh+ram ap hi yang na/ ap yal/ ya byung*/ sha ma sogs kyi ring po bh+rām bh+rā mya ti/ ༈ya mi byed na ap dbyi ba min te bh+ram ati sha ma sogs kyi ring po'o/ /bh+rā ma ti/ ༈ta mu dang kla mu ngan sems la'o/ /tam dang klam la tip dang ap/ ap kyi yul la ya ring po'o/ /tā mya ti/ ༈klā mya ti/ ༈duṣa log par spyod pa la'o/ /ji skad du/ duṣa la yang nyi der 'jug ste kha cig tu'o/ /zhes bshad pas du ṣa nyi/ ap ti/ ny dang p phyis/ i e de ay/ drangs/ dang po ring*/ dū ṣa ya ti/ ༈y+yoḥ/ ya la o'o/ /'di ni y di os y i os/ iy/ ru song*/ yy o la drangs s rnam bcad/ y+yoḥ/ zhes pa byung ste bar rkyen ya yig pha rol du yod pa'i byings kyi dang po'i dbyangs o yod na dbyi ba nyid do/ ༈do dum bur byed pa la'o/ /sho phra mor byed pa la'o/ ༈ /do tip ya dang po'i o phyis d ya ti d ya la drangs d+ya ti/ ༈sho ya ti/ o ya la drangs sh+ya ti/ zhes pa grub bo/ ༈ ṣo mtha'i las la'o/ ṣo ya ti o mi snang*/ ṣs/ drangs/ s+ya ti/ ༈po ru r/ pu yiṛ ur'o/ /ru zhes pa'i r ni ṛ yin mod kha cig rnam bcad yin par 'dod nas pu'i ur'o zhes par smra na'ang don 'dra'o/

/pha rol kit/ ngi?t kyi rnam dbye yod la tshur rol byings pa sde'i yi ge yin/ pa sde de'i yi ge phyi ma dbyangs ṛ yig yod/ ṛ yig ur zhes par 'gyur ro/ ༈mṛng srog 'dor ba la'o/ /mṛ tip sa rkyen/ pu'i ṛ ur/ mur sa ti gnyis brjod/ mur mur/ r dang po yal/ sa la ring po'o/ /u phyi ma ring po'o/ /sa ṣa mu mūr+ṣa te/ ji skad du sa dang lkog gyur sogs la pa ra smai'i tshig go /zhes 'byung bas sa rkyain bshad ma thag pa de yin/ ༈lkog gyur gyi rkyen la mtshon na/ mṛ ṇap/ ṇ dang p yal a bzhag gnyis brjod/ mṛ mṛ/ dang po'i ṛ a/ phyi ma 'phel/ ār/ ma m ār a drangs/ ma mā ra/ zhes so/ ༈yang gal te sa yang med ṇap mi byed na ya ga ster/ at+ma ne byed te/ smṛ yak te bzhag ṛ i ru bsgyur/ mi ya te/ ༈ru dā de tsa tur+ṇāṃ twa sā deḥ/ ru da sogs kyi ha dang ba sa dang po la ste bzhi po rnams la'o/ /ru da sogs kyi byings la pha rol tip sogs byings thams cad pa bzhi'i rnam dbye yod cing*/ ha yig dang ba sa so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge rkyen du yod na/ /iṭ ā ga ma ster ro/ /ad sog la 'jig go /zhes pas ap ster te 'jig go /ru dir mchi ma 'byin pa la'o/ /ir yal rud/ ap/ tip/ pit la yon tan/ ap 'jig /iṭ rod i ti/ ro di ti/ ༈byings ṣ+wap ṣ+wapa/ apti/ a 'jig iṭ ṣ+wa swa swa pi ti/ ༈byings swap swap ap tip a 'jig iṭswa pi ti/ ༈ byings an an ap ti p n ṇ a p 'jig iṭ pra gong 'dra ba ring*/ prā ṇi ti/ ༈de bzhin du pit min pa la yon tan med/ rnam dbye dbyangs la iṭ med/ ru di taḥ/ ru da n+ti/ ༈ro di ṣi/ ru di thaḥ/ ru di tha/ ༈ro di mi/ ru di baḥ/ ru di maḥ/ ༈ji skad du/ ru da sogs kyi ngi dang si dag la iṭ dang aṭ'o/ /zhes bshad pas dip sip phyi ma la/ iṭ dang aṭ gdam khar byed/

gnyis ka bit yin pas byings la yon tan no/ /ru d īṭ dip yon tan no/ /aṭ gong a rod īd/ a ro dīt/ aṭ byin a ro dat/ gzhan 'dra/ ༈rud īṭsip yon tan aṭ gong a rod īs/ a ro dīḥgrub/ a byin/ a ro daḥ/ zhes so/ ༈ /ru da'i sogs khongs gsum po'ang des rigs 'gre/ a swa pīt/ a swa bt/ ༈a swa pīḥ/ a swa baḥ/ zhes dang*/ ༈a swa sīt/ a swa sad/ a swa sīḥ/ a swa saḥ/ zhes dang*/ ༈an pra sngon aṭ kyi sngon du 'jog /p a/ an/ īd mtshams sbyar/ pā ṇit/ prā ṇat/ ༈prā ṇīḥ/ prā ṇaḥ/ zhes pa'o/ /༈ 'grel pa'i dpe kha cig las swa pi ti tsai ba swa si tiḥ prā ṇi tista thā/ dzak+ṣi ti tsai ba bi dz+nya yo ru diḥpañtsa ko ga ṇaḥ/ 'di 'dra ba ni swa pi ti yang ste/ swa si ti dang de bzhin prā ṇi ti/ /dzak+ṣa ti yang 'di dang 'drar shes bya/ /ru da la sogs lnga po tshogs pa'o/ /zhes lung drangs te/ ༈ shwa sa srog la'o/ //shwa si ti/ ༈ /nyi ṣ+wapnyal la'o/ /ṣ+ṭha swa du bsgyur/ swa si ti/ loṭ'i hi dang sbyar na swa pi hi/ ༈yang na an ma yin par byings rang la prāṇa rtsed mo la'o/ /prā ṇi ti/ iṭ kho na las aṭ med pa'ang gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa'o/ /dzak+ṣa dang bha k+ṣa rgod pa la'o/ /sngar bzhin te/ dzak+ṣ iṭ/ tip/ drangs dzak+ṣiti/ dzik+ṣa taḥ/ dzak+ṣa de raṃ to ྅da na usḥ/ dzak+ṣa la sogs pa'i an+ta dang ata dang an us so/ /'di kha skong gi gzhung du 'dod pa dang lung 'dren du 'dod pa gnyis yod/ gang ltar yang*/ dzak+ṣa sogs kyi byings la rnam dbye an+ta ata dang an us su bsgyur ro/ dzak+ṣa dzāgṛ da ṛ drā shā sa/ di dhi beṃ tsī tsa kā sṛ ste byings bdun dzak+ṣa la sogs pa ste/ drang srong thub pa kha cig gi 'di rnams la a bh+ya rta'i ming bzhag go ༈ 'dir aṃ ti a ti bsgyur/ dzak+ṣa ti/ an us su bsgyur bas/ dzak+ṣuḥyong ngo*/ ༈tsakā sṛ mdangs bkrag la'o/ /tsakā sṛ/

ṛ rjes 'brel/ tip bzhagabit la bya ba med/ s ta la drangs/ tsakā sti/ tsa kāstaḥ/ ༈aṃ ti'i nga ro phyis s a la drangs tsa kā sa ti/ ༈dhī/'dzā gṛ gnyid sangs pa la'o/ /dzāgṛ tip/ twa la yon tan/ dzā garti/ ༈tas ngit ha sa yin rnam 'gyur med dzā gṛ taḥ ༈dzā gṛ aṃ ti/ a tir bsgyur ngit dbyangs yin/ ṛ r dzā/ gr.ati drangs dzā gra ti/ zhes so/ ༈ /da ri drā de ri dā lo pash+tsa di ti/ dā ri dra sogs kyi ngit la i te a dbyi ba'o/ byings da ri drā sogs la pha rol rnam dbye ngit dbyangs dang po can byung na/ byings mtha' ā dbyi bar 'gyur zhing*/ ngit ha sa dang po can byung na/ byings mtha' ā ring po i thung du 'gyur ro/ ༈ /da ri drā ngan par 'gro ba la'o/ /da ri drā tip/ rnam 'gyur med/ da ri drā ti/ ༈tas ni ngi tha sa yin te/ da ri drā tas/ byings mtha'i ā i ru song*/ da ri dri taḥ/ ༈da ridrā.aṃ ti/ byings mtha'i ka a phyis d a la drangs da ri dra ti/ zhes sogs so/ /shās rjes su 'thor ba la'o/ /shās zhes pa'i byings 'di da ri drā sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs mtshon byed yin/ nus pa dang cho ga gcig kyang rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba 'byung bas nges pa skyed pa'i don du bshad do/ /de yang cis zhe na/ da ri drā zhes pa dbyangs ā ring po'i mtha' yin/ shās gsal byed mtha' can yin pas mi 'dra ste/ ā mtha'i i ru 'gyur yang s mtha' i ru mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang nus pa dang cho ga'i bya ba 'dra ba ni/ /snga mar ngit gsal byed mthong na dbyangs i ru 'gyur ba'i dod u pa dhā i ru 'gyur ba yin no/ shās tip pit la rnam 'gyur med/ s ta la drangs/ shāsti/ ༈shās tas gsal byed u pa dhā i shi/ ku i la/ s ṣ/ ṣa mthong ta ṭa shiṣ+taḥ/ ༈shās aṃ ti nga ro phyis/ ā mtha' yin na yal bar byed kyang*/ s mtha' la dbyangs med pas mi dbyi ste/

a la drangs/ shā sa ti/ ༈shā s yāt/ u ba dhā i/ s ṣa drangs/ shiṣ+yāt la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /ī ḍī shoḥ/ īḍa dang ī sha dag gi'o/ /dpe kha cig las ni/ īḍa dang ī sha dag gis dang dh+we la iṭ'o/ /zhes bshad do/ 'di gzhan gyi lung du byas pa'ang snang ste don la 'dra'o/ /byings īḍa dang ī sha la sbyor ba'i se dh+we'i rnam dbye'i sngon du iṭ ā ga ma ster ro/ ༈ /īḍ bstod pa la'o/ /īsh dbang phyug spyod pa la'o/ /īḍa/ te/ ī sha te bzhag kha sa la tsa pa sogs te ḍe ḍ/ iṭ+ṭe/ sh ṣ ru song*/ te ṭe ru song drangs/ iṣ+te/ ༈ā ḍā te/ ī shā te/ aṃ te a te/ īḍate/ ī sha te/ ༈des mtshon iṭa/ ī ḍiṣe/ ī ṣi ṣe/ ༈ī ḍā the/ ī shā the/ iṭ/ īḍi dh+we/ ī shi dh+we/ ī ḍe/ ī she/ ༈ī ḍā he ī shwa he/ ༈īḍ+ma he/ īsh+ma he/ ༈o rau/ u'i au'o/ /da lta 'chad 'gyur yu sogs byings bzhi la sogs pa mang po zhig rnam dbye mthong na byings kyi u yig au ru 'gyur te de yang ti sogs thams cad la ma yin pit kyi ming can la ta sa/ thog mar yod pa la'o/ /yu nu ru stu bh+ya īrbā/ yu nu ru stu rnams las ī r yang na'o/ /yu sogs bzhi la yang u 'phel ba aur 'gro /yang na yon tan o ru song ba īr rkyen du ster/ r rjes 'brel lo/ ༈ /yu tipa ྄/ u au ru song*/ yau ti/ ༈yu īr ti/ yu yon tan/ o ab ya ap ī ti/ ya bī ti/ ༈des mtshon ru tip/ rau ti/ ra bī ti/ ༈nu tip/ nauti/ na bī ti/ ༈stu tip/ stau ti/ sta bī ti/ ༈ngitl cho ga gzhan te/ stu tas/ stu taḥ/ ༈nu byings la'o zhes pas u ni urba ru bsgyur ba dbyangs rkyen la yin te/ stu aṃ ti/ u ni/ ub ru bsgyur/ stu ban+ti/ ༈stu sip/ stau ṣi/ yang na yon tan īr/ sta bī ṣi la sogs pa'o/ /lo pa sta nu dat+ta ta nāṃ/ tan rnams a nu dat+ta la dbyi'o/ /tan sogs kyi byings la a nu dat+ta nya ma so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge ste sde pa'i lnga pa rnams yod na dbyi ste/

kit dang ngit dzha sa'i yi ge thog ma can pha rol du yod pa la'o/ ༈ /han tip/ 'di ngit min/ pit yin pa dbyi ba min/ n nga ro/ haṃ ti/ ༈tan tas/ ngit dzha sa pha rol can yin pas nya ma'i yi ge n dbyi/ ha haḥ/ a ti dbyangs yin/ dzha sa min/ han aṃ ti gam rnams kyi dbyangs la'o zhes pas u pa dhā a yig yal/ h dbyangs med/ gh ghn aṃ ti drangs/ gh+nan+ti/ ༈namaḥ/ nam la'o/ /bar rkyen nam byung na'ang*/ nya ma'i yi ge byings la yod pa de dbyi'o khyad par du na yig nges par dbyi'o/ /hing si 'tshe ba la'o/ /i brjod don hi ngas tip/ tu dha sogs la nam'o/ /hing dang s'i bar du nam/ m rjes 'brel/ hing ti byung*/ ha'i mthar brten ng'am klad skor n nyid yin pas dbyis drangs/ hi na sti/ ༈hings tas nam hingnas/ tas hi ng gi nga ro snga ma yal/ na'i a phyis/ n nga ro drangs/ hiṃ staḥ/ ༈de dang 'dra s a la drangs hid+san+ti/ ༈bhadz bsnyed pa la'o/ /bhadz/ tip/ nam/ bhan/ dzti/ dz ṣ ru song*/ ṣk bha nak+ti/ ༈na ྄nga ro/ dz ṣ k/ bhaṃ k+taḥ/ ༈dbyangs dang phrad drangs/ bhaṃ dzan+ti/ ༈a pi raṃ dza daṃ sha ṣaṃ dza ṣ+waṃ dzāṃ/ raṃ dz daṃsh ṣaṃdza ṣ+waṃdz rnams ap kyi'o/ raṃdz la sogs pa 'di rnams ap dang bcas pa'i rnam dbye pha rol u pa dhā'i n dbyi'o/ /de raṃdz zhes klad skor dang*/ ran dz zhes n dngos dang*/ rañdza zhes ny yig byung kyang rung ste lus 'gyur mi 'dra ba yin gyi /don la skabs 'dir n zhes pa de yin te/ dbyi ba go dgos te snga phyi phal chair la rigs 'gre de ltar go dgos so/ /raṃdz ap/ tip/ nga ro/ n yin pas dbyi/ ra dza ti/ ༈raṃdz/ ap/ tas/ ra dza taḥ/ ༈'di la ap med/ ra dzan+ti/ ༈daṃsh aptip nga ro yal/ da sha ti/ da sha taḥ/ da sha ti/ ༈saṃdz/ ap/ tip/ sa dza ti/ sa dza taḥ/ sa dzan+ti/ ༈ṣaṃdz'i/ ṣa sa ru bsgyur/ nas na yal bar byed pa yin/ ṣ+waṃ dza la de dang 'dra ste/

ṣaṃ dz ap/ tip/ swa dza ti/ swa dza taḥ/ swa dzan+ti/ an+ti ku na la ap med do/ /bi do na pā nāṃ t+yā dī nāṃ ṇa bā dirbā/ bi da'i ti sogs dgu rnams ṇap sogs su yang na'o/ /byings bi da'i pha rol du byung ba tip dgu /ṇap sogs dgu ru rim pas grangs bzhin bsgyur nas bya ba byed do/ /yang na'o zhes gdam ka ste/ yang na mi bsgyur bar tip sogs rang gi sgrub tshul byed ces pa ste/ ༈de yang tip ṇap du bsgyur/ tas a thus su'o/ /an+ti us su'o/ /sip thap du'o/ /thas ni a thus su'o/ /mi p ni ṇap tu'o/ /bs ba ru bsgyur/ mas ma ru bsgyur ba'o/ /ṇap gnyis la p dang ṇ phyis/ a bzhagade gnyis dang*/ thap la yon tan/ bi be du 'gro /dbyangs rnams da'i srog tu bcug/tha la d t ru song ba drangs/ ba ma la d rang nyid 'dren/ ༈be da bi da tuḥ/ bi duḥ/ ༈bet+tha/ bi da thuḥ/ bi da/ ༈be da bid+ba/ bid+ma/ ༈mi bsgyur ba'i phyogs la/ ti la yon tan ti/ tas la d t drangs an+ti a la d 'dren pa kho na'o/ /bet+ti/ bi t+taḥ/ bi dan+ti/ ༈bet+si/ bit+thaḥ bit+tha/ ༈bed+mi/ bid+baḥ bid+maḥ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈bet+ta raṃ to bā ruṭ/ bi da'i mtha' la ruṭ yang na'o/ /'di kha skong gi mdo yin zer/ bi da'i byings la yang na ruṭ āg ma ster ro/ /bid ap/ te/ ruṭ/ ṭ rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ bidr.ate drangs/ bidra te/ ༈ruṭme da na/ bid ap te/ bid te/ zhes sogs āt+ma ne pa ti yang sbyor ba dmigs gsal la lo/ ༈de bzhin du/ bi d+yā t la sogs pa'o/ /bet+tu/ bit+tāt/ tup la gnyis so/ /bit+tāṃ/ bi dan+tu/ ༈bid+dhi/ bit+tāt/ hi la gnyis so/ /bit+taṃ/ bit+ta/ ༈be dā ni/ be dā ba/ be dā ma/ ༈a bet/ a bed/ dip yal/ ta ru bsgyur ma bsgyur gyi khyad yin/ a bit+taṃ/ an us/ a bi tuḥ/ ༈da sa'o zhes pas sip la d s ru bsgyur na a bid sip yon tan/ d s sip phyis s rnam bcad/

a beḥ/ ༈ma bsgyur na sip phyis pa tsam te/ a bed d t ru song na/ a bi t/ a bit+taṃ/ a bit+ta/ ༈a be daṃ/ a bid+ba/ a bid+ma/ ༈as yod pa la'o/ /as tip pit yin rnam 'gyur tsam med de/ a sti/ ༈ nam as la'o/ /zhes pas ngit pha rol la as'i a dbyi'o/ /as tas a dbyi s drangs staḥ/ ༈de dang 'dra aṃ ti san+ti/ ༈si saḥ/ si'i sa'o/ sip la as kyi a mi dbyi s dbyi'o/ /as sip s yal/ a si/ ༈pit ma yin pa'i rigs gzhan kun a yal ba ste s drangs pa'o/ /s+thaḥs+tha/ ༈asmiswaḥ smaḥ/ ༈s+yāt/ s+yā tāṃ/ s+yuḥsogs so/ ༈as tp pit yin/ astu/ tā tang du bsgyur na pit min par song bas a yal/ stāt/ stāṃ/ san+tu/ ༈dza h+ye dhi shā dhiḥ/ dzahi e dhi shā dhi'o/ /byings han ni dza hi ru ā de sha byed/ de bzhin du/ as ni edhi zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ shās ni shā dhi zhes par tshig phrad kyis bsgyur ba yin te/ de yang byings gsum po de la hi byin pa hi phyis te bsgyur ba'am/ byings hi dang bcas pa bsgyur ro/ ༈ /dza hi/ e dhi/ shādhi/ zhes pa kho na'o/ /staṃ/ sta/ ༈pit dran/ a sā ni/ a sā ba/ ༈a sā ma/ ༈aste rīṭ/ as nyid la īṭ'o/ /as kyi pha rol du dip dang sip byung na īṭ ā ga mar 'gyur ro/ /as dip 'di pit yin aṭ aṭ bzhaga.īṭ byin/ a.a.as.īng byung rim pas mtshams sbyar/ ā sīt/ ༈yang sip dang a mip ma gtogs pa la as kyi a yal/ aṭ aṭ sbyar ba'i ā yod/ āstāṃ/ āsan/ ༈sip la as'i a 'jog/iṭ ster ip phyis s rnam bcad ā sīḥ a staṃ/ āsta/ ༈a mip a sdod/ ip yal/ ā saṃ/ asba/ asma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈lih ro myang ba la'o/ /lih tip bzhag h'i ḍha'o/ /h ḍh ru song*/ ta tha dag gi dha'o/ /ti dhi ru song*/ ṣ+tu las ṣ+tu'o/ /dhi ḍhi ru 'gyur pit rnams la u padhā thung ngu'o zhes pas li yon tan le ru 'gro

/le ḍha ṭi zhes byung*/ ḍh la ṭi dbyi ste ring po yang ngo*/ /zhes ḍhi'i ḍhe mthong ba ṭi te ḍh snga ma ྄mi snang bar 'gro la/ pit min/ ta thog ma rnams la yon tan mi byed par u pa dhā ring por byed do/ ༈ /tip kyis skabs su leḍhi zhes pa'o/ /ta rkyen rnams dang tha rkyen rnams la dha dang ḍhar bsgyur ba dang*/ dbyangs mtha' ma yin/ sip dang wa ma spangs pa rnams la ha ḍha ru bsgyur nas dbyi ba yin mod/ sip dang ba ma rnams la ma yin no/ /sip dang po/ si sdod pas ha ḍha ru song ba yang ka ru song*/ si ṣi ru song ba k dang 'grogs k+ṣa ru 'gro /phyi ma skabs 'dir 'jig/ha ḍha ru bsgyur ba ste dza ba ḍa'am tsa pa ṭa ru byed do/ /ba ma dang dbyangs ngit yat sogs la yon tan dang ring po yang mi byed/ ha nyid ma bsgyur par 'dren no/ ༈ /tas sogs la lī ḍhaḥ/ lihan+ti/ ༈lek+ṣi/ lī ḍhaḥ/ lī ḍha/ ༈leh+mi/ lih+maḥ/ lihabaḥ/ zhes so/ ༈yang li h+yāt sogs dgu'o/ ༈leḍhu lī ḍhat/ lī ḍhāṃ/ li han+tu/ ༈dzha sa las hi dhi'o/ /zhes hi dhi ru 'gro ba dang*/ dhi ḍhi'o/ /yang iṭ 'byung bas liha'i h dang sbyor/ hi hi rang la gnas yang tā taṃ ru bsgyur ba pit min pa'i ta rkyen spyi dang 'dra'o/ /lī ḍhi/ li hi hi/ ༈lih'i iṭ'o zhes bshad do/ /lī ḍhā t/ ༈lī ḍhaṃ/ li ḍha/ ༈le hā ni/ le hā ba/ le hā ma/ zhes so/ ༈dip dbyi/ dza ba ḍa dang tsa pa ṭa 'dam ka dang pit dran aṭa a leṭ/ a leḍa gdam ka'o/ /ā lī ḍhāṃ/ a li han/ ༈sip yal/ a leṭ/ a leḍa/ gdam nga'o/ /a lī ḍhāṃ/ a lī ḍha/ ༈a le haṃ/ a lihā/ a lih+ma/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈tsak+ṣing gsal bar brjod pa la'o/ /ing rjes 'brel dgos don no/ /sko rā d+yash+tsa/ sa dang ka dang po yang ngo*/ /byings kyi mtha' la gsal byed rab sbyor yod pa'i nang na/ sa dang ka yig yod na dbyi'o/ /de yang pha rol dzha sa so sor bsdu ba yod pa la yin no/

༈ /tsak+ṣa te zhes pa bzhag k+ṣ dbyangs med kyi k dang ṣ so sor phral bas k ni dang po'i rgyu ṣa yig pas ṣ ru log/ṣa ni dang po sa yin pas s ru log/tsaṣs te byung gsal byed srog med gnyis phan chad 'dzom na gsal byed rab sbyor zer ba dran par bya/ skabs 'dir rab sbyor gyi s dbyi/ tshu rol ṣa mthong bas pha rol te ṭe ru song*/ drangs/ tsaṣ+te/ bi dang āng sngon du bzhag na/ bi.ātsaṣ+te/ byā tsaṣ+te/ ༈dbyangs lak+ṣ rang 'dren tsak+ṣā te/ bi āng sbyor ba kun la 'gre aṃ te la tsak+ṣa te/ ༈ṣa'i sa la ka'o/ /zhes pas ṣ s ṣkr song s dbyi rnam dbye se ṣe ru song k drangs tsak+ṣe/ ༈tsak+ṣā the/ ༈s yal ṣ k de ga tsag+dhā+e/ yang na/ tsag+dhā+e/ ༈tsak+ṣe/ ༈ji skad du/ sde par ma byung ba pha rol gyi gzugs la'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ma yig sde pa yin yang dzha sa'i yi ge ma yin la/ ba yig ni pa sde'i ba yin na/ dzha sa yin pas s dbyi dgos kyang mthar gnas yin/ sde ba min zhing dzha sa min pas s mi dbyi ste/ k+ṣ yongs rdzogs pha rol ba'i gzugs la 'dren no/ /tsak+ṣa ba he/ tsak+ṣ+ma he/ zhes pa'o/ ༈chog 'byung la/ tsak+ṣīta/ tsak+ṣī yā tāṃ/ tsak+ṣīran la sogs pa'o/ ༈shis byed la/ tāṃ sogs te s phyis/ tā ṭā tsaṣ+tāṃ/ tsak+ṣā tāṃ/ a taṃ/ a taṃ ngo*/ tsak+ṣa taṃ/ ༈tsak+ṣ+wa tsak+ṣā thaṃ tsak+ngaṃhwa de gnyis s yal ṣ yang ka ru slar log pa'o/ ༈tsak+ṣai/ tsak+ṣā ba hai/ tsak+ṣā ma hai/ zhes so/ ༈deng min la tan gyi n yal s dbyi/ ta ṭa/ tsaṣ+ta/ tsak+ṣā tāṃ/ tsak+ṣa ta/ ༈thās la s yal/ ṣ k/ tsak+thaḥ/ tsak+ṣā thāṃ/ tsak+ngaṃhwa/ ༈tsak+ṣi/ tsak+ṣī tsak+ṣiha hi/ byā tsak+ṣ+ma hi/ zhes so/ ༈a n+ya tra so dzaḥ/ gzhan du sa dza'o/ /o las+dzī ngo tshar byed pa la'o/ /o khyad don ī brjod don/ la sgra te bzhaga.ap 'dir s dz rab sbyor yin yang s mi dbyi ste/ s nyid dz ru bsgyur la dz dz a te byung drangs/ ladz+dza te/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈di pi sa s+ya taḥsi pi bā/

dip kyi sa'i t ste sip la yang na'o/ /s mtha' can gyi byings la di p byin na byings mtha'i s h ru 'gro la sip byin na h byed dam rnam bcad byed gdam ka yin/ dip sip gnyis po rang dbyi bar bya'o/ ༈tsakā sṛ gsal ba la'o/ /ṛ brjod don tsakās dip s t dip yal/ aṭ/ a tsakāt/ tsakās sip yang s t sip a tsakāt yang na sip yal s rnam bcad a tsa kaḥ/ zhes so/ ༈gzhan hi dhi ru bsgyur/ an us lhag ma rnams s pha rol du drang ngo*/ /'di pa ra smai'o/ ༈khyā gtam gyi sbyor ba la'o/ ༈khyā tip āng sngon du bzhag/ā khyā ti/ zhes dang*/ ༈ā khyā yāt sogs dang*/ ༈ā khyā tu/ ༈aṭ/ 'dra ba/ ā khyāt/ ces sogs so/ ༈mṛdzuṣa gtsang ma la'o/ /mradze r+bṛ rdi bi ti/ mṛdzal 'phel ba ste bitla'o/ /mṛ dza'i byings la bitra pha rol du byung na mṛ la 'phel bar 'gyur nges pa ditra dang bo dbyangs yin pa la gdam nga'o/ /mṛ dz ti p/ mṛ 'phel ba mā r dzṣ ta ṭa drangs/ māriṣ+ta/ ༈tas la 'phel ba med/ mṛṣ+taḥ/ ༈dbyangs la rnam rtog ste/ mārdzaṃ ti/ mṛdzan+ti/ ༈mṛ dz+yāt/ mṛ dz+yā tāṃ/ mṛ dz+yuḥ/ ༈mān+ṭu/ mṛṣ+tāt/ mṛ ṣ+tāṃ/ mṛ dzan+tu/ mārdzan+tu/ ༈amār+ṭa/ yang na/ a mār+ḍa/ a mṛṣ+tāṃ/ amṛ dzanra zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ 'dir māriṣ+wa zhes pa la/ mā ra s ṭhi zer blta bur klog/tsak+ṣa'i k+ṣa lta bu sgra 'gyur ba yin kyang*/ dbyangs med na/ tsa ka kha zer ba 'dra rung 'don/ sgra mi 'gyur ba/ a ma r+ṭa brtsegs pa srog med la/ a ma ra ṭ+ra zer ba lta bu dgos kyi/ blun po'i mun sprul dang mkhas su re ba 'dra'i tshod rgyag la snying po med do/ ༈ni dzāṃ gu ṇaḥ/ ni dza rnams kyi yon tan no/ /ni dza la sogs pa'i byings kyi thog ma'i yi ge la yon tan du 'gyur te ap zhig pa'i yul la'o/ /ṇi dzir dag byed dang so sor byed pa la'o/ /ir rjes 'brel ṇi dza ྄tip zhes pa bzhagaṇi ni ru bsgyur gnyis brjod thog ma ha sogs dz snga ma phyis/

ni dza rnams kyi yon tan no/ /zhes pas ni snga ma la yon tan no/ /yon tan 'di ni dza'i skabs 'dir rtag tu 'jug go /ne ni dz ti byung tip pit yin pas de'i yon tan ni gnyis brjod phyi ma la'ang 'byung ste/ ne ne dz ti byung dz+ra g g k/ ne nek+ti/ zhes pa grub/ nyer sgyur nir sngon du bzhag/ṣa ra ṛ sogs ne dang po ṇe r drangs/ ni r+ṇe ne k+ti/ ༈tas pit min pas yon tan phyi ma med/ nir+ṇe nik+taḥ/ ༈gnyis la'o/ /zhes pas/ an+ta a ta ru bsgyur/ nir+ṇe ne dza ti/ ༈dzk sipṣi/ nir+ṇe nik+ṣi/ dz k drangs ni r+ṇenik+thaḥ/ nir+ṇe nik+tha/ ༈nir+ṇe nidz+mi/ nir+ṇe ni dz+waḥ/ nir+ṇe nidz+maḥ/ ༈yang at+ma ne la mtshon na/ a ba sngon du bzhag/a ba ne ni k+ta/ a ba ne ni dzā te/ a ba ne ni dza te/ ༈a ba ne nik+tāṃ/ a ba ne ni dzā tāṃ/ a ba ne ni dza taṃ/ a ba ne ni dza k+ṣ+wa/ zhes pa la sogs phal cher snga ma rnams dang 'dra'o/ ༈bi dzir tha dad du gnas pa la'o/ /ir yal bidz tip ap dbyi gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa ni dza rnams kyi yon tan no/ /zhes pas bi dang po be yon tan 'di skabs 'dir kun la'o/ /pit yon tan te bi phyi ma be'o/ /tsu yi ku'o/ /drangs be bek+ti/ ༈de dang 'dra ba las pit ma yin pas yon tan phyi ma med/ dz drangs be bi dz+yāt/ ༈tup pit yin/ dzk dang ṣa ru 'gro/ be beṣ+tu/ be bek+tu/ ༈dip dbyi pit aṭ dzk'am gra/ a be bek.a be beg /piṣl̥ khyab pa la'o/ /piṣtip gnyis brjod ṣ yal yon tan yang yon tan/ ti ṭi be beṣ+ti/ ༈snga mas 'gre be biṣ+yāt/ bebeṣ+tu/ ༈ṣ ḍh/ a be be ḍh+ra/ a be beṭ zhes sogs so/ ༈pṛ srung ba dang gang ba la'o/ /pṛtip gnyis brjod/ ap dbyi/ ṛbro riḥbūrba s+ya/ ṛ dang pṛ dag thog ma'i i'o/ /byings ṛ dang pṛ dag la gnyis brjod thog ma'i ṛ yig de i yig tu 'gyur ro/ /bi āng sngon du bzhagaṛ pṛ sgrub pa la bi āng dgos pa min kyang nyer sgyur sbyor ba la nges pa ster ba'i dgos don no/

/pṛ pṛ ap tip ap yal ṛ dang po i/ phyi ma ar/ pi p ar ti/ pi parti/ bi āng byā pi parti/ ༈tip min la yon tan phyi ma med/ pṛ pri ap tas ap yal/ pipṛ taḥ/ ༈dbyangs la ri r ru gzhan 'dra/ /pipr a ti/ pi pra ti/ zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du yāt sogs/ byā pi pṛ yāt/ ༈tuppit dran byā pi partu/ ༈ji skad du/ ṛ dang pṛ dag gi di dang si dag la yang na aṭ ā ga mar 'gyur ro/ /pṛ pṛ dip aṭ bi āng aṭ dip dang*/ ṭ yal byā pi parat/ yang na bi.ā pi p ar dip yal r rnam bcad byā pi paḥ byā pu bapaḥbyā pi pṛ tāṃ/ an.us yon tan byā pi pa ruḥ/ ༈ṛ 'gro ba la'o/ /ji skad du/ mtshungs pa'i yi ge ma yin dbyangs kyi thog ma'i i yig ni i yr kun nas bsgyur ba'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /ṛ tip ap phyis gnyis brjod ṛ thog ma i/ phyi ma ar/ i dang ṛ mi mtshungs a dang yang mi mtshungs pas i ni iy ru 'gyur ro/ /y ar gyi a la drangs i yarti/ ༈pit min la ar med/ ay-i? (ra btags yin )yāt/ ༈tup la ar/ i yartu/ ༈dbyangs dang po la gnyis pa'o/ /zhes pas gong du aṭ gnyis 'jog go /ṛ dip ap dbyi aṭ byin/ ṛ ṛ aṭ dang po/ i a/ a i/ ṛng byung i ni i y zhes par song*/ ri phyi ma yon tan/ a i e/ e la ai/ i y song*/ dus kyi y ar gyi a la drangs/ ar gyi r aṭ gyi a la drangs d t ru/ ai ya ra twa/ ༈yang na/ ṛ ṛ dip ap dbyi dang po i/ i ni iy/ gong du aṭ gnyis/ a.a.iy.ardip/ a.i.e/ ai aiy riy ar ྄a la drangs dip yal r rnam bcad/ ai yaḥ/ ṛ+-iṛtām/ a a ṛ ṛtām/ ṛgong ma i i de.iy ru song*/ a i la e ai y ṛ la drangs ai y-i? (ra btags yin )tāṃ/ ༈ṛ ṛ/ an us su bsgyur/ a a ṛ ṛ us/ a a iy.ar/ us/ i ya ruḥ/ zhes so/ ༈iṇ 'gro ba la'o/

/ṇ rjes 'brel i tip pit la yon tan e/ e ti/ i tas i taḥ/ i an+ti iy dbyangs med du song drangs/ yan+ti/ ༈i yāt/ de la rnam 'gyur med/ ༈i tup yon tan/ e tu/ i hi/ rnam 'gyur med/ i a ni p yon tan/ i e/ e ay/ y drangs/ a yā ni/ ༈a a i dip ait/ a a itāṃ/ ai tāṃ/ ༈a.a.i.anra/ ai anra/ ai āy ā yan/ ༈'di man chad la iy mi byed kyang yak rkyen ster yak bzhi po la'o/ /zhes pas so/ /i te yak ster/ ī ring po/ ī ya te/ at+ma ne'o/ ༈iṇap gnyis brjod/ yang gsum pa 'phel/ i i i a byung*/ i bar ba y ru song*/ phyi ma la drangs pas yi/ de la 'phel ba yai byung/ ai.āya/ iy/ āy/ y gnyis drangs/ i yā ya/ grub bo/ ༈i a tus i i i a tus/ i dang po gnyis 'dra ring phyi ma y dbyangs bral/ de a la drangs rnam bcad ī ya tuḥ/ ༈i us/ i i i us gong dang mtshungs/ 'dra ring*/ phyi ma y rnam bcad/ ī yuḥ/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈iṣu 'dod pa la'o/ /u yal iṣ ṇap gnyis brjod gsum pa dbyangs 'phel gyi yan lag mi 'phel/ i iṣ iṣ a byung*/ thog ma'i ha sa sogs ṣ mi snang*/ i.i.iṣ a byung*/ i bar ba y/ phyi ma la yon tan/ y dang ṣ drangs i ye ṣa/ zhes so/ ༈iṣ atus/ gnyis brjod/ ṣ dang po yal/ mtshungs 'dra ring*/ drangs/ rnam bcad ī ṣa tuḥ/ ༈iṣ us/ iṣ iṣ us gong dang 'dra bar sgrubs/ ī ṣuḥ/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /byings rnams kyang ni mtha' yas nyid/ /sna tshogs don nyid thams cad du'o/ khams rnams mngon gsal nus ji bzhin/ kun bshad rdzogs par bshad pa'o/ /zhes 'grel bar 'byung ste/ byings mang po dang re re yang don mang po dang*/ de dag gi byings kyi don gsal bar brjod dgos pa/ rang gi nus pa dang 'tsham pa kun nas bshad pa'i don tshang bar bshad zin zhes pa ste/ rgya skad du/ shakya mit+ya laṃ/

zhes 'byung ba'i a laṃ gang ba'i don yin de ni rdzogs pa dang cha tshang ba'i don no/ /kun nas bshad par ming btags pa tip sogs rnam dbye'i rab tu bya ba re zhig bshad zin to// ༈ //da ni byings las ming du sgrub pa kṛt rkyen nam byed po'i rkyen gyi sgrub tshul rnams bshad par bya'o/ /de yang kṛt zhes pa byed pa po dang byed pa gnyis ka la 'jug/byed pa yang byed po'i cha shas yin pas byed po'i rkyen zhes byas mod/ 'dir thun mong du go ba'i phyir byed rkyen zhes bya'o/ /kṛt+ka rta ri/ byed pa po la kṛt'o/ /'chad par 'gyur ba tṛ dang buṇl sogs pa'i rkyen rnams la kṛt rkyen zhes bya ste/ gtso bor byed pa po'i don la ster ba yin no/ /de yang si sogs ti sogs de dag tshig tu sgrub pa'i rkyen yin la/ 'di ni ming du sgrub pa'i rkyen ming rkyen zhes kyang bya'o/ /si sogs ni ngo bo dang bya ba dang byed po ming gcig la brten pa'i don gyi dbye ba mang po ston pa dang*/ tip sogs ni dus dang bya ba'i rab dbye mang po zhig ston zhing*/ gnyis kas kyang gcig gnyis mang po dbye ba mtha' yas ston pa'i phyir rnam dbye zhes zer la/ 'dir ming tsam du sgrub pa dngos po dang*/ byed pa so so'i don tsam zhig gtso bor ston gyi/ don gyi ldog cha mtha' yas pa mi sgrub pas/ kṛt rkyen la rnam dbye mi zer ro/ /tṛ bu ṇau/ tṛ dang buṇ dag go /rkyen mang po dag las thog mar tṛ rkyen dang bu paṇ'i rkyen gyi bya ba bshad par bya'o/ ༈ḍupatsṣ 'tshed pa la'o/ /pats tṛ bzhag/tsu'i ku'o/ /tsk pak tṛ drangs pak+tṛ/ so rā/ si'i ā'o/ /ming gi brda chad can du si sogs rnam dbye'o zhes 'byung ste/ ming du grub pa mtshon byed du si sogs rnam dbye ster dgos pa las skabs 'dir rkyen ṛ yig mthar si byin na si de ā ring por bsgyur dgos la/

de ḍit yin/ ḍit la ṭi yal/ lhag ma'i yi ge ā ring po la 'dren no/ /pak+tṛ si bzhag si ā/ ṭi dbyi k+ta ā la drangs/ pak+tā/ grub/ ༈ pak+tṛ au 'di ma 'gyur bas ḍit min/ des na/ ṭi mi bsub 'dir ṭi ṛ 'phel/ ār du 'gyur r au la drangs pak+tā rau/ ༈ /de dang 'dra ba la pak+tṛ dzas dz yal s rnam bcad pak+tā raḥ/ ༈ḍukṛny byed pa la'o/ /kṛ tṛ bzhag kṛ yon tan kar+tṛ si si ā ṭi mi snang*/ drangs/ kartā/ ༈kar+tṛ au/ ṛ ār pak+tā rau/ ༈gong dang 'dra/ kartāraḥ/ ༈hṛny 'phrog pa la'o/ /hṛ tri hṛ yon tan har+tṛ si ā/ ṭi yal/ hartā/ ༈har+tṛ au 'phel ba drangs/ hartā rau/ ༈har+tṛ dzas as 'phel/ ha rtā raḥ/ ༈kṛ taḥ/ kṛt la'o/ /byings bh+rū sogs gsal byed mtha' tshu rol na yod/ pha rol pas so sor bsdu ba'i yi ge dang po can gyi kṛt rkyen yod na/ iṭ ā ga ma ster ro/ /bhū tri bzhagabyings la yon tan bha o/ ab/ bha b tṛ/ ba dang tṛ bar du iṭ ṭ yal/ bha bi tṛ si ā ṛ phyis/ bha bi trā/ ༈bha bi tṛ au 'phel ba drangs/ bha bi tā rau/ ༈dzas la gong bzhin/ bha bi tā raḥ/ ༈e dha 'phel ba la'o/ /e dhi tṛ iṭ/ edhi tṛ/ si ā/ ṭi mi snang*/ edhi tā/ ༈au ṛ ār/ e dhi tā rau/ ༈dzas la e dhi tā raḥ/ ༈ū di to bā/ ūt it yang na'o/ /ut ces pa u yig gi ming yin/ it ces phyis pa'i yul gyi ming yin/ des na yang byings gsal byed mtha' can yin yang*/ u yig phyis pa la yang na ba ste/ gu bu srung ba la'o/ /p'i dbyangs u dgos don yin pas phyis/ guptṛ zhes pa gnyis bzhagagu yon tan go༈ yang na iṭ go bo tṛ zhes pa byung yang*/ iṭ med/ gap-itra byung*/ go pitṛ si ā/ ṭi phyis go pi tā/ yang na gap-itra si ā sogs go p+tā/ ba lang 'tsho ru chug ces pa'i don no/ ༈au la/ go bi tā rau/ go bhā rau/ ༈dzas la go pi tā raḥ/

gop+tā daḥ/ ༈ ṣa ha bzod pa la'o/ ṣaha tṛ/ dang po'i ṣ ṇ ni s n'o/ /zhes pas ṣa yig sa yig ste/ sangtṛ/ sa ha ba ho rau da bar+ṇa s+ya/ sah bah dag gi a yig o'o/ /byings sah dang bah la tṛ rkyen byung na/ dbyangs kyi a yig ring thung gang yin kyang o yig tu 'gyur ro/ /sah soh bah boh ru 'gyur/ ha yi ḍha'o/ /ha ḍha/ ta tha dag gi dha'o/ /tri dhṛ ṣa ṭu rnams las ṣ+tu'o/ /dhṛ ḍhṛ ḍha snga ma dbyi/ ring por yod yod bapa'o/ ༈soḍh+ri si? ā ṭi yal/ so ḍhā/ bzod par byed du chugaso ḍhā rau/ so ḍhā raḥ/ ༈boḍha tṛ/ h bh/ t bha/ dha ḍha/ ḍh snga ma yal/ dang po ring por gdod nas grub bo ḍhṛsi ā ṭi yal/ thob par byed do'i don la/ bo ḍhā/ bo ḍhā rau/ bo ḍhā raḥ/ de dag tṛ'i bya ba'o// ༈ //da ni bu ny'i bya ba bshad de/ yu bo ra nā kau yu bu dag a na a ka'o/ /yu zhes yu rkyen bu zhes buny'i rkyen te/ de dag la yu zhes pa an dang*/ buny'i ny phyis nas bu zhes pa a ka ru bsgyur ba yin/ ༈de gnyis las thog mar buny'i? bya ba ni/ tsit nyid la at kyi u pa dhā'o zhes pas/ a ka ru bsgyur zin pa'i u padhā a la 'phel ba ā 'byung ngo*/ /'tshed par byed do/ /zhes pa'i don la/ bts buny zhes pa bzhag ny yal/ bu a ka/ buṇ ṇit yin pas byings kyi u pa dhā ā ring por song*/ ts drangs pā tsa ka rnam dbye dang po si byin/ de rnams bcad/ pā tsa kaḥ/ zhes pa grub/ pā tsa ka zhes pa'i ming de ltar sgrubs rnam dbye au sogs lhag ma rnams de ba'i sgra dang sgrub tshul 'dra'o/ ༈ /paṭh gsal por brjod pa la'o/ /paṭh buny a ka ru song drangs pāṭhā ka/ si/ rnam bcad klogs shig pa'i don la/ pā ṭha kaḥ/ pā tha ya ti/ klog tu chug cig pa'i don yang yin/ lhag ma 'dra/ ༈ḍukṛny byed pa la'o/ /byed do zhes dang*/ byed du chug ces pa'i don la/ kṛbuny aka ṛ/ ār ring po drangs/

kā ra ka si rnam bcad/ kā ra kaḥ/ kā ra kau 'dra ring*/ kā ra kāḥ/ ༈bhū buṇ ṇ 'phel ba'i don te yal/ bu a ka ru bsgyur/ bhū 'phel ba bhau au.ab b a ka'i a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ bhā ba kaḥ/ bhā ba kau/ bhā ba kāḥ/ ༈yang byings lūny/ ny mi snang*/ lu nā ti/ gcod par byed do/ lā ba ya te/ gcod du 'jug go /zhes pa'i don la/ lū buṇ a ka 'phel ba/ lau au āb/ si rnams bcad/ lā ba kaḥ/ lā ba kau lā ba kāḥ/ ༈ yu 'dres pa la'o/ /yau ti/ bsres so/ /yā ba ya ti/ sre bar byed 'jug go /de'i don la yu bu ṇ aka 'phel ba/ āb drangs si yā ba kaḥ/ yā ba kau/ yā ba kāḥ/ ༈pūny rnam par dag pa la'o/ pū puṇ a ka 'phel ba āb drangs si pā ba kaḥ/ pā ba kau /pā ba kāḥ/ la sogs pa'o/ /des bu na'i bya ba bshad zin to// ༈ //nā myu pa dhāt+kaḥ/ nā mi'i u pa dhā las ka'o/ /byings kyi u pa dhā nā mi'i yi ge yin pa de la/ kṛt rkyen ka yig 'jug ste/ k yig yon tan dgag pa'i don yin pas phyis te a 'jog go /ka rkyen byung yang nā mi u pa dhā can gyi gsal byed mtha' mi dbyi'o/ ༈k+ṣip byed du 'jug pa la'o/ /k+ṣi pa ti/ byed du chug cig ces pa'i don la k+ṣip ka k rjes 'brel te yon tan dgag pa'o/ /a bzhag p a la drangs k+ṣipa si rnam bcad/ k+ṣi paḥ/ k+ṣi bau/ k+ṣi pāḥ/ ༈bhi di r rnam par 'joms pa la'o/ /bhi nan+ti 'joms par byed do'i don la/ bhi dir ir song*/ ka a bzhag drangs/ si bhi daḥ la sogs pa'o/ ༈dz+nyā khong du chud pa la'o/ /ā yig mtha' can gyi byings pha rol ap med pa la byings mtha'i ā yig dbyi bar 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du/ dzā na la yang ka'o/ /zhes 'byung bas ā mtha' dbyi ba de yang kṛt rkyen ka byung na yin gyi/ gzhan ma yin no/ /dza nā ti/ shes par byed do'i don la/ dz+nyā ka a/ ṭi yal/ a thung la drangs/ si dz+nyaḥ/ dz+nyau/ dz+nyāḥ/ sogs so/ ༈patsi naṃ di gra hā de ra yu ṇi ni/

pa tsinan+di gra hā sogs la a yu ṇini'o/ /byings pa tsa sogs la rkyen a dang*/ naṃ di sogs la rkyen yu dang*/ grah sogs la kṛtrkyen ṇi ni ster te/ rkyen ṇi ni zhes pa'i ṇ 'phel ba'i don dang*/ ni'i i brjod don yin pas dbyi'o/ ༈ /de yang 'di ltar pats a drangs/ si pa tsaḥ/ 'tshod par byed do zhes sogs so/ ༈ /berti rig par byed do zhes pa la bid a yon tan be drangs si be daḥ sogs so/ ༈smra bar byed do'i don la/ bid/ i/ si/ gong bzhin sgrubs pa daḥsogs/ ༈di bu rtse ba la'o/ /dip a yon tan drangs si de baḥ/ dī bya ti/ rtsed mo byed do zhes pa'i don no/ ༈k+ṣibu bsnyen pa la'o/ /u brjod don k+ṣip a bzhag k+ṣa sa ru bsgyur sip a byung yon tan/ se drangs/ si se baḥ/ se ba ti zhes nye bar bsnyen no'i don to/ /ba tsa sogs song ngo*/ ༈ṭun di nor gyi tshogs la'o/ /ṭu dang i phyis ṇad byings so/ /it at la num'o/ /zhes pas/ byings kyi dkyil du num ā ga ma ster te/ it ste i yig ni/ it kyi tha snyad 'jug pa ni phyis ba de/ 'dir di zhes pa'i i phyis pa lta bu'o/ /ṇan yu byings kyi dang po ṇa na'o/ /nad yu?/ yu a na ru bsgyur na dang d'i bar du num/ na num d an zhes pa byung*/ m dang u yal n nga ro d a la drangs si naṃ da na/ phyug por byas so/ /nan+da ti/ ༈ra ma dga' rtsed lā+o/ /ram yu/ yu an/ i phyis pa'i yul min pas num med/ drangs ṣa ṛ sogs na ṇa si/ ra ma ṇaḥ/ ༈bā ma dang kra ma dga' ba la'o/ /bām yu an drangs/ si bā ma ṇaḥ/ ༈kram la yang de dang 'dra/ kra ma ṇaḥ/ dga' bar byed do/ /zhes so/ ༈ar+d+da dang mar+d+da 'dzoms pa la'o/ /ard/ yu/ an/ dzan gong*/ dzan arda/ an/ 'dra ba ring po drangs si/ dza nārda naḥ/ 'gro ba 'joms byed dam 'gro bas mchod pa'o/ ༈marda naḥ/ yang de dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /ru sgra la'o/ /'dir yu rkyen gyi khyad parayuṇ'i bya ba ni/

ror+yu ṇ/ ru'i yuṇ'o/ /ru zhes pa'i byings la rkyen yuṇ ster/ ṇ yig 'phel ba'i don te dbyi/ rau ti/ sgra byas so/ /rwa pa ya ti/ skad chen po byed du 'jug go /don 'di la ru yuṇ ṇ song*/ yu a na/ 'phel/ rau āp drangs si rā ba ṇaḥ/ naṃ di sogs la yu bshad zin to// ༈ //grah sogs ni 'di lta ste/ grah ṇi ni bzhagaṇ dang i 'og ma phyis/ grah in byung*/ ṇ 'phel ba'i don te ha drangs/ grā hin grub si in gyi si dang shi'o zhes pas si yal/ nā mi la n song*/ grā hī zhes sogs/ ༈de bzhin du/ tsar ṇi ni tsar in 'phel ba drangs/ si dbyi in'i n song bi sngon du bzhagabi tsā rī/ dpyod ldan no/ ༈ /dṛ shā deḥshaḥ/ dṛsh la sogs pa'i sha'o/ /dṛsh la sogs pa'i byings la kṛt rkyen sha zhes pa ster ro/ /rkyen sh yig ni bya ba'i don te dbyi'o/ /shi ti tsa turbat/ shit bzhi po dang 'dra'o/ /shit ces pa phyis/ dbyi bar bya rgyu'i sh yig dang bcas pa'i rkyen te/ sh phyis pa'i a yig go /bzhi po rnams zhes pa byings thams cad pa'i sde tshan bzhi po'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin no zhes pa ste/ kun nas bsgyur ba'i khyad par bshad pa sogs kyi skabs la dgongs pa'o/ ༈dṛsh shash yal/ a bzhagadṛsh pa sh+y ru bsgyur ro/ /drangs/ ut sngon du bzhagasi ut+pa sh+yaḥ/ sogs so/ ༈dhe ḍh 'thung ba la'o/ /dhe ḍh+rasha ḍh dbyi/ sha a/ e ay ut sngon drangs si ud+dha yaḥ/ yang na ut spangs/ dha yaḥsogs/ ༈dh+ma sgra dang me rab tu sbyor ba la'o/ /dh+ma sha sh song a dh+mā ni dha m ru bsgyur/ ut sngon gzhan snga ma rnams dang 'dra/ ud+dha maḥ/ ༈pā btung ba la'o/ /pā sha a pā pib ru song*/ gzhan 'dra/ pi baḥ/ ut sbyar na ut+pi paḥ/ ༈gh+ra dri snom pa la'o/ /gh+rasha a gh+rā zhes pa/ dzi gh+ra ru bsgyur/ drangs/ dzigh+raḥ/ zhes so/ /ut sngon du bzhagat dz 'gro drangs

udz+dzi gh+raḥ/ ༈han 'tshe ba la'o/ /han sha/ a dbyangs la u pa dhā dbyi/ h gh ghn a la drangs si gh+naḥ/ go zhes pa lta bu ming gong du bzhagagogh+naḥ/ ba lang gsod pa'o/ ༈ /bid sha a/ muṃ ā ga ma bi dang d'i bar du bzhag/m u phyis m nga ro/ bin+da si go gong du bzhagago bin+daḥ/ tud sogs la a'o zhes ā lhag po sbyin pa'i lugs gcig yod kyang mi dgos so/ ༈dz+wa lā der+ṇaḥ/ dz+wa la sogs la ṇa'o/ /byings dz+wa la sogs la rkyen ṇa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ṇa 'phel don te dbyi/ a bzhagadz+wa la 'bar ba la'o/ /dz+wa l ṇ a 'phel ba dz+wā drangs si dz+wā laḥ/ ta p'i byings kyang de dang 'dra/ tā paḥ/ ༈pa thi 'gro ba la'o/ /pa th ṇ a u pa dhā ring*/ mum pā dang tha'i bar du'o/ /um phyis nga ro drangs si/ pān+thaḥ ༈kar+ye aṇ/ las ka la aṇ'o/ /las dang bya ba gnyis sdoms ni/ kar+ya ste las ka'o/ /don de dang sbyor ba'i phyir du/ aṇ gyi kṛt rkyen ster ro/ /ming gzhan thog ma bzhag pa'i byings la/ 'phel ba ste 'dir ṇa dang bcas pas kyang ngo*/ ༈ /kṛ.aṇ ṇ yal/ a/ ming kum+bha gong*/ 'phel ba/ kā r/ kum+bha kāraḥ/ ༈kṛ aṇ ṇ yal/ graṃ tha gong 'phel ba/ ār drangs si gran+tha kā raḥ/ ༈ā to ḍaḥ/ āt kyi ḍa'o/ /ā yig mtha'i byings la/ las ka'i don du ḍa rkyen ster te/ nām+ni tsa/ ming can yang ngo*/ /ming thog ma'i byings su 'gyur ba la yang ḍa'i rkyen no/ /dper na dā ḍa/ ḍa rjes 'brel/ a ḍit la ṭi dbyi/ byings d dbyangs bral/ a la drangs/ go gong du bzhagadha na gong du bzhagago daḥ/ ba lang sbyin pa/ dha na daḥ/ nor ster ro/ ༈ /pā btung ba la'o/ /pāḍa/ ḍ song*/ a ṭi yal/ p drangs dwi gong si dwi paḥ/ gnyis 'thung ngo*/ /gnyis su 'thung bar byed bas so/ ༈ /dzanra ḍ ḍ song*/ dzan/ a ṭi mi snang*/ dz a dwi sngon si dwi dzaḥ/ ༈ṣ+ṭhāḍa/ s+thār bsgyur ḍ yal/ a ṭi mi snang*/ gṛha gong*/ drangs/ si gṛ has+thaḥ/ ༈dru 'gro ba la'o/

/druḍa/ a ṭi mi snang*/ dra a drangs dra shuts sngon du bzhag/shutsaḥshū dre/ shutsa ni dra la shū'o/ /shuts ni shū zhes pas bsgyur/ si rnam bcad shū draḥ/ gtsang sbra song ba ste dmangs rigs so/ ༈ /ur saḥs lo po mum+bā/ u ra sa'i sa phyis pa la mum yang na'o/ /uras/ rkyen ḍa pha rol tu yod pa/ bar du 'gro ba'i byings yod na/ sa yig mi snang ba dang*/ de'i shul du mum ā ga ma'o/ /u ras/ gaml̥ḍa/ l̥ rjes 'brel/ ḍa a/ ṭi am yal/ g drangs s dbyi mum nga ro/ si u raṃ gaḥ/ mum mi byed na u ra gaḥ/ ༈bi hā ya so bita tsa/ bi ha ya sa'i bi ha yang ngo*/ /bi ha yas zhes pa ming gi byings te 'di dang u ras sgrub tshul spyi 'dra ba las/ sa ru ma zad ya yang dbyi'o/ /bi ha yas/ gam ḍa/ ḍ song*/ a ṭi yal/ g lus drangs ā bi ha yas bi ha zhes par song*/ de'i shul du mum/ de nga ro/ si/ bi ha ya sā gats+tshati/ nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /zhes pa'i don la bi haṃ gaḥ/ yang na mum spangs pas/ bi ha gaḥ/ ༈a ṭau/ a dang ṭa dag go /ming yod cing ming de dang 'brel ba'i las ka'i don la rkyen a dang ṭa zhes pa dag 'byung*/ de'i ṭa yig ni īṭā kyi don yin pas phyis te a nyid do/ /hṛ a yon tan/ hra ar so sor/ drangs as+thi gong*/ ming yin/ si rnam bcad mthar/ shwā sbyar as+thi ha raḥshwā/ rus pa khyer ro khyis/ zhes so/ ༈as+thi'i tshab tu ka ba tsa bzhagashwa'i tshab tu k+ṣat+t+ri yaḥ/ ka ba tsa ha raḥk+ṣat+t+ri yaḥ/ go cha phrogs so rgyal rigs kyis/ ༈bhā ra ha raḥ/ khur po phrogs so/ /mum byung na bhā raṃ ha raḥl sogs pa'o/ ༈dhṛny 'dzin pa la'o/ /dhṛ.a/ yon tan dhar a drangs dha nu gong si dha nu dha raḥku mā raḥ/ gzhung 'dzin no gzhon nus so/ /de dag la a rkyen no/ ༈ /tsar ṭa ṭ phyis a bzhagadrangs tsa ra ku ru gong si ku ru tsa raḥ/ sgra mi snyan du spyod pa'o/ ༈ /yang na īp 'byung ste/ bud med kyi rtags so/ /gong ltar ku ru tsa ra sgrubs

īp bzhag p song*/ byings mtha' yal/ drangs ku ru tsa rī/ sgra mi snyan du spyod pa mo'o zhes so/ /a rkyen gyi mtha' ma byings thams cad pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ ṭa a kri mtha' rnams tsa ra sogs dang 'dra/ zhes 'grel bar bshad de rnam dbye sbyor tshul lo/ ༈kṛṭ a yon tan drangs sho ka gong sho ka ka ra byung īp mthar ka n+yā zhes bzhagasho ka ka rī kan+yā/ bu mo mya ngan byed do/ /zhes so/ ༈ya shaḥka ro ti/ snyan grags sgrog go /zhes pa'i don la kā rī gong bzhin thog mthar ming bsnan pas/ ya shaska rī bid+yā/ snyan grags byed do rig pa mo/ /zhes so/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ dṛ rnam par 'joms pa la'o/ /dṛṭa a yon tan drangs/ da ra/ pur mum pu raṃ gong si/ pu raṃ da raḥ/ pu raṃ da ra ya ti/ grong sde bcom du bcug go ༈da ra la bha ga gong mum si bha gaṃ da raḥ/ skal ba 'joms pa'o/ ༈yam ṭa drangs bā tsa gong mum/ si/ bā tsi ya maḥ/ ngag 'gog ces pa'o/ ༈i kha khi/ i kha khi'o/ /gang yang ming dang bcas pa'i byings kha dang khi dang i ste rkyen gsum 'jug ste byings nyid kṛ i yon tan/ stam+ba sngon dang*/ bṛ hi 'jug tu sbyar/ si rnam bcad bṛ hi stam+paṃ ka ro ti/ 'bru 'debs par byed do zhes pa'i don la/ staṃ ba ka ri bṛ hi/ ༈abl̥ khyab byed la'o/ /l̥ rjes 'brel/ ap i de ba gong*/ 'dra ring*/ drangs si rnam bcad/ de bā nābho ti/ lhas khyab bo zhes pa'i don la/ de bā piḥ/ de dag i rkyen gyi dpe'o/ ༈ khi ti pa da s+ya/ kh it tshig gi'o/ kha rkyen byin rjes/ it kyi ming can te gsal byed kha nyid phyis pa la byings kyi thog mar sbyar ba'i tshig gi mthar mum ā ga ma ster dgos so/ ༈kṛ kha k+ṣe ma gong kh phyis a bzhagam dang kṛ bar du mum um phyis m nga ro/ /kṛ yon tan r drangs k+ṣe maṃ ka raḥ/ bde bar byed do/ ༈bd kha/ pṛ ya gong*/ kh yal/ a mum pṛ yaṃ ba daḥ/ de dag kha rkyen gyi dpe yin no/:

/de bzhin du/ bhṛ khi āt+ma gong phyis/ i bh+ri yon tan mum/ at+maṃ bha riḥ/ bdag rgyas so/ /'byor ba thob pa'i don no/ ༈ /u darabhṛkhi i yon tan/ mum/ u da raṃ bha riḥ/ lto ba khengs so/ /u da raṃ bi bha rti/ zhes so/ /de dag khi rkyen gyi dpe'o/ ༈edzāṃ kha sh/ edz rnams kyi kha sh'o/ /e dzṛ kam+pa ne/ edzṛ 'dar ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings edzṛ sogs la/ khash zhes pa'i rkyen 'jug go /rkyen gyi kha yig ni gong bzhin thog ma'i tshig la mum ster bar go phyir dang*/ sh yig ni la yig bzhi po bya ba mtshungs so ba'i brda yin pas kh gsal byed sh gsal byed mi snang*/ a bzhag go /dper mtshon na e dzṛ ṛ rjes 'brel/ e dz+ra kha sha bzhag /kh dang sh yal a gnas/ nyi ster/ tsu ra sogs la nyi'o/ nya thim/ dza na gong*/ mum/ nga ro/ dza naṃ e dz i a byung*/ i yon tan/ e ay/ nga ro e la drangs/ dz dang y a so sor drangs/ si rnam bcad/ dza na me dza ya/ grub/ dza naṃ e dza ya ti/ skye bo rnams 'dar bar byed do/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /'dir sha yig ni la yig bzhi bya ba mtshungs par 'grel pas bshad la/ dpe kha cig las ap byed pa la'o/ zhes pa'ang drangs yod pas/ edz a zhes pa'i skabs der/ ap byin de phyis pa'i yul la nyi ster ba dgos par mngon mod/ ap byin ma thag dbyi dgos phyin bla (sla )bcos su byas kyang don 'grub par bsams nas mi 'god pa mang ngo*/ /'dir rigs can gong 'og thams cad du mang mod/ 'bri ba rang legs so/ /ma nu shes rig la'o/ /u brjod don mn kha sh a dip sogs la a'o/ zhes rkyen ya ster mn ya a sngon du paṇ+ḍita bzhagamum nga ro/ /ya'i a yā/ y a la drangs/ n ya la drangs/ mthar si rnam bcas paṇ+ḍi tam+ma n+ya/ de yang paṇ+ḍi ta māt+mā naṃ ma n+ya te/ mkhas pa ni bdag rang gis shes so/ /khyuṭ ka ra ṇe/ byed pa la khyuṭ'o/ byings gang la byed pa'i don sgrub pa khyuṭ rkyen du 'byung*/
