rkyen de'i kh yig ni mum ā ga ma ster ba'i don yin/ ṭ yig ṭa'i bya ba'i don te phyis nas rkyen dngos yu yig las so/ /yu a na'o/ nag+na kṛ khyuṭa/ kh dang ṭ yal/ kṛ yu byung*/ yu e nar bsgyur/ ṛ ar/ gong ma la mum/ nag+na mum k a r an si zhes pa byung*/ mum nga ro/ k dang r a gnyis la drangs/ si am du gyur drangs nag+naṃ ka ra ṇaṃ grub/ a nag+naḥ nag+naḥ kri ya te a ne na/ 'dis gcer bu min pa sgren mor btang ngo*/ /de'i don gcig la dh+yū taṃ/ mthong bar byas so te/ sba bar bya ba rnams mthong ba'o/ /de dang 'dra ba s+thu laṃ ka ra r+ṇaṃ da dhi/ zhes pa'i don ni/ a s+thu la s+thu la kri ya te/ ska ba ma yin pa ska bar byed do/ /'o ma sla ba'i dngos po de zho bska ba'i dngos por byed pa lta bu'o/ /bha dzāṃ ba ṇi/ bhadz rnams kyi biṇ'o/ bhadz la sogs pa'i byings la byed pa po'i don du biṇ rkyen du sbyor ro/ /be:/ bi nyid kyi'o/ rkyen biṇ zhes pa'i rjes 'brel ṇ yig ni/ dang por 'phel ba'i don yin/ rkyen dngos bi yin na de yang dbye ba nyid do/ /bha dz nye ba la'o/ bha dz biṇ/ ṇ yal/ bha la 'phel ba bhā/ bi dbyi dz g/ g k/ ar+dha gong*/ si mi snang*/ ar+dha bhak grub/ ar+dha bha dza ti/ phyed mar byas kyi don no/ /pra tsh bi ṇ/ ṇ yal/ 'phel ba/ prā/ bi nub/ tsh ṣ/ ṣ ḍ/ ta twa gong*/ si mi snang*/ ta twa prāṭa/ ta twa prā ṭ/ zhes te/ ta twa bṛts+tsha ti/ de kho na nyid 'dri bar byed do/ /bah phyin pa la'o/ baha bi ṇ/ bsubs bā 'phel/ bi song*/ hḍh/ ḍhṭ/ bhār gong*/ si yal/ bhār bāṭ/ yang na/ bhā ra bāḍ/ khur skyed do/ /bā ho rbau sha sā dau swa re/ ba ha'i ba au te shas sogs dbyangs la'o/ /snga rol na ming ngam byings tshig tu gyur pa a mtha' can yod la/ bar der bah'i byings gnas pa'i pha rol du shas sogs dbyangs dang po'i rnam dbye byung na/

bah'i ba au ru bsgyar te au ha ru 'gro'o/ bhā r bah zhes pa yan chad gong bzhin/ si mi byed par shas bzhag/sh yl/ as bhā ra bah as byung*/ bah'i ba au bhā/ ra'i ra'i dbyangs a dang 'dus pa au h shas kyi a la drangs/ s rnam bcad bhā rau ha/ ṭā la yang 'dra/ bhā rau hā/ bh+yām dbyangs dang po ma yin pas ba au ru mi 'gro/ h ḍh ru 'gro/ ḍh ḍ drangs bhā ra baḍaṃbah+yā/ zhes sogs so/ /sah lhan du 'grogs pa la'o/ /sa heḥṣaḥsāḍhi/ sah sā ḍha te ṣa'o/ biṇ'i rkyen la byings sah ni sḍh ru bsgyur/ sa yig ṣa yig byed do/ /sah biṇ/ ṇ snang med/ sa ring*/ h ḍh/ sā ṣā/ ḍh ḍ'am ṭ ru song*/ tu rā gong*/ si yal/ tu rā ṣā ṭ/ tu rā ṣā ḍ/ don ni tu rā sa ha te/ lhan cig mgyogs par ro/ /au dang dzas h nyid 'dren/ tu rā sā hau/ tu rā sa haḥ mo no dhā tau/ byings la ma'i na'o/ /byings ma yig mtha' can yin na/ pha rol bi ṇ la/ m mtha' n yig tu bsgyur ro/ /bi ṇ'i yang pha rol ra sa so sor bsdu ba'i rnam dbye dgos so/ /sham dang dm nye bar zhi ba la'o/ /sham bi ṇ ṇ yal/ sha 'phel bi song*/ nyer bsgyur b gong*/ mn ru bsgyur/ si mi snang*/ pra shā n/ don ni pra sha mya ti/ rab tu zhi bar byas so/ /ra sa ma yin par dbyangs pha rol la/ pra shā mau/ prashā maḥ au dang dzas la'o/ ā bhū tad+bha be kṛ bahwa sti yo gertswi/ 'das pa min par gyur pa la/ kṛ bhu as sbyor ba la tswi'o/ 'das nas ring du lon pa ma yin pa'i don du byings kṛ dang sbyor ba ste kṛ'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ bhū dngasbyor ba as dang sbyor ba la yang ste/ tswi rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /tswau dīr+gha ī sh+tsā s+ya/ tsi la ring po dang a'i ī yang ngo*/ /rkyen tswi pha rol la byings ming gi mtha'i dbyangs gang yang ring por 'gyur zhing*/ a mtha' ni ī ring por 'gyur ro/ /bi nyid kyi'o/

/zhes pa tswi'i bi dbyi/ ts yig kyang dbyi ste rkyen gyi dbye ba shes pa'i don tsam mo/ /dper na a mi thu naṃ me thu naṃ kṛ ya te a ne na/ 'di mi 'khrig pa las 'khrig par byed do/ /zhes pa'i don la/ mi thu na sngon du bzhag /kṛ las ka ra ṇa gong bzhin sgrubs/ rkyen tswi ster/ mi thu na tsi ka ra ṇa byung*/ na'i srog a ni ī ring por song*/ bi phyis de rjes/ ts yal/ si am/ mi thu nī ka ra ṇaṃ/ zhes te 'di ni kṛ'i sbyor ba'o/ bhū 'gyur ba bhā ba shukla sngon du bzhag/bar du tswi shukla/ tswi bhā ba byung*/ ya'i a ni ī ru song rkyen sngar bzhin phyis/ si rnam bcad/ shuklī bhā ba/ don ni/ a shuklaḥshuklaḥbha ba ti/ dkar po min pa dkar por song*/ zhes so/ bhū'i sbyor ba'i/ dper brjod ro/ /byings as su dang*/ cho ga 'byung gi /yāt sbyar dus a dbyi bas 'dir s+yāt zhes 'byung*/ sa hā ya sngon du bzhag/bar du tsī ya yī/ bi dang ts yal/ sa ha yī s+yāt/ don ni a sa hā yaḥs hā yo bha ba ti/ lhan cig pa med pa las lhan cig pa can du gyur to/ /zhes so/ /as kyi sbyor ba'i dper bshad do/ /kṛ bhū as gsum dang sbyor ba min yang*/ tswi la snga ma'i mtha' ring por 'gyur ba'i dpe ni/ pāṇi tswi g ha ṇa/ ṇī ring po/ tswi phyis si am/ pā ṇī gra ha ṇaṃ/ lag pa nas bzung ngo*/ /zhes so/ de bzhin du/ kṛ gzugs ma gyur ba la yang ste/ he tu tswi kṛt zhes pa la t'i srog ū ring po/ tswi yal si am/ he tū kṛ taṃ/ don ni a he tuḥhe tuḥkṛ ta/ gtan tshigs mi shes pa la gtan tshigs ston no/ /tswau sa lo pash+tsa/ tswi la sa dbyi ba yang ngo*/ /byings man s dang tse tas dang*/ ma hā s dang*/ ra dzas zhes pa 'di rnams la pha rol du tswi byung na/ byings mtha'i sa yig dbyi'o/ ma nas tswi bhā ba sa dbyi na'i a ni ī ru song*/ bi dang ts yang mi snang*/

ut sngon/ t ni lnga pa n ru song*/ si rnam bcad/ an+ma nī bhā ba/ skyo bar gyur to/ ji skad du/ kha cig tu ḍā yang ngo zhes 'byung bas/ duḥkhī dang ka ro ti'i bar la ḍā rkyen bzhag/ṭ phyis ā ṭi phyis/ ā la drangs/ duḥkhā ka ro ti/ sdug bsngal bar byed do/ /bhad dang ka ro ti bar du ḍā a bzhag/ṭi dbyi/ drangs/ bha drā ka ro ti/ don ni a bha dāḥbha drā kṛ ya te/ legs pa ma yin pa rnams legs par byed do/ /ā to ma ni pra kwa ni pra ba ni paḥ āt l ma nip kwa nip ba nip'o/ byings mtha' ā yig ring po can gyi pha rol du/ rkyen ma nip dang*/ kwa ni pa dang*/ ba nip gsum po las gcig 'byung ba mang ngo*/ /rkyen gsum po de'i p rnams rjes 'brel/ na rnams kyi dbyangs i yig rnams brjod don no/ ༈ /tā sbyin pa'i byings/ dā ma nip p rjes 'brel/ i brjod don dā mn si/ u pa dhā ring*/ mā su gong*/ sngar rtags drug ra dzan gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin/ si dang n 'jig go /suṣ+ta da dā ti/ legs pa'i sbyin pa sbyin no/ /zhes pa'i don la/ su dā mā/ ༈ṣ+ṭhā ma nip p i yal/ ṣ+ṭhā s+thā ru/ a shwa th gong*/ s mgo mi snang*/ th t/ si dbyi/ n yal/ t drangs/ a shwa ta i ba tiṣ+ṭha ti/ 'di ni rta la tshugs pa'o/ /zhes pa la a shwat+thā mā/ sngar gzhan rnams kyis rta shugs su bsgyur ro/ kha cig 'di la a shwat+tha sngon du bzhag nas tha dbyi ba'i cho ga byas nas/ shing a shwat+tha la bsnun brdegs kyang mi 'bros pa bzhin g.yul ngor mi 'bros pa la 'chad pa'ang yod do/ ༈s+thā mī/ s+thā rnams la ī'o/ /byings s+thā dang pā dang gā rnams la byings mtha'i ā yig ring po ī yig ring por 'gyur te/ kit pha rol la yin kyang nang tshan kwip rkyen byung na ī ru mi 'gyur ro/ ༈ /de yang pā kwa nip p i yal/ k yang dbyi/ ban lus s+thā rnams la ī'o/ /zhes pas pā pī zhes par bsgyur/

su gong*/ si/ u pa dhu ring*/ pā/ si n 'jigasu pī bā/ suṣ+ta pi ba ti/ rab tu 'thungs so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈dā ba nip/ ip phyis dā ban bhū ri gong*/ si/ u pa dhā ring*/ n si gnyis sbas so/ /bhu ri dā bā/ ༈ ji skad du/ gzhan 'ga' zhig dag las kyang mthong ngo*/ /zhes 'byung bas s+th dang bā dang dā sogs ā mtha' ru ma zad ā mtha' ma yin pa la yang*/ ma nip sogs 'jug go ༈ kṛ ma nip/ gong bzhin ṛ ar/ su gong*/ si/ u pa dhā ring*/ gnyis po yal/ su karmā/ legs pa'i las byas so/ ༈su ṣ+tu ka ro ti/ zhes pa'i don no/ ༈shṛ mnip kṛ dang 'dra bar sgrubs/ suṣ+tashṛ no ti/ legs par thos so/ /zhes pa la/ su sharmā/ zhes pa'o/ ༈kwi paḥ/ kwip'o/ /byings thams cad kyi pha rol du kwip rkyen skabs su bab na 'byung du rung ngo*/ /h swa s+ya pi ti kṛ ti tuk/ thung ngu'i kṛt kyi pit la tuk'o/ /byings thung ngu'i mtha' la kṛt rkyen gyi nang du gtogs pa'i pit kyi ming can pha rol byung na tuk ā ga ma ster ro/ /kṛta kyi pit ces smos pas rnam dbye si sogs ti sogs kyi pi t ma yin zhes pa'o/ /kwip/ kwip yang ngo*/ /kwip kyi rkyen ni k b ip ste yi ge bzhi 'dus pa yin rung thams cad dbyi ste/ dbyi lugs 'di la a pa ha ti kun tu 'joms zhes bya'o/ ༈ /de yang kṛ kwip kwip ni dus gcig tu dbyi'o/ /ka lā pa'i lugs la kwip kyi yi ge bzhi po la mdo tshig re res dbyi mod/ 'dir kwep yang ngo zhes pa gcig pus so/ /kṛtu k/ karma sngon/ tu/ k gi k rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ si phyis/ karma kṛt karma ke ro ti/ las byed do/ zhes so/ ༈de bzhin du/ ag+ni tsiny/ kwip dbyi/ tuk uk yal/ t lus/ si 'jiga.ag+ni tsit/ ag+ni tsi no te/ me shing gsog go /zhes so/ ༈ /stu kwip mi snang tuk uk dbyi/ de ba sngon/

si 'jigade bstu ta/ de baṃ stau ti/ lha la bstod pa byed do/ /zhes so/ ༈kwip yod kyang tuk rkyen med pa'i dper brjod ni/ /de bzhin du/ ༈pā kwi p tuk med/ so ma gong*/ si rnam bcad/ so ma pāḥ/ de bzhin du/ dṛsh kwip yal/ si dbyi sh k sarba gong*/ sarba dṛk/ thams cad mthong ngo*/ /sarba pa sh+ya ti/ ༈shṛny ngag bzhin nyan pa la'o/ /shṛ kwip/ ji skad du/ prats+tsha sogs la ring po yang ngo*/ /zhes 'byung bas shṝ su gong si yal su shṝ/ bde ba'i grogs so/ ༈ta twa sngon/ byings prats+tsha/ kwip 'jigasi tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs tsha ṣa ru song*/ ṣ'i ḍ'o/ ḍ yang na ṭ ru song*/ pra tsa sogs la ring po'o/ /ta twa prā ṭ/ ta twa prāḍ/ de kho na nyid la 'dri'o/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ ba ts kwip yal/ tsu'i ku'o/ /ts k/ yang na k g si 'jig bāg /bāk/ gdam ka'o/ /au dang dzas la bā tsau/ bā tsaḥ/ ༈ji skad du/ kwip pha rol la nyer bsgyur gyi ring po na h la'o/ /zhes bshad ps na h 'ching ba la'o/ /nah kwip 'jig u pa gong*/ nyer sgyur gyi ring po/ na h la'o zhes pas pā ring po/ si na/ ha'i dha'o/ ༈ /h dh/ dh t/ si 'jig u bā na ta grub/ de ni lham gyi ming yang yin/ u ba sa mī pe na h+ya te/ nye bar phyin nas btod do*/ /zhes par yang 'gyur ro/ ༈ /yang kṛ kwip yal/ sa rkyen byin ṛt kyi ir'o/ /ri ir du bsgyur byings gnyis brjod/ si byin ki rki rs si byung thog ma'i ha sa sogs r sngon ma yal i u ra ba sogs kyis ki phyi ma ring po'o/ /ya las so zhes pas sa'i dbyangs a phyis/ s dbyangs med/ k gong ma ts/ si dang rab sbyor mtha'i s dbyi r rnam bcad/ ka ṭa gong*/ ka ṭa tsi kīḥ/ rtsa lhas byas so/ /don ni ka ṭaṃ tsi kīr+ṣa ti/ zhes so/ ༈au dang dzas sogs la s mi dbyi ste/ s ṣ au dang as la 'dren ka ṭa tsi kīr+ṣau/ ka ṭa tsi kīr+ṣaḥ/ zhes so/

༈dh+yai sems pa la'o/ /ji skad du/ dh+yai rnams kyi kwip la slar yang dag par bsgyur ba ring po nyid kyang ngo zhes 'byung bas/ dh+yai la sogs pa'i byings la/ kwip byung na saṃ pra sa ra ṇa 'byung la/ de yang thung ngu ma yin ring po ste/ dh+yai kwip de thams cad dbyi/ dh yai so sor phral/ saṃ pra sa ra ṇa spyi khyab la/ y nyid i thung ngur bsgyur ba yin kyang*/ 'dir y dang srog ai gnyis po sdoms nas ī ring por bsgyur bas/ dh ī byung drangs/ su gong*/ si rnam bcad/ su dhīḥ/ rab tu sems pa'am/ legs par sems pa'o/ ༈ /dṛ sheṣ+ta k sa kau tsau pa mā ne kar+ye/ dṛsh la ṭak sak dag kyang ste dpe'i bya ba la'o/ /byings drish sogs la/ sarba sogs kyi sgra rtags sngon du bzhag na/ rkyen ṭak dang sak gang rung 'byung zhing*/ kyang zhes pa'i sgras kwip kyang 'byung ngo*/ /de lta bu'i rkyen gsum po gang byin kyang 'dra ste/ don ni dpe nye bar mtshon pa ste/ gser ma mthong ba'i mi la dpe ni/ gser las gzhan pa ra gan lta bu ste/ gser ci 'dra zer/ ra gan 'dra bar mthong zhes pa lta bu'o/ / dṛsh ṭak ces pa bzhag/sarba sogs kyi nang nas an+ya gong*/ k ṭ phyis a bzhagash a la drangs/ a sarbā de sarba sogs la ā'o/ /ṭak sak kwip ste rkyen 'di rnams pha rol du byung na/ sngon du bzhag pa'i sarba sogs kyi rtags mtha' ni ā ring po nyid du 'gyur ro/ /'dir a n+ya zhes pa'i n+ya ring por song*/ si rnam bcad/ a n+ya i ba dṛ sh+ya te/ gzhan dang 'dra bar ltos shig/ces pa'i don la/ a n+yā dṛ shaḥ ༈yang dṛ shs k k yal/ a n+ya gong*/ sarba sogs la ā'o/ /zhes pas n+yā ring po/ tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs/ sh ṣ/ ku ha sogs ṣa k rkyen gyi sa ṣa k ṣa k+ṣa si rnam bcad a n+yadṛk+ṣaḥ/ ༈a n+ya dṛ sh kwi p de yal n+yā ring*/ sh ka/ si phyis a n+yādṛkra/ ༈tat dang ldan pa'i dṛ sh las so/ /zhes pas dṛ sh ṭak k dang ṭ yal a sarba sogs kyi nang nas tat gong*/

'di la tat kyi dbyangs a thung dang*/ mthar brten t dbyangs med sbrags nas ā ring por 'gro t ā la drangs sh drangs si rnam bcad/ tā dri shaḥ/ des rigs 'gre/ ༈tat dṛ shs ksi zhes pa la k yal/ sh k/ sa ṣa/ at ā/ si rnam bcad tā drik+ṣaḥ/ ༈ta t dṛ sh kwip si zhes pa la kwip 'jiga.at ā/ ash k/ ha sa la si yal/ tā dṛg/ zhes ba'o/ ༈sgrub tshul byings de kho na bzhin dri sh'i gong du āsmad bzhag/āsmad ni mat ces bar bsgyur/ sarba sogs kyi thog ma'i ā ste/ ma ta zhes pa/ mā zhes par 'gro ba khyad par ro/ /mā dṛ shaḥ/ mā dṛk+ṣaḥ/ mādṛk /zhes so/ ༈rkyen ṭak zhes pa'i ṭa rjes 'brel ni īp bud med kyi rkyen sbyin du rung ba'i don te/ dṛ sh ṭak k dang ṭ+ra yal/ a bzhag/de la sh drangs ta t gong zhes te/ tā dṛsh la īp byin p thim a i la dbyi/ sha'i dbyangs a mi snang*/ ī la drangs/ si 'jigatā dṛ shī/ ༈de bzhin du/ ā smad mat ru bsgyur/ de mā ṭak īb/ mā dṛ shī/ ༈a n+ya ring po ā/ ṭa k īp/ a n+yā dṛ shī/ ༈ki mi da moḥkīshau/ kim dang i dm ni kī dang ī sh'o/ /ṭek sogs rkyen gsum po'i skabs 'dir/ byings dṛ sh'i gong du sarba sogs nang tshan rtags sam sgra kim yod na kī ring po dang*/ i dm yod na ī sh ru bsgyur ro/ /ka i ba dṛ sh+ya ti/ gang dang 'dra bar mthong*/ zhes pa la 'di ltar sgrub/ ༈kim dṛsh ṭak /kim dang zhes pa'i mdo 'dis/ kim ni kī zhes par bsgyur/ kī dṛsh a drangs/ si rnam bcad/ kī dṛ shaḥ/ kī dṛ k+ṣaḥ/ kī dṛk dṛsh ṭak i dm gong*/ i dm ī sh ru bsgyur/ sh yig khyad don gzhan 'dra/ a ya mi ba dṛ sh+ya te/ 'di dang 'dra bar mthong ngo*/ /zhes pa la/ ī dṛ shaḥ/ ī dṛk+ṣaḥ/ ī dṛkra zhes pa rnams gong bzhin/ ī dṛsh ṭak dang īp byin na gong bzhin te/

ī dṛ shī bārtā/ gtam 'di dang 'dra bar shes so/ /zhes pa'o/ /ji skad du/ bha ba t sogs rnams la/ dṛ sh'i rnam par gnas pa'i don la ṭak la sogs pa'i thog ma'i ṭi ring po nyid do zhes 'byung bas/ dṛ sh ṭak/ a bt kyi ṭi ni/ at te/ de ni ā ru bsgyur/ bha bāsh a la sbyar/ si rnam bcad bha bādṛ shaḥ/ bha bā dṛ k+ṣaḥ/ bha bā dṛ k/ bha bā ni ba dṛ sh+ya te/ khyod dang 'dra bar shes so/ ༈ /ṇi ni ra tī te/ 'das pa la ṇi ni'o/ /byings gang la 'das pa'i dus kyi don dang*/ tshul khrims kyi don du ṇi ni zhes pa'i rkyen ster ro/ /ṇ ni 'phel ba'i don n'i i rjes 'brel rkyen dngos ni in zhes pa'o/ ༈de yang 'di ltar yadz ṇi ni zhes pa bzhag/i phyi ma dang ṇ yal/ yadz in/ dang por 'phel/ ba ā te yādz byung*/ drangs/ yā dzin ag+niṣ+to/ ma sngon du bzhagasi in rnams kyi si la'o zhes pas ring*/ u pa dhā'i rigs dzī ring por song*/ /si dbyi n ya nga dbyi/ me'i las kyis lha mchod do/ /ag+niṣ+to ma yā dzī/ zhes mchod zin 'das pa'i dus so/ pra dz ṇi ni in/ dang por 'phel/ drangs/ pra gong*/ si/ dzī ring si dang n 'jig/p brā dzī/ rab tu spong ba'o/ /tshul khrims kyi don no/ ༈bhudz ṇi ni/ bhudz in 'phel ba thob kyang 'dir yon tan no/ /drangs bho dzin uṣ+ma gong si u pa dhā ring*/ si dang n yal/ uṣ+ṇaṃ bhuk+ta ban/ zas dron mo zos so/ /zhes pa'i don la/ uṣ+ma bho dzī/ ༈ kwip ba nip ḍāḥ/ kwip dang ba nip dang ḍa rnams so/ /'das dus tshul khṛms kyi don la/ rkyen kwap dang ba nipa dang*/ ḍa zhes pa rnams 'jug ste/ kwip ni pit yin kyang thams cad dus gcig tu dbyi ba dgos chos yin/ ba nip ni pit gyi bya ba byed do/ ༈ /ha n kwip 'jig bṛtā gong*/ si/ u pa dhā ring*/ si dang n yal bṛ tā hā/ grub/ bṛ tā ha ta pān/

lha min 'joms pa dang ldan pa'o ste brgya byin no/ ༈ /ṣāny srog mched pa la'o/ /ṣu ny ny dbyi/ ba nip ster/ p dang i mi snang*/ ṣu ban pit la tuk ste k dang u yal/ t lus/ ṣut ban/ ṣa sa/ t ba la drangs su twa n/ si/ u pa dhā ring si dang n yal su twā grub/ 'tsho ba rgyas pa'i don no/ /tuk ni kit yin pas yon tan mi 'byung ste/ so twa zhes par mi 'gro'o/ ༈dzan ḍa zhes bzhag/ḍ phyis a/ ḍit ṭi yal ba an med/ dz dbyangs med lus/ de rkyen gyi a la drangs/ sa ra/ si gong*/ si am/ ḍa'i a dza la yod pa phyis nas aṃ la drangs/ sa ra si dzaṃ/ zhes te/ sa ra si dzā taṃ/ mtsho las skyes pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ gam ḍa a drangs/ sarba gong*/ si rnam bcad/ sarba gaḥ/ sarba t gats+tsha ti/ thams cad du 'gro'o/ ༈ /gaiḍa/ a ṭi yal/ g dbyangs med rkyen la drangs sā ma gong si rnam bcad/ sā ma ga ya ti/ snyan tshig 'don no zhes pa'i don te/ sā ma gaḥ/ ༈k+ta k+ta ba tu/ k+ta dang k+ta ba tu'o/ /byings gang la 'das dus ston pa'i don la rkyen k+ta dang k+ta ba tu gnyis kyang 'byung ste/ 'das dus kyi dngos po'i bya byed la k+ta dang*/ 'das dus kyi byed pa po'i don la k+ta ba tu'o/ ༈ /byings kṛ la/ rkyen k+ta bzhagak 'jig ta lus/ si rnam bcad kṛtaḥ/ de yang kṛ taḥka ṭaḥ/ rtsa lhas byed rgyu sngar yod pa'o/ ༈yang byings kṛ la rkyen k+ta ba tu ster k 'jig/u ni num ster ba'i khyad don no/ /si kṛta bt si/ ba dang ta'i bar du num m dang u yal/ kṛta ban tra si/ u pa dhā ring po/ ma ning la si 'jigarab sbyor mtha'i t yal/ kṛ ta bā n/ de la kṛ ta bān k ṭaṃ rtswa lhas byas zin pa'o/ /yang gam k+ta k yal a nu dat+ta dbyi ba nyid do/ /zhes m dang āng gong ng dbyi si am/ ta'i srog yal ba am la drangs/ ā ga taṃ/ tshur shog༈ṣ+ṭhāk+ta k song s+thā ru bsgyur iṭ ā phyis nas iṭ la drangs s+thī se a m gong bzhin/

s+thi taṃ/ 'dug shig༈ga t+ya r+thā da karma kāts+tshakarta rik+taḥ/ 'gro ba'i don dang las med pa dang byed po la k+ta'o/ /byings gang la 'gro ba'i don yod pa dang byed po'i don dang*/ byings las med pa la yang rkyen k+ta 'jug pa yin no/ ༈aṭ 'gro ba la'o/ /yaṭ k+ta bzhag /byings rkyen bar du iṭ aṭ ita si byung*/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ i ṭi taḥ/ 'khor bar gyur to/ a ṭa ti/ zhes so/ ༈ṣ+ṭhā k+ta iṭ s+thā ru song*/ i mthong*/ ā yal/ drangs/ si s+thi taḥ/ gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ ༈ /sham k+ta iṭ med/ sham rnams kyi ring po'o/ /zhes pas byings kyi dbyangs ring po ste/ shām nga ro/ /si rnam bcad shāṃ taḥgrub shāṭan+taḥlus 'gyur gyi khyad tsam yin/ shīn+taṃ prābhaḥ/ zhi ba thob bo/ /shā mya ti/ zhi bar byed ces pa'i don no/ ༈sgrub tshul de kho nas dm k+ta ces pa la/ dān+taḥ/ dā myata/ dul bar byed do/ ༈k+to bā se ṭ/ iṭ bcas k+ta la yang na'o/ /gong du bshad pa'i a ṭi taḥdang*/ s+thi taḥsogs dmigs gsal rnams ma yin pa'i iṭ yang yod pa'i k+ta byung na/ byings la yon tan byed mi byed gdam nga ste/ rkyen kit kyi ming can du byed na/ yon tan spangs pas rang gnas yin/ kit min la yon tan no/ ༈d+yu t iṭ k+ta zhes bzhagak dang ṭ song*/ nyer sgyur pra gong kit du bsams na yon tan med/ pra d+yu ti taḥ/ kit min du bsams na yon tan te/ prad+yo ti taḥ/ pra d+yo ta tesma/ rab tu gsal bar 'dug go /d+yu tam+p+rap+taḥ/ snang ba thob pa'o/ ༈ /bd k+ta iṭ sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byas pas ba yig u yig tu bsgyur/ ud it si byung gong bzhin/ u ti taḥ/ u da yaṃ prā p+ta/ smra ba'i skabs byung ngo*/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ rud iṭ k+ta zhes pa la/ ru di taḥ/ yang na/ ro di taḥ/ rod naṃ pra bhaḥ/ ༈muṣ iṭ k+ta/ zhes pa la mo ṣi taḥ/ yang na mu ṣi taḥ/ mu ṣ+ya te sma/ rkun po 'dug go /zhes pa'i don no/ ༈ /grah aiṭ k+ta bzhagagrah rnams kyi iṭ la'o/

/zhes pa iṭ'i ī ring po'o/ /kit la slar yang dag par bsgyur te/ gra gṛ ru 'gro/ kit min la mi 'gro /gṛ hī taḥ/ gra hī ta:/ don ni gṛh+ya tesma/ bzung bar gyur to/ ༈ /nud byed du 'jug pa la'o/ /nud iṭ k+ta/ no de ta:/ nu di taḥ/ gong bzhin no/ /nu d+ya ste sma/ byed du bcug pa'o/ ༈bid iṭ k+ta/ be di taḥ/ bi d+ya te sma/ rig par byed pa'o/ /ki taḥ/ kit la'o/ /byings u yig mtha' can dang*/ ṛ yig mtha' can dang shrī zhes pa'i byings las pha rol rkyen kit kyi ming can k+ta lta bu byung na/ iṭ ā ga ma'i rkyen mi ster te/ ṛ mtha'i dper brjod/ prit k+ta si zhes pa la/ pṛt+taḥ/ zhes par 'gro bas rnam 'gyur gzhan med/ ༈u mtha'i dper brjod ni/ bhū k+ta zhes pa la si byin/ bhutaḥzhes pa kho na'o/ ༈ /shrī la shrīk+ta si bzhag/shrī taḥ/ zhes pa kho na'o/ ༈bṛ t+yaṃ prap+taḥsgribs par gyur te/ bha ba ti/ byung bar gyur to/ /shrī ya te sma/ 'byor bar gyur to/ /de dag ni k+ta'i rkyen gyi bya ba ste/ k ni rnam pa kun du dbyi'o/ ༈ /ī dī di taḥ/ āt dang īt it nyid do/ /āt ces pa ā ring po'i ming yin/ īt ces pa'ang ī ring po'i ming yin/ it rting ma ni sngar yod phyis pa'i yul gyi ming ngo*/ /des na āt kyi mtha' it du gyur pa ste phyis pa dang*/ āt kyi mtha' it kyi ming can te phyis pa la ni iṭ mi 'jug go /nyī nyī tāṃ tak brta mā ne nye ba/ nya dang i itra la tak te 'jug bzhin pa la yang ngo*/ /byings gang la ny rjes 'brel yal ba dang*/ i phyis pa la tak zhes pa'i rkyen 'jug ste/ iṭ med pa'o/ /da sta s+ya no da sh+tsa/ da las ta'i na te da yang ngo*/ /byings kyi mtha'i d yig gi pha rol du rkyen ki t yin pa'i ta yig byung na ta yig de na yig tu 'gyur la/ d yig rang nyid kyang n yig tu 'gyur ro/

༈ /de yang nyi mi dā snum pa'am 'phrod pa la'o/ /nyi ma dā/ nyi rjes 'brel/ da yi dbyangs ā brjod don/ mid lus/ mid ta k/ k rjes 'brel da las ta'i na te zhes pas/ byings kyi mtha'i d yig gi pha rol rkyen tak zhes pa'i ta yig dbyangs bcas na yig srog can du 'gyur ro/ /mid na zhes so/ /d yang ngo zhes pas byings mtha'i d yig dbyangs med mid zhes pa'i d rang nyid kyang n dbyangs bral du 'gyur ro/ /min byung*/ drangs/ min+na si am/ n'i a yal/ drangs/ min+naṃ grub/ bsres pa'am sbags pa'i don te/ min+ni man+naṃ tai le na brta te/ zas la til mar 'dres par blugs so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈nyiṣ+wi dā lus gsher ba la'o/ /nyi dang ā yal/ ṣ+wi d tak iṭ med/ tan d n/ swi/ si rnam bcad/ pra gong*/ pra swin+naḥ/ rdul nag gis gsher ba'o/ /ā yā se na pra swi d+ya ti/ rang las byung bas rab tu gsher ro/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /nyikiṣ+wa dā phyi mar 'thag pa la'o/ /nyi dang ā phyis/ k+ṣ+wid tak bzhag iṭ med ta na/ d n si rnam bcad/ k+ṣ+wan+naḥ/ k+ṣ+wi d+ya ti/ phye mar 'thag go / ༈ a do dza ghuḥki ti/ ad dzagh kit l'o/ /ad ces pa'i byings ni pha rol du kit yin pa'i rkyen byung na/ dzagh+ra zhes par kun nas bsgyur te/ de yang ad tak k song*/ ad ces pa dza gha ru song*/ dza gha ta byung*/ gha g ru 'gro ta tha'i dha zhes pas ta dha ru 'gyur/ dzag dha byung*/ drangs/ si am sngar bzhin/ dzag+nghaṃ/ bza' bya thob bo/ /zhes pa la/ a da naṃ brā bhaṃ/ 'on kyang dzag+dhaṃ/ sha'i bza' ba la bye brag tu 'jug go ༈ raḥ/ ra las so/ byings kyi mtha' gdod ma'am rnam 'gyur gyi re pha yin na yang*/ pha rol kyi rkyen gyi ta yig na yig tu 'gyur te/ de yang byings mtha' rang dgos kyi byings mtha' rkyen gyi re pha'i mtha' tsam la ma yin no/ /kṛny 'tshe ba la'o/ /ny yal/ kṛ tak bzhag ṛt ir 'o zhes pas/ k ir/

drangs/ kir/ i ur ba ha sa la zhes pas re pha'i gong gi ī ring po/ ta na/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs ṇa/ chu la ku ba sogs/ bi sngon si am/ gong bzhin/ bi kīr+ṇaṃ/ rab tu bcom mo/ /bi ki r+ya te/ ༈ kṝ rnam par bskyod pa la'o/ /kṛta k ir thung ngu sogs sngar dang 'dra/ bi kīr+ṇaṃ rnam par myos so/ ༈ /dz+ṝ ṣu dzhā+-iṣu lang tsho bcom pa la'o/ ༈ /dz+rīṣ ṣ yal/ dz+ṝk+ta/ ṛ ir/ i ring ta na/ na ṇa/ si am/ dzī ya tesma/ rgas so dang 'gyur song dang rnyings pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /de la dzīr+ṇaṃ/ ༈dz-ihra k+ta gong ltar sgrubs dzhīr+ṇaṃ/ dzhī r+ya tesma/ rnyings so/ /dzhī r+ṇaṃ sha rī raṃ/ lus rgas so/ ༈ /lwā d+yo di taḥ/ lū sogs dang ot it la'o/ /lū ny gcod pa la'o/ /zhes sogs kyi byings dang*/ ot ces pa o yig go /it te o de 'dra/ phyis pa'i byings la yang*/ h yig ni na yig tu 'gyur zhing*/ byings la i thung yod na ī ring por yang bgyur ro/ ༈ /lūk+ta/ ta na/ si rnam bcad/ lū naḥgrub/ lū ya te sma/ gcod par byed pa nyid do/ ༈ /lū sogs zhes pa'i sogs khongs dper brjod ni/ k+ṣi zad pa la'o/ /k+ṣi k+ta zhes pa bzhag/ji skad du/ yang na k+ṣi la ring po ste/ nges par rtogs pa la na'o/ /zhes 'byung ba byings k+ṣi gcig bu yin yang zad pa'i don dang nges par rtogs pa gnyis su 'gro bas/ ༈nges par rtogs pa'i don du sgrub na/ k+ṣi'i i thung ī ring du 'gyur/ rkyen gyi ta yig na yig go /k+ṣ+win ṣa ra ṛ sogs ṇa/ si am k+ṣ+ṇi ṇaṃ/ don ni k+ṣī ya te sma te nges pa rnyed pa'o/ /zad pa'i don du byed na/ k+ṣitra/ si rnam bcad/ k+ṣitaḥ/ gzhan rnam 'gyur med/ ༈m+lai kata/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ā ring por 'gro /m+lā ta na si rnam bcad/ m+lā naḥ/ m+lā ya ti sma/ mi dga' bar gnas so/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ glai k+ta/ glā na/ glā ya tesma/ don snga ma dang 'dra/ ༈o hāk btang ba la'o/ /o dang k yal/

ot phyis pa'i dper brjod de/ o yig byings mthar yod mi dgos so/ /des na thog ma'i khyad don o yig phyis pa nyid o it yin no/ /hā k+ta hā'i dbyangs ā ring nyid ī ྄ring du 'gyur/ ta na/ si rnam bcad hī naḥ/ hī ya te sma/ nyams pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ dāk+ta ā ī ru/ ta na/ si/ dī naḥgrub/ di ya te sma/ sbyin par gnas so/ /ā ī ru 'gro ba ni/ s+thā rnams kyi ī'o zhes pa'i gzhung las so/ ༈ /o byā yi rgan pa la'o/ /o dang i phyis byā bī/ byā ya pī'o/ /byāy zhes pa'i byings pī zhes par bsgyur ba ste/ ta'i rkyen pha rol du byung na'o/ /byā ya k+ta/ pī zhes par bsgyur/ ta na si rnam bcad pī naḥ/rgan po'o/ /rtsub po'o/ /do dat+ti/ dā'i dad 'o/ /byings dā ni/ kit rkyen k+ta lta bu la dad ces bar bsgyur ro/ /dāk+ta/ k 'jig dā zhes pa dad dat drangs si dat+taḥ/ dī ya tesma/ sbyin pa gda'o/ ༈dā k+tabtu/ ka dang u yal/ dāta bt byung*/ da dad/ dat/ si/ ba dang t'i bar du num ā ga ma/ dad ta ban ta ྄si zhes byung*/ u pa dhā ring*/ bā si 'jig rab sbyor mtha' t dbyi/ dat+ta bā n grub/ da dā tisma/ sbyin pa 'dug go ༈ /dū h nye bar gdung ba la'o/ /dū k+ta ta na/ si/ dū naḥgrub/ tsha bas gdungs so/ ༈ /swa rāt+to bā/ dbyangs las ta yang na'o/ /dā zhes pa'i byings ni/ pha rol rkyen k+ta byung la byings rang gi thog mar ming tshig gzhan dbyangs mtha' byung na/ ta dbyangs med du 'gyur ba'am/ yang na sngar bzhin dad du bsgyur ro/ ༈ /dāk+ta nyer sgyuras pra gong*/ de'i tshe dbyangs mtha' thog mar byung*/ dā dbyangs bcas t dbyangs bral du bsgyur/ rkyen gyi t yig na ru mi 'gro'o/ /prat/ ta si/ prat+taḥ/ yang na pradata sipra dat+taḥ/ ༈yang pra'i dod du a ba bzhag na/ si am/ gzhan 'dra/ a bat+taṃ a ba dat+taṃ/ ches sbyin pa nyid do/ ༈ /yadz lha mchod pa la'o/ /ya dza k+ta/ yadz rnams kyi ya ba ra rnams so zhes/

sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byed pas ya i ru song i/ dz tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs dz ṣ/ ta ni ṣa mthong bas ṭa/ si/ am/ iṣ+taṃ/ ༈k+ta ba tu ster na'ang gong bzhin thams cad te/ iṣ ṭa ban/ t/ si/ u pa dhā ring*/ si dang ta ྄yal/ iṣ+ta bān/ 'dod pa'i lha mchod do/ ༈ /ṭub p sa bon dang thags skyed pa la'o/ /ṭu dbyi'o/ /bap k+ta/ ba u ru/ m+p+ra sa ra ṇa byed/ drangs/ si am/ up+taṃ/ grub/ ubya te sma/ sa bon las myu gu skyes so/ yang na thags btags so/ ༈ /bah thob pa la'o/ /bah k+ta/ ba sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byas/ u/ h ha'i ḍha'o zhes pas/ h ḍha ta tha'i dha'o/ /rkyen dha dha ḍha ru song*/ ḍha la ḍha dbyi ste ring po'o/ /zhes pas u ring por song*/ ḍh dbyangs bral mi snang*/ ū ḍhaḥ/ ū ḍho3n ḍu hā saṃ guḥ/ khyu mchog 'theng po la zhon pa'o/ ༈hwe ny 'bod par byed pa la'o/ /ny rjes 'brel hwe k+ta bzhag h beta byung*/ sam+p+ras ra ṇar byas/ ū ring por song*/ rgyu mtshan pa tsam la u thung yin kyang*/ srog e yod pas rgyu de las ring po'o/ /nyer sgyur ang sngon/ si rnam bcad/ ā hū ya tesma/ mgron du bos so zhes pa la/ ā hū taḥ/ ༈bye nya g.yogs pa la'o/ /bye k+ta b eta byung*/ saṃ pra sa ra ṇas/ ye/ ī ru bsgyur rgyu mtshan/ ya rang nyid i thung 'gyur dgos na'ang*/ srog e ya bsgyur ba'i nus pas ī ring po'o/ /gong du h la rnam 'gyur med/ be la sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa byed pa ltar/ 'dir thog ma'i yi ge bral/ rnam 'gyur med/ ye sam+p+ras ra ṇa byed pa'o/ /nyer sgyur sam gong*/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ yang na si am saṃ bī ya tesma/ sam+bīta/ sam+bī taṃ/ yang dag par g.yogs pa'o/ /yang na mang pos mchod do/ ༈ /yang byings bd k+ta k yal/ ba dbyangs bcas u iṭ ster/ ud i ta drangs/ si am/ am shas la a phyis/ drangs/ u di taṃ/ ༈btsk+ta/ ba u/ tsa yi ku'o/ /tsk ru song*/ drangs/ si am/ uk+taṃ/ u di taṃ dang*/ uk+taṃ don gciga.u d+ya te sma/

smra ba nyid do/ ༈ba si k+ṣu dho riṭ/ bs dang k+ṣu dh dag la iṭ'o/ /byings bs dang k+ṣu dh la rkyen k+ta pha rol la iṭ ster ro/ /bs k+ṣa iṭ/ sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa/ us ita/ si am/ uṣ+ya te sma/ u ṣai taṃ/ gnas chos shigaces pa'o/ ༈k+ṣu dh bkres pa la'o/ /k+ṣu dh k+ta iṭ k+ṣu dh ita/ si/ k+ṣu dhi taḥ/ ༈gha sā deḥṣaḥ ghas sogs la ṣa'o/ /byings ghas sogs la k+ta byung na/ byings mtha'i s ṣ yig tu 'gyur ro/ /ghasl̥ za ba la'o/ /l̥ rjes 'brel/ ghas k+ta/ s ṣ/ ta ṭa si rnam bcad/ ghaṣ+taḥ/ zas la spyod do/ ༈ /traing srung ba la'o/ /ng rjes 'brel/ trai k+ta bzhag/trā ṇā d+yā bā ni bā tān+te/ trā ṇa sogs la ni pā ta yang na'o/ /ji skad du/ ta yig na yig tshig phrad do/ /zhes kyang bshad pas trai ng la sogs pa la k+ta'i rkyen gyi skabs 'dir srung ba'i don la sogs pa don gyi khyad par sna tshogs pa yin kyang k+ta'i ta yig na yig tu bsgyur ba'i ni pā da'i sgrub pa byed do/ /'on kyang mtha' gcig tu ni ma yin te/ yang na/ ta nyid du gnas so/ /ta na ru bsgyur bar ma zad/ trai ni trā ring por bsgyur ro/ ai ā ru bsgyur ba trai kho na la yin gyi gzhan la ma yin no/ ༈ des na t ai ta tan/ na ṇa/ ai ā/ si rnam bcad trāṇaḥ/ yang trai ta si/ trai trā ru bsgyur ba las gzhan mi dgos/ trā taḥ/ ༈sogs khongs dper brjod hrīk+ta/ k yal tan de ṇa/ si/ hrī ṇaḥ/ ta rang gnas hrī taḥ/ ngo tsha'o/ /zhes so/ ༈gh+rā k+ta/ tan/ de ṇa/ si/ gh+rā ṇaḥ/ gh+rā taḥ/ snom byed de sna'o/ ༈ /bid k+ta ta na d yang n/ si/ bin+naḥ/ yang na ta rang gnas/ d ta/ bat+tiḥrig pa'o/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ nud k+ta na/ d n si/ nun+naḥ/ yang na/ ta rang gnas/ da ta/ nut+taḥ/ byed 'jug go'am gyis shig go ༈bā 'gro ba dang dri dag la yang ngo*/ /bāk+ta ta na/ nir gong*/ si rnam bcad/ nirbā ṇaḥ/ yang na ta mi 'gyur/ nirbā taḥ/ kun spangs sam/

myang 'das so/ ༈ /sam+par+yang pe bh+yaḥka ro ti bhū ṣa ṇe su ṭ/ sa m ba ri u ba rnams las kṛ la rgyan gyi don du su ṭ'o/ /mdzes byed dang gzhan na las khyad 'phags kyi yon tan brjod pa'i don du/ kṛ'i byings la thog mar saṃ dang pa ri dang u pa zhes pa nyer sgyur gsum gang rung sbyar na su ṭ ā ga ma ster te/ de yang byings kyi thog mar ro/ ༈ /kṛ k+ta suṭ ā ga ma byings kyi gong du bzhagaṭ dang u yal/ s dbyangs med phar drangs/ sam gong*/ si rnam bcad/ saṃ skṛ taḥ/ saṃ skṛ te sma/ legs byas sam legs sbyar ro/ ༈ /pa ri sbyar na/ pa ri skṛ ya te sma/ yongs su byed pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don la/ pa ri skṛ taḥ/ u ba sbyar na/ u pa skṛ ya te/ nye bar sbyor bar byed ces pa'i don la/ u ba skṛtaḥ/ ༈bha be ghany/ dngos po laghany'o/ /dngos po'i don du kṛ'i byings la gha ny'i rkyen ster te ny rjes 'brel lo/ /kṛ ghany gh yang khyad don no/ /suṭgong*/ skṛ a/ sam gong*/ ṛ 'phel ba ār/ si/ saṃ ska ār a si/ rim pas drangs rnams bcad saṃ skā raḥ/ 'du byed ces pa'o/ /de yang saṃ skṛ ya te/ shin du byed pa'o/ ༈ /gzhan de dang 'dra ba las/ suṭ med/ a laṃ sngon du bzhag/a laṃ kṛ ya te/ mdzes bar byed do/ /zhes pa'i don la/ a laṃ kā raḥ/ rgyan no/ ༈dzan gha/ dza nerdzāḥdzā'o/ /dza n dzā ru bsgyur/ si/ dzā taḥ/ dza tesma/ skyes so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /pa tse baḥ/ pa ts la ba'o/ /pa ts'i byings la ba rkyen te/ k+ta ba ru bsgyur pa yin no/ /pa ts k+ta /k yal/ ta ba ru bsgyur/ tsu'i ku'o zhes pas tsk drangs si/ pakwaḥ/ btsos pa'o/ ༈ /pakwa sgrub tshul de ltar byas nas/ sla yang bt rkyen byin/ si num ā ga ma 'jog ste/ ba dang t'i bar du'o/ /bkwaban t si/ u pa dhā ring po/ si 'jigarab sbyor la t yal/ bkwa bān/ ༈shuṣ skams pa la'o/ ༈ /shu ṣeḥkaḥ/ shuṣ la ka'i/ /byings shuṣ'i pha rol du rkyen k+ta byung na ta ni ka zhes par 'gyur ro/

/shuṣ k+ta ta ka/ ṣ s drangs/ si shu ṣ+ya te sma/ skams pa'o/ /zhes pa la shuskaḥ/ k+ṣai zad byed pa'o/ /k+ṣaik+ta ka ru song mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ā'o/ /zhes pas k+ṣā byung*/ k+ṣe dermaḥ/ k+ṣa las ma'o/ /k+ṣā sogs kyi byings kyi pha rol rkyen k+ta ni ma rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /k+ṣā+ai ya te sma/ /zad byed do zad byed kyi nad lta bu'o/ /don de la k+ṣā maḥ/ ༈s+phā yi dang o bya yi rgan po la'o/ /s+phā yaḥs+phīḥ/ s+phī ni s+phī'o/ /byings s+phā ni rkyen k+ta mthong na s+phī ru 'gyur ro/ ༈ /s+phā k+ta s+phī ru bsgyur/ si/ s+phī taḥ/ ༈abyā ya k+ta/ o dbyi byā ya zhes pa pī ru song pī taḥ/ rgan po'o/ ༈kwa su kā nau ṇa be bt/ kwa su dang ka ṇa dag ṇap be dang 'dra'o/ /byings la k su'i rkyen byung na 'das dus lkog gyur gyi rkyen ṇap sogs/ pa ra smai dang 'dra ba'i cho ga dang*/ kaṇī rkyen byung na/ lkog gyur gyi e sogs āt+ma ne'i bya ba dang 'dra'o zhes pa'i don no/ ༈ /bhi dir gnyis su 'byed pa la'o/ /ir mi snang*/ bhed kwasu kā ni yon tan dgag pa dang*/ u ni num gyi cho ga 'jug ba'i don yin dbyi/ bhi d bs byung*/ ṇap mtshungs pa'i don gnyis brjod yin pas/ bhid bhid thog ma'i ha sa sogs d snga ma yal/ bhi bi ru song*/ si dang num/ bi bhi d ba ns si zhes byung*/ u pa dhā ring si dang sa 'jig d drangs bi bhi dwān/ grub bo/ /bi bhe te ti/ 'joms par byed ba'am bsed par byed pa'o/ ༈kri kwa suk dang u thim/ kṛ bs gnyis brjod kṛ kru bsgyur/ ka tsa/ si/ num/ u pa dhā ring*/ tsa kṛ bā ns si/ si dang s dbyi tsakṛ bān/ byed pa po'o/ /tsa kā ra dang don gcig go ༈kṛ kā ṇa k yon tan spangs pa'i don/ kṛ ān gnyis brjod ṛ dang po a thung de tsa ṛ phyi ma r ru song*/ tsakra r ā na si r dang k ā la drangs/ naṇa si rnam bcad/

tsakrā ṇaḥ/ ༈ /han kwa su/ k dang u yal/ gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa sogs/ ha dzha de dza ha phyi ma'i dbyangs phyis hgh+ra ru song*/ si num/ n dang ba'i bar du iṭ/ u pa dhā ring*/ dza ghan i bāns si zhes pa byung*/ ngh i la drangs si su yal/ dza ghi bān/ zhes grub/ dza ghā na/ 'tshe ldan no/ ༈ /sha tri shā nau tip te bt kri yā yām/ sha tṛ dang shā na dag tip te dang 'dra ste bya ba la'o/ /bya ba zhes pa bya ba'i tshig ste/ ga mya ma na zhes byings dang rkyen 'du bar rung ba'o/ /de la rkyen shatṛ byin na pa ra smai'i tip dang sgrub tshul 'dra la shān byin na/ āt+ma ne te dang sgrub tshul 'dra'o/ ༈ /ba ts shashṛ sh yal ṛ num gyi bya ba'i don no/ /pats at si num pats an tsi/ drangs/ si dang t 'jig pa pa tsa na/ zhes pa grub po/ /patsan a sti bzhagathung ngu mtha'i d ṇ na rnms pha rol dbyangs mthong na gnyis su 'gyur bas/ a thung gi mtha'i n yig pha rol a yig mthong bas/ n nyis 'gyur du song ba a sti'i a la drangs/ pa tsan+na sti/ tshos nas sdod cigaces so/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ paṭh shatṛ bzhagapaṭh na ru bsgyur lugs/ pa tsan dang 'dra/ pha rol du tiṣ+ṭha ti bzhagabar du sak rkyen byin/ akra song*/ s dbyangs bral gnas/ paṭha nas/ tiṣ+ṭha ti/ zhes pa byung*/ n nga ro s ti la drangs pa ṭhaṃ stiṣ+ṭha ti/ klog nas 'dug cig༈gai sha tri ai ā ya si num g ā y ānat si/ si t yal/ so sor drangs/ gā yān grub/ gats+tsha ti dang sbyar/ gā yaṅga ts+tsha ti/ smos la song zhig༈mu gā ne3 taḥ/ at las ā na la mu ka'o/ /byings a mtha' can gyi pha rol rkyen ā na byung na bar du muk ā ga ma ster ro/ /patsa shān/ sha song*/ patsa ān 'dir pa tsa'i tsa dbyangs ldan no/ /byings rkyen bar du muk k dang u song*/ pa tsam ān m drangs si rnam bcad pa tsa mā naḥ/ 'tshed pa po'o/ /pa tsa ti/ ༈de bzhin du/

pi pa shān zhes pa muk pi pa mā naḥ pi pa ti/ 'thung ba po'o/ /yadza shān/ muk/ yadza mānaḥ ya dza te/ mchod sbyin byed mkhan no/ /ya dza mā na stau ti/ mchod sbyin pos bstod do/ ༈ /ma nu a pa bo dhe ne/ ma nu shā na bzhag 'di rkyen ā na yin yang byings a mtha' min bas muk mi ster/ u p drangs/ si rnam bcad/ ma n+wā naḥ/ grub/ ma n+yate/ gus pa po'o/ ༈ /ā se rā na ī/ ās la ā na'i ī'o/ /byings ās rkyen ā na byung na ā na ī ru 'gyur ro/ /ās gnas pa la'o/ /ās ān si/ ā na ī na ru bsgyur/ si rnam bcad ā sīnaḥ/ ā ste/ gnas par gyis shig༈bā di'i poḥsha tuḥ/ at la sha tu te īp la yang na'o/ /at mtha' la rkyen sha tu ster ba ni rtag tu yin la/ de'i steng du bud med kyi ī p ster na num ā ga ma ster mi ster gdam nga'o/ ༈tud shatu/ sha dang u yal/ tud a t drangs si yal tudad/ yang na tu dat/ gdung ba po'o/ ༈ /īp ster na/ tud/ at/ tu/ dat/ īp/ si/ dbyangs mthar num/ tud nt ī si byung na nga ro t ī la bud med la si dbyi/ tudan+tī/ ༈num spangs na tud at īp si drangs/ si yal tu da dī/ zhes so/ ༈ /tudan+tī au/ tu da n+t+yau/ ༈tu dan+tī dzas/ dz dbyi/ as/ tu dan+t+yaḥ/ ༈īp la num med na/ tu da t+yau/ tu da t+yaḥ/ ༈ī p med na si gong du song*/ tud t au bzhag/au ī/ tu da tī/ ༈tud t/ dzas/ dzas shas shi/ ste/ tu da ti/ zhes pa'o/ ༈rung sha tu rung at/ bar du num/ mthar ī p si bzhagarud a nt ī si byung*/ n nga ro drangs/ si dbyi ru daṃ tī/ grub/ s+t+rī ru da tī brta te/ bud med du bar byed bzhin pa zhes so/ ༈ /a bya yo rān+ni t+yaṃ/ ༈at la ap kyi a'i rtag tu'o/ /'dir mdo 'di ltar sgrubs te/ a bi zhes pa ab kyi'o/ /a os/ a la drug pa'i os sbyar/ a'i zhes pa'i don no/

/bi dang sbyar/ bya ru song*/ 'di a er song*/ e ay/ bya a la drangs/ y o la drangs/ s rnam bcad/ a bya yoḥ ap gyi a'i zhes pa'o/ /de rjes āt ces a yig gi don dang*/ nit+yaṃ zhes pa ni rtag tu zhes so/ /ā t la ngi yod kyang tshig phrad kyis zhig pa'o/ /des na āt las zhes bya'o/ /nā mi'i pha rol rnam bcad r dbyangs med du song ba de ā la drangs/ t n de ni la drangs pa'o/ /de ltar ā mtha' can gyi pha rol zhes pa ni/ ap bi ka ra ṇa'i rkyen dang sbrel ba'i/ a yig gi mtha'i pha rol du rkyen sha tu byung na num ā ga ma rtag tu 'byung ste/ i yig dang īp kyang pha rol du sbyor zhes bya ste/ 'on kyang re zhig īp las gzhan pa'i i yig ngos 'dzin rgyu med do/ ༈ /bhū la ap yon tan ab ste bha ba sngar bzhin sgrubs/ bha ba sha tu bzhag/ba'i dbyangs ap kyi a de yal/ shatu at du song ba'i a la drangs īp si ba dang t'i bar du num/ bha ban t ī si/ n nga ro/ t ī la drangs/ si 'jig bha ban+tī/ ༈des mtshon pa/ pa tsa dang pa ṭha dang ha sa la de bzhin du sgrubs pas/ pa tsaṃ tī dang pa ṭhaṃ tī/ ha sa n+ti/ ༈dī bya dang sh+liṣ+ya la a pmed/ di bu rtsed mo dang*/ sh+liṣ dga' ba'i byings la sngar bshad ltar ya rkyen byung ba yin/ de dag īp si num rnams byin pas/ dī byan+tī/ sh+li ṣ+yaṃ tī/ grub bo/ ji skad du/ gnyis brjod pa rnams kyi dzak+ṣa sogs la yang sha tu rtag par te num dgag pa'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ dā dang ya dza k+ṣa sogs kyang yin pa'i byings gnyis brjod can la/ sha tu rtag par 'jug kyang num med ces pa ste/ shatu rtag par 'jug ces pa'i don 'chad tshul gcig la/ byings de dag ming du sgrub tshad rkyen sha tu med du mi rung ba'i go ba ma yin mod/ sha tu rkyen nam sbyor kyang 'dra/ num mi 'byung zhes pa'i go don no/ /des dus nges med du 'jug par 'brel ba la yang rtag par ming 'dogs pa'ang yod/

don gzhan gnyis sogs du ma la thun mong du 'jug pa la yang rtag pa'i sgra yod pa shes par bya'o/ /dper na lo gcig la 'jigs pa zhig dus lan gcig gam 'ga' re las mi 'byung yang dus nges pa med na/ rtag tu zon dgos zer ba dang*/ mi che ge mo dus ston gnyis ka la 'ong ba la/ che ge mo de rtag par 'ong zer ba lta bu'o/ /yang bshad lugs gcig la 'dir sha tu rkyen mang du'ajug pa yod pa la num dgag pa'i don te/ yang na rtag par zhes pa num la sbyar te/ rtag par num dgag pa'o zhes bton na rig pa mi shes pa la go bde'o/ ༈ /dā shatu at du song*/ gnyis brjod/ dang po thung ngu*/ a mthong bas dā'i ā yal/ drangs/ si yal/ dad t au ī/ da da tī/ dzas i/ da da ti/ ༈ dzak+ṣa gad mo la'o/ /dzak+ṣa at a ya la drangs/ si mi snang*/ dzak+ṣat/ au la dzak+ṣa tī/ dzas la num byung na/ dzak+ṣan+ti/ num med na dzak+ṣa ti/ ༈dzāgṛ shatu/ ṛ yon tan dzāgar at/ drangs/ si yal/ dza ga ra t/ yang na ṛ r/ dzā gra t/ ku lā ni dzagarti/ rigs can mel tshe byed do/ ༈ /da ri drā sha tu/ da ri drā'i ā dbyi'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ da ri d a t drangs si yal/ da ri dra ta/ tsa kāsṛ ṛ rjes 'brel/ tsa kās at drangs/ si yal tsa kā sat/ 'od can no/ ༈ /shās at drangs/ si mi snang*/ shā sat/ a nu shā sa ti/ chad pas bcad do/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /bidā derbā ba suḥ/ bid la nges par ba su'o/ /bid kyi byings la rkyen sha tṛ'i gnas su ba su ster ro/ /de la rgya skad bā zhes yang na ba la 'jug pa mang yang*/ 'di mi zad pa yin pas res 'ga' yang na ba bkag pa'i nges pa la yang 'jug res 'ga' gnyis ka ma yin pa'i tshig rgyan nam tshig gi kha skongs tsam yang yod pa las/ 'di'i 'grel bshad la las nges par 'chad/ la las gdam khar 'chad do/ /'grel par sha tri'i yul la ba su rkyen du 'gyur ro zhes pa'i don yang kha cig /shatṛ'i yul te gnas su 'chad cing*/

bid la yang na rkyen shatṛ ste ba yang yod/ /shatṛ'i tshab tu ba su ster ba'ang yod ces 'chad/ nges par 'dod pa 'ga' zhig yul gyi don sngar byung zhig pa'i shul te shatṛ phyis nas ba su ster zer/ la la shatṛ ba su ru bsgyur ba yin yang zer ro/ ༈ /bid ba su u brjod don bs/ si/ num/ u pa dhā ring po'o/ /bid bā ns si byung*/ si dang sa yal/ d bā la drangs bidwān/ rig pa can te mkhas pa'o/ ༈ /yang na bar 'dod na/ ba su bshad zin/ bid sha tṛ ri dang sh mi? snang*/ at lus/ si/ num/ u padhā ring po med/ gzhan 'dra/ bi dan zhes so/ ༈ /yang ji skad du/ at bha ba ta dang tat bha ba ta kyi sgra dag mchod pa'i don la ni pā da'o/ /zhes 'byung pa at bha ba ta si rnam bcad/ bhaṭ+ṭa mishrā/ rnam bcad u de o/ 'di rkyen sogs gang yang med/ ba la nga ro baṃ tshig phrad do/ /at bha ban+to bhaṭ+ṭa mi shrā/ 'dir yod pa ni rje bo gsal pa'o/ zhes so/ /'di don la bhaṭ+ṭa ni rje zhes bya mod/ gtso bo yin tshad la mi zer/ rgyun bzhag gi me la ra skyes kyi mchod sbyin byas pa'i bram ze mkhas pa la zer bas mchod pa'i don dang ldan pa'o/ ༈de bzhin du/ tat bha ba la bhis byin/ tat bha babhiḥ pha rol du bha ga btwā daur+bha ṇi taṃ/ rnam bcad/ r drangs/ tshig phrad kyis ba la nga ro'o/ /nga ro n/ n d/ tat bha bad+bhir+bhag bat+pā daurba ṇi taṃ/ der gnas pas bcom ldan gyi zhabs la bsngags so/ /de yang bcom ldan la mchod pa'i don no/ ༈shī le tṛn/ tshul khrims la tṛ n'o/ khrims dang ngang tshul bzang ngan gyi don dang 'brel ba la rkyen du tṛn 'jug go /n yig ni rkyen gyi dbye ba shes pa'i don no/ /kṛ tṛ n n khyad don kṛ yon tan/ si/ ā ru bsgyur/ ḍit la ṭi dbyi/ drangs/ kartā/ ka ro tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ tshul khrims 'di ltar byed pa 'di'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ ༈dhṛ tṛ yon tan/

si/ ā ṭi phyis/ dhartā/ dha ra tī t+ye bang+shī laḥ/ tshul khrims 'dir 'dzin pa'o/ ༈ /hṛ tṛ si/ gong bzhin hartā/ ha ra tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'phrog par byed de 'di ltar khrims so/ ༈ /mṛ tṛ si martā/ mṛ ya te i t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di ltar 'di srol lugs kyis 'chi ba'o/ ༈ /bh+ri tṛ si bhartā/ bi bhartā t+ye bang+shā laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar khrims 'jug byed do/ /bhṛ rgyas pa'i don ni 'dir 'jug pa'o/ ༈btsir tṛ/ n iṭ ster/ ts-ir yon tan/ bi ts/ ar/ i tṛ si zhes byung*/ si.ā ṭi phyis/ drangs/ bi tsa ri tā/ bi tsa ri tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di ni tshul khrims 'di 'drar rig par byed do/ ༈shī nga ྄tṛ iṭ shī yon tan/ she sha y/ sha y itṛ/ si ā sogs/ sha yi tā/ grub pa sogs shin du mang po'o/ ༈ /iṣ+ṇu snu k+ṇu/ iṣ+ṇu dang snu dang k+ṇu'o/ /'dir tshul khrims zhes pa rang bzhin gyi ngo tsha khrel yod kyi ngang tshul la yang 'jug/bca' khrims sgrigs bkod la yang 'jugabartul zhugs dang sdom pa la 'jug pa kun la grags pa'o/ /don de la tṛn du ma zad/ iṣ+ṇu sogs rkyen gsum po 'di yang 'jug go /༈ji skad du/ kṛny bhṛ dzṛbhū sa hi biṣa dzī dza ni pṛ ti gra si tsa ri bra dza bak+ṣa a ba tra bā rnams la/ iṣ+ṇu yang ngo*/ /zhes 'byung bas/ kṛ ny ny rjes 'brel/ kṛ iṣ+ṇu kṛ yon tan/ a lam gong*/ si rnam bcad/ a laṃ ka riṣ+ṇuḥ/ zab pa'i ngang tshul lo/ ༈ /yang na/ a laṃ ka ro tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar tshul khrims kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhes so/ ༈ /kṛ iṣ+ṇu/ ṛ ar/ āng sngon/ nir thog mar bzhag/nir āk ar iṣ+ṇu rim pas drangs/ ni rā ka riṣ+ṇuḥsi rnam bcad ni rā ka ra tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di ni 'di 'drar gcig tshul khrims so/ /yang na nir dgag tshig ste/ 'di 'di ltar tshul khrims med pa'o/ ༈ /bh+rā dz+ra iṣ+ṇu/ si drangs/ rnam bcad bh+ra dziṣ+ṇuḥ/

bh+rā dza te i t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di khrims gsal bar byed pa 'di skad do/ ༈ /gras iṣ+ṇu si drangs rnam bcad/ gra siṣ+ṇuḥ/ gra sa ti shī laḥ/ zas bza' ba'i bkod khrigs so/ ༈ bhu iṣ+ṇubhu yon tan/ ab/ bhab /iṣ+ṇu si drangs/ rnam bcad/ pra gong pra bha biṣ+ṇuḥ/ pra bha ba tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ khrims 'di bkrag dang ldan pa 'di 'dra'o/ ṣahra bzod pa la'o/ ṣa'i sa'o/ /sa h iṣ+ṇu/ si gong bzhin/ sa hi ṣ+ṇuḥ/ sa ha te e t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di ltar bzod pa'i ngang tshul 'di zhes so/ /ji skad du/ ༈dzibhu dag gi yon tan mi 'byung ngo*/ /zhes bshad pas/ dzi rgyal ba la'o/ /dzisnu bzhagas ṣ/ na ṇa/ si rnam bcad/ dziṣ+ṇuḥ/ yang na dzi snuḥ/ dza ya tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di ltar khrims kyis rgyal ba 'di'o/ /bhū snu bzhag s ṣ/ na ṇa/ si/ bhūṣ+ṇuḥ/ yang na/ bhū snuḥ/ bhūṣ+ṇuḥ bhū snuḥ/ bha ba tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di tshul khrims bden pa 'di 'dra'o/ ༈ /gṛdhu mngon par re 'dod la'o/ /gṛdh+ra kanu bzhag k yal dhanu la drangs si rnam bcad gṛ dh+nuḥ/ gṛ dh+ya tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'dra'i tshul khrims 'dod pa'o/ ༈a pat bā iṣ+ṇu bzhagapā'i ā ring dbyangs la phyis nas i la drangs/ si rnam bcad a pa tra biṣ+tuḥ/ a ba tra ba te i t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di bdag nyid srung ba'i ngang tshul 'di 'dra'o/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ ṣā ko ka ṇaḥ/ ṣā ka u u kaṇ'o/ gzhan yang tshul khrims kyi don du byings gang don 'brel du rung ba la ṣā ka dang*/ u dang u kaṇ rnams kyang 'jug go /b.r smod pa la'o/ /b.r bar mi la'o/ /b.r ṣā ka bzhag/ṣ khyad don ā ka drangs si rnam bcad/ ba rā ka:/ grub/ bar ṇa shī laḥ/ smad pa'i khrims so/ khrims kyi bar mi/ zhes so/ ༈ ṣā ka'i ṣ yig īp kyi don zhes 'grel par byung ste/ de ltar na bud med kyi don la/ ba rā ka gong ltar sgrubs nas īp bzhag/rkyen mtha'i a phyis/

drangs/ si 'jig ba rā kī te/ rang rigs kyi khrims dang ldan pa'i bud med do/ ༈ /bhik+ṣu slong ba la'o/ /u brjod don/ bhik+ṣa ṣāka/ ṣ phyis/ drangs si/ bhi k+ṣā kaḥ/ ༈de bzhin du/ bhi k+ṣa u bzhagadrangs si bhi k+ṣuḥ/ ༈yang*/ bhi k+ṣa u kaṇ/ ṇ yal/ drangs/ si/ ṇ rjes 'brel la 'phel ba ltar na/ bhaik+ṣu kaḥ/ 'dir 'phel ba thob kyang 'gog ste/ bhik+ṣu kaḥ/ slong ba'i tshul khrims can te/ dge slong ngo*/ ༈ /sāṃ tā shaṃ sa yosh+tsa/ sa mtha' dang shaṃ sa la u yang ngo*/ /'dis mtha' ni rkyen sa byin pa'i sa mtha' ste de dang*/ nyer sgyur āng sngon du bzhag pa'i byings shaṃ sa la'ang u rkyen du 'jug go /'dir u rkyen yin yang tshul khrims kyis don ma yin pas u rkyen snga ma las tha dad par bgrang ngo*/ ༈ /dper brjod/ pa tss bzhag/gnyis brjod/ thog ma'i ha sa sogs ts gong ma yal/ a i ru song bas/ ba gong ma/ bi/ ts phyi ma k/ sa ṣa k*/ k+ṣa u rkyen ster si/ bi bak+ṣa u si byung/ k+ṣa'i a yal/ u la drangs/ rnam bcad/ bi bak+ṣuḥ/ yid 'dod byed pa zhes so// ༈ kṛ sa bzhag ṛ ir du bsgyur kir gnyis brjod/ r thog ma dbyi/ ki dang po tsi/ i u ra ba sogs kyis i phyi ma ring po/ sa ṣa r de la drangs/ tsi kīr+ṣa byung/ u/ si/ ṣa'i a yal/ u la drangs rnam bcad tsa kīr+ṣuḥ/ ༈shaṃ su bstod pa la'o/ ༈ shaṃs u si āng sngon du bzhag / sa rnam bcad/ ā shaṃ su ཿ/ ༈ grah nye bar 'dzin pa la'o/ /grah sa bzhag / sa m+p+ras ra na ste/ gṛh gnyis brjod/ h yal/ ṛ a ga de dza/ yang*/ de dzi h 'og ma ḍha ḍha mthong bas/ gṛ ghṛ du song*/ ḍh k/ sṣa/ dzighṛ/ k ṣa de la u dang si/ k ṣa k+ṣa/ k+ṣa'i a yal/ u la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ dzi ghṛ k+ṣuḥ/ grub/ dzi ghṛ k+ṣa ti/ khyim pa po'am/ 'dzin par byed pa zhes so/ ༈ /ka mu mdzes pa la'o/ /kam u ka ṇ/ ṇ yal/ u pa dhā 'phel ba/ drangs/ si kā mu kaḥ grub/ kā ma ya te/

mdzes byed/ 'dod pa byed/ ces so/ ༈ /bhu yod pa la'o/ /bhū u kaṇ bzhagaṇ yal byings 'phel/ au āb/ si rnam bcad/ bhā bu kaḥgrub/ bha ba ti t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar bden pa'i ngang tshul lo/ ༈ /nam rab tu 'dud pa la'o/ /ṇam ṇa'i na'o/ /na mā de ཿraḥ na ma sogs la ra'o/ /na ma la sogs pa'i byings ni sogs khongs nas dip sogs te/ ji skad du/ dip kam+pi ya si/ hi ng+si ka mi smid te/ na ma rnams la ra'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /nam la rkyen du 'jug/m ra la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ na mḥ/ phyag 'tshal ba'o/ ༈ /hing sr bzhagadrangs si hing+saraḥ/ hi na sti t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar 'tshe ba can gyi khrims so/ ༈ /ya sh ra drangs/ si ya shḥ/ ya sha ti t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar khrims kyi grags pa'o/ ༈ /kam ra drangs si kamḥ/ kā ma ya te i t+yi baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di mdzes pa'i khrims 'di 'dra'o/ /gha sl̥ za ba la'o/ /l̥ rjes 'brel/ gha sā deḥk+ma raḥ/ ghas sogs la k+ma ra'o/ /byings ghas sogs la rkyen k+ma ra 'byung ste/ k yig yon tan dgag pa'i don tsam ste dbyi'o/ ༈ /ghas k+mar zhes bzhag/k yal s ma la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ gha smaraḥ/ grub/ gha sa ti t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar za ba'i ngang tshul lo/ ༈ sdig pa'i ngang tshul lo/ /ang k+mar bzhag/k yal drangs/ si/ a sma raḥ grub/ at+tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar za ba'i tshul lo/ ༈ /sṛ skyabs su 'ongs ba la'o/ /sṛk+mar/ ṛ yal drangs/ sma raḥ/ sṛ s k+mar/ k yal/ drangs/ sṛ sma raḥ/ skyobs pa'i don no/ ༈ /tshi di bhi di bi dāṃ ku raḥ/ tshi di bhi di bi da rnams la ku ra'o/ /tshid kur k yal u ra rkyen no/ /drangs/ si a m tshi du raṃ/ ༈ bhid ku ra u ra si am/ bhi du raṃ/ ༈ bid kur/ ur/ si am/ bi du raṃ/ ༈ bhā sā der+ghu raḥ/ bhās la sogs pa rnams la ghu ra'o/ /byings bhās la sogs pa la rkyen ghu ra ster/ gh ni ghit gyi tha snyad kyi phyir te dbyi/

rkyen mtha' nyid do/ /bhās ghur bzhagagha dbyi/ bhās ur drangs si bhā su raḥ/ grub/ bhā sur shī laḥ/ 'od zer gyi ngang tshul lo/ ༈ /bhaṃ dzu 'joms pa la'o/ /u brjod don/ bhaṃdz byings so/ /tsa dzoḥka gaughi ti/ tsa dza dag ka ga dag ste/ ghit la'o/ /byings mtha'i tsa la ghi t byung na dz ru 'gro/ byings mtha'i dz la ghit byung na g ru 'gro ba las/ 'dir rkyen ghu ra'i gha phyis pa'i/ urani ghit yin no/ /bhaṃdzghur*/ song*/ ur/ dz g ru song*/ si bhaṅgu raḥ/ bha na k+ti t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar zhig pa'i ngang tshul lo/ ༈ /yadz lha mchod dang mnyam pa 'grogs pa dang byed pa dang sbyin pa rnams la'o/ /'dir 'phros don yadz la rkyen ghu ra/ u ra/ dz g ru song*/ ya sam+p+ra sa ra ba ṇa i te/ i gu raḥ/ ya gu raḥ/ mchod pa po/ grogs dang*/ byed po dang*/ sbyin pa po zhes pa'o/ ༈ /yang ū kaḥ/ yang la ū ka'o/ /rkyen yang'i mtha' can gyi byings la ū ka rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /'grel par ū ka'i rkyen yang tshul khrims kyi don du ster par bshad do/ /phul du byung ba la ha sa sogs la yanga'o/ /yadz yang zhes pa bzhag ng rjes 'brel/ gnyis brjod/ dang po ha sa sogs dz snga ma phyis/ ya mthong bas ya dang po ring por song*/ dz phyi ma yang rkyen la drangs/ yā ya dz+ya ūka zhes pa bzhag/dz+ya gyi ya pha rol a dang phrad pas phyis/ dz ūr drangs/ si rnam bcad/ yā ya dzū kaḥ/ grub/ a ti sha ye na ya dza tī t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar mchod pa phul du byung ba'i tshul khrims so/ ༈ /daṃ sh yang bzhag/gnyis brjod/ sh sngon ma phyis/ da 'og ma'i nga ro bsal/ ū ka bzhag/dad sh ya ū ka si zhes byung*/ ū dang phrad pas ya mi snang*/ sha ū la drangs/ dan+da shū kaḥ/ daṃ da sh+ya te i t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar sos shin du gcod pa'i ngang tshul lo/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /de bzhin du/ dza p yang ū ka gnyis brjod/

p dang po yal/ ya las dza dang po ring*/ ya mi snang*/ pa u la drangs/ si dzā dza pū kaḥ/ dzaṃ dza bya te i t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di 'di ltar bzlas pa phul du byung ba'i lugs khrims so/ ༈ /yang bd yang ūka si bzhag/bā ba d ya ūka si ru 'gro/ bā ba dū kaḥgrub/ bā ba t+ya te i t+ye baṃ shī laḥ/ 'di ltar skad gsangs chen po'i lugs so/ /bā ba dū kaḥ/ bā ṭa'i mi la rgya gar grags/ ༈ ā dṛ ta ཿ kir+d+wish+tsa bhu te/ ā t dang ṛt la ki te gnyis byung zin pa la'o/ /byings ā ring mtha' dang*/ ṛ mtha' can la 'das dus ston pa'i phyir ki rkyen du 'byung ste/ ātmatha'i byings ap med pa la ste/ byings gnyis brjod kyang 'byung ba'o/ /rā ma so mam+pa bir+ya dz+nye da dirgāṃ sh+tsa kri rad+bhu taṃ/ yā dza kān+paprirā dza hriḥpun+ḍa ri ka mahā dwi dz+nya na/ zhes pa ni/ dga' byed mchod sbyin la ni zhi ba 'thungs/ /ba yi sbyin pa rmad du byung ba byas// bka' yi mchod sbyin byed po bos te 'ongs/ /gnyis skyes chen pos pad dkar dus ston no/ /'dir ba briḥni pho nya la bka' byin pa/ ā dza hriḥni khrid nas 'ongs ba'o/ /pa biḥdang da diḥdang tsa kriḥdang ba briḥdang ā dza hriḥzhes pa rnams dper brjod te/ rkyen ki ster ba yin/ 'das pa'i don yin/ gnyis brjod/ byings pā dang dā gnyis āt mtha' ring po/ kṛ bṛ hṛ rnams ṛ t mtha'i dpe'o/ ༈ /pāki bzhagaganyis brjod/ pā pā ki/ pā dang po thung ngur song*/ k phyis/ i bzhagapā phyi ma'i ā yal/ pa p i byung*/ drangs/ si/ pa piḥ 'thungs pa'o/ ༈ /dā ki bzhag/gnyis brjod/ dang po thung*/ k yal gnyis pa'i ā yal/ da d/ i si/ da diḥ/ byin no zhes pa'o/ ༈ /kṛ ki bzhag/gnyis brjod dang po ka phyi ma'i ṛ r/ ka tsa/ tsakrar.i si byung*/ tsakriḥ/ byas so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /briki bzhagabṛ bṛ.a de nas ba br/ i/ si/ babriḥ smras te btang ba la'o/ ༈ /hṛki bzhag/k yal/

gnyis brjod/ hṛ dang po ṛ a ha ru song ha dzha/ dzha dza/ hṛ phyi ma/ ṛ r/ h r ru song*/ dzahr.i āng sngon ādzahr.isi/ dngs rnam bcad/ ā dza hriḥ/ bos nas khrid pa'o/ ༈ /sā do ṇā da yaḥ/ u ṇ la sogs pa ni rtag tu'o/ /rtag tu zhes sngon nas phyi mtha'i bar du rtag par 'byung ba ste/ dus gsum so so ba'i dngos po dang gnyis gnyis pa dang gsum ka ldan pa'i dngos po'i don gang la yang*/ u ṇ la sogs pa'i rkyen 'jug tu rung ba'o/ ༈ /ḍukṛnya kṛ.u ṇ zhes pa bzhag/ṇ 'phel ba'i don no/ /ṛ 'phel ba/ ār ring po/ k.ār u si drangs/ rnam bcad/ kāruḥ/ yang na si 'jig pa'i lugs kyang yod/ kā ru/ byed pa'o zhes te dus gsum ka'o/ /k ār/ u drangs/ kā ru au bzhag/au u ru bsgyur/ 'dra ba ring kārū/ kār dzas as/ u o ru song*/ o.ab/ kār/ ab as byung*/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ kā ra baḥ/ gnyis byed pa mang po byed pa/ byed pa dag byed pa rnams zhes so/ ༈ /bā 'gro ba dri dag la'o/ /bā u ṇ bzhaga.āt la yuk'o/ /zhes pas bā dang u'i bar du yuk k rjes 'brel/ u brjod don/ pā y u si byung*/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ pā yuḥ/ rlung ngo*/ ༈ /da ni uṇ la sogs pa zhes pa'i sogs khongs bshad de/ krush skad gdangs la'o/ /krusha ྄tṛ zhes pa bzhag/'di la 'phel ba min yon tan te/ kro/ tsha sha ṣa ra dza sogs shṣ tṭ drangs/ kroṣ+tṛ/ si/ si ā/ ḍita/ ṭi dbyi/ ko ṣa ྄ta ṭa ā byung*/ drangs/ kroṣ+tā/ don 'gyur lce spyang ngo*/ /kro sha ti/ skad chen no/ /zhes pa'i don no/ ༈ /de kho na ltar kroṣ+t-i au ṛ ār/ drangs kroṣ+tā rau/ ༈ kroṣ+ti/ dzas as ṛ ār drangs kroṣ+tā raḥ/ ༈ yang kro sh la rkyen tṛ na byin n dbyi/ gzhan de dang khyad med/ rkyen du na byin na n yal/ ḍi t l̥ṭ dbyi skabs/ tṛ'i ṛ yig gi dod du tu yig gi u phyis/ gzhan khyad med pas/ gzugs 'dra ba kho na'o/

༈ /'dir ab rak+ṣa bā la ne zhes pa bod skad du/ a bar k+ṣa srung ba la'o/ zhes bod snga ma rnams 'don/ a ba srung zhing skyong ba la'o/ /zhes paṇ+ḍi ta gsung*/ byings a ba dang byings rak+ṣa gnyis mi zer/ pā la srung bar bsgyur pa'ang bag tsam mi 'grig zer/ des na byings a ba gcig pu dang*/ rak+ṣa pā la srung skyob gi don yin gsung pa 'thad dam snyam mo/ /muk gi rkyen ster te/ k ni rkyen kit kyi ming can gnas tha mar 'byung ba'i don yin/ u brjod don no/ /rkyen ni m dbyangs med do/ /a ba muk bzhag/k dang u yal/ ba sa m+p+ra sa ra ṇa byas pas u ru song*/ a um u la om nga ro/ oṃ zhes pa'i sngags grub bo/ ༈ /ma ni ṇ zhes pa'i rkyen yod do/ ṇ 'phel don na'i dbyangs i brjod don/ maṇ kho na rkyen dngos so/ /ma n+yu pa dhā yā ṛ raḥ ma ni'i u pa dhā'iṛ ra'o/ /ṛt mtha'i byings la/ ma ni ṇa'i rkyen byung na/ u pa dhā ṛ yig ni ra/ dbyangs bcas su 'gro'o/ /bṛ hi bṛ dhi 'phel ba la'o/ /bṛ hi ma ni ṇ bzhagahi'i i dang/ ṇ dang*/ na'i i rnams bsubs/ bṛh mn pa'i ṛ phul/ ṛ ra ru song*/ h ma la drangs brah+man byung*/ si dbyi/ na mi'i mtha' ya la/ brah+ma zhes pa grub/ de ni chen po dang 'phel ba grags shing grub pa dang*/ lha tshangs pa dang*/ srog can rnams la 'jug go /bṛ had+ba d+piṃ ha na t+pat/ chen po dang ldan zhing 'phel ba dang ldan zhes pa'o/ ༈ /at bden par 'gro ba la'o/ /at ma ni ṇ/ i dang ṇ yal/ at mn ṇa'i 'phel ba ā ring por song*/ si u pa dhā ring*/ mā si yal/ n yang dbyi/ āt+mā/ grub/ bdag ste rtag pas 'gro ba'am/ bden pas 'jug pa'i don no/ ༈ /dhṛnya 'dzin pa dang gso ba la'o/ /de la ma rkyen du ster/ dhṛm byings/ yon tan/ dha ar/ ma drangs/ si rnam bcad/ dhā ra ṇa t/ 'chad par byed do zhes pa la/ dharmaḥ/ ༈ dhu nya g.yo ba la'o/ /dh+wā de ru liḥ/

dhu sogs la u li'o/ /byings dhu sogs la rkyen u li 'jug ste/ dhu u li/ si/ 'dra ring*/ si rnam bcad/ dhū liḥ/ dhun ti skyod par byed de/ zhes pa'i don no/ ༈ /a gi ra gi la gi 'gro ba'i don la'o/ /byings a gi sogs gsum po 'di'i i yig ni brjod don no/ /de'i phyir it it kyi tha snyad 'juga.i phyis pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /ag u li zhes pa bzhag/ it it la'o zhes pas/ a dang g'i bar du num ā ga ma ster/ m dang u yal/ n nga ro/ g u la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ aṃ gu liḥgrub/ aṃ ga ti/ cha shas so/ ༈ /des 'gre ste/ rag uli si num/ raṃ gu liḥ/ ༈ lag u li si/ num/ laṅguliḥ/ zhes so/ ༈ /ji skad du/ shas sogs la rang bzhin gyi bya ba la t'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ shas gnod pa la'o/ /shas t bzhag/s drangs/ si am/ sha s+t+raṃ/ mtshon chas snun no/ /sha sa ti/ zhes so/ ༈ /a su 'phen pa la'o/ /as t bzhagadrangs/ si am/ astaṃ/ a sa ti/ lag chas snun no/ / zhes so/ /shas+t+ra/ as+t+ra/ gnyis ka lag cha la spyir yang 'jug la/ yang shas+t+ra ni lag tu bzung na sa rdeg pa ral gri lta bu dang/ as+t+ra ni mda' dang 'ur rdo la sogs pa rgyang du 'phen pa la bye brag tu yang 'gro'o/ ༈ /pā srung ba la'o/ /pāt bzhag /si/ pā traṃ snod do/ ༈ /ṇi gsal ba la'o/ /ṇit/ ṇa'i na/ ṇit yon tan/ si am/ ne traṃ/ ༈ dārda ba la'o/ /dāt si/ dā traṃ/ ༈ gaml̥ 'gro ba la'o/ /gam 'grel par ṇi ni rkyen no zhes pas/ ṇi ni rkyen du ster/ ṇa yig 'phel don/ na'i i brjod don/ rkyen dngos -in'o/ /āng sngon/ ā gam isnri bhung*/ gal ṇa'i 'phel ba byung*/ si'i nus pas u padhā ī ring por song*/ g de la drangs/ si yal/ n yang phyis/ ā gā mī/ ā gan+tuṃ shī la ma s+ya/ 'di ni tshur 'ong ba'i lugs so/ ༈ /bhū ṇi ni in/ bhū 'phel/ au āb drangs/ si/ i ring po si dang n yal/ bha bī shī la ma s+ya/

'di ni bden pa'i khrims so/ /zhes pa la bhā bī/ ༈ īsh dbang phyug la'o/ /ī shāderba raḥ/ i sh sogs la ba ra'o/ /byings ī sh sogs la rkyen br ster te/ īsh br bzhagash ba la drangs/ si ī shwaraḥ/ iṣ+te 'dod pa'i dbang can no/ ༈ ṣaṣ+ta 'gro ba 'gog pa la'o/ ṣ+ṭh b.r bzhag/s+thā zhes bsgyur/ si s+thā ba raḥ/ brtan pa'i dngos po'o/ ༈ /rā dzā der n/ rā dzā sogs la an'o/ /rā dzṛ gsal ba la'o/ /ṛ rjes 'brel/ rādz an bzhag/si u pa dhā ring po/ drangs/ si dang n thim/ rā dzā/ gsal ba po ste rgyal po'o/ ༈ /yu 'dres pa la'o/ /yu an bzhag / yu'i u ni 'phral te/ ub ru song*/ drangs/ si/ u pa dhā ring*/ si na yal/ yu bā/ yau ti/ lang tsho can no/ /byis pa dang dar ma 'dres pa lang tsho can yin pas 'dres pa'i byings don ma 'gyur ba'o/ ༈ /i ma na trā su ka ཿ iman t a sukra go /byings gang yang rung ba thams cad la rkyen i mn dang t dang a suk rnams kyang 'jug te/ pats.i mn bzhag/yang na/ mn thog ma phyis/ drangs/ si/ pa tsiḥ/ yang na pats i mn la si bzhag drangs/ u pa dhā ma ring po/ si dang n phyis/ pa tsi mā/ ༈ t rkyen gong bzhin/ pā traṃ karma sngon/ karma pā traṃ/ las kyi snod do/ ༈ /te dz a suk k dang u song*/ as rkyen no/ /yon tan dz a la drangs/ si/ te dzaḥ/ ༈ bhu dz as/ yon tan/ dz g/ g ka/ drangs/ si/ bho kaḥ/ ༈pats de ras/ ba ts sogs la as'o/ /byings pats sogs la rkyen as 'jug go /pats as bzhag/drangs si 'jigs sa rnam bcad/ pa tsaḥ/ ༈ mah as drangs si spangs s rnam bcad/ ma haḥ/ mchod pa'o/ ༈ /tap a sa drangs si sbas s rnam bcad/ ta baḥ/ ༈ sau kar+y+ye ke li maḥ/ mchog min gyi las ka la ke li ma'o/ /'dir sau kar+ya ni las ka ngan pa brul ma thub kyi ming ngo*/ /de 'dra'i don la rkyen ke li ma ster ro/ /bhid ke li ma bzhag/ka yon tan med pa'i don/

e lus/ d drangs/ si am/ bhi de li maṃ kaṣ+ṭhaṃ/ gshog ma legs pa'i shing zhes pa'o/ ༈ /pats e li ma bzhagasnga ma ltar sgrubs/ si ā ru bsgyur ba khyad par ro/ /pa tse li mā ā ḍha kyāḥ/ nyung zad bcos te gzhal/ zhes pa'o/ /zas btsos te 'grangs tshad re srang la gzhal te byin pa'i don yin/ de ni kha phyid tsam ma gtogs gzhan med pas mchog min no/ ༈ /yu ba ha gi bh+yo nip/ yi bah a gi rnams las nip'o/ /byings yu dang ba hi dang a gi rnams la rkyen ni p 'byung ngo*/ /pa rjes 'brel lo/ /yu nip/ p yal/ yon tan/ yo/ si rnam bcad/ yo ni ཿ/ yau ti/ skye ba'i lam mo/ ༈ /ba hi nip ha'i i yal/ ha ni la drangs/ si ba h+niḥ/ ba ha ti/ 'tshed cing 'gro ba'o/ ༈ /ag nip drangs/ si/ ag+niḥ/ aṃ ga ti/ yan lag med par 'gro ba'i don no/ ༈ /i di tsa di sha ki ru di bh+yo raḥ/ i di tsa di sha ki ru di rnams las ra'o/ /byings 'di rnams kyi i yig sbas par 'gyur bas/ id tsad shak rung zhes pa ste/ de rnams la ra yig rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /id ra zhes pa bzhag/i dang d'i bar du nu m bzhag/na ng ro/ iṃd ra la drangs/ nga ro n ru 'bri si rnam bcad in+d+raḥ/ tsa di bsil ba snang byed la'o/ /tsadr bzhag tsa dang d'i bar du num n nga ro/ si/ tsan+d+raḥ/ ༈ shakr bzhag/si/ num nga ro drangs rnam bcad/ shaṃ kraḥ/ ༈ rud ra bzhag/si drangs ru daḥ/ de dag ni uṇ sogs dngos yin la/ ༈ rjes 'brang 'phros don ni/ puṣa la pa rkyen du sbyar bas ṣa pa la drangs/ si/ am/ puṣ+paṃ/ me tog yin/ ༈ ya rkyen byin na/ puṣ+yaṃ/ ༈ phal dang*/ mūl la a rkyen du byin/ si/ a m/ phalaṃ/ mū laṃ/ zhes so/ ༈ /u ṇā da yo ྅ pa ri mi tāḥ/ uṇ la sogs pa gzhan dpag tu med pa'o/ /tum ta dar+thā yāṃ bha bi ṣ+ya ti/ 'byung 'gyur la de'i don du tum'o/ /byings la ma 'ongs pa'i dus ston pa'i phyir tum gyi rkyen du 'gyur ro/

/de'i don zhes pa'i de'i sgra ni cung zad lkog tu gyur ba ste/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa mi ring ba'o/ ༈ /de las 'dir ma 'ongs pa ste/ bhudz skyong ba dang zas bzang ba la'o/ /bhudz tum/ dzg/ g k/ bhu bho/ drangs bho k+tuṃ bra dza ti/ zas zos nas 'gro ༈ /pa ṭh tu m/ iṭ+ra/ paṭha/ i tum paṭhi tu miṣ+te/ 'dod pa ltar klog dgos/ ༈ ṣ+ṇā snā ru bsgyur/ snā tum snā tu mi ha ta/ khrus byas nas rtse'o/ ༈ /gha ny bhā be/ dngos po la ghany'o/ /dngos po'i don la ghany'i rkyen ster te/ dper brjod ni/ pa tsghany bzhag/ny rjes 'brel/ gha khyad don/ a bzhagatsa dza dag ka ga dag tu ste ghi t la'o/ /zhes pas ts k dang por 'phel ba/ k a la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ pā kaḥ/ pa ts+ya ta/ smin pa nyid do/ ༈ /d+ya dzas ghany/ as phyis ghany a dz g t+ye la 'phel ba/ si/ t+yā gaḥ/ byin can no/ ༈ /yadz ghany a 'phel ba/ drangs/ si/ yā gaḥ/ mchod pa po'o/ ༈ /bhadz ghany/ a 'phel ba dz g drangs bi gong*/ si/ bi bhā gaḥ/ rnam par 'byed do/ ༈ /yudzir sbyor ba la'o/ /ir yal/ yudz ghany a yu yon tan yo drangs/ si/ yo gaḥ/ ༈ yadz ghany a dang por 'phel ba/ dz g/ drangs/ si/ yā gaḥ a nu i dz+ya te/ rjes su mchod pa'o/ /slar yang bskyar te mchod pa'o/ ༈ /btsa ྄ghanya ྄a badz+ra a/ si/ 'phel/ tsk /drangs/ rnam bcad a nu gong*/ anu bā kaḥ/ ༈ 'grel bar 'dir ghita ྄ma yin no zhes 'byung bas/ yang na ghany med/ bts la si byin/ dang por 'phel ba/ a nu gong*/ si yal/ ts k/ anu bāk /rjes su smra ba'o/ /a nū ts+ya ti/ rjes su brjod pa'o/ /zhes so/ ༈iṇ 'gro ba la'o/ /iṇ ṇ dbyi naṃ di sogs la yu'o/ /zhes 'byung ba yu rkyen du ster/ i yu yu zhes pa a na ru bsgyur/ i a na i ay drangs/ si am/ a ya naṃ/ ༈ yang na ghany ster/ i a si/ ṇ ti nyid la ba'o/ /zhes pas 'phel ba/ āy āya asi byung*/ drangs/ rnam bcad/

āyaḥ/ ༈ de bzhin du*/ bhu yu bzhag yon tan ab an si am bha ba naṃ/ ༈ bhū ghany ū 'phel ba āb/ drangs si rnam bcad/ bhā baḥ/ bden dngos so/ ༈ /bā dang dā la yu byung*/ a na 'dra ba ring po gdod nas yod/ si am dā naṃ/ pā naṃ/ ༈ de gnyis la ghany byung na āt la yuk'o/ /zhes pas bar du yuk/ u dang k yal pāy a byung*/ si rnam bcad/ drangs pā yaḥ/ pī ya ta/ 'thung bya'o/ /dā yaḥ/ dī ya te sbyin bya'o/ /skabs 'dir yu a na la si am ghany la si rnam bcad yin no/ ༈ /s+tṛ ts kun nas 'gebs pa la'o/ /ts rjes 'brel ṛ brjod don/ rkyen arka ster/ st arka/ drangs/ si rnam bcad/ stargaḥ/ sgribs pa'am 'gegs pa ste gab tshig go /añtsu 'gro ba dang mchod pa dag la'o/ /aṃtsu/ tsu dbyi nga ro yal/ rkyena.ak byin/ pra sngon/ pra a aka/ si 'dra ba rang po ste/ a gnyis/ pra la thim/ rnam bcad/ prā kaḥ/ pa ri to añtsa ti/ yongs su mchod pa/ yongs su 'gro ba zhes pa'am/ phyogs shar ro/ ༈ /añdzu yang dang 'dra ba la dzg g k byed/ ak mi byed par ghany ster/ prā kaḥ/ yang*/ pra adz akasi byung ba la dz yal/ pra la a gnyis po 'dra ba ring*/ prākaḥ/ zhes pa'ang 'byung/ aṃ tsu dang aṃ dzu la sgrub lugs gsum byung yang gzugs gcig don yang gcig go ༈ saṃ dz+nyā yā ma karta ri tsa/ ming la byed po ma yin pa la yang ngo*/ /byed po'i don ma yin pa'i ming gi yul zhes pa/ ming gi don la'am/ brda chad so so'i don la yang ghany 'jug go ༈ hṛny ny yal/ gha ny bzhag/hṛ a/ ṛ 'phel ba/ ār/ sngon/ de'i yang sngon du pra ti bzhag pra ti āh ār asi iy/ rim pas drangs/ rnam bcad prat+yā hā raḥ/ prati pra ti kar+yaṃ ā hri ya te/ so so so sor bya las la kun nas sdud pa'o/ ༈/sā rā daḥ/ byangs las a'o/ /dngos po'i don la 'jug cing*/ byed po'i don spangs pa'i skabs su byings dbyangs mtha' can la/ rkyen a yig 'jug go

༈ tsi zhes pa'i byings la rkyen a ster/ yon tan tse e ay/ saṃ sngon du bzhag/si rnam bcad/ sañtsa yaḥ/ saṃ tsi yat/ sdud pa'o/ /bde ba'o/ /zhes so/ ༈ /ṇi thob pa la'o/ /ṇi ṇa'i na'o/ /ni a yon tan/ ne ay/ si/ rnam bcad na yaḥ/ nī ya te/ thob pa'o/ ༈ /na yaḥde kho na ltar sgrubs/ uta gong sde pa'i dang po'i mtha' ni/ rang gi lnga pa pha rol la lnga pa der 'gro bas/ t n drangs/ un+na yaḥ/ mthon po'o/ stu a yon tan/ sto ab si sta baḥ/ ༈ nṛ rnam par g.yo ba la'o/ /nṛ a yon tan ar drangs si/ na raḥ/ ༈ na ra ste/ mi zhes pa'i don ni/ nṛ ya te g.yo bar byed pa'o/ /de'i yang don no/ /bi k+ṣe bya te kā mā bhiḥ/ zhes 'dod chags la sogs pa rnams g.yo ba'o/ ༈ /ma dāṃ/ ma da rnams la'o/ /byings md la sogs pa rnams la yang a rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /de yang dngos po'i don byed po min pa kho na la'o/ /ma dī rangs pa la'o/ /ī brjod don/ md a drangs si/ ma daḥgrub/ pra mā t+ya te ྅ne na/ 'di rab tu yi rangs pa'o/ /pra sngon/ pra ma da/ rab myos so/ /a na ya pā pramā dā/ 'di ni kun du dregs pa'o/ /zhes pa la/ ghany byin na ma 'phel ba ste/ mā si ā mā dā pramā dā/ pā ṇa gha ny a/ dang po thung ngu*/ paṇa a/ si/ pa ṇaḥ/ ba n+ya t tshong byed pa'o/ ༈ /sham a drangs/ si/ sha maḥ/ dm a si/ da maḥ/ yam a drangs si/ ya maḥ/ di p a yon tan de drangs/ si/ de baḥ/ dī bya te bi shwa ma ni na/ 'di ni sna tshogs pas rtse bar byed do/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ ṣi ny 'ching ba la'o/ ṣi a yon tan/ ṣe/ ay/ bi sngon/ bi ṣ a ya si drangs/ bi ṣa yaḥ/ bi she ṣe/ ṇa/ si/ ya ta/ khyad par gyis 'ching ba/ zhes te/ yul gzugs sgra sogs khyad par sna tshogs pa'i 'ching ba'o/ ༈ /mū k+tau gha naḥ/ mū k+ta dag gi gha na la'o/ /de yang mū k+ta zhes pa ni/ sra ba dang yongs su gcog pa dang 'dres pa la yang 'jug pa las 'dir dang po gnyis so/ /don de gnyis 'brel ba'i byings ghan la yang rkyen a 'jug

go /ghan ni han ghan du bsgyur ba'i ming ngo*/ /'di yang dngos po'i don la'o/ /han a han ghan/ du song*/ drangs da dhi gong si da dhigha naḥ/ ga ṭhiṃ naṃ da dhi/ zho gar po ste sra ba'i don can no/ ༈ /han a ghan sain+dha/ pa/ gong*/ drangs/ rnam bcad/ sain+dha ba gha naḥ/ pa ri tse da naṃ sain+dha baṃ/ lan tshwa gcog pa'o/ /zhes so/ ༈ /brna bi par+ya yash+tsa/ yi ge bsgyur ba la yang ngo*/ /hing si 'tshe ba la'o/ /hing si i brjod don/ hiṃs a drangs hiṃs rim pas phral/ h iṃ s a s dang h gong 'og bsgyur/ s.iṃ h a la drangs si/ sidhaḥ/ seng ge ste/ hi na sti/ ches 'tshe ba'o/ ༈ /ṭ+wi to thuḥ/ ṭu it la a thu'o/ /it zhes pa phyis pa'i don du dran te/ byings gang ṭu dbyi ba de la rkyen a thu 'jug ste/ dngos po'i don la'o/ ༈ /dper brjod/ pa ṭu be pṛ g.yos pa la'o/ /ṭu dang ṛ mi snang bar bya/ be p a thu bzhag/drangs si/ be pa thuḥ/ be pya te a ni na/ 'di lus 'dar ba'o/ ༈ /ṭuk+ṣe pṛ lag gis 'phen pa la'o/ /ṭu dang ṛ yal/ k+ṣe p a thu bzhag/drangs si/ k+ṣe ba thuḥ/ k+ṣe pya te a ne na/ 'dis 'phen pa'o/ ༈dwi da s+t+ri mak tat+kṛ te/ ḍu it la tṛ mak de'i byed pa la'o/ /byings gang du ḍu yig phyis pa'i rigs la t-i? mak rkyen du ster te 'das pa de'i don du'o/ /ḍu kri ny/ ny dang ḍu phyis/ kṛ bzhag ḍu i t zhes pa thog ma ḍu dang por yod kyang rjes su phyis zin pa de la zer/ kṛ tri mak bzhag/k song*/ si rnam bcad/ kṛ tri maḥ/ kṛ tri maḥ gha ṭaḥ/ zhes pa la rnam bcad u/ u la o/ kṛ tri mo gha ṭaḥ/ bum pa'i bya ba zin to/ /kri yā yā ni bṛt+tā gha ṭa/ bya ba rnams 'gags pa'i bum pa'o/ ༈ /ḍu bhṛny ḍu ny song*/ bhṛtri mak /k yal sam gong*/ si am/ saṃ bhṛ tri maṃ yud+dhaṃ/ g.yul 'thab pa/ saṃ bhā re ṇa saṃ bhṛ taṃ/ dmag tshogs 'khrugs pa'o/ ༈ /yā tsṛ slong ba la'o/

/ṛ song*/ yāts trim k bzhag/k song iṭ/ yāts itrim/ si am sa gong*/ sa yā tsi tri maṃ/ de slong mo byas pa'i bi pra dha naṃ bram ze'i nor/ zhes so/ /yā tsa ne na/ saṃ bṛt+taṃ/ 'di slong mo la rgyus zin no/ /zhes so/ ༈ /na ḍa kī/ na ṭ dang ki dag go /byings la dngos po'i don du rkyen na ṭ dang ki gang yang rung ba ster te/ ya tī mchog la'o/ /ī song*/ yat na ṭ bzhag/ṭ song*/ drangs/ yat+naḥ ya ta naṃ/ sdom brtson no/ ༈ prats+tsha/ bits+tshoḥsha ne/ pratsha dang bi tsha dag na la sha'o/ /byings pra tsha dang bi tsha sogs la/ rkyen na ṭ byung na tsh yig ni sh yig tu 'gyur ro te 'di yang dngos po'i don la'o/ ༈ /pratsh na ṭ ṭ song*/ tsh sa/ s sh /drangs si/ prash+naḥ/ pṛts+tsha ta/ 'dri ba'o/ ༈ /bi tsh 'gro ba la'o// bi tsh na ṭ tsh sa/ s sh /drangs si/ bi ṣa naḥ/ khyab par 'gro ba'o/ /'dir pra dang bi la yon tan thob pa ltar snang yang mi thob bo/ ༈ ya dz na ṭ/ ṭ song*/ sa tu ni sha tsu rnams la sha tsu'o/ /zhes pas dz mthong bas pha rol na yig nya yig tu song*/ dz drangs/ dz+nya si/ yadz+nyaḥ/ idz+ya te/ mchod pa'o/ /de ltar na ṭ bshad zin/ ༈ da ni ki bshad de/ byings dhā la rkyen ki ster/ k phyis i bzhag/a p med pa'i ā t kyi ā yig dbyi'o/ /zhes pas dhā yi srog ā ring yal/ rkyen gyi i la drangs/ dhi byung*/ bi sngon si rnam bcad/ bi dhiḥ/ bi dha yata cho ga'am sems la 'dzin pa'o/ ༈ /gzhan de dang 'dra/ bi'i dod du saṃ/ saṃ dhe saṃ dhi ya te/ mtshams 'byor bar byed/ gnyis sbrel bar byed/ ces pa'o/ ༈ de ka 'dra ba la bi'i tshab tu āng/ ā dhiḥ/ a dhi yat/ yul srol lam/ mtshams bzung ba'o/ ༈ /yang dhi sgrub lugs gcig la/ ni sngon/ ni dhi/ de'i yang sngon du am bhas bzhags rnam bcad/ de u o/ am+bho ni dhiḥ/ am+bho ni dhi ya te yat/ gang du chu las skyes pa'o/ /zhes te/ 'on kyang chu gter la grags che'o/

/dpe gcig na/ so3 m+bho ni dhi zer ba yod pa/ sa am+bho zer ba snang de/ chu skyes so/ ༈ /bhā bo yuṭ/ dngos po la yuṭ'o/ /byings rnams la dngos po'i don du'ang rkyen yuṭ ster ba ste/ kṛyuṭbazhag/ṭ phyis yu a na ru bsgyur/ ṛ at drangs/ na ṇa si am ka ra ṇaṃ/ kri ya te a ne na/ 'di ni bya ba byed pa'o/ ༈ /kṛ zhes pa'i dod du hri ny ha ra ṇi/ hri ya te a ne na/ 'di ni 'phrog pa po'o/ ༈ /hu sbyin pa'i byings yuṭ a na/ yon tan/ o ab/ hab a na si ha ba naṃ/ hū ya te a ne na/ 'di ni sbyin sreg byed pa'o/ /bhūṣa ྄yuṭ a na drangs/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs/ si am/ bhū ṣa ṇaṃ/ bhūṣ+ya ti a ne na/ 'di rgyan par byed po'o/ ༈ /bah an si drangs pa ha naṃ/ u h+ya te a ne na/ thob par gyur pa ni 'di'o/ ༈ /dā yuṭ a na 'dra ring*/ si am/ ha naṃ/ ༈ duṣ yuṭ a na sham rnams kyi ring po'o/ /zhes pas byings kyi dbyangs ring po'o/ /drangs ṣa ra ṛ sogs si am/ dū ṣa ṇaṃ/ dūṣ+ya te a ne na/ sdug bsngal 'byung 'gyur ni 'di'o/ ༈ /ut s+thā deḥs lo paḥ/ ut s+thā sogs la sa dbyi'o/ /byings s+thā sogs la yuṭ byin dus ut sngon du byung nas mgo dbyi'o/ ༈ ṣ+ṭhā yuṭ a na s+thā ru bsgyur/ ut gong s+thā zhes pa'i s mgo dbyi/ a na 'dra ba ring*/ si am/ ut+thā naṃ/ steng gi gnas te bya tshang lta bu'o/ ༈ /staṃ bh+rayuṭ.a na /ut gong s yal/ si am/ ut+ta m+bha naṃ/ steng gi ka ba'o/ ༈ /sā dha nāṃ dhā ra yosh+tsa/ sgrub pa'i thabs dang rten gyi dag la yang ngo*/ /sgrub thabs kyi don dang rten gyi don du byings la yuṭ'i rkyen 'jug go pats+ya te a ne na/ 'dis 'tshed pa'i bya ba po'o/ /zhes pa'i don la/ ༈ patsyuṭ.a na/ drangs/ si/ pa tsa naḥ/ grub/ pa tsanaḥ.ag+ni/ patsa no3g+niḥ/ me ni 'tshed pa'i sgrub thabs so/ ༈ /pats+ya te3pa s+yāṃ/ 'di'i 'tshed pa zer te/ 'dir 'tshed pa po'o/

༈ /pa tsanaḥthā lī/ rnam bcad s drangs pa tsa na s+thā lī/ gzhong bar btsos so/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /īṣa duḥsuṣu khal+yuṭ/ īṣa duḥsu rnams la khal dang yuṭ'o/ /byings īṣat dang duḥdang su zhes pa rnams la rkyen khal dang yuṭ 'jug go /rkyen khal zhes pa'i la nī rkyen gyi dbye ba shes pa'i don dang*/ kha ni yon tan gyi don dang*/ muk ā ga ma ster ba'i don yang ste/ ༈ de yang ī ṣa t āḍh+ya zhes pa bzhag/t d/ a la drangs/ ī ṣa dā ḍh+ya/ zhes pa la num byin u dang m song*/ n nga ro/ /īṣa dā ḍh+yaṃ byung*/ bhū khal bzhag/kh dang l song*/ a bzhagabhū bho/ o ab/ drangs pas/ bha ba/ si rnam bcad/ īṣa dā ḍh+yaṃ bha baḥ/ bden pa nyung ngo*/ /zhes te/ ī ṣa dāḍh+yaṃ bhū ya te a ne na/ 'di ni nyung zad tsam byung ba'o zhes pa'ang yin no/ /īṣat dang*/ alpa dang*/ sul pa rnams cung zad kyi ming yin no/ ༈ /duḥ.āḍh+ya num/ bhūkhal rnams bzhag/ rnam bcad/ r num nga ro/ khal a yon tan ab so sor drangs/ si rnam bcad/ du rā ḍh+yaṃ bha baḥ/ grub/ du khe na aḍh+yaṃ dhā ya te a ne na/ 'di ni sdug bsngal ldan par gyur to/ ༈ /kṛ khal a/ ṛ ar/ drangs/ si/ ka raḥ/ īṣa dā ḍh+yaṃ gong du bzhag/īṣa dā gong bzhag/īṣa dā ḍh+yaṃ ka raḥ/ cung zad tsam byed pa'o/ ༈ /yang na ka raḥgrub pa la/ īṣat gong*/ ī ṣat+karaḥ/ ༈ yang kri khal ka raḥgong bzhin du sngon du bzhag/rnam bcad s/ sṣ/ ka la drangs/ duṣ+ka raḥ/ duḥkhe na kre ya te/ sdug bsngal bar byed pa po'o/ ༈ /ka raḥ gong bzhin/ su sngon/ su ka ra/ su khe na kri ya te/ bde bar byed pa po'o/ ༈ /yudh saṃ phā rai/ yudh ches rdeg pa la'o/ /yudhāyuṭ bzhag/ṭ yal/ yu a nar bskyar/ yon tan/ yodh drangs/ du ཿgong rnam bcad/ r drangs/ si/ dur+y+yo dha naḥ/ 'thab dka' ste/ duḥkhe na yo dha yi tu shakyaḥ/ g.yul du sdug bsngal bar nus pa'o/ ༈ /du ཿzhes pa'i dod du su gong du bzhag na/

su yo dha naḥ/ bde bar 'thab pa'o/ /su khe na yo dha na yi tung+sha kyaḥ/ 'thab mo rnams bde bar nus pa'o/ ༈ /ta byā nī yau/ ta bya dang ā nī ya dag go /ma 'ongs pa'i dus ston pa'i don la/ byings bhū sogs la rkyen ta bya dang*/ ā nī ya gang rung 'jug go ༈ bhu ta bya zhes pa bzhagabar du iṭ byung*/ yon tan o ab/ bh.ab.ita bya si byung*/ rim pas drangs/ si am/ bha bi ta byaṃ/ ༈ yang na/ bhū ā nī ya bzhagayon tan ab/ bh.ab.ānīya si drangs/ rnam bcad/ bha bā nī yaḥ/ 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bden par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /bhū yāt/ 'byung ba'o/ /zhes kyang ngo*/ ༈ /ās sdod pa la'o/ /ās ta bya bar du iṭ/ ās it bya si drangs/ am/ ā si ta byaṃ/ gnas 'cha' bar 'gyur/ zhes pa'o// ༈kṛ ta bya bzhag ṛ ar drangs/ si am/ karta byaṃ/ kṛ ya te/ byed par 'gyur/ zhes so/ ༈ /kṛ ā nī ya/ ar drangs/ na ṇa/ si am/ ka ra ṇī yaṃ/ don snga ma dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /grah rnams kyi iṭ la'o/ /zhes iṭ kyi ī ring por 'gro /grah ta bya bzhag/bar du iṭ ī ring bor 'gro /grah īta bya si byung*/ drangs/ grahī ta byaṃ/ gṛh+ya ta/ 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /pṛny yang dag sbed pa la'o/ /bṛt bya bar du iṭ ī ring po/ ṛ ar b.r īta bya byung*/ si am/ ba rī ta byaṃ/ ba ri tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ sbed par 'gyur ba'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /swa rā d+yaḥ/ dbyangs las ya'o/ /byings dbyangs mtha' can la ya yig rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /k+ṣe 'ching ba la'o/ /k+ṣe ya bzhag/si am/ k+ṣe yaṃ/ k+ṣe tung+yogyaṃ/ phrad pas 'ching ba'o/ ༈ /dzi ya bzhag/yon tan si am/ dze yaṃ/ dze tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ rgyal ba'i tshogs pa/ ༈ tsi ya bzhag/yon tan si/ tse yaṃ/ tse tuṃ yo gyaṃ tshogs pa'am/ grabs sam/ bsags pa'am bde ba la 'jug go ṇ-iny ya ṇa'i na'o/ /yon tan/ si/ ne yaṃ/ ne tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ ma thob pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /ne yaṃ zhes pa rang bzhin skad la/

a ga ba ni zer te rdzong hab thob tu byung ba'i ming la'ang zer ro/ ༈ /ji skad du/ k+ṣa y+ya dang dza y+ya dag kyang nus pa'i don la nges pa'i tshig go /zhes bshad do/ /stobs dang ldan pas bya ba byed nus kyi don la/ k+ṣi dang dzi rkyen ya byung na byings kyi i yig ni ay ru bsgyur ba'am/ dbyangs i yig y ru bsgyur/ k+ṣa dang dza srog can du bya ste gzugs 'dra/ 'di la yon tan e med pas e ay dang mi gcig pas/ ni pā da'i sgrub pa'o/ ༈ /k+ṣi ya bzhag/k+ṣa y ru bsgyur/ drangs/ si/ k+ṣa y+yaṃ/ k+ṣe tuṃ shakyaṃ/ zad par nus so/ /de'i don yang*/ 'joms par rtsol phod pa'o/ ༈ /dzi ya dzay ā de sha/ drangs/ si/ dza y+yāṃ/ dze tuṃ shakyaṃ/ rgyal thub pa'o/ ༈ /gzhon nus ldan ma yin pa'i don la gong du bshad pa ltar/ k+ṣe yaṃ dze yaṃ te/ 'di la btang snyoms pa dang*/ /log pa gnyis so/ /bā paṃ dze yaṃ mnaḥ/ yid sdig pa la ma rgyal lo/ /zhes pa lta bu*/ k+ṣay+ya dang dzay+ya dag kyang zhes pa'i kyang gi skad dod tsa yig ni dze yaṃ zhes pa yang 'byung ste/ tshig phrad du ma zad ces pa'o/ ༈ /dzṛya bzhag/ṛ ar/ dgag pa'i a gong*/ a dzar+ya/ de la/ saṃ ga taṃ sbyar/ mi rgyal ba'i rgyu tshogs/ na dzīr+ya te/ rgyal bar mi 'gyur ba'o/ /pu sha kān+tā d+yaḥ/ pu dang shak mtha' la ya'o/ /pu ste pa sde mtha' can gyi byings dang*/ byings shak gi mthar yang rkyen ya sbyor te/ byings dzap ya bzhag/drangs si/ dza byaṃ/ /dza bū yo gyaṃ bzlas pa'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /ḍu labhaṣa/ thob pa la'o/ /ḍu dang ṣa dang bhā'i srog song*/ labh ya bzhag/drangs/ si/ la bh+yaṃ/ la b+bhuṃ yo gyaṃ/ lab+tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ thob pa'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /ya bha 'khrig pa la'o/ ༈ /yabh ya bzhag/drangs/ si/ ya bh+yaṃ/ ya b+dhuṃ yo gyaṃ/ ya b+tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ 'khrig pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /'di gnyis la bhbt dh ces pa'am/ bh b b p byas pas b+dhuṃ b+tuṃ de rnams yang ngo*/ /de rnams p sde mtha'i dper brjod yin/

shak gi don ni/ shakl̥ ya bzhag/l̥ rjes 'brel/ drangs/ si/ shakyaṃ/ shak+tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ shakyaṃ/ stobs kyi sbyor ba nus pa'o/ ༈ /pu dang shakya min pa'ang yod de/ ṣah ngo mtshar la'o/ ṣa'i sa'o/ /sa h ya bzhagadrangs/ si/ sa h+yaṃ/ so ḍhuṃ shakyaṃ/ dga' bar nus pa'o/ ༈ /so ḍhuṃ sgrub na/ sah tum bzhag/ha'i ḍha'o/ /ta tha dag gi dhā'o// dha ḍha ru song*/ saḍh/ ḍhum byung*/ ḍh snga ma yal/ sa'i a ring por song*/ ā ring po o ru song*/ so ḍhuṃ grub bo/ ༈ru tsa ya bzhag/drangs/ si/ ru ts+yaṃ/ ro tsa pi tuṃ shakyaṃ/ dang bar nus pa'o/ /'dod par nus pa'o/ /mdzes par nus pa'o/ /ī tsā taḥ/ āt la ī yang ngo*/ ā yig mtha' can gyi byings la rkyen ya byung na/ byings mtha'i ā yig ni ī yig tu 'gyur ro/ ༈ /dā ya bzhagadā'i ā ring po ī ru 'gyur/ yon tan e/ si/ de yaṃ/ dā tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ sbyin pa'i tshogs pa'o/ ༈ /dz+nyaya bzhag/ā ī/ ī e/ si/ dz+nye yaṃ/ dz+nya tuṃ yo gyaṃ shes pa'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /pā ya bzhag/ā ī e si/ pe yaṃ/ pā tuṃ yo gyaṃ /btung ba'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /ṛ ha sān+tāṅghayaṇ/ ṛ dang ha sa'i mtha' las gh+yaṇ'o/ /byings ṛ mtha' dang ha sa ste gsal byed mtha' la rkyen gh+yaṇ 'jug ste/ dngos po'i don sogs la'o/ ༈ /kṛgh+yaṇ zhes pa bzhag/ṇ 'phel ba'i don/ gha brda chad kyi don/ ya nyid rkyen no/ /ṛ ār 'phel ba'o/ /drangs/ si/ kār+yaṃ/ kartuṃyo gyaṃ /bya rgyu'i tshogs pa ste las ka'o/ ༈ /bṛny sgrib pa la'o/ /bṛ gh+yaṇ ya bzhaga'aphel ba ste/ ṛ ār drangs si/ bār+yaṃ/ bā ra yi tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ sgrib pa'i 'gegs pa'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /bts gh+ya ṇ ya/ 'phel/ gong bzhin/ bā ts+yaṃ/ bak+tuṃ yo gyaṃ /ngag gi sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /badh gh+yaṇ/ ya 'phel/ bā dh+yaṃ/ bādhi tuṃ yo gyaṃ gsong por smra ba'i sbyor ba'o/ /bhū gh+yaṇ ya/ 'phel ba/ āb/ gong bzhin/ bhā byaṃ/ bha bi tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ yod pa bden pa 'byung ba nor skal ba legs pa rnams kyi tshogs pa'o/

༈ /ha se rgod pa la'o/ /ha s gh+yaṇya/ 'phel/ drangs/ si/ hā s+yaṃ/ ha si tuṃ yo gyaṃ /gad mo'i sbyor pa'am tshogs pa'o/ /pats gh+yaṇ ya/ 'phel/ drangs/ si/ pā ts+yaṃ/ yang na ghit nyid la ka yi kyang ces/ tsak gzhan 'dra/ pā kyaṃ/ de gnyis don gcig ste/ pa k+tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ 'tshod pa'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /ji skad du*/ gang 'dir dngos po'i bya ba dag la rab tu 'dres pa'i ta bya la sogs pa de mchod pa'i cho ga la yang ngo*/ /zhes bshad pas/ dngos po'i don gyi skabs 'dir mchod pa'i bya ba'i don la yang*/ ta bya la sogs pa 'jug go /ta bya la sogs pa ni/ ta bya i nī ya kyap gh+yaṇ ya ste/ rkyen 'di rnams yin la/ 'di dag la kṛt kyi ming 'jug go /'dir lnga dngos su smos gzhan yang yod do/ ༈ /dper brjod ni/ dṛsh ta bya bzhag/shṣ/ ta ṭa/ ṛ yon tan ar/ dṛ sh rnams kyi dzhas la ar ra'o/ /zhes pas ar ra dbyangs bcas su song*/ da ra la drangs ṣa ṭa la drangs/ da sh+ta byaḥ/ daṣ+tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ bltas nas mchod pa'i bya ba byed ces pa'o/ ༈ /yang*/ bṛsh a nī ya ṛ ar/ drangs/ si/ dar+sha nī yaḥ/ ༈ dri sh ya bzhag /drangs si/ dri sh+yaḥ/ de rnams don gcig /dar+sha na dho/ bltas nas mchod do zhes pa'o/ /dh+yai sems pa la'o/ /dh+yai ya bzhagamatshams sbyor gyi yi ge ā ru 'gro bas/ dh+yā su dang ād/ si rnam bcad/ swā dh+yā yaḥ/ kun tu legs par sems pa'o/ ༈ /dh+yai ta bya bzhag/ai ā/ si/ dh+yāta byaḥ/ yang na mtshams sbyor yi ge ai ā ru bsgyur/ ā t la ī/ ī e/ dh+ye ta byaḥ/ zhes pa'ang 'byung ste/ dh+yā tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ sems pa'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /shru thos pa la'o/ /shru bya bzhag/yon tan/ shro/ si rnam bcad/ shro ta byaḥ/ shro tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ thos sbyor te thos pa'i thabs so/ ༈ /shru a nī ya yon tan/ o ab drangs shra ba ṇī yaḥ/ ༈ man shes pa la'o/ /mn ta bya/ n nga ro/ /si rnam bcad/ maṃ ta byaḥ/ man+tu ng+ya gyaṃ/ yid la byed sbyor ro/

/ji skad du/ sa rkyen gyi mtha' las kyang ngo*/ /zhes 'byung*/ byings sa rkyen gyi mtha' can la yang*/ ta bya sogs 'jug go ༈ di dh+ya sa zhes pa'i byings la ta bya bzhag/bar du iṭ/ i la sa'i a phyis/ drangs ni sngon du bzhag si ni di dh+yā si ta byaḥ/ ni ta rāṃ dh+yā tu meṣ+ta byaḥ/ bar ma chad par bsam gtan 'dod pa'o/ ༈ /dzi dz+nyā sa ta bya bzhag/iṭ sa'i a yal/ drangs/ bi sngon/ si/ bi dzi dz+nyā si ta byaḥ/ dz+nyātu miṣ+taḥ/ bye brag tu shes par 'dod ces so/ ༈ /o rā ba sh+ya ke /u yi lhag par la'o/ /u yig mtha'i byings la lhag pa'i don shin du'am nges par ram cis kyang los kyang zhes pa lta bu la gh+yaṇ rkyen du'ajug go /ji skad du/ ot dag la ya'i rkyen ni dbyangs dang 'dra'o zhes 'byung pas/ o yig dbyangs la ab ru 'gro ba ltar/ dbyangs ma yin kyang dbyangs dang 'dra bar ya rkyen la yang a b ru 'gro ba dang*/ o dag ces gnyis tshig ni o ab dang*/ au āb gnyis ka'i don yin/ ༈ bhū ghuṇa ya a ba sh+yam gong*/ bhū bhau/ au āb/ drangs/ si/ bhā byaṃ/ a ba sh+yaṃ bhā byaṃ/ los kyang bden zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈ /lūny gcod pa la'o/ /lūgh+yāṇ+ḍa ya 'phel ba/ lau ā b drangs/ si a ba sh+yam gong ab sh+yaṃ lā byaṃ/ cis kyang gcod do/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /'di la tshig sdud kyi skabs su ab sh+ya la sogs pa'i sh+yaṃ gyi m yig la sogs pa m yig rnams dbyi bar bya ste/ ab sh+ya bhā bya/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ji skad du/ tshig sdud pa/ a ba sh+yam sogs kyi m dbyi bar 'dod do zhes 'byung ngo*/ /'dir tshigs bcad ni/ lum+pa de bash+yamaḥkṛt+ye/ tuṃ kā ma ma na so ra bi/ sa mo bā hi ha ta ta yormāṃ/ sa s+yapatsiyuḍ+gha nyoḥ/ de nyid bod skad ltar na/ kṛt la a ba sh+ya gyi m dbyi ste/ /kā ma ma nas la ni tum gyi yang*/ hi ta tat la sam gyi yang na ste/ /māṃ sa'i a ni pa tsa yuṭ*/ nyl/ zhes gsungs te/ byings kyi sngon du a bash+yam yod la/
