pha rol kṛt ming can gyi rkyen yod na/ ab sh+yam gyi m dbyi'o/ /tshig sdud la nges par dbyi ba yin gzhan ma nges so/ ༈ /dper na/ a ba sh+yam bhā byaṃ gyi m yal/ a bash+ya bhā byaṃ/ a ba sh+yam sā byaṃ la m yal/ a ba sh+ya lā byaṃ/ 'byung ngo*/ /kṛta ming can gyi rkyen ni/ ta bya sogs la zer ro/ ༈ /byings la tumu? gyi rkyen sbyar ba'i pha rol du/ kā ma zhes sam/ ma nas zhes pa'i ming yod na/ tum gyi m dby-i'o/ /byings bhudz pha rol du ming kā ma bzhagabar du rkyen tum/ bhu la yon tan/ dz g/ g ka/ si/ bhok tum kā ma si/ drangs/ bho k+tum kāmaḥ/ tum gyi m yal/ bhok+tu kā maḥ/ longs spyod 'dod pa zhes so/ ༈ /yang thog mar/ ma nas/ ma nāḥru sgrub na/ ma na s la si byin/ u pa dhā ring po/ si yal/ s rnam bcad/ ma nāḥgrub/ byings shru/ mnāḥzhes pa bzhag/bar du tum byings yon tan/ shro tum ma nāḥ/ tum gyi m thim/ shro tu ma nāḥ/ thos pa yid la byed pa'o/ ༈ /sam gong du yong*/ pha rol tu hi ta dang*/ tat gang rung byung na/ sam gyi m dbyi ba dang mi dbyi ba yang na'o/ /sam ྄hit m nga ro/ si am/ saṃ hi taṃ/ yang na sa m gyi m song*/ sa hi taṃ/ grogs bzang ba'am/ lhan cig pa'i don yin/ ༈ yang sam tat m song*/ si am/ sa ta taṃ/ yang na/ sam rang gnas/ saṃ ta taṃ/ ༈ de bzhin du/ māṃ sa'i sgra'i pha rol du/ byings pats nges par yod/ pats'i pha rol tu rkyen yuṭ dang gha ny gang rung gcig byung na yang*/ māṃ sa zhes pa'i sa yig gi dbyangs a dbyi ba ste/ 'on kyang yang na ba'o/ /māṃ sa pats yuṭ bzhag/ṭ song*/ yu a na ru bsgyur/ si/ māṃ sa pats a na/ si/ ts drangs si am/ māṃ sa pa tsa naṃ/ zhes pa grub/ yang na sa'i dbyangs phyis/ s dbyangs med pha rol du drangs/ māṃ spa tsa naṃ grub/ māṃ sa s+ya pa tsa na/ sha btsos pa'o/ ༈ /don de dang gcig pa la/ māṃ sa s+ya pā kaḥ/ de ni rkyen gha ny byung ba ste/

māṃs pats gha ny bzhag/ny yal gh song*/ a lus pa la 'phel ba bā/ tsk māṃ sa pāk a si byung*/ drangs rnam bcad/ māṃ sa pā kaḥ/ yang na sa'i a phyis/ drangs/ māṃ spā kaḥ/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ /ṛ du pa dhā ṅk+yap/ ṛ u pa dhā las kyap'o/ /byings gang la u padhā ṛ ra yig tu yod pa de'i pha rol du rkyen kṛ t ming can gyi nang tshan kyap ster ro te dngos po dang las sogs la'o/ ༈ /kṛ tī gtub pa la'o/ /ī brjod don no/ /kṛt kyap bzhag /k yon tan med pa'i don/ pa pita ྄kyi brda chad don/ rkyen dngos ya nyid do/ /t ya la drangs/ si am/ kṛ t+yaṃ/ kar+t+raṃ yo gyaṃ/ gtubs pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /ni sngon du bzhag na/ ṇi kṛ t+yaṃ/ ni ta rāṃ/ kartuṃ yo gyaṃ/ rgyun du gcod pa'i sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /des mtshon nas nyer sgyur gzhan dang sbyor ro// byings mtha' thung ngu can stu la rkyen pit byin na/ rkyen tu k bar du sbyin no/ /'dir rkyen kyap ni pit yin no/ /ji skad du/ ṣ+tuny/ gubū/ shāsu/ guh rnams la kya p'o/ /zhes kyang bshad pa las ṣ+tu thung ngu'i mtha' can yin pas tuk bar rkyen du 'jug/gzhan gsal byed mtha' can yin skabs 'dir tuk rkyen mi 'jug go ༈ ṣ+tu ny stu kyap bzhag rkyen ya/ tuk k dang u song*/ stut ya si drangs/ am/ stu t+yaṃ/ sto tu yo gyaṃ/ bstod pa la sbyor ro/ ༈ /gup kyap bzhagaya drangs si/ gu byaṃ/ gob+tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ sbed pa'i thabs so/ ༈ /shāsu bstan pa la'o/ /shāsu shish ru bsgyur/ kyap bzhag/sh ṣa/ shiṣa/ ya si drangs am/ shiṣ+yaṃ/ slob ma ste/ shā si tungol gyaṃ/ bstan pa ltar byed pa'o/ ༈ /guhkya p ya/ drangs/ si gu h+yaṃ/ gu hi tuṃ yo gyaṃ/ gsang ba'i tshogs pa'o/ ༈/ bde/ bd la'o/ /ba de'i byings la yang kyap 'jug ste dngos po la sogs pa'i don la'o/ /bd kyap bzhagaya/ sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa/ b u/ mṛṣa sngon du bzhag༈ u dang mtshams sbyar/ drangs/

si/ mṛ ṣo d+yaṃ/ mṛ ṣā ud+ya te/ rdzun smras pa'o/ ༈ /bd kyap/ ud+ya/ song*/ lugs de dang 'dra/ brah+ma gong*/ u dang mtshams sbyar/ si/ brah+mo d+yaṃ/ brah+ma u d+ya te yā ka thā sā/ gang gtam de tshangs pas smras pa'o/ ༈ /bd bzhin du grah la yang ste/ grah kyap/ la sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa/ r ṛ ru song*/ gṛ drangs/ si/ gṛ h+yaḥ/ ardzu na gṛ h+yā se na/ srid sgrub dmag dpon 'dzin zhes te/ mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i don no/ ༈ /s+t+ri yāṃ ya dzāṃ bhā be/ yadz rnams kyi dngos po la bud med do/ /byings yadz la sogs pa rnams la/ bud med kyi rkyen āp lta bu ster ba la/ sngon la dngos po'i don du kyap ster ro/ /kyap ni pit yin pas/ pit la byings kyi sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa skabs 'dir 'jug go ༈ yadz kyap bzhag /ya/ sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa/ i ru song*/ dz drangs idz+ya byung*/ pra gong*/ a i/ e bud med la āp/ 'dra ring*/ si dbyi predz+yā/ ༈pradz/ kyap/ ya/ sam+p+ra med pra gong āp si yal/ pra pradz+yā/ prakar+ṣe ṇa pradz+ya te as+yāṃ/ 'di ni phul du byung bar spangs pa'o// ha n+testaḥ/ ha na ta'o/ /han kyi byings la kyap byung na/ han gyi n yig ta yig tu 'gyur ro/ /han kyap bzhag/n t ru song*/ ya la drangs/ āp ring po/ si yal ha t+yā grub brah+ma sngon/ brah+ma ha t+yā/ brah+ma han+ya ta/ tshangs pa gsod pa'o/ /tshangs pa ni srog can gyi ming ngo*/ /adz 'gro ba dang 'phen pa la'o/ /adz kyap bzhag/ya sam gong*/ āp sam adz ya/ āsi/ gnyis drangs/ 'dra ring*/ si song*/ sa madz+yā grub/ samyak a dz+ya te/ yang dag par 'gro ba'o/ ༈ /k+tiḥ/ k+ti'o/ /byings k+ti rkyen du sbyar ba la yang*/ bud med kyi rkyen 'byung ngo*/ /dper na/ bhūk+ti/ k yal/ a nu gong si rnam bcad/ a nu bhū tiḥ.a nu bha ba naṃ/ rjes su 'byor ba'o/ /'byor ba ni yon tan phan yon te/ blo gros la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /bhūk+ti bhū ti si/ bi gong*/ bi bhū tiḥ/

bi shiṣ+tā bhū ti/ khyad 'phags kyi 'byor ba'o/ /bha ba na bhu tiḥ/ legs pa'i 'byor ba'o/ ༈ /shubha k+ti ti/ ta tha'i dhā'o/ /dh gong ma d/ drangs/ si/ shud+dhiḥ/ sho dha naṃ/ dag pa'o/ ༈ /patsi yangs pa la'o/ /pa tsi k+ti bzhag/ti tsa'i i phyis/ it la num mo/ /pa dang tsa'i bar du num ā ga ma'o/ /ban tsti si byung*/ n nga ro/ tsk drangs/ paṃ k+tiḥ/ grub/ pa tsa na/ gral rings sam yig 'phreng lta bu/ 'phreng sgrigs ring po'i ming ngo*/ ༈ /bah k+ti ti/ ta ḍha dha ḍha ha'i ḍha'o ha ḍha pa saṃ pra u/ ḍha pha rol du mthong bas/ ḍha de yal/ u pa dhā ring*/ si rnam bcad ū ḍhiḥ/ bid k+ti ti d ta drangs sam gong si rnam bcad saṃ bi t+tiḥ/ yang dag par rig pa'o/ ༈ /glai k+ti ti mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ā ste/ glā ti ni ru song*/ /si/ glā niḥ/ m+lai m+lā niḥ/ de dang 'dra/ gnyis po don gcig ma mgu ba'am ma dad pa'o// ī sha shī dorbar k+ti ne ṭa gu na sh+tsa// ī shra dang shī d la pa ra dang k+ti'i iṭ dang yon tan yang ma yin no/ /tshig 'di mdo gzhan gyi lung 'dren no zhes ṭi kā kha cig las so/ ༈ /dmigs gsal byings ī sh rkyen bar dang*/ byings shīng la rkyen k+ti byin/ iṭ rnam pa kun du mi 'byung la/ spyir btang shīng rnam pa kun du yon tan bshad kyang k+ti byin pa'i skabs/ 'dir yon tan yang mi byed do/ ༈ /shīng k+ti ng yal sa m sngon/ si rnam bcad/ saṃ shī tiḥ/ grub/ saṃ sha ya naṃ/ the tshom can no/ ༈ /īsh b.r drangs si/ ī shwa raḥ/ ༈ hrī 'gro ba la'o/ /hrī k+ti ti si/ hrī tiḥ/ ༈ dzā gṛ k+ti rnam 'gyur med/ dzāgṛ tiḥgrub dza ga ra naṃ/ mel tshe ba'o/ ༈ /kartari k+tish+tsaḥ/ byed pa po yang k+ti'o/ /sngar dngos po'i don la k+ti 'jug par ma zad/ byed pa po'i don la yang k+ti 'jug go ༈ ḍu kṛny byed pa la'o/ /kṛ k+ti k yal/ pra gong*/ si rnam bcad/ pra kṛ tiḥgrub/ pra ku ru ta/

dang po'i byed can te rang bzhin no/ ༈ /dhṛny 'dzin pa la'o/ /dhṛ k+ti ti/ bi gong*/ si/ bidhā ra naṃ/ khyad par 'dzin pa ste/ bye brag phyed par blos 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don la/ 'dir bi dhṛtiḥ/ ḍupa tsasha 'tshed pa la'o/ /ik sh+ti pau dhā tu nirde shaḥ ik dang sh+tīp dag byings mi bsgyur ba'o/ ༈ /rkyen ik dang sh+tipra dag byings la byin na byings la rnam 'gyur med ces pa ste/ dbyangs med dbyangs dang sbyar ba ni/ spyir rnam 'gyur du gtogs pa tsam yin du rung yang byings kyi rnam 'gyur min no/ ༈ /btsa ik bzhagak dbyi/ ts i la drangs/ si/ btsiḥ/ ༈ bts sh+tip bzhagap yal sh yig ni shit kyi bya ba'i don no/ /byed pa po la a p pa tsa ྄a ti si drangs rnam bcad/ pa tsa tiḥ/ ṣid+bhi dā md/ bhidra rnams kyi ṣit la ang'o/ /bhid la sogs pa'i byings la ṣi t kyi ming can yin na/ ang rkyen ster ro/ ṣit zhes paṣ yig phyis pa ste/ byings ṣ yig dbyangs med phyis pa'i don yin/ 'og bhi d sogs la bhid rang nyid lta bu ṣi?ta ma yin pa la'ang ang 'jug pa yod mod ṣi ta nges pa'o/ /mo rkyen āp kyang 'jug go ༈ mṛdzūṣ gtsang byed la'o/ ṣ song*/ u brjod don/ mṛdz.a ng ng dbyi drangs/ mṛdza āp 'dra ring si yal/ mṛ dzā/ ༈ bhid ang drangs āp 'dra ring*/ si mi snang bhi dā/ ༈tshid k+ṣid sogs la'ang de dang 'dra/ tshi dā*/ k+ṣi dā*/ dzṛṣ/ dzh-iṣa lang tsho yol ba la'o/ /dzṛṣ ang yon tan ar drangs āp 'dra ring*/ si phyis dza rā/ ji skad du/ dza ra la sogs pa zhes pa 'dir ng rjes 'brel bzhag ste/ a rkyen no/ /zhes 'byung pas/ yang na thog ma nyid nas a rkyen du ster/ ang ces/ ng rjes 'brel mi byed do/ /zhes pa ste/ ang gi ng dbyi ba'i spros pa spangs te/ a rkyang ba ster ba ste gzhan gzugs la khyad med do/ /dzi rdzat+ya na ya/ rgas khogs pa'o/

༈ /li kha a bzhag /drangs yon tan āp ring po/ si bsub/ le khā/ le kha naṃ/ smyug gu'o/ ༈ /gudh+ra.a drangs/ yon tan/ āp ring*/ si mi snang*/ go dhā/ gu dh+ya te/ phu ga can te/ srog chags go ha ru grags pa sbal pa chen po 'bur can no/ ༈ /midh/ a drangs*/ yon tan/ āp si/ medhā/ me dh+ya ta/ rtogs pa pa'o/ ༈ /sudha bsangs gtor la'o/ /su dh a drangs/ yon tan āp/ si/ so dhā/ suṣ+tu dhī ya te/ rab tu bsangs so/ ༈ /shrad+dha a bzhag/drangs/ āp si/ shud+dhā/ 'di dza ra sogs ma yin kyang*/ ng rjes 'brel mi byed par a rkyang pa ste ba ni nges tshig gi sgrub pa'o/ ༈ /gu rorta sā t/ lcid can gyi ha sa las so/ /yi ge lci dang ldan pa ste lci ba'i yi ge yod la lci ba'i yi ge de nyid kyi mtha' ha sa ste gsal byed mtha' yin zhing*/ bud med kyi rkyen 'byung 'gyur yang yin na de'i pha rol du yang ang rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /yi ge lci ba'i ngos 'dzin skabs 'dir dbyangs ring po la byed do/ ༈ /īh rtsed mo rnams la'o/ /īh a d bzhag drangs/ ap/ si ī hā/ ༈ ūh rnam par rtog pa la'o/ /ūh ang āp si/ gong bzhin/ ū hā/ u h+ya ta/ rtog par byed pa'o/ ༈ /īk+ṣa lta ba dang mtshan ma 'debs pa'o/ /īk+ṣa a āpsi/ gong bzhin/ īk+ṣā/ ik+ṣu naṃ/ 'dod par byed pa'o/ ༈ /iṣa 'dod pa la'o/ /u brjod don iṣ.ang ā pgazhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ byings la rnam 'gyur byed pa nges tshig gi sgrub pa ste/ i thung ngu ring por bsgyur/ ṣ tsh ru bsgyur/ tsha gnyis/ gong ma tsa'o/ /īts+tshā/ yang na rnam 'gyur med do/ /iṣā/ ༈ iṣā de rab r+theyus so/ /iṣā sogs la ang gi don du yus'o/ /yang na.iṣā sogs kyi byings la ang ster ba thob thang yod kyang*/ ang mi byed par de'i tshab tu yus ster ro/ ༈ /iṣ yus bzhag/s yal yu a na ru bsgyur/ yon tan i e/ drangs na ṇa/

āp/ ring po/ e ṣa ṇā grub/ e ṣa ṇaṃ/ 'dod pa can no/ ༈ /gran+th yus a na drangs āp si/ gran+tha nā/ gran+tha naṃ/ 'dud pa'o/ /a si yus a na drangs āp si u pa/ sngon 'dra ring*/ u pā sa nā/ u pā sa naṃ/ lha la bsnyen pa'o/ ༈ zhes so/ /bid yus a na yon tan be drangs āp/ si/ bed nā/ be da naṃ/ rig pa pa'o/ ༈ /ghaṭyus a na/ āp/ si/ gha ṭa nā/ gha ṭa naṃ/ rtsed mo rtse ba'o zhes sam/ sa la skungs pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ ༈ /prat+ya yān+tāt/ rkyen mtha' las kyang ngo*/ /byings rkyen mtha' la dngos po'i don du a rkyen 'jug ste/ bud med kyi rkyen 'byung 'gyur la'o/ /tsikīr+ṣa/ a/ bzhag/ṣa'i dbyangs song*/ rkyen a la drangs/ āp si/ tsi kīr+ṣā/ kartu mits+tsha/ byed par 'dod pa'o/ ༈ /pu tī? ya a bzhag/srog a yal/ a la drangs/ āp/ si/ pu tī? yā/ āt+manaḥpu te? ts+tsha/ bdag gi bu 'dod pa'o/ ༈ /a sha na a āp/ si gong bzhin/ a sha nā ya/ a sha nā tu mi ts+tsha/ ༈purba kā le k+t+wā/ sngon gyi dus la k+t+wā'o/ /sngon gyi dus ni 'das pa ste 'dir 'das ma thag pa da ltar gyi bya ba de dang de mnyam pa ste 'brel mar byung ba'i don la k+t+wā rkyen du sbyor ro/ ༈ /ṣ+ṇā gtsang byed la'o/ /ṣ+ṇā k+t+wā bzhag/snā ru bsgyur/ k yal snā twā grub/ snā twā bhuṃ k+te/ khrus byas nas zas bza'o/ /zhes so/ ༈ /bhudzk+t+wā/ k yal/ dzg/ gk/ bhuk+t+wā grub/ bhuk+t+wāb dza ti/ zos nas 'gro'o/ /k+t+wā nus pa'i byas nas zhes pa lta bu/ nas zhes mtshams sbyor byed kyi tshig 'byung ngo*/ ༈ /k+t+wā seṭ kid+bā/ k+t+wā iṭ bcas kyi ki t yang na'o/ /kit dit kyi ming can la yon tan bkag pas/ k+t+wā gyi k dbyi bas/ don la ki t kho na yin yang*/ cho ga mi 'dra ba byed dgos/ kit kyi ming 'dogs pa dang mi 'dogs pa'i gnas skabs gnyis byed de/ de yang bar du rkyen i ṭa yod na gdam kha yin gyi/ med na kit ming can kho na yin pas yon tan med pa kho na'o/

/de yang k+t+wā gyi 'jug yul byings bṛng la sogs la dbyi ba 'di byung gi kun la min zer ro/ ༈ /bṛ tu 'jug pa rgyas pa'o/ /u rjes 'brel/ bṛtk+t+wā bzhag/k yal iṭ bṛ yon tan/ b ar tra/ itwā āp/ si/ rim pas mtshams sbyar/ brti twā grub/ kit min iṭ bcas kyi lugs so/ ༈ /bṛ yon tan ma byas na yang gzhan 'dra/ bṛ ti twā grub/ ki t iṭ bcas so/ ༈ /bṛt k+t+wā bzhag/k song t twā la drangs/ āp si bṛ twā/ 'phel ba'o/ ༈ /bid k+t+wā iṭ āp/ si bi di twā/ ki t iṭ bcas so/ /yon tan/ bi be/ be di twā/ kit min iṭ bcas so/ ༈ /iṭ spangs d t bit+t+wā/ iṭ med do/ ༈ /bd gsal po brjod pa la'o/ /bd k+t+wā bzhag/kit kyi ming can lugs byed na/ sam+p+ra sa raṃ ṇa byed/ kit min la mi byed de/ de yang iṭ bzhag/ba u/ d drangs/ āp si/ u di twā/ ༈ kit min la ba di twā/ ༈a laṃ kha lwoḥp ti ṣe dhek+t+wā/ a laṃ dang kha lu dag dgag pa la k+t+wā'o/ /mi zad pa'i rtags a laṃ dang kha lu gang rung sngon du sbyar zhing*/ de yang sngar byung gi rgyun dgag pa'i don du sbyor na/ byings la k+t+wā'i rkyen sbyor ro/ /bhu dz+rī byings la gong du a laṃ bzhag/k+t+wā byin nas/ gong bzhin/ bhuk+t+wā du bsgyur ba sogs bya/ /a lam+bhuk+t+wā/ zas kyi 'grangs zin nas mi bza' 'o zhes pa'o/ ༈ kha lu gong du 'bri/ badz+ra k+t+wā bzhag/ba u lu dang 'dra ring*/ dz g g k drangs/ si/ ṣa lū k+t+wā/ smra 'phro chod cig pa'o/ ༈ /u di taḥk+t+wā beṭ/ ut it la k+t+wā ste iṭ yang na'o/ /ut te u yig iṭte phyis pa'i byings la yang rkyen k+t+wā 'jug la/ k+t+wā byung ba la bar du iṭ ni gang mnga'o/ ༈ /iṣu 'dod pa la'o/ /u yal/ de ka la*/ ut.it zer/ i ṣ k+t+wā bzhag/k yal/ ta ṭa/ iṣ+tā/ ༈ yang na iṭ te/ iṣk+t+wā/ bar du iṭ/ i yon tan eṣ itwā byung*/

e ṣi twā/ 'dod pa nyid do/ /'dod pa'i phyir zhes so/ ༈ /bsu nges par gnas pa la'o/ /u brjod don/ bas ྄k+t+wā bzhaga.iṭ/ ba/ sam+p+ra sa ra ṇa/ u/ sṣa uṣ itwā/ drangs/ u ṣitwā/ ༈ yang na iṭ med/ bs k+t+wā/ ba u*/ s ṣa/ ta ṭa/ drangs/ uṣ+t+wa/ ṭs mā sekyap/ bsdu ba la kya p'o/ /tshig sdud la yod cing sngon gyi dus sten pa la kyap rkyen du 'gyur ro/ / de yang byed pa'i don can gyi byings la sbyor ba ste/ bhṛny ny song bhṛ kyap bzhagathung ngu'i pit byed pa la tuk'o/ /u dang k phyis/ t lus/ bhṛt ya/ saṃ gong*/ saṃ bhṛ t+yaṃ/ si am/ saṃbhṛ t+yaṃ/ yang dag par 'dzin pa'o/ /saṃ bhṛ t+ya kaṃ ka ro ti/ yang dag par 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /ṇm rab tu 'dud pa la'o/ /ṇa m kyap bzhag/ṇa yi na'o/ /ṇa nam rkyen gyi ya la drangs/ pra ṇa mya grub/ prakar+ṣe ṇa na twā/ phul du byung ba'am/ dga' bas phyag 'tshal zhes so/ ༈ /natwā zhes pa ni nam k+t+wā k dang m yal bas/ na twā zhes pa'o/ /pra ṇa mya gats+tsha ti/ phyag btsal nas song ngo*/ ༈ /'grel par a nany sngon du'o/ /zhes kha cig go zhes byings k+t+wā can la dgag pa'i an ny sngon du 'byung ngo*/ /a dzi twā shā t bāt+sa rba rbā na a kṛ twā bi ma laṃ ya shaḥ/ a da t+t+wa bit+ta mar+thidh+yaḥ/ ka thaṃ dzī ban+ti bhū bh-i?taḥ/ dgra rnams kun las ma pham pa'i/ dri med grags ldan mi byed la/ /sbyin pa min dang nor zad las/ sa 'dzin 'tsho ba'i gtam yang med/ /a dzi twā/ a kṛ twā/ a dat+t+wa zhes pa dper brjod do/ ༈ /dzik+t+wā dgag pa'i a sngon/ a dzi twa ma rgyal nas zhes bya'o/ ༈ /'on kyang rang las pha rol po rgyal bar byed mi thub pa la'ang*/ a dzi ta zer ba'ang yod do/ ༈ /yang*/ dā k+t+wā dgag pa'i a sngon/ dā zhes pa dat zhes bsgyur/ a da t+t+wā ma byin pas zhes pa'o/ ༈ /kṛk+t+wā dgag pa'i a sngon/ a kṛ twā/ mi byed pa nas zhes pa'o/ ༈ /yang ji skad du/ kyap kyi nyi la yon tan yang ste/

thung ngu sngon gyi'o/ /zhes bshad pas/ byings thung ngu can dang por yod la kyap pha rol du yod pa bar rkyen nyi zhugs na/ nyi rang la yon tan 'byung zhes pa ste/ nyi'i i la yon tan no/ ༈ /ṇam kya p bzhag/ṇa na ya nyi bar du byung*/ ny song*/ i pa ri sngon/ ṣa ra ṛ sogs na ṇa ru log/pa ri ṇam i ya byung*/ i yon tan e/ 'dir ya dbyangs dang 'dra bas/ e ay y a la drangs/ pa ri ṇa may+yo bhuk+te/ yongs su 'dud nas zas za zhes pa'o/ ༈ /ji skad du/ de dus la yang kyap rab tu mthong ngo*/ /zhes 'byung bas/ mī la 'byed 'dzum la'o/ /mīl kyap/ ya drangs/ mīl+ya grub/ tsak+ṣu ṇī sam+mīl+ya ha sa ti/ mig dag rab tu btsum nas rgod do/ /mī la/ mig 'dzum mo/ ༈/ dā kyap bzhag ya bi āng sngon/ iy ru/ byā dā ya/ gdangs pa'o/ /mu khaṃ byā dā ya swa pi ti/ kha gdangs nas nyal lo/ / kyap dang*/ k+t+wā 'di dag dus can gyi dngos po dang byed pa gnyis mtshams sbyor bar ston pa las/ phyag btsal nas zas za zhes pa lta bu dus snga phyi can yin pas/ za ba'i dus na phyag 'tshal ba 'das pas nas zhes sngon dus kyi don yin/ kha gdangs nas nyal zhes pa thog mar kha gdangs nas phyis nyal bas don ma yin/ kha gdangs bzhin du nyal ba ste/ de dus kyi don no/ /'dir kyap de dus dngos su bshad pas/ k+t+wā la yang ngo*/ /thung ngu ma yin pa dang po'i nyi dbyi bar 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pas/ gong du thung ngu'i nyi la yon tan byed/ 'dir ring po'i pha rol kyi nyi dbyi bar bstan to/ /ts+ṝkyap bzhag /nyi sbyin ts+ṝ i ya byung*/ 'di byings ring po'o/ /'phel ba ste ār/ ār drangs ya gnyis/ bi sngon bi tsār+y+ya ka ro ti/ spyang por gyis shig pa'am/ rnam par dpyod pa po'o/ /ṣ+ṭhā kyap s+thā ya u pa sngon/ u pa s+thā ya grub/ u pa sa mī pe s+thi twā/ nye bar 'khris su 'dug cigas+thā rnams kyi kyap'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ s+thā i mi byed de/

s+thi ru mi 'gyur ro/ ༈ /māng gus pa la'o/ /ng song mā kyp ya pra sngon/ pra mā ya/ gus par bsten pa'o/ ༈ /pi ba terbā/ 'thung ba la yang na'o/ /pā 'āthung ba la'o/ pākyap ya psngon/ pra pā ya/ īṭ ster na/ pā kyap ya īṭ pra sngon/ pra pā ī ya byung*/ pā gyis ā phyis/ ī la drangs/ pra pī ya/ mang du 'thungs nas so/ ༈ /a nu dat+ta rnams dbyi ba nyid do/ /zhes 'byung bas/ rkyen kyap byung na byings mtha'i nya dng m yang na dbyi ba nyid do/ /ṇam kyap ya pra gong*/ m ya la drangs/ pra ṇa mya/ ༈ yang*/ ṇa ma'i m dbyi ste/ ṇam kyap ya m dbyi rkyen du k byin/ t/ pra gong t yal drangs/ pra ṇa t+ya/ de gnyis don gcig ste/ pra kar+ṣe ṇa na twā/ ches cher 'dud pa'o/ /'di dag la thog mar byings kyi dang po ṇa na dang rjes su ṣa ra ṛ las slar ṇa nyid du shes dgos so/ ༈ /gaml̥̄ 'gro ba la'o/ /gam kyap ya/ āng sngon/ drangs ā ga mya/ ༈ yang na gam kyap ya/ m dbyi/ tu k ā ng sngon/ ā ga t ya byung*/ drangs/ ā ga t+ya/ ā sa man+tā t+gā me/ kun du kun nas 'gro ba'am/ dal bur shog cig pa'o/ /ā dar+sha na bha be yang zer te dal bus shog cig go ༈ paunaḥpun+ye ṇa ma pa daṃ dwi sh+tsa/ yang yang la ṇam ste tshig gnyis kyang ngo*/ /ches che ba dang shin du chung ba lta bu'am/ bzang ngan dang gsal mi gsal la sogs pa shin du ba'i don ma yin par bar ma mnyam par gnas pa'i don dang*/ 'das dus kyi dbang du byas nas yang yang bskyar ba'i don la rkyen ṇam 'jug cing*/ byings dang rkyen 'brel ba'i tshig tu gyur de nyid tshar gnyis su 'gyur ro/ ༈ /pā btung ba la'o/ /pā ṇam bzhag/ṇa 'phel don/ a bzhagabar du yu k byin/ k dang u dbyi/ py am drangs/ m nga ro/ de ltar tshig tu grub par 'dod pas/ tshig de tshar gnyis su 'gyur/ mjug tu gats+tsha ti sbyar/ pā yaṃ pā yaṃ gats+tsha ti/ mdo 'dis don de ltar sgrub/

de'i don rgya skad la go bde ba ni/ pā k+t+wā bzhagak song*/ pā pī ru bsgyur/ gnyis pī twā pī twā gats+tsha ti/ / 'thungs shing 'thungs nas song ngo*/ phal cher grags so/ /ge ṇam/ am ai āy drangs/ m nga ro/ /gnyis/ gāyaṃgā yaṃ gats+tsha ti/ smras shing smras nas 'gro'o/ /glu len bzhin len bzhin 'gro'o/ ༈ /bhudz ṇam am 'phel ba thob kyang yon tan/ m nga ro/ /gnyis/ bho dzaṃ bho dzaṃ bradza te/ zos shing yang zos nas 'gro'o/ /bho dzaṃ rgya skad du/ cung zad go dka'/ bhu k+taṃ bhu k+taṃ/ go bla'o/ /de ni mdo 'dis ma yin sngar sgrubs so/ ༈ /bhudz k+t+wā/ dz g/ g k/ drangs pas 'byung ngo*/ /ka tha mā di ṣu swār+theṇam kṛ nyaḥ/ ka thaṃ la sogs pa rnams la rang don du ṇam kṛ ny la'o/ /dang por ka thaṃ la sogs pa'i tshig yod/ byings kṛny la yang rkyen ṇam ster ro/ ༈ /kṛny ny song*/ ka thaṃ gong*/ ṇam bzhag /ṇ song kṛ 'phel ba/ ka thaṃk ār am byung*/ drangs nga ro/ ka thaṅkā raḥ/ gang ltar byed/ ༈ ka thaṃ gi dod du/ -it+thaṃ it+thaṅkā raḥ/ 'di ltar byed ces so/ ༈ /bhu bo bhu be kyap/ bhu dngos po la kyap'o/ /bhū'i byings dngos po kho na'i don du sgrub pa la yang kyap rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /bhū kyap ya brah+ma gong si am ya'i a song*/ drangs ga taḥ/ mjug tu sbyar/ brah+ma bhu yaṃ ga taḥ/ srog can du 'gyur ba'i 'gro'o/ /yang na tshangs par song nas 'gro'o/ /zhes bram ze sgrubs pa la yang 'jug go / ༈ lak+ṣe rī muṭ tsa/ mtshan nyid la ī ste muṭ kyang ngo*/ /mtshan nyid te la k+ṣi'i byings la rkyen ī ster bar du muṭ ā ga ma'o/ /lak+ṣa ī bzhag/bar du muṭ ā ga ma/ ṭ dang u yal/ lak+ṣam ī/ m.ī la drangs/ k+ṣa ma la drangs/ si rnam bcad/ lak+ṣ+mīḥ/ mtshan nyid don du ma dang ldan pa'i 'byor pa ste dpal zhes bya/ ī ni īp kyi don du byed na dpal mo'o/ ༈ /s+t+ya ya teḥs+t+rītwe ḍa ṭ/

s+t+yai la ḍṭ bud med nyid la'o/ /byings s+t+yai sogs la bud med kyi don du sgrub na/ ḍṭ ces pa rkyen du byed do/ /s+t+yaiṣain+ya sgra dang mnyam par 'dres pa la'o/ /byings s+t+yai rang dag*/ byings ṣain+ya yang ṣa'i sa'o/ /ṭ yang ta ru bsgyur bas s+t+yai ru 'gro bas/ /'dir sgrub tshul dang gzugs don la khyad med do/ ༈ /s+t+yaiḍ ṭ bzhag /ṭ song ḍ phyis/ ḍit la ṭi dbyi bas/ ai yal/ gsal byed tha ma y yang song*/ sta lus/ de ra la drangs/ s+t+ra mo rkyen īp/ p song*/ /s+t+ra'i dbyangs a yal/ /ī la drangs/ s+t+rī/ grub bo/ /s+t+ya ya ti/ /sgra ldan nam bde bar tshogs pa can te/ /bud med do/ /bar+ṇa t+kā raḥ/ /yi ge las kā ra'o/ /yi ge so so'i mtha' las pha rol du rkyen kā ra byin na/ /de dang de'i rang bzhin gyi yi ge zhes so/ /'di la rnam 'gyur med yi ge nyid la rkyen sbyar ba tsam gyis 'grub bo/ /kā ra shes pa'i mthar si sogs rnam dbye ni sbyor dgos so/ /ka yig la rkyen kā ra bzhagasi rnam bcad/ /ka kā raḥ /de bzhin du/ ṭa kā raḥtsa kā raḥ/ ta ka ra/ pa kā raḥ /ya kā raḥ /sha kā raḥ/ /ā ka raḥl sogs pa'o/ /rā di pho bā/ /ra las i pha yang na'o/ /ra yig ming du byed pa la ni rkyen i pha dang kā ra yang na ba'o/ /ra i pha bzhag /a i la e/ re phaḥ/ yang na ra kā raḥ /'dir kā ra zhes pa rkyen yin/ /yi ge re re ba byings ma yin kyang byings kyi dod thub byas/ byings las rkyen gyis ming du grub pa yin/ /yang a bar+ṇa zhes pa lta bu/ /bar+ṇa ni rkyen ma yin ming du grub zin yin mod/ /yi ge re re dang sbyar na/ /de kho nas ming du 'grub/ /des na kā ra dang bar+ṇa gnyis ka bod skad du yi ge'i don la 'jug par 'dra yang*/ /kā ra ni dbyangs gsal thams cad la shas che chung med par 'jug/bar+ṇa gtso bor dbyangs la brjod dgos pa mang ngo/ /skabs 'gar dbyangs kyi skabs su rkyang pa la kā ra dang 'dra mtshungs sogs rigs mthun la bar+ṇa 'jug pa'ang yod do/

/lo kā ts+tshe ṣa s+ya sid+dhi/ /lhag ma 'jig rten las grub ba'o/ /zhes pa ni thog mar bshad pa bzhin te brda sprod kyi cho ga nye bar mkho ba thams cad bshad zin mod/ /'dir ma bshad pa'i lhag ma gang*/ /'jig rten bstan bcos gnyis ka la thun mong du grags pa dang*/ /bstan bcos nyid la grags pa rnams ni/ /de dang de las rtogs par bya'o/ /'grel ba'i 'jug (mjug )na/ /swa rupā n+to ྅nu bhū t+ya diḥshab+do3bhū d+ya tra sār+tha kaḥs ma ska rī shubhāṃ tsakri prakriyāṃ tsa tu ro tsi tāṃ/ bod skad du/ thog mar rjes 'byor mthar ni rang bzhin bzang*/ /don bcas sgra la 'dir ni 'jug byas te/ /mnyam par sbyod ldan dge bar byed pa yis/ /rab tu bya ba gsal ldan rnams la bshad/ /tshig rkang dang po 'grel mdzad nyid kyi ming ston pa'o/ /don dang bcas pa ni skye bo mang po la phan par 'gyur ba'o/ /sgra la 'jug byas zhes 'das pa'i tshig ni bstan bcos brtsams zin pa'o/ /mnyam par spyod pa ni gcig la chags pa med pa dang*/ /gcig shos la sdang ba med pa ste/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi chags sdang mngon du rgyu ba bsdams pa'o/ /dge bar byed pa ni tshangs par spyod pa bstan pa'o/ /rab tu bya ba ni sgra'i sgrub tshul cho ga ste/ /gsal ba dang ldan pa ni blo gsal ba rig pa shes su rung ba rnams so/ /tshigs bcad 'di slob mas sbyar bar 'dod pa'ang yod do/ /a ba tāt+po ha ya grī baḥ /ka ma lā ka ra ī shwa raḥ /su rā su ra na rā kā ra/ /madhu pā pī ta paṅka dzaḥ bdag la srung bar mdzod cig rta mgrin kye/ /pad+ma'i phyag can dbang gis mnga' bsgyur ba/ /lha dang lha min mi la phan pa ni/ /sbrang rtsi 'thung bas chu skyes la 'thung bzhin/ /zhes pa ni/ /a shwe pa da ste bkra shis pa'i tshig go /ha ya grī ba ni/ /mu stegs can dag lha 'jug sel gyi khyad par ro zer ba ni rang gi 'dod pa tsam ste/ /lha de'i ming stong gi bstod pa'i nang na yang*/

ha ya grī ba med do/ /des na nang pa rnams bcom ldan 'das khro rgyal rta mgrin la bzhed pa nyid don la gnas so/ /lha de'i khyad chos ni/ phyag na pad+ma 'dzin pa dang*/ dbang thang che ba dang*/ bung ba la pad+mas nyer 'tsho mdzad pa ltar/ 'gro ba thams cad la phan par mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar na brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo dang de'i 'grel pa slo dpon anu bhu ta swa ru pa ste/ rjes su 'byor pa kun nas rang bzhin bzang po zhes bya bas mdzad pa'i don nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs pa'i tshul du bshad zin to// //gzhung 'di la yang si sogs kyi mtha' gcod/ tip sogs kyi mtha' gcod dang*/ mi zad pa'i sde rgyas pa dang*/ de'i yan lag nyer sgyur gyi 'grel pa dang*/ de phan gyi zur bkol dang*/ ming sgrub kyi zur bkol dang*/ de'i yan lag uṇ la sogs pa dang*/ yi ge ming tshig rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ sdeb sbyor nyer bsdus te cha lag dgu yod par grags la/ byings kyi tshogs pa ni med du mi rung ba'i gzhung yin mod/ drang srong pā ni nis mdzad pa kho na las gzhan du med do/ /da lta ka lā pa'i byings mdo zhes sogs so sor yod pa ltar byed kyang go rim phran tshegs brjes pa yod srid gzhan sgra mdo so so la byings mdo so so mi 'tshal la/ spyir pā ṇi bas mdzad pa'i byings kyi tshogs pa che chung gnyis yod zer/ chung ba sh+lo ka lnga brgya pa 'di grags che'o/ /'di la'ang 'grel chen yod/ gzhung du sgrub tshul spyi 'doms su bshad pa de/ byings 'grel du byings thams cad la sgrub tshul so so'i dper brjod re re sbyar bar snang ngo*/ /cha lag rnams 'di'i dgos gzhung ma snyed na gzhan nas kha bskang bas rung*/ 'di'i cha lag rnams kyang byed pa po rnams phyis rim pas byung ba yin gyi/ slob dpon chen po a nu bhu ti nyid kyis sbyar ba ma yin no/ da ni 'di lta ste/ mig dmar gyi lo la/ gzhung 'grel 'di'i bud med kyi rtags sgrub yan chad bsgyur ba'i skabs/

paṇ+ḍi ta kṛṣ+ṇa pas bdag la shis brjod pa ni/ ād+ya ba ta ra baud+dha sh+tsa/ sṛṣ+ti karta swa yaṃ bud+dhaḥ rak+ṣe ts+tsa bha ba taṃ de ha/ bau d+bhāde ga ṇa de pa tāḥ de ba naṃ bhai ra po de po/ sarba byā dhi bi nā sha naḥ tri shrā lī tsa ma hā krān+taḥ sa mi tre ṇa pā yāt+sa baḥ zhes so/ bod skad du/ gdod ma nas 'jug sangs rgyas pa/ /rang byung blo gros spro ba'o/ /sangs rgyas la sogs lha tshogs kyis/ khyod kyis lus la srung bar mdzod/ /'jigs byed lha rnams kun gyi lha/ /gnod pa thams cad rnam par 'joms/ /rtse gsum 'dzin pa 'bar ba che/ /des khyed bshes dang bcas su srungs shig/ces pa'o/ /bod+dha shra zhes pa'i si byung ba dang*/ krā n+ta 'od 'bar ba'o/ /sa zhes des dang*/ bzhes khyod do/ /tshigs bcad dang po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ gnyis pa dpal mgon po'i sgo nas shis pa brjod pa'o/ /deng skyes bdag gi lo la/ byed can man chad byed can nas brtsams te yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur zin pa na/ paṇ+ḍi ta ba la bha dras shis pa brjod pa ni/ yau tau shaṃ kha ka pā la bhū ṣi ta ka rau mā la s+thi mā lā dha rau/ de bau drwā ra ba tī sh+ma shā na ni la yau nā gā ri go ba ha nau/ dwi t+ya k+ṣau ba li dak+ṣa ya dz+nya ma tha nau shrī shai la dza ba l+la bhau/ pā ba m+bo sa dā ha ra tāṃ ha ri ha rau shrī bat+sa gaṃ ga dha rau/ de bod skad du brjod na/ gang dang dung dang thod pas brgyan pa'i phyag ldan de dag phreng ba ru phreng 'dzin pa dag/sgo ldan dang ni dur khrod gnas bzhugs kyi lha dag klu yi gshed dang ba lang chibs pa dag/gnyis dang gsum mig stobs ldan myur ba'i mchod sbyin 'joms byed dpa' mo ri skyes la dga' ba/ khyod kyi sdig pa rtag par 'phrog 'gyur 'phrog byed 'phrog po dag ni dpal be'u gaṅga 'dzin/ zhes nor lha'i sras dang*/ lha chen po drag po dag gi sgo nas bkra shis par brjod pa'o/ /ni la yau zhes pa khang pa dag gam bzhugs sa dag la go

/pā paṃ po zhes pa'i po ni khyod la'o/ /dak+ṣa ni skye dgu'i bdag po myur ba'o/ /gzhan rnams skad 'dod sbyor tshul go sla'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas ni/ srid zhi kun na dpal dang g.yang dang bkra shis pa mtha' dag gi mthar thug pa dang*/ gtso bo dang*/ rab dang mchog gi nom pa/ dpe zla bral ba'i dge legs dang*/ ye shes mgon po yang*/ de nyid kyi rnam 'phrul dang*/ bstan pa skyong ba po thams cad kyi gtso bor phul du byung ba yin pa'i dge legs dang*/ khyab 'jug zhi ba gnyis po 'di dag kyang*/ lha klu mi dang 'byung po'i yul na cher cher grags pa 'phrul dang gzi brjid dpag par dka' ba nyid kyis bkra shis dam pa 'dis srid pa thams cad du bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /phan par bzhed pa gang gi blo mtsho las/ /legs par bshad pa'i dbyar skyes bye ba bskrun/ srid 'dir ma rig gdung bas ngal ba la/ rig pa bdud brtsi'i chu rgyun ci yang babs/ /dbyangs can gsung gi 'od dkar 'bum phrag dag /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir lan brgyar shar ba yi/ /rab tu dkar ba'i 'du byed rab dga'i des/ /bde ba bla med mkha' dang mnyam par shog /ces pa 'phags ma dbyangs can gyis gsungs pa'i sgra mdo 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bshad sbyar mchog tu gsal ba zhes pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'am ming gzhan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ kun mkhyen chen po dol po mtshan brjod par dka' ba shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i dus mchod chen mo'i nyin par sbyar ba'o/ /shu bha mā stu// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo 'grel mchog tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 640 -- PAGE 641 -
